pod 7sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang /dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang‘‘gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i 1

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos’’zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bstsal/gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'then dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung / nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing / dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dugade phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng /1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsang rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshal du〈khra dge slong tshal rib bye riri bye riri byi2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 7khrims dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga gzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtso ma 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung thengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub 3

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ston la brtsi srang sgos/ mi rigs phul byang rig gnas dar spel spyorazur༄shi yig 05 ra zerachagadang / ma rags mthun sgral dang rag gnas brja ras la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gcigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smros ma dgos/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 7dngul gyi mthan rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshal 'og〈dpe tshogs〉nod mi rigasir+shade jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe / nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing / mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog dang / phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du‘‘mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min’’ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi 5

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshogs la thugs gzhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang / legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min rig gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 7rjes sa yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i ༄rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gtsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang‘‘mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste’’sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas tebu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 7

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gyar mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srang skyob byas raring rig mi'adug da lta bsam na 'di ni goms srol legs po tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/ de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo log 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo khams rig gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig gnas kun la sa cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang /sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la/ tha na 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 7bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang gses phyogs rer mtshon na de phyogs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/gang ltar da lta nga tshos〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing / krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bsnyon du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing / dus mtshungs su〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor 9

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu//zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris/10

pod 7rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa rgis li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyar bsod nams mtsho //khye/ //re/niri me//bye //de/ //ji/gnyis — sras su bod rab byung bcu ba ba sna shing mo 5nga lor(d+ngha lo1865)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 11

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhan phan 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag pa mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so//rdza stod du phebs nas 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas/lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lo brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'jug gi bka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob ba mang du bsdus tshe/༄nye gnas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong sku na chung drags pas re zhig 'khor de lta bu la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad par brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo zhing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal sprul rin po 2

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 7che'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byis pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzogs sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla gter chen/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thig gong 'og sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ mdo smad rdi tsha dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig chas gtso byas ri bo dge ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med par thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher rgyas/13

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rab tshes lcags 'brug spyi lo1880lor mgo log pad ma 'bum dpon shog brgyad kyis ched du phul ba'i bzhugs gnas rdo yul khri zhes bya bar dgon gnas gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes bya ba gsar du bzhengs pa/ phyis ming zur shugs kyis 'gyur te gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling du grags/de tsam nas dgon pa de'i g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong mar thang stong rgyal po'i lha khang du grags pa'i dben khrod cig tu sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas/ tshal khrims kyi dri bsang zhim pos khor rigang raring yug dus kun 'gengs la/ lhag pa'i lha la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bgro gleng byed cing / ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus nas glegs bam skyel 'bul byed pa/ nyin lam du ma'i sar rab gnas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang brdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhug sa kho nar dgyes pas don gyi gsang ba sus kyang dpogs par dka'/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs su bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ bod kyi mkhas grub ris med kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi phrin las kyang rgya cher spel/mthar rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad pa me stag gi lor(1929)14

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 7gzags sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings sa bsdus so//ri rizu ri ringalung gis zin pa'i thugs sras mgar ba mkhan po 'jigs med 'od zer dang / ser shul mkhan po/ klu shul mkhan po/ mkhan po dam chos bcas mkhan chen bzhis gtso'i rnyiḥphi dug tsha sogs yul gru kun nas slob ma mang du 'dus kyang / 'khor slob rgya cher bsdu ba sogs thun mong gi mnga' thang dang gzi byin gyi spros pa rtag tu bskyungs te bzhugs/gsung rtsom la〈rgyud ma hā yo ga'i tan+d+ra gsang ba'i snying bo de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa la zur lugs ltar gyi dgongs 'grel spyi don rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig〉dang / 〈mdo las byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs kyi rgyan rnam par bshad pa rgyal yum lus bzang mdzes byed legs bshad phreng ba〉sogs mdo sngags gzhung 'grel gyi skor dang / sgrub thabs skyed rdzogs kyi skor/ lo rgyus gtam tshogs kyi skor/ gsung mgur snyan ngag gi skor/ zhal gdams man ngag gi skor sogs gang la'ang thun mong min pa'i khyad chos rtsal du thon pa'i gsung chos pod chen bcu phrag lhag cig bzhugs pa las/gong smras〈gsang snying spyi don〉dang / 〈gzungs kyi rnam bshad〉〈gter gyi rnam bshad〉sogs la shes nas smra ba'i mkhas pa du mas bstod bsngags kyi me tog mang du 'thor/ gzungs kyi skor la rnam 15

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad 'di nyid kho na las gzhung logs su brtsams pa zhig bod na med par grags pas/ 〈gzungs rnam〉'di'i dpe zhig a mdo dge bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi phyag brgyud nas kun gzigs bcu gsum pa chen po'i spyan sngar phul bas dgyes gzigs dang bsngags brjod yang yang gnang bar gsung la/ rdo grub khong rang nas kyang〈gsang snying〉dang〈gzungs rnam〉gnyis ka snying dmar rjen du bstan pa yin ces lan du mar gsung bar grags/ 〈gzungs rnam〉dang〈gter rnam〉gnyis dbyin ji sogs kyi yi ger bsgyur yod pa'ang nye lam thos so/ /gzhan yang khong gi gsung chos gang la'ang rtsom nyams dang rtsom stangs kyi cha nas thun mong la rjes bzlos su ma song ba'i khyad chos shig yod la/ snyan rtsom la'ang 'gyur bag dang ro nyams gzhan dang gzhan la yong dka' ba'i cha bklags pa tsam gyis lhag ger myong thub pa zhig yod pas/gsung mgur dang / gtam tshogs khrod kyi sgrung thung dag la rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur dang rin thang ngo mtshar ba zhig yod par sngon dang da lta'i ngag rig smra ba kun zhal gcig tu gleng ngo / /zhes pa'ang lnga rig smra ba bde legs rab rgyas sa 'bod pas ༄khul gna' rtsom gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor zla tshes dge bar 'phral mar sbyar ba'o// //16

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i gtam/ (1)rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ (11)rten snying skor (1)bstan pa'i byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ (120)brjed tho sna tshogs/ (131)skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ (195)gtam tshogs/ (208)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ (1)

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/spro/ /rten snying 'grel ba/ye dharmā'i zin bris n+ya gro dha'i sa bon/ na ma shākya mu ne ye/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis rnam bsgyings shing / /'khor gyi nang na bsnyeng dang bral/rten 'byang seng ge'i sgra sgrog pa/ /skyes bu'i khya mchog de la 'dud/ /rten byebye/ 1(snahāre :'erdo :de :de raX () rtsa'i:tre'abrel (nga sku —gas bcad 'a 'phags pa rta thul —sa shā ra ri bu la bshad pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkar yongs su grags/ de kho nar yang ma nges te/ ston pa ri rab kyi rtse mor bzhugs dus mchod rten byed par 'dod pa'i lha mang po'i don du 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis zhus nas gsungs pa gzungs chen sde lnga'i ya gyal du bzhugs shing / spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang las kyang gsungs/ bya ba'i rgyud dpung bzang du yang / gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa yi phyogs su ni/ /'jim pa'am ni bye ma las byas pa'i/ /bde gshegs mchod rten rten 'brel snying po can/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir ni rtag tu gdab/ /ces gsungs shing / de'i 'grel bar rten 'brel snying bo ni rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs par bshad/ dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od las kyang / lha thams cad la phyag rgyas 'debs pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong la phyag rgyas 'debs pa ni ye dharmā'o/ /zhes 2

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7sgosnyozhe— sde gsungs la/ grub chen nag po spyod pas/ dpyid thig tu yang drangs pa sogs bla med kyi chos skor nas kyang mang du bshad do/ /shā ri'i bus tshigs bcad 'di lan gcig thos pa kho nas don khong du chud pa dang /tshigs bcad gcig po 'dis don mang bo la zhugs pa dang / shin tu phra ba'i don rnyed pa dang / 'di thos pa'i mod la zag pa med pa'i shes rab skyes pa dang / 'di kho na las brtsams te yun ring bor dris lan byas kyang zad mi shes pas na go rim bzhin du/ shes rab myur ba/ shes rab mgyogs pa/ shes rab rno ba nges par 'byung ba'i shes rab can/shes rab yangs pa zhes mdo sde las bshad par rnam bshad rig pa nas gsungs/ 'di bod skad du bsgyur ba'i 'gyur la mi 'dra ba bcu skor tsam 'byung yang bzang shos/ /chos gang rgyus byung de dag dang / /rgyu dang de 'gog gang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bagho te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /zhes dpung bzang gi 'grel ba na snang ba 'dul ba lung gi shā ri'i bu'i thad na/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung ba dang / /de yi rgyu dang de 'gog gang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bka' ba.a+yo te/ /de skad gsungs pa'i tshul can dge sbyong che/ /zhes 'byung ba dang shin tu mthun no/ /chos gang rgyus byung /zhes yar bcad/ de dag ces mar bcad pa'i dbang du btang na/ /chos gang rgyus byung de dag gi/ /rgyu dang zhes pa'ang go bde'o/ /mdo 'di'i 3

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/don ji bzhin shes pa ni rten 'brel mdo 'grel dang / sa lu ljang ba rtsa 'grel/ dbu ma rigs tshogs sogs zhib tu blta ba la rag las kyang /'dir tshig 'bru gnon tshul rkyang ba tsam brjod na/ chos gang zhes pa rgyus byung dang / 'og gi rgyu dang zhes pa gnyis char la sbyor te/ rgyus byung gi chos gang dang / rgyur gyar pa'i chos gang zhes pa'o/ /rgyus byang zhes pa zurag zurang dzerang thudag ra mi zurang zing spu(1 ri'i 155na sbyar 'du byad ma rag pa' rgyus byung ba sags da kyang skabs 'dar de la mi bya'i/ rnam shes/ ming gzugs/ skye mched/ reg pa/tshor ba/ skye ba/rga shi ste sdug bsngal gyi lam bdun/ rgyu dang zhes pa ma rig pa dang sred len gnyis te nyon mongs gsum/ 'du byed dang srid pa ste las kyi lam gnyis dang lnga'o/ /de rnams la chos gang zhes gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/dbu ma rten 'brel snying por/ 'gro kun rgyu dang 'bras bu ste/ /'di la sems can gang yang med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sems can 'khor bar 'khor zhes pa rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos 'di rnams 'khor lo bzhin du 'byung ba la brten nas btags par zad kyi/ 'khor ba po'i gang zag gi bdag ni cung zad kyang med do zhes bstan pa'i ched yin no/ /chos gang rgyus sbyang zhes sbyar bas rnam shes la sogs pa'i chos 'di dag ni rang gi rgyu las nyon gyi gzhan dbang kho nas byung gi/ rang dbang gtan nas med do zhes phra ba'i sdug bsngal bstan/ rgyus byung tshul ni snga ma las/ /kha ton me long mar me rgya/ /me shel sa bon skyur dang sgras/ /phung 4

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7trad+kuzhebo nying 'tshams sbyor ba yod/ /ma 'pho bar yang mkhas rtogs bya/ /zhes dpe brgyad gsungs pa ltar rgyu med par de dag mi 'byung la/ rgyu nyid de dag/ tu 'pho ba'ang ma yin gyi/ rgyu la brten nas 'byung ba'i rten 'brel tsam mo/ /rgyu 'bras su 'gyur tshul ni/ ma rig pa dang 'du byed gnyis 'phen byed kyi rgyu/ sred len srid pa gsum 'grub byed kyi rgyu/ rnam shes nas tshor ba'i bar 'phang 'bras/ skye ba rga shi gnyis grub pa'i 'bras bu ste/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis yang srid mngon par 'du byed pa'i 'du byed kyi las bsags te/ rnam shes nas tshor ba'i bar lnga 'grub rung du 'phang ba sred len gyis gsos btab pas 'du byed kyi bag chags srid pa'i rten 'brel du go 'phos te skye ba 'grub cing / de'i nyes dmigs su rba shi 'khor bcas 'byung ba yin no/ /bdag nyid chen po nye rgyal lta bu'i tshe rabs gzhan du rten 'byung stong ba'i don du 'gro tshul la blo shin tu byang ba rnams la 'di ltar brten nas 'byung ba'i rten 'byung gi chos bstan pa nyid mtha' bral dbu ma'i de kho na nyid kyi chos yongs rdzogs bstan par yang 'gyur te/ brten nas skyes pa nyid kyis gtan ma skyes pa dang rang dbang ba'i skye ba'am ngo bo nyid kyis skye ba gnyis char gyi sgro 'dogs gcod nus pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon rtogs rgyan las/byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid/ /ces pa'i thad kyi brgyad stong 'grel chen du tshigs bcad 'dis gang zag gi bdag med tsam bstan par 5

casarngan/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/ 4074〉07zhegasungs te/ 'di skor la bshad rgyu mang ngo / /'phang 'bras 'phen byed la brten nas 'byung ba la sogs pa'i rten 'brel gyi ngang tshul shes pa na de'i log phyogs bdag tu sgro 'dogs pa de rmongs pa ma rig pa dang 'khor ba'i rtsa bar shes la/ de zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes su mthong nas rten 'byung rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis spong nus su yang mthong bar 'gyur te/ bden bzhi'i bden pa dang po gnyis kyi go rim yang de ltar ro/ /de dag ni kun nyon phyogs kyi rten 'brel yin la/ de 'gog ces pas rnam byang phyogs bstan te/ de'ang tshig zar dang po de ༄zhes pa 'di rgyus byung dang / rgyu gnyis char la mi bya bar/ rgyu kho na'i don la bya dgos te/ 'di'i 'gyur kha cig tu/ rgyu la 'gog pa/ zhes 'byung ba ltar yin zhing / 'gog ces pa'i don ni 'phags pas mdzad pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo rnam par 'grel ba las gsungs pa ltar 'gog pa nyid gang yin pa 'gog bden dang / gang gis 'gog pa lam bden gnyis su bya ste/ rgyus byung bdun po slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byed pa ni rgyu lnga'i rgyun 'byung ba bkag pa'i 'gog bden thob stobs kho nas yin te/ 'dis sdug bsngal nyer zhi'i 'gog bden 'thob tshul dang /'thob nus gnyis ka shes nus/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa yongs rdzogs skye ba la de ltar shes pa nges par dgos gsungs/ de lta bu'i 'gog bden ni rang sde kha cig rdzas grub dang / gzhan dag bral cha tsam la 6

phangashāmimang 〉 /re//(1// //snye/1rwaspro/ ////shā ba// skyi /rgo2ཿཿ// 47mi/bzhed kyang 'phags pa klu sgrub ni/ de kho na nyid kyi khyad par lam dang rigs pa'i dgag bya gnyis bcad pas rab tu phye ba la bzhed do/ /rgyus byung bdun po 'gag pa rgyu 'gag pa kho na'i stobs kyis yin par shes nga/ na/ rgyu 'a gog byed kyi lam de rgyus byung 'gag pa'i 'gog bden 'thob byed du mthong bar 'gyur la/ rgyu lnga'i nang nas kyang nyon mongs pa'i lam ni rtsa ba gcig bcad pas las dang nyon mongs thams cad rang log tu 'gro bar byar yod cing las la tshul de med pa dang / nyon rno/ngas pa'i rtsa ba yang ma rig pa gcig pur gong du brjod zin pas mdor na ma rig pa zlog byed de thar ba'i lam gyi dngos gzhir ngos zin no/ /de'ang ma rig pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bzlog phyogs su 'jug pa'i bdag med rnam can gyi lam kho na dgos kyi ma rig pa tsher ma dbyang ba bzhin byar med la/ bdag med gtan la 'bebs tshul yang /rtor /ste /lnga/ //ste 'erto :de/tshon 'byung nga ba don dang nga ba na 'byung don du 'char ba tshigs bcad phyed 'dis bstan pa nyid las lhag pa gzhan med pas lam sgom tshul la nges pa rnyed do/ /'das lam bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gyi dbye ba thams cad kyang gtso bor nyon mongs dang de las kyang bdag 'dzin spong ba dang spangs pa'i lam gyi steng nas bzhag pa las sdug bsngal spong ba dang spangs pa'i rim pas bzhag pa med do/ /rten snying gzungs chog las/ las dang nyon mongs med na 'khor la 7

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las kyang ldog /ces par yang 'di dag dran dgos/ 'ang sgras 'khor ba'i 'jug rim du ma zad ldog tshul yang bstan zhes pa'o/ /rkang ba gnyis po 'di'i don dngos smra bas gzhan du bshad tshul yang yod mod kyi/ slob dpon gyi rin chen phreng ba ltar byed dgos so/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bstsal te//zhes pa ni sngar drangs pa'i lung las de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bka' bstsal te/ /zhes nyid kyi sgra yod cing /tog gzungs las/smra ba'i khyu mchog de yis rang gis mkhyen te gsungs//zhes 'byung ba ltar bka' bstsal tshul khyad par can zhig yin te/mngon 'byung gi mdo las/ rang gis mngon par shes na su la brten/ /zhes slob dpon med par rang dbang du gsungs pa'o/ /de skad gsungs pa zhes pa ni lung las/ de skad gsungs pa'i tshul can zhes pa ltar te 'phags pa rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang slob dpon med par rten 'byung gzigs pa yin yang mdzod 'grel las gsungs pa ltar skye dgu rgyun phyogs su 'jug pa rgyun las bzlog par dka' ba'i phyir dang /snying rje dman pa'i phyir dang / shes sgrib ma spangs pas gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa'i khyad par phra mo bzhin du rten 'byung gi chos ston pa la 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i dbang gis nyid kyis bka' bstsal zhes mi brjod cing / de skad gsungs pa'i tshal can zhes kyang mi brjod ༄ de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni rgyu mtshan de las bzlog pas de 8

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7skad gsungs pa zhes dang gsungs pa'i tshul can zhes bya'o/ /de'ang rten 'byung gi gtam gsungs pa'i ched du sngon smon lam btab nas bskal ba grangs med gsum du rten 'byung rtogs pa'i lam spyod pa rgya chen po'i grogs dang bcas te sbyang ba mthar son te 'jig rten du byung ba dang / chos bstan pa thams cad de las brtsams te 'jug cing / de gsungs pa la skyo dub mi mnga' ba dang / rten 'byung gi phyag rgyas ma btab pa gang yang mi gsungs pa sa rten 'byung gsungs pa'i ngang tshul can zhes pa'i tshig nus pa can smos te/ tshul can zhes pa dngos su yod med ji ltar yang rta thul gyis nye rgyal la bshad pa'i tshigs bcad kyi rkang ba tha ma gcig po de yin pas don gcig par bshad dgos so/ /dge sbyong ni nyon mongs pa'i dgra thul ba dang / che zhes pa ni de rnams kyi mchog ste bshad ma thag pa'i bden pa bzhi bstan pa'i rtags kyis legs par spangs pa dang / mi ldog par spangs pa/ ma lus par spangs pa'i bde gshegs 'grub tshal rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa las rgya cher ༄bshad pa bzhin no/ /rten 'byung smra ba las phyi rol du gyur ba la dge sbyong gi chul dang dge sbyang tshul gyi 'bras bu gang yang si srid r+pās bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis/ 'di kho na la bram ze yod kyi/ bstan pa gzha na ni dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis stong ba yin no/ /zhes seng ṅga'i sgras gsungs so/ /mdor na rten 'byung gsungs pa nyid kyis ston 9

21/da/ 11 lngardo lnga/ngaku 'o/:drob/bzhi byaspucad nga//mizud rta):re ba/sdo/spreng 'o/sdo/zug/ trapa mtshungs pa med par bstan pa ste/ don 'di la dgongs nas rtsa ba shes rab las kyang / gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /zhes pa nas/ spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi//dam pa/ zhes dang / /'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa las/ rten cing 'brel bar gang 'byung ba/ /de nyid lo kyis stong bar bzhed/ /dngos po rang dbang yod min zhes/ /mnyam med khyod kyi seng ge'i sgra/ /zhes sogs ches mang du gsungs so/ /nam zhig 'phags lam thob dus sangs rgyas la shes nas dad pa rnyed de bdud dang phas kyi rgol bas bkrir mi btub pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog ces pa'i grangs su 'gro ba'ang rten 'byung gi de nyid mthong ba'i sgo nas ston pa la yid ches rnyed pa 'dir thug pas tshe rabs kun tu ston pa gzhan la mi bsten pa'i dam pa'i gral du sdod par 'dod na 'di la gces spras chen po bya ste/ don tshul bzhin bsam na lta ci smos/ tshig tsam bzlas pa la yang phan yon tshad med pa 'byung ba'i phyir te/ gzungs chog las/ rtag tu bzlas brjod byas gyar na/ /dam pa'i chos kyang bzung bar 'gyar/ /zhes /rje/ ra mi byerjeste 71( /bye bye 111dang / mdo las/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba da par dka ci/ / sa sa pa rnyed par dka'o/ /tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang /rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba dpag tu med pas yongs su bsgos pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag kyang rnyed 10

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7khyokhyo d+ku pa/ra dka'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bka' 'gyur gyi grar 'di'i sazungs chog tshigs bcad ma zhig bzhugs shing / rten snying gi cho ga 'i/ba mo zhes pa tshigs lhug tu mdzad pa zhig bstan 'gyur khrod du bzhugs te/ phyi ma 'di nerban rak+ṣi tas rang gi bla ma las rten snying gi las kyi cho ga brgya thos pa las phyis su phal cher brjed de lhag ma rnams kyi brjed byang du btab pa yin par gzhung rang gi mjug tu gsal la/de gnyis tshigs bcad lhug tsam las khyad par mi snang zhing / tshigs bcad ma'i mthar yang / dge slong nerban rak+ṣi tas/ /tho gar yul nas rnyed pa ste//zhes 'byung bas gnyis ka bstan bcos yin no/ /rten 'brel snying po'i sngags thems zhib mor bkod pa zhes bya ba jo bo rje dang nag tshos bsgyur ba zhig dang / rten snying gi srung ba rje btsun birba pa nas sa skya ba chen po la brgyud pa'i gdams skor dang / rten snying gi zin bris 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi gsung sgros ltar 'phags pa rin po ches bkod pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i rnam bshad ces klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang / rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel ba dang /lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyis mdzad pa'i rten snying gi rnam bshad bde gshegs dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba sogs yod pas don du lganyer ba rnams kyis de dag las kyang btsal bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rnga chen nag zla'i dga' ba bzhi ba la'o// / /1

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /rten snying gi gleng gzhi las 'phros te 'phags pa shā ri'i bu'i lo rgyus chad dum 'ga' zhig bris pa/ shā ri'i bus tshigs bcad 'di lan gcig gsan pa kho nas bdud rtsi rtogs shing / mong gal bus lan gnyis gsan nas rtogs gsungs/ shā ri'i bu mngal na gnas dus ma shā ri kas sa steng gi rtsod pa smra ba'i khyu mchog bram ze skar rgyal tshar bcad/ston pas/de bzhin gshegs pa ma gtogs pa//'jig rten ku na gyi shes rab kyis/ /shā ri'i bu yi shes rab la/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhes gsangs/ bram ze shin tu mkhas pa zhig gis ston pa la ༄ bdag rab tu byung nas chos bklag na shā ri'i bu'i blo gros tsam 'ong ngam zhus tshe mi 'ong gsungs nas rab tu ma byung / de phyis spos 'tshong gi bur skyes pa 'phags pa nye sbas te/ 'di la slob ma nyin gcig la bden mthong 'bum phrag bco brgyad byung ba dang / phug gru bcu gnyis pa dgra bcom pas bor ba'i shing bus gang ba sogs kyis mtshan med pa'i sangs rgyas su grags/ drang srong ri bos ston pa la/ khyod kyi slob ma khyod kyi rjes su chos kyi 'khor lo skor zhing shes rab kyi 'od byed pa su yod zhus pas/ nye rgyal yod ces sangs rgyas gnyis par bsngags/ drang srong las rab tu byung ba stong las lnga brgya ka pi na la dang / nyis brgya lnga bcu re mchog zung gcig la gtad nas so sor btul bas zla ba gsum na ka pi nas gdams ngag btab pa rnams dgra bcom/ mong gal bus 1 2

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7trad+kubatab pa rnams phyir mi 'ong / shā ri'i bus btab pa rnams rgyun zhugs thob pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lnga brgya bo dbang rnon dang / lhag ma 'bring dang rtul po yin pas gal te shā ri'i bu'i slob ma rnams ka pi na dang mong gal bu la gtad na de'i tshe gcig gis kyang rgyun zhugs mi 'thob gsungs te gdul ba la mkhas pa'i khyad de 'dra yod/ mtsho ma dros par las kyi rgyu ba lung ston pa'i skabs su/ mchog zung rdzu 'phrul 'gran pas ming gal bu pham pa na/ ston pas ngas rdzu 'phrul la mang du gnas pa'i sgo nas mong gal bu rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog tu bstan gyi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yul shes pa'i sgo nas ni ma yin zhes dang / 'phags pa mong ga/la bu gang la snyom par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin phal cher gyi ming tsam yang nyan thos gzhan gyis mi shes/ gang la shā ri'i bu snyom par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin phal cher mong gal bus ming tsam yang mi shes sogs bka' stsal/ mchog zung dmyal ba mnar med rgyur byon pa na aung gal bus mnar med kyi 'gro ba la snying brtse bas shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi char rgyun phabs pa me 'od kyis skam ste sa la 'babs rgyu ma byung / shā ri'i bus mos pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mnar med pa'i 'jig rten bsil bar mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar shā ri'i bu dgra bcom brgyad khri dang bcas pa grong na lan dar mya ngan las 'das tshe 'phags pa kun dga' bos ston pa la shā ri'i bu ston pa gnyis pa lta bu 13

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mya ngan las 'das pas de'i shes rab dang chos kyi longs spyod dran nas bdag gi yid mya ngan gyis 'khrugs te phyogs bslad/ thos pa'i chos rnams kyang brjed sogs zhus tshe/ ri nyil ba na thog mar rtse mo'i cha 'jig pa dang / shing gi 'bras bu smin pa lhung ba na dang por rtse na yod pa rnams lhung ba ltar nyan thos chen po rnams zhi bar mnal ba na thog mar nyan thos thams cad kyi tog 'phags pa shā ri'i bu lta bu mya ngan 'da' ba yin gsungs/ shā ri'i bu'i sku gdung kun dga' bo'i phyag na bzhugs pa khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis zhus pas kho bo nyid kyis mchod pa byed dgos gsung nas ma byin/ der ston pas 'di tsam gyis khyod shā ri'i ba la drin gzo mi nus/ de khyim bdag la byin cig ༄gsung nas gdong byin te/ khyim bdag gis mchod rten brtsigs shing mchod pa rgya cher byas so//dge zhing bkra shis//14

rten snying skor/ dzo da/ 7thar༄/ /rten 'brel snying bo la brten te bsod nams bya ba'i cho ga mchod sbyin gter gyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'ang gzungs sngags kyi tshul rgya mtsho'i nang nas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bstan don stong dang rten 'byung zung 'jug gi don du bzlum pa rten 'brel snying bo'i gzungs la brten te mchod sbyin gyi cho ga nye bar sgrub pa la/ sbyor dngos gnyis las dang po ni/ gong du mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal zlum po ba byung dang dri bzang gis byug pa'i dkyil du ston pa'i sku byin can bzhugs/ de'i g.yas su gzungs bum bzang bo drug dang ghi haṃ dang tsan+dan dkar dmar la sogs pa'i chus bltams shing 'bras bu can gyi shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas te bzhag la/ mtha' bskor du mchod yon dang me tog dang spos dang mar me dang lha bshos la sogs pa mchod pa bzang la mang ba brgya mchod dam stong mchod lta bu ci 'byor bstar legs su bsham/ mchod dkyil gyi mdun ngos dma'/ ba ra stegs bu gru bzhi khyon yangs pa la dbus bu ri rab dang / phyogs mtshams su gling gtso dang / gling phran/ mtha' bskor du khor yug lcags ri dang bcas pa'i bkod pa rags pa re byas la tshon gyis bsgyur/ ri rab kyi steng du tshon sna 'i skud pa las khang bzang gru bzhi ba'i rnam par phub ste de'i nang gi phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar rin po che'i snod bzang por dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma zlum po gtsang zhing gya nom pa dang / mchod yon rnyog med/ 'o phud mngar dang sbags pa rnams tshang ba re bshams/dbus kyi gtor ma'i mdun phyogs su dmar gtor brjid bag can zan dang sha dum sogs kyis bskor ba dang / bar mtshams su dkar gtor gang rigs bzhag d+ngha/gling bzhi gling phran brgyad la so sor ngar glud dang nam rgyang mda' 'phang shing ris rnams tshang ba re dang / de dag gi mthar sha chang la phug sgog tsong sran chan sogs 'byung po'i zas sna dang / gos dar 'bru sna rin po che sogs dkor cha/ mtha' 'khor du ri dwags dang g.yung dwags sogs srog chags kyi 15

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mdangs gang mang bkod/ ngar glud rnams kyi mdun du chang bu dang ting lo bzhag ci bde bar kha skong gi mchod gtor dkar mngar zas snas sbags pa brgya rtsa dang / de las logs su mthing shel zangs lcags sogs glud rdzas dang 'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo srog zhugs kyi sbrel glud che ba glud phran brgya rtsa/ chang bu brgya rtsa/ ril bu brgya rtsa rnams ja sha sngo ngad sogs kyis brgyan te nye bar bsdogs/ de nas dngos gzhi la bab pa na/ gtsang sbra'i kun spyod dang ldan pas mchod sbyin mkhan po rnams rang rang gi stan la 'dug ste/ dkon mchog gsum la gus pa mngon du phyogs pa'i yid kyis skyabs sems bya/ rten snying gi cho ga rgya gzhung ma'i rang tshig /'di ltar las dang nyon mongs yod gyur na/ /sems can rnams ni 'khor bar 'gro 'gyur la/ /las dang nyon mongs med na 'khor ba las kyang ldog /bden pa 'a di yis bdag gi bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'chal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes pa'i mthar rten snying dang mchod pa'i sprin gzungs sbrel ba lan bdun gyis mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs la stong gsum yungs 16

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7'brur tshud pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo la dran pa nye bar bzhag ste mchod tshul drug ldan du 'bul/rjes su rol mo bya/ de nas/ na mo rat+natra yā ya/ sogs rten snying gi bzlas pa bya zhing stong nyid dang rten 'byung tha mi dad pa'i don la dpyad pas drangs pa'i nges shes khyad par can bskyed de ston pa chos kyi sku rjes su dran pa'i ngang la blo bzhag thun mthar nye ba na/ mdun mkhar bzhugs pa'i thub dbang 'khor bcas kyi sku las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gser zhun ma'i kha dog lta bu babs pas bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur ba'i dmigs 'dun gyis gzungs ci nus bzla/ de das grub nas/ thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byang //bye/sne/ //re/ //bye /rdo pe /re rdo rig mid+ngha med zad pa med bstan pas/ / sad pa ༄ 'a—nga ba ga sned mdzad pa/ /kun ma.o khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /snang bas stong ba la 'jug cing / /sto nga nyid snang ba'i skor ston pa'i/ /mgon po gnyis med tshul gsungs pa/ /kun mkhyen khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /brjod med de nyid la gnas nas/ /rjod pa'i tha snyad sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro la zhi gyur don ston pa/ /kun mkhyen khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /chos nyid gcig las ma sasu/ngas kyang / /rigs can bsam pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /rgyas dang bsdus tshul mang snang ba/ /kun mkhyen khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /phyi tshul ngal brgya ma brten par/ /nang gi bdag nyid rnam dag pas/ /khyad par phul byung rnyed mdzad pa/ /kun mkhyen khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ston pa mchog la 'dis bstod pa'i/ /bsod nams gang zhig bdag rurnyed pa/ /de 17

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yis skye bo thams cad ni/ /mgon po don kun grub 'drar shog /ces bstod smon bya/ de nas mdos chog bya ba las/ thog mar gdon gyi sde dpon chen po rnams la mchod pa ni/ khang bzang du bkod pa'i gtor ma sogs mchod rdzas rnams/ sngags drug phyag drug gis brlab la/ kye/ srid pa dri za'i grong khyer bzhin/ /skye 'gags 'gro 'ong mi dmigs kyang / /'dzin pa las kyi rjes 'brangs pas/ /brtan g.yo sgyu ma'i rol bar shar/ /dbyings la snod bcud ma mchis te/ /snang ba rten 'brel 'khor lo ni/ /rtog pa smig rgyu lta ba ru/ /brten nas 'byang ba kho rig mi zirang nar zad/ /don la gtso 'khor ma grub kyang / /'jig rten las kyi zlos gar che/ /tshogs shing dus la babs pa na/ /bde sdug rmi lam bzhin tu snang / /mthon po nyi zla'i ska rags can//'chi med lha brgya'i 'dun sa ste//ri rgyal lhun po'i ba gam ni/ /gdon gyi sde dpon du ma'i gnas/ /shar phyogs lhun po'i rtse bla na/ /bsod nams sprin gyi rol mo'i sgra/ /srid na che btsan chen po'i gzugs/ /phyogs skyong rgyal bo yul 'khor srung / /dri za 'bum sde'i bdag po ste/ /brgya byin rdo rje can gyi ni/ /dmag dpon grags dang ldan pa yin/ /de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i phyir/ /dri za lha rnams mang bor bcas/ /rol mo sil snyan sgra dang bcas/ /gshegs nas gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ /gtsang ma chab kyi mchod yon 'dis/ /dag pa khrus kyi las mdzad de/ bdud rtsi phud kyi btung ba dang / /dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 18

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7tratrashe 'di bzhes la/ /deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi/ /bla srog byad du 'beb pa dang / /g.yeng byed snying la 'dzin pa yi/ /gdug pa dri za'i gdon rnams kun/ /phyogs skyong khyod kyi mnga' ris dang / /'bangs su ma chud 'ga' med pas/ /de dag phyi nas mi 'tshe bar/ /brjid pa'i bka' nan dbab tu gsol/ /lho phyogs lhun po'i rtse bla na/ /dge mtshan dbyangs su 'bar ba'i dpyid/ /srid na che btsan chen po'i gzugs/ /phyogs skyong rgyal bo 'phags skyes po/ /grul bum 'bum sde'i bdag po ste/ brgya byin rdo rje can gyi ni/ /dmag dpon grags dang ldan pa yin/ /de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i phyir/ /grul bum lha rnams mang por bcas/ /snyan pa glu yi sgra dang bcas/ /gshegs nas gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ /gtsang ma chab kyi mchod yon 'dis/ /dag pa khrus kyi las mdzad de/ /bdud rtsi phud kyi btung ba dang / /dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi/ /bla srog byad du 'beb pa dang / /skem byed sha la dpa' ba yi/ /gdug pa grul bum gdon rnams kun/ /phyogs skyong khyod kyi mnga' ris dang / /'bangs su ma chud 'ga' med pas/ /de dag phyi nas mi 'tshe bar/ /brjid pa'i bka' nan dbab tu gsol//nub phyogs lhun po'i rtse bla na/ /bkra shis snyan pa 'bum sde'i dbyig/srid na che btsan chen po'i gzugs//phyogs skyong rgyal po mig mi bzang / /klu dbang 'bum sde'i bdag po ste/ /19

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brgya byin rdo rje can gyi ni/ /dmag dpon grags dang ldan pa yin/ /de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i phyir/ /gdeng can klu rnams mang por bcas/ /sil khrol nor bu'i sgra dang bcas/ /gshegs nas gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ /gtsang ma chab kyi mchod yon 'dis/ /dag pa khrus kyibyulas mdzad de/ /bdud rtsi phud kyi btung ba dang / /dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi/ /bla srog byad du 'beb pa dang / /myos byed dbugs la stungs pa yi/ /gdug pa klu yi gdon rnams kun/ /phyogs skyong khyod kyi mnga' ris dang / /'bangs su ma chud 'ga' med pas/ /de dag phyi nas mi 'tshe bar/ /brjid pa'i bka' nan dbab tu gsol/ /byang phyogs lhun po'i rtse bla na/ /phun tshogs nyi ma stong gi dngos/ /srid na che btsan chen po'i gzugs/ /phyogs skyong rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin 'bam sde'i bdag po ste/ /brgya byin rdo rje can gyi ni/ /dmag dpon ༄ grags dang ldan pa yin/ /de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i phyir/ /gnod sbyin lha rnams mang por bcas//'bum phrag dbyig gi gdangs dang bcas/ /gshegs nas gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ /gtsang ma phud kyi btung ba dang / /dag pa khrus kyi las mdzad de/ /bdud rtsi phud kyi btung ba dang / /dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi/ /bla srog byad du 20

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7'beb pa dang / /smra byed gnyid las gnon pa yi/ /gdug pa gnod sbyin gdon rnams kun/ /phyogs skyong khyod kyi mnga' ris dang //'bangs su ma chud 'ga' med pas/ /de dag phyi nas mi 'tshe bar/ /brjid pa'i bka' nan dbab tu gsol/ /steng phyogs lhun po'i yang rtse na/ /mchod sbyin grags pa brgyas mtho zhing / /sa steng 'jig rten skyong ba'i gtso/ /brgya byin dbang dang ldan pa po/ /nye dbang lha rnams bdag po ste/ /srid na che btsan dbang phyag che/ /dkar phyogs dbugs 'byin byed pa yin/ /de thubar rwa padzoririg zu rig /rdo/khro ma rig tsho ra zugacingarang rnal 'asur bdag cag gas/ /ma da dang bsnyan bkur bgya ba' phyir/ /sum rtsen lha rnams mang por bcas/ /rgyud mangs bye ba'i sgra dang bcas/ /gshegs nas gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ /gtsang ma chab kyi mchod yon 'dis/ /dag pa khrus kyi las mdzad de/ /bdud rtsi phud kyi btung ba dang / /dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi/ /tshe srog byad du 'bebs pa dang / /'gugs byed bla la snyob pa yi/ /lha srin drag/ shul chen po rnams/ /phyogs skyong khyod kyi mnga' ris dang / /'bangs dang bka' 'khor la gnas pas/ /de dag phyi nas mi 'tshe bar/ /brjid pa'i bka' nan dbab tu gsol/ /'dod pa'i khams na che ba'i lha/ /gzhan 'phrul bdud kyang 'jigs mdzad ma / /drag mo bdud kyi bdud chen mo/ /dud sol ma hā re ma ti/ /'jigs pa ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /de ring mdos la spyan 'dren na/ /gshegs 21

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nas rgyan gyi mchod gtor bzhes/ /byad dang khram kha dbyings su bsgyur/ /nam mkha' go la'i me long dang / /'byung lnga srid pa'i rus sbal la / /brten pa spar sme lo zla zhag /gza' skar dus sbyor tshes grangs lha/ /rang rang rigs kyi 'khor tshogs bcas/ /kun kyang mdos la spyan 'dren na/ /gshegs nas mthun pa'i dam rdzas bzhes/ /phyi nang rten 'brel log pa gsos/ /gzhan yang grong dang grong khyer dang / /ri dang nags tshal skyed mo'i tshal/ /lha khang dur khrod shing gcig drung / /gzhal med khang dang yul 'khor sogs/ /gnas dang gnas min la dbang ba'i/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams thams cad kyang / /'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /tshe dang grags pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /mdor na phyogs skyong chen po bcu'i/ /bka' dang 'khor du gtogs pa yi/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /mkha' 'gro brtan ma sder bcas rnams/ /kun kyang mdos la spyan 'dren na/ /gshegs nas mthun pa'i mchod gtor bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang / /bkra shis bde legs chen por mdzo da/ /ces gyer/ de nas kha skong gi gtor ma rnams/ a kā ros brlab te/ mdos dkyil gyi nye logs su rkang sum lta bu'i khar yol go gtsang ma zhig bzhag la/ saṃ bha ra lan re dang sbrag dkar gtor yol gor phul/ bcu tsho re song ba dang / /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /phun tshogs 22

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7khyokhu rgya chen 455 du gsol/ /zhes 'dod don gsol/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis brgya phrag thal ba dang / /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhe sa la/ /sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /kyi bar brjod/ de ltar grub nas gdon phal ba gtsang sbra las nyams nying mdangs la rgyu ba rnams la rngan 'gyed bya ba ni/ swa bha wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdzas rnams srid pa'i 'dod yon rgya mtsho zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin phung dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sgyu ma ma/khan po'i mig 'phrul ltar cir yang 'char ba'i tshogs su gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ mgron 'bod pa ni/ kyai/ ston pa phan bzhed bla na med/ /kun mkhyen mi yi seng ge ste/ /spros kun nyer zhi'i rten 'brel ni/ /thugs rje kho nas gdam par mdzad/ /bden tshig 'di ni bden pa'i mchog /bden pa dus kun mi bslu'i tshig /bden pa'i tshig la mi nyan med/ /de ring bden pa'i g.yar dam sgrog /gling bzhi srid pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul chen po'i gdon/ /gnod sbyin srin po mi'am ci/ /'byung po ro lang sha za dang / /bya gdon srul po tsher ma 'don/ /smyo rjed rmongs rengs byed pa dang / /skyem byed rdul khrod ma mo'i tshogs/ /grib gnon rnon po re lde 'don/ /byad stem pha rol rbad 'dre sogs/ /sha lan 'khon du chags pa yi/ /lha 'dre sdig pa'i sems lda na dag /kun kyang yas smyoka mgron du gnyer/ /bying 'thibs rmugs pa lkugs rengs dang / /smyo 'bogs mig ser gzer tham mdze/ /skran dang 23

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dmu chu lhan skyes rma/ /kha med sur+ya la sogs brgya/ /'bab pa thog ltar rno ba dang / /gdug pa hur thum che ba'i rigs/ /mdor na bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong dang / /dus min 'chi ba rnam dgu sogs/ 'chi rkyen rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /tshe dang srog la bsdo ba'i gdon//kun kyang mdos la sbyan 'dren na/ /mdos khang 'di ru brtan par bzhugs/ /ma bstab gson sha dron mo dang / /ma bsngos mi khrag tshan mo yang / /ldad kyi mche ba gang rno dang / /rngub pa hub la gang che ru/ /glal bas gnam sa kha gdangs na/ /de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /mdos bskangs brtan g.yo kun khyab 'dir/ /bos pa'i mgron la cis mi 'byon/ /ma thogs skad cig nyid la gshegs/ /sarba bhu ta saṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ zhes brjod/ de nas dz+rel glud che ba dang mdos dkyil du bshams pa'i yas rnams bsngo ba ni/ /ser sna'i kun sbyor smin pa'i gzags/ /phung po thal ba lta ba'i mdog/zirang rabargyayi dwags me ru 'bar ba'i kha/ /ngal gso'i dbugs 'byin la sbyar ba/ /rig pa mchog gi bdud rtsi ni/ /'od zer rnam rgyal chen po'i shugs/ /thub chen gang gis 'di gsung ba'i/ /rgyal ba phan mdzad des srungs shig /na maḥsarba sogs rgya chen shugs ldan lan bdun gyi mthar/ mtshan bzhi brjod/ de 'dra lan gsum bskyar bas sngags nyer gcig mtshan bzhi lan gsum rdzogs pa na gyer bya ste/'dre lnga bdud gcod kyi phyogs su dmar gsur gtong zhing / /kye snang ba rten 'brel chen mo ste/ /sgyu ma las kyi cho 'phrul nyid/ /sna tshogs srid pa'i 'jig rten 24

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7thalanadhe ni//sgra brnyan bzhin du snang bar zad/ /khams dang 'gro ba tha dad dang / /zas bzhi gnas ris longs spyod kun/ /lam gsum rten 'brel 'khor lo ste/ /ma rig rgyu las shin tu byung / /bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub snying bor 'di gzigs te/ /'dod pa'i khams ni kha zas la/ /brten pa med par yongs mi gnas/ /de phyir 'tsho ba zas la brten/ /srog dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten ni/ /rgyags dang brngan la mi chags med/ /dkor dang nor la mi sems med/ /brgya byin bdud rtsi 'thung ba nas/ /srin po rkang mar za ba yan/ /kun kyang 'tsho ba'i 'du byed ni/ /zas kyi rgyud la brten pa can/ /gdug pa gshin rje'i 'jig rten ni/ /rten 'brel lam la mi mkhas shing / /goms pa'i gzhan dbang kho na yis/ /zas phyir sdig la nan gyis 'jug /gzhan gyi 'tsho ba mi sems par/ /dmod pa dug gi kha phru yis/ /'dre srin dmyal thag gcod pa rnams/ /phan bzhed thub pa mchog gis smad/ /de slad stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon/ /mi bzad sdig las bskyab pa dang / /sbyin bdag 'jigs pa bsal slad du/ /byams chen sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar dbye/ /gshin rje lag pa dmar ba dang / /srog bdud las kyi bshan pa dang / /ma mo dal nad rims bdag dang / /dmu the la srid pa dbugs sdud dang / /yi dwags mi sha za ba dang / /rkang dang klad pa tshil bu 'dod/ mchin pa nang khrol za ba'i tshogs/ /khrag dang mdangs la dga' ba rnams/ /deng gi rgyu sbyor 25

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yon bdag gi/ /sha yi lhun dang khrag gi bcud/ /me drod nus pa dbugs kyi shugs/ /bla dang tshe yi sku mkhar la/ /gshed kyi thag pa brkyang srid na/ /rig pa sngags kyi ral gris bkrol/ khros pa'i kha rlangs btab srid na/ /dag pa ye shes sman gyis 'tsho/ / mkhon lan sha la gzhal srid na/ /gces pa nor la gras te brdzangs/ /gshin rje'i rngub la drang srid na/ /gdon kha yas kyi ston mos gcod/ /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /bla dbugs srog gi rin thang du/ /mi las dga' ba'i glud 'di 'bul/ /mi las glud 'di mi dga' rgyu/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa/ /rin chen ngar gyi mi bo che/ /rnam 'gyur tshangs pa bzhin du brjid/ /bag dro gzi byin chi li li/ /zhal ngo zla ba bzhin du mdzes/ /bzhad gad mdzum mdangs ya la la/ /ral ba lcang lo bzhin tu 'khyil/ /gser g.yu'i lan tshar khra la la/ /gre 'gyur gling bu bzhin tu bde/ /gdangs snyan rgyang glu kyu ru ru/ /smra sgo pi waṃ bzhin tu gsal/ /brda' dag ngag sgros sa la la/ /rdog bro rma bya bzhin tu 'khrab/ /gar stabs mnyen 'gyar khyugs se khyag /zhwa mo lcag zurag char 'a sna ri sna ༄shi raX ra༅ ༷)rwaphran bzhan tu ldam/ /dar da cad pan pu ru ru/ /stangs stabs 'khar lo bzhin tu bskyod/ /phyag rgya pad skor gyi li li/ /na bza' 'ja' tshon bzhin tu bkra/ /za 'og dar chen shigs se shig /glud gtor brngan sbyin rgya mtsho 'dis/ /gdug pa drag shul chen po'i gdon/ /stong phrag brgyad cu'i yid tshims shing / /sha 'khon 'gras pa bsdums gyur cig /mi gson 26

phang mipho parabyungangag /rten/tre// //steḥru //rdo shā pa/ rngordo//4ཿཿ// rto71/zas su za ba yi/ /'dre srin ma rung byed pa rnams/ /bla dang tshe la bzhab srid na/ /mthun rdzas mdos dang yas su bcal/ /sku mkhar mthon po nam mkha'i rdzong / /brjid dang lhun chags dpungs se dpung / /rten shing ldem pa rgyang bu'i shing / /bal tshon 'dab ma nyugs se nyug /dpa' ba pho chas mda' khra ste/ /gcod dang rno ngar brengs se breng / /mdzangs ma mo chas 'phang khra ste/ /sgril dang zlum 'khor hri li li/ /srid pa kun tshang shing ris te/ /snod bcud gzugs brgya lams se lam zas mchog 'dod yon chang ba ste/ /zhim mngar ro bda' chi li li/ /gos mchog lha ༄rdzas na bza' ste/ /phrug dar reg 'jam 'bol lo lo/ /bdud rtsi bcud kyi btung ba ste/ /skyems phud zhag g.yo me re re/ /longs spyod dkor nor sna tshogs te/ /rngam dang 'tshub ma nyi li li/ /khyon la yangs pa sa gzhi ste/ /'bri brgya rdangs su bsgrig bsgrig nas/ /sa chen dog por song la khad/ /yul la che ba stong gsum ste/ /phyugs brgya 'jal du sprad sprad nas/ /stong khams lhas su song la khad/ /lhun la mtho ba ri rab ste/ /lug brgya rin du bcal bcal nas/ /lhun po rdzi rir song la khad/ /ne'u thang 'dal ba gling bzhi ste/ /rta brgya spang la brtad brtad nas/ /gling bzhi dkyus rar chud la khad/ /shwa brgya ra brdar khrigs se khrig /rkyang brgya rtse gar khrabs se khrab/ /'brong brgya rnga gur zings se zing //ri dwags ma brgya bu brgya ste//srog chags mdangs su bstar ba yi/ /spyan gzigs rnams pa sna tshogs 27

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dis/ /gdon rigs 'dod pa skong gyur cig /tshe rabs lan chags 'khor gyar cig /sha rjen dmar gyi dwangs ma dang / /'bra bcud chang gi sna rigarigazi 1115 1rngo// zirang ma rig rwag pazhal skyams 'das/ /'byung sha la dga' ba dang / /chang skyams 'dad rnams dgyes pa bskang / /la phug lan tshwa sbyar ba dang / /kun dong tsong gi tshod ma yis/ /'byung po sngo ngad za ba dang / /mi kha bdud du 'bab pa bskang / /sran chan 'bru snas sbags pa dang / /phye zan 'bras bus brgyan pa 'dis/ /'byung po gtor ma za ba dang / /ro bda' 'dod rnams dgyes pa bskang / /lha rkang zhun gyi mar me dang / /tshil chen dmar gyi gsur dud 'dis/ /gshin rje zhun la rngam pa dang / /'byung po dri la za rnams bskang / /rdol mo nas la tshad 'dzugs na/ /'bru dar bang ba gang zer te/ /de ring mgron la byin drags pas/ /stong ba'i nam mkha' brnang gis dogs/ /mang ba mi la tshad 'dzugs na/ /mi dar go kha gang zer te/ /de ring gdon la 'jal ches pas/ /glud kyis bar snang ral du nye/ /bsags pa nor la tshad 'dzugs na/ /dbyig dar mdzod mig gang zer te/ /de ring bgegs la brngan drags pas/ /brtan pa snod kyang dog por thal/ /ma bsad stongs su phab pa dang / /ma brkus 'jal du brdzangs pa yi/ /gya nom dkor cha sna tshogs 'dis/ /gtso bo'i gdon chen bco brgyad dang / /byis pa'i gshed chen bco lnga sogs/ /bgegs rigs brgya phrag brgyad brgya bskang / /so so'i re 'dod bskangs nas 28

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7kyang / /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po rnams/ /bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol/ /bsdams pa bshig la mnan pa phyungs/ /zos pa skyugs la 'chi ba gsos/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /bla yi sku mkhar brjid pa dang / /srog gi ka ba brtan pa dang / /rlung rta'i ba gam mthon por mdzod/ /gnas skabs rang gzhan bder spyod cing / /mthar thug 'chi med bde ba mchog /bde zhing bde ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /dus rnams kun tu shis gyur cig /de nas sbrel glud che ba'i drung du glud phran re dang chang bu re ril bu re rnams zas snas sbags te 'dor ba dang sngags rgya chen shugs ldan lan re brjod/ bcu tsho re'i mtshams su mtshan bzhi re dang / khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams/ /sred dang chags dang tsha sgog g.yer ma ram bu la sogs mi kha'i rdzas rnams dang glud chang bu ril bu rnams dang bsres te/ zhen pa dang / /dran dang gzung dang bsam dang reg /glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ /ces pa lan re btang tshul 'dis brgya tshar grub nas gdon gyi rgyal po dang sde dpon dmangs phal ba rnams dang bcas pa'i byad 'grol zhing nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i phyir/ rten snying gi shams su/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum sogs bden pa'i byin rlabs ral gri ngar 'byin gang mang du bskyar/ do gal che zhing spro na/ oṃ trīḥ badz+ra dz+wa la sarba karma/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byad du bcug pa dang / bcings pa dang / mnan pa dang / nus pa bshigs pa thams cad khrol bar gyur cig oṃ badz+ra sbyin+dha ya ha he hūṃ phaṭaḥgazhan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad las bdag rgyal bar gyur cig oṃ 29

lhu pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ma ma sarba bhi dha bhi dha/ dza ye dza ye/ bi dza ye bi dza ye/ a dzi ta a pa ra dzi ta ye/ ma ma hai su pra mar+bha/ ha ye ma ma hūṃ phaṭaḥ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig sngags chen mo 'dis gang dag bdag la sdang ba dang / log par sems pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig oṃ shārnyiṅkari ni ye ma ma badz+ra dzñā na pra yats+tsha yi ma ma bi dha ra ya/ ha ha he he hi hi hūṃ hūṃ/ pra ka ra na sarba tsa la sarba badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'ang mang du brjod/ mjug tu/ nam mkha' med par gyur na yang / sogs/ ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro'i bar du brjod do/ /'di ni phyogs gzhan gyis byas pa'i rig sngags 'grol ba dang 'grol rgyu yang sbyin bdag chos bzhin spyod pa yin na bya'i/ cung zad re'i ngo thad dang rang nyid mthu chen grub pa'i rloms pa la rgyab dpung bcol nas bka' chad rin gyis nyo bar mi bya'o/ /de nas chos sbyin bya ba ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal bden pa ni/ /skye shi zo chun khyud mo ltar/ /nyon mongs las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /sna tshogs lus su rnam par snang / ji ltar 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'dir/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rnam phye ba/ /de ltar srid pa'i 'du byed kyang / /dkar dang nag dang 'dren mar snang / /ston pas nyon mongs lam gsum dang / /las kyi lam ni gnyis brten te/ /sdug bsngal bdun du 'byung bshad pa/ /de kun ma rig rtsa ba can/ /gang du rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i/ /chos de btags tsam nyid shes nas/ /mkhas pa tshul min mi sems te/ /blo ngan rtag tu gdungs ba brten/ /de dag lha ri ma/thor gnas pas/ /tshul bzhin min sems dang 'brel ba/ /30

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7khyed+ku'adod dang sdang sogs nyes rnams ni//gti mug kho nar brten nas skye/ /skye ba'i nya rgya 'dral ba dang / /rga shi'i khyim nas 'thon pa dag /dngos po yul la ma mthong bas/ /gti mug shin tu zhi ba 'thob/ /su zhig sngon dang phyi ma yi/ /mthar lta mi bzad la gnas pa/ /de nyid de yi 'ching ba ste/ /zab mo'i rten 'brel yongs mi shes/ /gang rnams bdag gzhan las min zhing / /gnyis ka'am rgyu med ma yin pa'i/ /srid 'di brten nas skyer shes pa/ /de dag shin tu mi rmongs 'gyur/ /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /'di don brnyes nas gsung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'dren zla med pa/ /go'u tam chos ni de ltar zab/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /sogs/gzhan yang bya khyi sprang gsum la sbyin 'gyed sogs ston mo'i 'du ba rgya chen po gces shing phangs pa'i nor rdzas las blangs te ser sna dang phangs sems kyis ma sbags par bya/ de nas lam bstan bya ste khang bzang dang lha gtor rnams blang la mchod dkyil gyi nye logs su bzhag mdos las gzhan rnams phyogs gcig tu 'khyer sla bar bsdu zhing ting lo rnams bltam la btegs te//kye snang ba kun byed sems kyi 'phrul/ /shes bya gshis la ma grub kyang / /rtog pa 'char sgo 'gags med las/ /rten 'brel sgyu ma chen por shar/ /bsam gtan rnal 'byor ldan pa dang / /grub pa rig sngags 'chang rnams kyis/ /snang ba sprul bsgyur nus pa yang / /rig pa rang byan tshud pa'i mthu/ /de phyir de ring rnal 'byor ngas/ /stong gsum srid pa'i lha 'dre dang / /sbyin bdag 'gras pa bsdum slad du/ /gsang sngags bden 31

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /longs spyod dkor nor rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i 'dod yon ches/ /gtan pa med par brngan zin na/ /da ni dkor la ngo zhig 'tshal/ /byams pa'i drin la rlung yang gzo/ /bden pa'i tshig la mi yang nyan/ /rig pa mchog la lha yang dad/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten smos ci 'tshal/ /phyogs kyi chu gter chen po bzhi/ /rin chen dbyig gi bang mdzod de/ /de ru khyed la lam bstan gyis/ /da ni gshegs shig sha ra ra/ /da ni bzhud cig si li li/ /stong ba nam mkha'i rum du bzhud/ /ting lo'i lam sgron 'di thogs la/ /dgu tshig zhags pa bzhin du bsdogs/ /'bab pa chu bo'i gzhung du bzhud/ /snang gsal me sgron 'di thogs la/ /chu chen gru gu bzhin du sdus/ /'tshubs ma rlung gi bang la bzhud/ /sgron chen 'od 'bar 'di thogs la/ /rlung nag gru bo bzhin du skyod/ /bsgo ba'i bka' la mi nyan na/ /gdon gyi sde dpon chen po bcur/ /chad pa las kyi bka' nan gsol/ /dbang phyug che rnams rig sngags dang / /'bar ba'i phyag rgya rnon po yis/ /bsdig dang brlag par gdon mi za/ /de bas da lta nyid du dengs/ sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/ zhes yi las byung ba'i rlung gis gtor snod btegs par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra gro ta ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+wan sa ya dza ṭi lam bho dha ra u tsusma kro ta hūṃ phaṭaḥ swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing yungs kar 'thor/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug mdos rnams chu bo chen po'i dba' rgal la bskyon/ rlung bra brtag la/ bsrung 'khor bsgom zhing / bsgrub bya de bzhin gshegs 32

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7 zhe gyepa la yid phyogs pas sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa la tshe 'gug tshe gzungs dang rten snying bzla zhing bum chu blud lus bkru shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis dbugs dbyung /rjes la lha gtor rnams gshegs/ khang bzang mdzod khang gi phug lta bur bzhag ste mtha' bsdu'o/ /rgyab chos su sats+tsha lo grangs dang lam 'phrang bcos pa sogs bya zhing / khyad par du srog bslu gang mang gtong / de ltar byas pas mtho ris kyi yon tan rnam pa bdun char bas brlan pa'i ljon shing ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa la brten nas phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo mang po zhig rnam par phye bar 'gyur ba ni the tshom med pa'i gnas so/ /zhes pa'ang mdos chog gto'i rig pa la ring nas dga' ba'i 'du 'dzi can sprang bo/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas chu stod zla ba'i nyi ring 'phul ba dang 'ga' zhig la phan par 'gyur ba'i bsam pas yar lung pad+ma bkod sngags rig grub pa'i slob dpon bgrang bar dka' ba'i zhabs kyis bcags shing lha dang rig 'dzin gyi 'du ba sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i gnas su sbyar ba dge zhing shis par gyur cig/ //maṅgalo// //༄/ /rten snying sngags kyi mde'u thung ni/na mo mañdzu shri ye/ rten 'brel snying bo'i sngags kyi sham bu bden tshig gi mde'u thung ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum/ chos kyi sku sgrib pa med pa'i phyag rgya/ dus gsum gyi 'phags pa rnams kyis dgongs pa/ brtul zhugs grub pa rnams kyi bsam pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad la srung ba gyis shig tshe dang gzi brjid dang longs spyod dang 'khor dang chos dang grags pa la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sbyin pa dang / yongs su 33

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzung ba dang / phyir zhing rgyas par spel ba sgrubs shig gang yang bdag cag la 'tshe zhing rnam par sdang ba'i dgra dang / dbul phongs dang /gdon dang / nad dang / rims nad dang / gcan gzan khro bo dang /dug dang / me dang / chu dang / mtshon cha dang / rmi ltas ngan pa dang /gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / phyogs ngan dang / sri kegs dang / byad stem dang / grib mnol dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad rig sngags kyi ral gris gcad pa dang / phur bus gdab pa dang /'khrul 'khor gyis gzhom pa dang / go chas mtshams bcing bar gyis shig swā hā/ nam mkha' med par sogs zhes gdab bo/ /nags kyi mthongs 'chi med dga' ba'i tshal du/ a bh+yas bris/ /༄/ /rten 'brel snying bo la brten pa'i mdos kyi cho ga nyung ngu 'jig rten gsum gyi rna rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo bud+dha ya/ rnal 'byor ba gang zhig gis rten 'brel snying po'i cho ga la brten nas rang gzhan gyi 'chi ba bslu zhing nad gdon zhi bar byed pa mdos glud yas kyi rim pa gtong bar 'dod pas/ thog mar mdun du stegs bu'i khar sa'am zan gtsang rin chen bye ma dang sres pa la ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa'i gzugs bya/ ri rab kyi steng nam mkha' kha dog lnga pa dang / gling bzhi shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ser ba'i kha dog can gyi nam mkha' so sor bran/ gling che chung bcu gnyis ri rab dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bla glud bzang po/ mda' 'phang / shing ris/ rgyang bu/ thebs skyu dang lan chags gang mang bcas bsag ri rab kyi bang rim sogs mtha' bskor kun tu rin chen sna tshogs dang / dar sna/ ras sna/ ja phud/'o phud/ zho phud/ chang phud/ chu phud/ ci 'byor dang / de dag las cung zad ring ba'i nye 'khor ci rigs 34

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zhetshar par dmar gsur gyi snod dang / sha tshil kyang bsags/ de ltar mdos chas rnams sta gon byas nas/ gong du bum pa bcud ldan shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa'ang bsham la/ dngos gzhi'i dang por skyabs sems ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs mchi zhing / /'gro kun byang chub mchog thob phyir//gzhan phan rlabs chen bsgrub par bgyi/ lan gsum/ de nas 'jug tshig rten 'brel gling po'i gzhung las byung ba tshig sna bsdus te/ /las dang nyon mongs yod gyur na/ /sems can 'khor bar 'gro 'gyur la/ /las nyon med na srid las ldog /bden des bdag gi bsam 'grub shog /de nas lha rjes su dran pa ni/chos gang rgyus byung de dag dang / /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bstsal te/ /tshul bzhin gsungs pa dge sbyong che///drang srong yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan gyis brgyan/ /dpe byad bzang bo brgyad bcus spras/ /'od kyi gzi byin mtshungs med sku/ /me yi khams la rab gnas pa/ /bdag nyid kyi ni lag mthil du/ /gser gyi ri bo 'bar ba bzhin/ /skyil krung zhabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo//chos la phyag 'tshal lo /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom pa la phyag 'tshal lo /phyir mi 'ong ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan gcig phyir 'ong ba la phyag 'tshal 35

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /denas/ na mo rat+na tra yāya/ oṃ ye dharmā sogs ci 'grub bzla/ de nas mdos byin rlabs ni/ gzungs de nyid slar yang lan bdun brjod nas/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bstsal te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /chos kun rten 'byung zab mo ru/ /mkhyen pa bla na med brnyes pa'i/ /mtha dang stobs dang dbang phyag gis/ /stong gsum stong gi /jiXge /bye/rte rig mi risi mi' ༄ga ’na 'di/ /ngo mtshar rin chen bkod pa'i zhing / /yid 'ong lta na rab mdzes par/ /longs spyod mi zad nam mkha' mdzod/ /'dod dgu'i sprin phung chen por gyur/ /zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas mgron 'bod pa ni/ kyai/ de ring sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /sems can yongs la phan gdags phyir/ /'dzad med sbyin pa'i sgo 'byed kyis/ /lan chags mgron rnams da gshegs shig /ma rig sred len gzhan dbang gis/ /sna tshogs srid pa'i lus blang zhing / /las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan pa'i/ /gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i sde/ /mdos glud yas kyi ston mor gshegs/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla ste/ /'jig rten gsum la rab rgyu ba'i/ /bgegs chen ma rung gshin rje'i rgyal/ /bdud btsan gnod sbyin gza' klu'i tshogasga/ /rjed 36

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zheloraporabyed grib gnon srul po'i gdon/ /skem byed smyo byed sha za'i sde/ /the'u rang srin po ma mo sogs/ /log 'dren mgron rnams da gshegs shig /khyad par deng gi bsrung bya 'di'i/ /srog dbugs drod dang mdangs 'phrog pa'i/ /steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar dang / /'og gdon klu dang sa bdag dang / /bar gdon btsan dang ma srin sogs/ /mtho ba rje dpon rgyal rigs nas/ /dma' ba rdul khrod sha za'i bar/ /de ring ston chen mgron la gshegs/ /'tsho ba'i zas la lha yang 'du/ /bden pa'i tshig la mi yang nyan/ /de phyir rnal 'byor sngags 'chang gi/ /dkor nor sbyin pa'i mgron la 'dus/ /phan byed bden pa'i ngag la nyon/ /thogs med skad cig yud tsam la/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis da gshegs shig /sarba bhu ta saṃ gu sha ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas mgron rigs de dag thams cad kha ba dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar 'dus par bsam mo/ /de nas mdos gyer ba ni/ kyai/ chos dbyings phyogs dus mnyam pa nyid/ /gzod nas zhi zhing rnam dag kyang / /chos kyi rang bzhin ma rtogs te/ /ma rig bdag tu lta ba las/ /srid pa rmi lam bzhin du snang / /bgegs rgyal chen po khyed rnams kyang / /'du byed mi dge'i las bsags shing / /sngon gyi srid pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /mi bzad gshin rje'i 'jig rten du/ /'khrul snang sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / /rgyu 'bras tshul la rnam rmongs te/ /gzhan la gnod pa lhur len zhing / /sha khrag drod dang dbugs la rngam/ /mi brdzu dgu brdzu'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /skye 37

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gro'i srog la hur thum byed/ /mtho ris bde ba'i yon tan bdun/ /kun gyi dang por tshe zhes brjod/ /tshe dang srog las phangs pa'i nor/srid na nam yang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi srog len pa/ /'phral du gzhan la 'tshe byed cing / /yun du rang nyid phung khrol skyed/ /de dag bskal mang bye ba brgyar/ /log par ltung zhing grol mi 'gyur/ /de phyir de ring rnal 'byor ngas/ /sbyin bdag sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / /bgegs rnams yun du bde ba'i phyir/ /byams dang snying rje'i mthu bskyed de/ /mdos glud dkor nor longs spyod kyi sa/ /lan chags mgron rigs rgya mtsho brngan/ /zhes brjod nas rten snying lan bdun gyis shar gdon rnams la mdos bsngo zhing gyer bya ba ni/ kyai/ shar phyogs dri za'i gdon rnams la/ /mdos glud rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ri rab gling bzhi'i 'jig rten kun/ /rin chen gos dang dar snas bkang / /gser skyems bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bskyil/ g.yu skyems phud kyi chu rgyun bsgrengs/ /ro mngar 'o phud chi li li/ /bcud ldan ja zhag me re re/ /'bru rigs sna tshogs 'dzad med pa/ /'bras sran bong dang gtos su che/ /gro nas lhun dang dpangs su mtho/ /khre yungs grangs dang rngams su brjid/ /longs spyod rgya chen dang ldan pa'i/ /bla glud brngan sbyin rgya mtsho'i gter/ /bkrag dang gzi byin lams se lam/ /bzhad dang bro gar khrabs se khrab/ /rtse dang bang 'gros brengs se breng / /gos dang dar thod lhabs se lhab/ /rgyan dang dril g.yer khro lo 38

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7khyo sgelo70zhe'o// /de 'dra'i bla glud bzang po la/ /mdos rdzong skyes su 'debs pa ni/ /tshon skud de ni nam mkhar bran/ /nam mkha'i mkhar rdzong wangs se wang / /bal tshon de ni rgyang bur brgyus/ /rgyang bu'i 'khri shing ldems se ldem/ /pho shing de ni mda' khrar bsgrigs/ /mda' khra'i yo lang sga ra ra/ /mo shing de ni 'phang khrar bskor/ /'phang khra'i sgril 'gros pu ru ru/ /lnga tshon de ni shing ris bkod/ /shing ris bkrag mdangs ya la la/ /ting 'dzin sngags kyis byin rlabs te/ /stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus par/ /'dod yon rgyan gyi sprin bkod nas/ /sbyin bdag tshe yi glud du 'bul/ /so so'i re 'dod bskangs nas kyang / /rnal 'byor sngags 'chang bdag cag gi/ /bsrung bya yon gyi bdag po rnams/ /dran dang bsam dang gzung dang reg /glod dang zhi dang bkrol nas kyang / /slad chad 'tshe bar ma byed cig /ces gyer/ slar yang mdos la dmigs nas rten snying lan bdun brjod nas/ kyai/ lho phyogs grul bum gdon rnams la/ /mdos glud rnam pa sogs nas/ slad chad 'tshe bar ma byed cig gi bar btang / yang rten snying lan bdun brjod nas/ kyai/nub phyogs klu yi gdon rnams la/ /mdos glud sogs rigs 'gre/ kyai/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon rnams la/ /mdos glud sogs 'gre/ kyai/ phyogs kyi mtshams na gnas pa'i gdon/ /me lha'i gdon dang srin po'i gdon/ /rlung lha'i gdon dang dbang ldan gdon/ /'byung po mi bzad gdon rnams la/ /mdos glud sogs/ kun la bar mtshams su rten snying brjod/ spyir gong gi 39

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mdos byin rlabs la sngags drug phyag drug gam nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lta bu sbyar kyang legs mod/ rten 'brel snying bo kho nas kyang 'thus te rten snying bstan pa las/ mchod pa gang la dmigs nas brjod na 'jig rten gyi khams gang ba tsam phul bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bshad cing / de nyid mdos la'ang mtshungs so/ /de nas dmar gsur gtong zhing / nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya'am rten snying gis brlabs la/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i dmar gsur gyi cho ga cung zad rgyas pa nyid gtong ba'am bsdu na/ /sems can kun gyi drod dbugs dang / /srog dang sha khrag la rngam pa'i/ /bgegs rigs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la/ /dmar chen 'dod dgu'i brngan sbyin ni/ /sha gsar dud pa'i sprin chen 'khrig /tshil chen gsar gyi dri ngad 'thal/ /rib byi riri bye riri ༅stobs dang mdangs dang drod dbugs bcas/ /ting 'dzin dgongs pas rnam sprul te/ /sbyin bdag tshe yi glud du ster/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bsrung bya rnams/ /dran dang chags dang gzung dang reg /glod dang gtong dang grol bar mdzod/ /ces brjod cing dmigs gnad gzab rgyas bya/ slar yang yi dwags spyi la dmigs te chu sbyin bya ba ni/ zangs dngul sogs rin po che'i snod gtsang ma'am rdza snod gtsang mar chu gtsang blugs te/ lag g.yas snod kyi khar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ lan bdun bzlas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'chal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing se gol gsum byas te sa gtsang mar 40

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7blugs so/ /de ci nus su bskyar/ 'di kho nas kyang yi dwags mang bo tshims shing / sbyin pa bo'i bsod nams 'phel ba dang / mdangs dang stobs 'phel ba dang / bgegs rnams kyis 'tshe mi nus pa sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par mdo las bshad do/ /mthar/ kyai /stong gsum srid pa'i 'jig rten na/ /lha 'dre yid kyi rdzu 'phrul can/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang gnas/ /chen po'am chung ngu gang yang rung / /ston chen mgron la spyan drangs nas/ /longs spyod 'dod dgu'i char phab ste/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo/ /yid bzhin nam mkha' gang bar 'bul/ /brtan g.yo phyi nang snang ba 'di/ /gdod nas rang bzhin ma skyes te/ /rten 'byung sgyu ma'i snang cha ru/ /'phags dang 'phags pa ma yin pa'i/ /blo yis ji ltar bzhag pa bzhin/ /dag dang ma dag so sor snang / /sgro dang skur ba zhi ba yi/ /don 'di su zhig rtogs gyur pa/ /de dag zab mo ye shes kyis/ /mkha' dang lag mthil rab mnyam pa'i/ /cho 'phral sgyu ma bzhin du ston/ /de phyir rnal 'byor dbang phyag ngas/ /chos spyorar༅47 tshor 0༄ ༷༄tsho 0༄ rabye spre'i 0ranyad rtags pa' lta ba dang / /tang 'jan sgyu ma' 'phrul chan gyas/ /'dzad med dkor nor nam mkha'i gter/ /de ring khyed la dngos su 'bul/ /dgyes shing tshim par bzhes nas kyang / /gdug rtsub gnod sems zhi ba dang / /rtag tu bde la gnas gyur cig / ces brjod cing bsam/de nas chos sbyin dang bden tshig bsgrags pa ni/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bcilo5 te/ /de 41

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skad gsangs pa dge sbyong che/ /chos nyid mtha' dbas med pa'i klong / /ri ring risibatsuchos kun gzod nas zhi ba ste/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing / /mtshan ma kun las rab tu 'das/ /rgyus byung chos gang rgyur bcas pa/ /tha snyad snang ba kho na ste/ /blo yis rnam par bzhag pa la/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung tshul zhes bya/ /stong dang rten 'byung zab mo'i don/ /ma rig 'dzin pas rab bsgribs te/ /rten 'brel lugs 'byung bcu gnyis kyis/ /skye bo byis pa bslu zhing 'khrid/ /nyon mongs sgyu ma'i sgyu thabs dang / /'du byed sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor la/ /sdug bsngal sgyu ma'i gnas bcas nas/ /sems can sgyu ma ya re nga / /gang tshe kun 'byung srid pa'i khams/ /'phagasabyupa'i lam gyis spangs pa na/ /chos mchog mya ngan med pa'i gnas/ /ji lta ba bzhin thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig bdag tu sgro 'dogs pa/ /de dag nyon mongs rnam mang po/ /sred dang sdang dang khengs la sogs/ /brgyud mar 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ /de phyir o kyang 'di 'dra'i tshul/ /mthong nas don bzhin spyod pa dang / /mthong don gzhan la 'dom byed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas phan mdzad nyid gyur cig /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed cig /sangs rgyas yon tan rmad byung ba/ /kun kyang byang chub sems las skye/ /gzhan phan snying rje'i rtsa ba dang / /lhag bsam rnam par dag pa las/ /bla med byang chub sems 'byung ste/ /'gro don sangs rgyas don gnyer yin/ /sdig pa 42

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7trazheshe ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ slar yang rten snying brjod nas de nyid bod skad du bsgyur ba/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bar+shalo5 te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /sangs rgyas chags med spyod yul can/ /sanas med len pa med brnyes shing / /bdud rtsi rdul med don ston pa'i/ /bden tshig nam yang bslu ba med/ /bde gshegs rig pa gsum mnga' bas/ /chos kun rang bzhin rnam stong zhing / /kun rdzob rten nas 'byung gzigs pa'i/ /bden tshig nam yang bslu ba med/ /rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam sbyor zhing / /rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i/ /bden tshig nam yang bslu ba med/ /'dren pa mtshungs me/da blo mnga' zhing / /sems can khams rnams ma lus par ma dmigs byams pas khyab mdzad pa'i//bden tshig nam yang bslu ba med/ /skyo ba pa 'jig rten mkhyen mang 'a ba'i/ /phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /ye shes 'phel dang 'grib med pa'i/ /bden tshig nam yang bslu ba med/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs 'di dag gis/ /ma rig rgud pa zhi ba dang / /bgegs rnams 'phags pa'i lam rnyed nas/ /rang gzhan bde la spyod gyur cig /sangs rgyas stobs bcu'i stobs mnga' ba'i/ /stobs ma/chog mtshungs pa med pa dang / /grags chen byang chub sems dpa' 43
