pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams/ /ye shes chags pa med brnyes pa'i/ /mthu dang stobs dang dbang phyug gis/ /bgegs rnams gnod sems zhi ba dang / /sbyin bdag 'jigs pa kun bral nas/ /rang gzhan bde la gnas gyur cig /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin sogs/ /ting 'dzin gzi brjid chen po yi/ mthu dang stobs dang dbang phyug gis/ /sogs 'gre/ rgyun zhugs lan cig phyir 'ong sogs/ /gang dag nyan thos rang sangs rgyas/ /slob dang mi slob lam gnas shing / /kun sbyor rgyu ba rnams zad pa'i/ /mthu dang stobs dang dbang phyug gis/ /bgegs rnams gnod sems zhi ba dang / /sbyin bdag 'jigs pa kun bral nas/ /rang gzhan bde la gnas gyur cig /yangaye dharmā gcig gam gsum brjod/ de ltar sbyin 'gyed rdzogs nas/ mgron lam bstan pa ni/ mdos btegs la/kyai/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni//de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bstsal 6te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /rten 'brel nus pa bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul bsam mi khyab/ /rig sngags bden pa bsam mi khyab/ bsam gyis mi khyab 'di dag gi/ /stobs nus bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /'jig rten khams rnams rgya mtsho'i khyon/ /'dod yon sprin gyis rab bkang ste/ /de ring khyod la phul zin gyis/ /da ni gshegs shig sha ra ra/ /bgegs rgyal da ni gshegs re ran/ /lha 'dre yid kyi rdzu 'phrul can/ /phyogs bcu dag nas gang lhag 44

mi shāmishi pa〉 //)//bye / //snye/1ཿpa/ //rdo/shā spro// /rdope shāḥ// rtotāshā/dang / /sbyin bdag 'gras pa bsdum pa'i phyir/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bgyis zin gyis/ /byams pa'i drin la ngo zhig 'tshal/ /bden pa'i chad tho don yod mdzod/ /mtho ba ri rab rtse mo nas/ /dma' ba gshin rje'i 'jig rten yan/ /lha dang lha min yi dwags gdon/ /srid pa las kyis bskos pa bzhin/ /rang rang so so'i gnas su deng / /bsgo ba'i dam la mi nyan na/ /rig sngags zhags pa mi bzad pas/ /'ching dang gzir dang pham byas nas/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad myong bar 'gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor sngags 'chang gis/ /ji ltar rjes su bstan pa bzhin/ /rang rang gnas su slar gshegs nas/ /byang chub sems dang ldan par byos/ /sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/ /zhes brjod nas mdos yas rnams phyogs gtsang sar bskyal/ rten snying gi sngargas kyis btab pa'i gu gul bdug cing / bsrung gur bsgom pa ni/ chos gang rgyus byung nge/ dag ni/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bagho te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /'dren pa shākya seṅge yi/ /ye thes chen po'i byin rlabs las/ /mi shigs gzhom med rdo rje'i gur/ /'ab ra ba'i me 'od rab 'phro bas/ /phyi rol phyogs rnams kun khyab ste/ /log 'dren rgyu ba'i skabs med gyur/ /ye dharmā sogs lan gsum/ de nas bsrung bya'i lus thams cad bum chus bkru zhing byug gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs yod na/nge nyid kyi ngogs su chu rgyun sbreng bas khrus gsol zhing / khrus chus bsrung bya bkru ba'ang bya la/'dir tshe 'gugs spro na/ tshe 'gugs kyi cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya zhing / shin tu bsdu na 45

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mda' dar blang la/ ye dharmā sogs/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni//de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' ba455 te/ de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /chos nyid gcig las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gang 'dul thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo/ /tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab cing / /thugs rje'i thugs dam chen po yis/ /sems can don du da bzhengs shig/brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten khams//'byang ba chen po rnam bzhi yi/ /༄snying po'i dwangs ma mdangs dang bcud/ /rdo rje tshe yi gsos su che/ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin gyi/ /stobs dang mdangs dang gzi brjid dang / /rig sngags byin rlabs tshad med pa/ /kun kyang mi shigs tshe yi grogs/ /mdor na rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi/ /brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis 'dir bkug ste//bsrung bya rgyu sbyor yon dmigs yul bsrung bya'i sems can gyis kha bsgyur/ bdag gi/ /khams drug srog gi gsos su stsol/ /bla tshe srog dbugs drod dang bcas/ /chad pa mthud la zad pa bsrings / /'thor ba khugs la nyams pa gsos/ /rdo rje tshe yi byin phob cig /spro na tshe gzungs bzlas/ rten snying gis tshe srog brtan par bya/ de nas bum chu blud gong smos kyi sku khrus kyi chu yod na'ang blud/ mjug tu bkra shis brjod pa ni/ye dharmā sogs /chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni//de la 'gog pa gang yin pa//de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bstsal te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /'phags tshogs sras dang bcas rnams kyi/ /ye shes byin rlabs rmad 46

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7trapo ches/ /de ring rgyu sbyor bsrung bya 'di dag gi/ yon bdag gi/ /dgos 'dod 'grub pa'i bkra shis 465/ /nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang / /tshe bsod yar zla ltar 'phel te/ /mtho ris legs pa'i yon tan bdun/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod cing nas 'thor ro//sngon byung skye bo mkhas rnams kyis/ /skye rgu bde bar gnas bya'i phyir/ /cho ga 'di 'dra bkod mthong nas/ /ngas kyang de 'dra'i lad mo byas/ /gto bla mgo 'dzong bzhugs so cog /gto nag 'di yis thugs dam bskang / gto pod ba tsha'i mtsho nang nas/ /don zab nor bu rnyed kyang srid/ /'khrul dang nongs pa ci yod pa/ /de kun gto mkhan rgyal la bshags/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa yis//'gro ba yongs la phan byed shog /ces pa'ang sprang smyon 'jigs med pas bris pa dge/ /༄/ /rten 'brel mdos kyi bca' thabs/rang gi mdun stegs bu'i khar ram/ cung zad 'phags pa'i steng snod gtsang gi nang sa blugs nas chag chag gdab la/ de'i steng khams sa'am bag zan gyi nang rin chen phye ma bsres la ri rab bang rim bzhi'i steng ri rab kha khyer la bla glud bzang po zhwa mo dang gzan sham can dang / nam mkha' kha dog lnga ba rgyang bu shing ris mda' 'phang bcas/ ri rab kyi shar du gdan zlum po dbus che ba g.yas g.yon chung ba/ lho phyogs gdan sog kha dbus che ba g.yas g.yon chung ba/ nub phyogs gdan zla gam yang gong ltar/ byang gru bzhi gong ltar byas pa'i gling bzhi gling phran bcu gnyis steng bla glud bzang po re re dang / shar nam mkha' dkar bo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / de bzhin du re re 47

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin mda' 'phang bal rgyangs shing ris bcas bkod/ mtha' bskor rin po che sna tshogs/ dar sna/ ras sna/ ja chang 'o zho chu gtsang dang /gzugs 'gros sna tshogs pa ci 'byor bshams/ dmar bsur gyi sha tshil dang /chu gtor gyi chu dang / zangs snod bcas 'du bya'o//༄༅/ /rten 'brel gtam gyi rnga sgra yis/ /mi shes gnyid 'thug gsal mdzad pa/ /kun mkhyen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mnga' ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel snying po la brten pa'i las sbyor gyi sham ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum/ chos kyi sku sgrib pa med ༄pa'i phyag rgya/ dus gsum gyi 'phags pa rnams kyi dgongs pa/ brtul zhugs grub pa rnams kyi bsam pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la bsrung ba gyis shig yongs su bzung ba dang / yongs su skyabs pa dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / sa bcings pa gyis shig gang yang bdag la rnam par sdang ba dang / gnod par bsam pa dang / dgra dang chom rkun dang bshes bral dang gdon dang nad dang rims nad dang / gcan gzan khro bo dang /dug dang me dang chu dang mtshon cha dang rmi ltas ngan pa dang gza' dang rgyu skar dang phyogs ngan dang sri kegs dang / byad stem dang grib mnol dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad phyir bzlog 48

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zhelo〉tshelisko〉bo/ /rnam par bskrad do/ /yongs su gzhig go/ /rig sngags kyi ral gris ka/cod do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mtshams chen po bcad do/ /rig sngags bden pa'i byin rlabs 'di/ /stobs ldan bdud kyi stobs 'joms pa'i/ /ral gri ngar ma phyung brjeka/ ste/ /ngo mtshar phan bde'i nyi ma'ang yin/ /byad bzlog dmigs bsal can lta bu yin na/bangen tshig gi mjug tu/ oṃ trī badz+ra dz+wa la sarba karma sogs nas/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā'i bar lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa las rgyal bar byed pa'i gzungs gang mang bskyar/ mig sbyong ba la/ rten snying gi mthar mig rnam par sbyong ba'i rig sngags sbrel zhing / tshul trem/sa kyi bden pa dang sogs bden stobs brjod pas 'thus/ de'i rigs pas las gang la'ang rigs 'gre sbyar ro/ /de yang mig 'byed la dper brjod na/ dus gnyan rnams su mig 'a bsgril ba'i zan gyi 'theb skyu brgya rtsa brgyad phyogs su bsngo ba lta bus mtshon te/ nad gdon byad grib sogs gang la'ang skabs su ngo lon gyi glud mang du 'jal/ rgyab chos su 'phags pa sa 'u ljang ba dang / mdo sdud pa klog sgrog bya zhing rgya chen shugs ldan la brten pa'i drang srong ma chod pa sogs bya'o/ /rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad ji lta bar shes nas gzung sngags kyi sbyor ba 'di the tshom med pa'i yid kyis brtsams na rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong gi dmod pa rnams kyang zha nye pha lam gyi brag la babs pa ltar bya bar nus na gzhan lta ci smos te/ mdor na bram ze 'i 'dzin mchog gi rnam par thar ba'i yul gyi rjes su song ba yin no/ /nags tshal dril bu'i sgra can du/ /brjod pa ku hu'i mgrin ldan glu/ /dpal ldan pad+ma'i 'dab stegs su/ /slar yang nyung ngur rjes bzlas byas/ /zhes pa'ang sprang po 'jigs med bstan rgyal gyis sbyar ba maṅgalo/ /༄khya/ /glud bsngo thabs nyung la 'don bde ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glud dang chang bu brgya rtsa bsngo na/ spyir glud kyi khungs ni/ skyes rabs las/ ngang ba'i rgyal po'i srog glud du/ /bdag nyid mchid kyis 'tshal bar bgyi/ /zhes glud kyi brda chad mdzad pa dang / sha lnga ma snyed na zan las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis kyang rung bar rgya gar paṇa chen gyi gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar rigs pa mtshungs pa yin zhes mkhas pa 49

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dag gis gsungs pas/ de'i rigs pas rdzas gzhan la yang dpag nus so/ /de ltar na 'dir cho ga shin tu bsdus te 'god pa la/ thog mar mdun du rin po che'i snod dam chu bor bskur na shing gi bzhi skor lta bu la glang thag gi drwa phad ltar bcings pa'i steng sa dang lci bas byug de'i khar bsgrub bya'i dri ma dang bsres pa'i bag zan la glud dang chang bu brgya rtsa dang / grub na nam rgyang mda' 'phang shing ris rnams tshang ba gcig gzhan yang ting lo/ sha chang / la phug sgog tsong / ram dug dar sna ras sna/ rin po che/ srog chags mdangs rnams bstar la bzhag de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs skyabs sems mthar/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing ri dwags kyi lpags pa 'chang ba pad zla'i gdan la bzhengs stabs mdzad pa sku mdog dkar gsal ye shes kyi 'od zer zla ba ltar kun nas snang ba'i skur gyur/ bar bltas la yig drug bzlas mthar/ lha snang de nyid kyis/swa bha wa sogasastong ba'i ngang las rdzas rnams zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi cho 'phrul nam mkha' gang ba'i 'dod yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlabs/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje yi dam pad+ma gar dbang spyan ras gzigs kyi bden pa dang / gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi lha rnams kyi bden pa dang / chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing chos can rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i mtha ༄50

rten snying skor/ pod/ 74zhedang nus pa la brten nas/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po sa dang bar snang la brten pa thams cad khra hor gzan la rub pa ltar skad cig gis chang bu'i mgron la 'dir mchis par gyur cig sarba bhu ta i ku sha dza/ lan gsum/ de nas/ ho 'dod yon longs spyod kyi sprin phung rgya mtsho bzang zhing gya nom pa/ mthun rdzas dkor nor spyan gzigs nyer spyod bza' bca' ldag gzhib/ bcud ldan bdud rtsi'i btung ba/ lha rkang dmar gyi gsur dud/ 'dod yon ro brgya'i chang bu/ lhun po ltar spung ba/ rgya mtsho ltar bskyil ba/ gram khrod ltar gcal du bkram pa la sogs te zad mi shes pa rin po che'i sprin phung / khyad par du'ang rin chen ngar gyi mi gzugs/ khams drug dbang po lnga ldan du byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba'i glud gtor brngan sbyin rgya mtsho/ gsal byed ting lo'i snang ba dang bcas pa/ mgron rnams so so'i dbang po drug la dgyes dgur 'char ba'i longs spyod kyi gter chen po bgegs rigs lan chags kyi mgron chen po dang phal ba'i tshogs thams cad brngan zhing bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir/ gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo 'od zer tshad med pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i gzi brjid rnam par rgyal ba'i shugs la brten te/ mchod sbyin gyi cho ga mngon du bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i mthar saṃbha ra sogs lan bdun/ mtshan bzhi lan gcig khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan 5 1

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams/ /sred dang chags dang zhen pa dang / /dran dang bzung dang bsam dang reg /glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ /de 'dra ba lnga'am bdun sogs skabs dang bstun no/ /de la'ang sngags kyis rdzas rnams spel ba dang / yi dwags kyi sde tshan sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs mgron rigs thams cad dga' bar byed/ mtshan bzhis go rim bzhin du gdon rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba dang / gzugs bzang 'thob pa dang / zas kyis chos shes shing ngoms pa dang / 'jigs pa'i 'tshe ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar byed do/ /mjug tu/mchod sbyin 'dod yon gyi dga' ston rgya chen po 'di nyid bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i yul du gyur pa ni/ rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dpal chos 'byor la bar du gcod cing / byur dang mi shis pa'i sna 'dren pa rmi lam rtags mtshan ngan pa/ glo bur bdud dang ye 'drog rkyen ngan dang 'chi rkyen rbab rgod ltar gtong ba'i srog bdud las kyi gshin rje rgyal bsen dam sri the'u rang / gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gtso bo'i gdon chen bco brgyad/ gdon phal ba bcu bzhi la sogs pa skye 'gro yongs la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor can/ bla la hab len byed pa/ srog la rgyug 'gyel gtong ba/ dbugs la rkan sgra rdeb pa/ gza' skar dang dus sbyor ngan pa/ dar rgud spar sme la dbang ba/ lo'i mtshams na gnas pa/ zla ba'i mal na sdod pa/ zhag gi lam 'phrang sgug pa/ dus tshod rtsis grangs la 'debs pa/ sha lan dang rus lan chags pa/ mkhon bu lon bzhin du 52

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7khyo'aded pa/ tshe rabs kyi lan chags zho ltar snyol ba/ rlung ltar 'tshubs pa/dpang rgya ltar gnas pa rnams kyi spyan sngar bla tshe srog dbugs phywa mdangs me drod kyi glud du bsngo'o/ /gtong ngo/ /ster ro/ /sha'i rin du 'jal lo/ /khrag gi gta' mar bzhag go/ /bdag cag dpon slob mi phyugs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gshin rje'i gtad khram zug pa/bdud kyi za skal bab pa/ ma mo'i dal kha thebs pa/ the'u rang gi sho sna rdol ba/ sde brgyad kyi zor lam thod pa/ mi kha dang dgra sna ldang ba la sogs pa chags che ba dang nyam nga ba thams cad yongs su zhi zhing /sngon rabs kyi srid pa kun tu byas shing bsags pa'i sha mkhon rnams byang / lan chags thams cad 'khor te/ nad gdon byad grib mtha' das las rnam par grol ba la brten nas/ gnas skabs su srog gi ka ba brtan zhing / bla'i sku mkhar sra ba/ rlung rta'i ba dan mtho ste/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' bor sa gsum na grags shing /mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang rin po che dka' ba med par myur du 'grub par gyur cig smrang dang bcas bsngos nas/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogasadang / 'byung po gang dag sogs kyi chos sbyin dang smon lam bya/ yas rnams 'dre lnga bdud gcod ltar skyol/ de'i tshul ni g.yang sman srog lus dbal bdud 'dre sadon ste brgyad las/ phyi ma'i phyogs su mdos rdzong bar dge zhes bshad pas/ spar kha li thog na yo da pa rnams kyi byang shar/ des mtshon khon la shar/ dwa la byang / khen la shar lho/ khams la 53

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nub/ gen la lho/ zin la lho nub/ zon la nub byang rnams su yod do/ /bsgrub bya'i gdon phyogs slob dpon gyi srog phyogs song ba lta bu yin na chu bo chen po'i gzhung la bskyal/ gsur dud kyis sngun bsu/ gang ltar yang / sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/ yo yig 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i 'deg byed rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i rlung nag ltar drag la rngams pa'i shugs kyis gtor snod rdzas dang bcas pa rnams ras bal gyi 'dab ma rlung la phyar ba bzhin du bskyod de phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i pha mthar dor bas bgegs rigs 'byung po thams cad skad cig nyid la hab sgra di ri ri song bar bsam/ gā te nyer gcig gi mthar/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i bden pas/ nad gdon bgegs rigs chags che nyam nga / sri gegs byad phur la sogs pa 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig lan gsum/ thal mo brdab/ gang mtshan lan gcig yid la dran pas kyang / /'chi med tshe dang ye shes mchog sbyordzob ba/ /yon tan dpag med zhing gi mgon po mchog / sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod nas tshe bsnyen dang tshe gzungs bzla/ dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /'chi bdag la sogs bdud bzhi rnam bcom ste/ /skye rga na 'chi'i mtsho chen las brgal ba/ /mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa thob par shog /zhes pa bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang 'jigs med pas snga sor bris pa'i yi ge nyung ngu la phri snon cung zad byas te 'don bde bar bkod pa dge zhing bkra shis/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /༄7/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten snying gi mdos chog 'di'i khrigs ni/ bca' shom la/54

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7t+yātra stse dbus kyi ri rab bang rim bzhi'i khar zom gyi rnam pa can/ gling bzhi'i shar zla gam/ lho sog kha/nub zlum po/ byang gru bzhir bya ba mdzod lugs/ gling phran rnams rang rang gi gtso bo'i gzugs dang dbyibs mthun du bya/ de'ang bris 'bur gang rigs kyis chog go/ /gal te de las sla bar byed pas/ rtsis gto gtso bor byed na/ zlum skor bzhi'i dbus su/ 'phur sme lte bar bcug pa'i sme ba gling dgu/ mu khyud gnyis par pad 'dab brgyad la spar kha'i phyag rgya brgyad/ gsum par re'u mig bcu gnyis la lo skor bcu gnyis kyi gzugs sam/ ming yig bzhi bar pad+ma 'dab ma lnga la/ 'byung lnga'i snying po/ ma ma ka rā/ sogs bkod/ mu khyud dang po la 'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo nang rten du bcug pa'i bla glud/ nam mkha'/ rgyang bu/ mda' 'phang / shing ris sogs kyis brgyan pa/ mu khyud gnyis pa dang gsum par lo spar so sor grangs ldan gyi ngar mi chas ldan dril zan las byas pa/ glud re re zhing ngam bsdu na bla glud dbus ma'i mdun du ting lo bzhag par ma chams thams cad du chang bu dang dkor nor spyan gzigs gang mang / khyad par srog chags mdangs mang du bstar/ bshad ma thag pa'i ri rab gling bzhi mdos dkyil du bkod na/ dbus kyi lhun po'i steng du bla glud che ba bkod tshul sogs dkyus kyi yig chung bzhin/ cho ga dngos gzhi la mdos 'di nyin bzhi pa'i cho ga lta bur byed na chu sbyin dang dmar gsur gtong ba'i chog roṭa ci rigs pa logs su 'dug ste/ mdos gzhung dngos kyi tshe/ bdag nyid nus ldan du bya ba'i phyir bzlas brjod dang / sbyin bdag gi sha mkhon bcag pa'i phyir yas 'gyed bya ba ste 'di gnyis gal chen du bya/ de las kyang phyi ma'i phyogs la/ 'dis nad pa 'chi bdag gi kha nas rin gyis nyo ba'i phyir/ shin tu rgyas par na/ phyogs skyong gi mtshams kyi gdon chen rnams la ster rgyu'i gtor glud stong / chang bu khri/ ril bu gang mang bcas bsdog la/ gyer gyi skabs/ thog mar/lan chags mgron rigs rgya mtsho brngan/ zhes pa'i 'phror/ rten snying bdun bzlas te gtor glud gcig bsngo bzhin saṃ bha ra lan gcig de dang rjes 'brel du chang bu bcu dang ril bu bcu ste/ chang bu re dang ril bu re stabs gcig par saṃ bha ra lan re rnams sbrags mar btang / khyer cig khyer cig sogs/ yang glud gtor sogs bsngo bzhin/ de 'dra'i rim pas yas glud brgya/ chang bu dang ril bu stong phrag saṃ bha ra stong / khyer cig gi tshigs bcad tshar 55

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brgya bcas rdzogs pa dang / kye shar phyogs dri za'i sogs gyer/ yang gtor glud chang bu sogs sngar bzhin gyi rjes/ ༷ste :sgrogs grul bum sogs/ gzhan go sla/ mtshams bzhi'i gyer soso gos sa shar ོ me lha'i ོ nub srin po'i nub byang rlung shā se /bye/ ཿba/ 2pa/ / sgyure// ste/ more// — ste/ — — lha'i: byang shar 'byung po'i: zhes bsgyur/ steng 'og gi gyer la/ steng phyogs lha dbang gdon rnams la/ /'og phyogs sa bdag : zhes bcug de ltar phyogs kyi gdon bcu phrag po re re zhing glud brgya re dang / chang bu stong re/ ril bu stong phrag re bcas byin zin pa na/ kye stong gsum srid pa'i sogs nas/ chang bu khri 'gyed nyin gcig gis 'gro min ni chog rogs grangs mang nyung la ltos mod/ gal te nyin bzhi lnga sogs su 'gyang dgos pa yin na/ mgron 'gyed ci rigs pa re'i mtshams su nyin chog gis mjug bsdu zhing /phyi nyin yang de ltar byas pas mtshon no/ /tshul 'dis glud brgya 'jal dang chang bu stong 'gyed kyi cho ga 'bring dang / glud bcu chang bu brgya bsngos kyi cho ga bsdus pa dang / de 'dra'i 'phyong gang yang med pa'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa gyer rang gzhung nas gsal ba tsam kho nas 'thus par byas pa rnams kyang mtshon nus so/ /gang ltar yang / stong gsum srid pa'i 'jig rten na/ /sogs 'jal gyi mtha' bsdus pa'i 'og tu/ chos sbyin dang bden tshig sogs gzhung nas gsal ba nyid chu 'bebs mar bya ba spyir btang dang / dmigs bsal du sbyin bdag nad pa lta bu/ do gal che ba yin na ni bden tshig klad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sogs sam/ gang yang bdag la rnam par sdang ba dang sogs bden pa'i byin rlabs phan bde'i nyi ma gang mang du bskyar/ lam bstan gyi tshe mdos zhal phyir bsgyur la/ chos gang sogs dkyus bzhin gyi mthar 'dre lnga bdud gcod dam chu bo chen po'i gzhung la bskyal/ yul gru kha cig na/mdos rdzong gi bca' lag dar phrug gcan lpags sogs gang byung bla ma dang mchod dpon gyis spyad de re thag gi dkris ra dang / rtsam sgong gyong po rnams sku rkyang gsung rkyang la gtong ba ni/56

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zhe 4skyub pa slar la za ba dang / grong khyer gyi gtor ma len pa'i sprang rgan gdol ba rnams kyi kun spyod kho nar snang ngo / /mdos skyel ba ni/ gsur dud dang gser skyems kyis sna drangs/ mdos chog pa rnams nas sher snying dang gā te ci mang gi mthar bdud bzlog gsum bdun nyer gcig so gas gdab/ chos gang sogs srung 'khor bsgom/ tshe gzungs dang rten snying sbrel la brgya rtsa sogs bzla zhing / dkyus nas bshad pa'i sku khrus kyi chu nyid bum par snal ba la byin rlabs brtan par bya/ bsgrub bya la tshe 'gugs gang mang gis tshe bkug ste/ mjug tu tshe chu blud/ rgya cher na tshe mdo klog sgrogs dang tshe sgrub tshe dbang sogs skabs 'dir bya/ 'di'i rgyab chos su/ dkon ma/chog mchod pa dang / ngan slong la sbyin 'gyed/ lam 'phrang bcos pa/ tshe mdo sogs gsung rab klog 'don/ sdig pa bshags sbyangs rnams la nan tan brtson 'grus bskyed pas shin tu le ba/sa par 'gyur ro/ /mdos gzhung 'di ni/ nged rang nas de mo'i bu lnga zhig gso bskyangs byas skabs/ gnyis btsas nyin nas shi/ gcig btsas nas zhag drug cu rtsa lnga na shi bas klad chung byis pa'i snang shes kyi snying rje sad de sud de ba zhig gis sna drangs te bris pa las sri can gyi bya phrug lhag ma gnyis kyang dus min gyi 'chi ba las rnam par grol ba sogs rten 'brel gyi lta sa bzang po 'ga' zhig byung ba yin pas skye bo mdzangs pa rnams kyis dang du blang byar ma zad/spyi /ro yang rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i che ba'i yon tan rgyas par dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab/ rigs nga drug cu ba/ dbu ma la 'jug pa/ dbu ma rten snying / spyod 'jug shes rab kyi le'u/ de dag gi 'grel ba 'grel bshad rnams dang / 'phags pa sa lu'i ljang ba'i mdo 'grel gnyis/ dbyig sa/nyen dang / shākya 'od kyi rten 'brel mdo 'grel sogs shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs mtha' yas pa zhig rgyab chos su sbyar te thos pa dang bsam pa'i shes rab khyad par can gyis legs pa ra gtan la phab pas rtogs pa nyid do/ /zhes pa'ang gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas skad cig gis bris pa dge zhing bkra shis/ / ༄/ /sa gar song du/ spyod pa gang 'tshams dgos zer te/ de bden/ lha 'dre drag po banas pa'i sar zla re'am/ zla phyed rer sdod kyang de'i ring la gnas bdag dang bstun gang nus dgos te/ jo bo'i slob ma lha rje bsam gtan gyi lo rgyus po to bas gsungs pa lta bu yin/57

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yonades na re zhig gar sdod kyi gzhi bdag la gsur mchod 'bul tshul gtsang chen srin mo la dper brjod byas nas bstan na/ lci ba'i me du ba med pa dang / dkar mngar dang chos sman bsres pa'i gsur phye gtsang ma bdud rtsi can gyi shing sna dang sbyar ba 'du bya/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gu ru zhi ba'am thugs rje chen por bskyed de/ thugs ka nas byams brtse'i 'od zer dkar bo spro bsdus gzhi bdag sogs kyi gdug rtsub dang gnod sems zhi ba'i dmigs gnad dang bcas bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya/ de nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas yi ge ram̐ yam̐ khaṃ gsum chad/ ram̐ las ye shes kyi me lce 'dod yon rnam pa thams cad pa'i dud sprin 'phro ba/ yi las byung ba'i rlung gis sbar/ khaṃ las chus bsangs te/ rdzas rnams mchod sbyin gyi mgron thams cad la tshim/ par stob pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ zhes rlung yab yod na g.yab cing / chu gtsang bis bran la/ ram̐ yo khaṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ gsur phye la'ang chab bran te/ rgyu las rin po che'i snod du 'bru gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i rdzas thams cad mgron rigs so sor gang la ci 'dod du 'char ba'i yid bzhin gyi longs spyod zad mi shes par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdun dang nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum bzla/ spro na rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs pa'i/ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs/ stobs rnams kyis/ /sems can kun la phan gdags phyir nas/'byung bar shog gi bar bden stobs brjod pa'ang bya/ rdza bu'i gling spyi dang / bye brag yul phyogs 'di na gnas pa'am gsar du rgyu ba'i gdon bgegs//bdag cag dang zhe 'gras shing sha 'khon zhugs pa/ bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang zhing / tshe dang chos dang bde ba la bar du gcod pa rnams dang /58

neshāshā /re/////sdo //khye/:rdospro/ ////shāḥ pa/ /rdo/sa4ཿཿda/ rdotāshā/gzhan yang sems kyi rgyud sdig pas bsreg cing / sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis nyam thag pa dang / rang bzhin du gnas pa'i 'byung po gang su yang rung ste/ thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis shin tu zhi zhing byams pa dang dul ba'i yid dang ldan par gyur te/ skad cig nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes 'gug 'dren yid ches par byas la/ smrang 'don pa ni/ gsur mchod 'dod yon mi zad pa'i sprin phung / gdon rigs so so'i mos pa bzhin 'char bar sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dang bden tshig gis byin gyis brlabs pa 'di nyid/ rdza bu'i gling spyi dang / bye brag yul phyogs 'di'i la klung nyin srib/ lung ba phu mda'/ sa rdo chu shing / khang khyim phyi nang / rta bres phyags rwaskye/sne bye//nge rig shālhas/ lam phran dang srang — sogs na gnyug mar gnas pa dang / glo bur du lhags pa'i gdon bgegs/ lha dang klu dang yi dwags kyi 'gro bas bsdus pa/ bdag cag dang 'gras shing sha 'khon chags pa/ gnod pa'i bsam ngan 'chang zhing glags 'tshol ba/ bkra mi shis pa'i ltas ston cing /byur dang sdug bsngal gyi sna 'dren pa/ rang bzhin gyis 'tshe ba/'phral rkyen gyis bskul ba/ pho rgyud mo rgyud ma ning gi rigs su gtogs pa thams cad dang / khyad par du yang rdo stod rtsang chen gyi sa cha 'di nyid na gnas pa'i brag srin mor grags pa/ sna 'khrid sdong zla rgyab 59

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpung dang bcas pa gtso bor byas te/ ji ltar mgron du bos pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs la gzhi'i longs spyod dang / byes kyi lam rgyags/'phral du bde ba'i 'tshog chas dang / yun du phan pa'i gsos sman dam par bsngo zhing 'bul lo/ /bdag cag la sha 'khon dang bu lon chags pa thams cad byang zhing 'khyol ba dang / so so'i lus sems kyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag nye bar zhi ste/ nyams pa med pa'i bde ba'i dpal la rol bar gyur cig phyogs 'dir sa g.yo dang me dgra/ thog ser dang lo nyes sogs 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa ma btang / mi la na tsha dang grir shi/ rta phyugs la god kha dang stor brlag bya ba la blo nyes dang mgo skor/ yul du yams nad dang dbul phongs/ spyi sgos su ltas ngan dang chag sgo'i rigs ma btang / phyi dgra dang nang 'khrugs ma slong / mi kha dang kha smras ma g.yob/ lha mi'i bar du dbyen ma sbyor/ dpon slob nang du sel ma 'jug g.yos sbyor nang du dug ma 'debs/ tshogs su rkun bu ltar ma 'jab/ dben par jag pa ltar ma 'phyo/ rnal 'byor ba'i tshogs khang ma nyul/ bang mdzod kyi sris la ma rku/ sho rde ma 'grem/ za lam ma gtod/'dre tshang ma bca'/ gros ngan ma shoms/ mi mi yul na skyid pa/ lha 'dre rang yul na bde ba/ gzhi mgron bar du byams pa'i gser zam gyis sbrel ba/ yangs pa'i 'jig rten rgya mo'i dar gos ltar 'jam pa chos srid shing rta'i 'gro lam lha yul gyi lam srang ltar bde zhing bar chad 60

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7tramed par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ tshar grangs gsog na/ slar yang gsur mchod khra gsos te/ byin rlabs kyi sngags brjod nas/ khams gsum dag pa'i zhing / sogs sa/zhan nas 'byung ba ltar bsngo ba la grangs gzung / mthar/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /sogs dang / sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs/ chos sbyin btang / 'byung po gang dag sogs kyis smon lam gdab/ gats+tsha gats+tsha/ mgron rnams so so'i gnas su gshegs la chos spyod par mdzod cig ces se gol brdab/ shis brjod kyi tshigs bcad kyang brjod do/ /g.yu 'brug nam mkha' stong ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs ri klung 'geng bar sgrog /bdag kyang thang stong rgyal po'i pho brang nas/ /kun rtog dgod pa'i rang sgra 'di ltar phyung / ha ha/ hi hi// //༄/ /na ma shākya mu na ye/ rten snying la brten nas glud gtor bsngo chog 'di nyid gsung rab kyi khungs la brten nas 'chad du yod med sogs spro rgyu mang yang gzhan btang snyoms su byas nas/ shom dang 'don 'grigs tsam gsal bar brjod na/ bla gab med pa'i gnas sogs btsang zhing byi dor byas pa'i phyogs su/ gzungs chog gi shom dkyus su gsal ba ltar dang /nge'i 'og ci bder ba byung gis byug pa'i gzhi 'khyer bde bar rgyas pa byed na 'jim pa'am zan sosas las khang bzang lcags ris bskor ba bcos/ bsdu na tshon phye dang chu tshon gang rung gis re kha gru bzhi nyis rim phyi ma la rgya phibs kyi ri mo/ phyogs bzhi ga'am shar du sgo khang gi rnam pa dang bcas pa/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ rtsig pa sngo/ rgya phibs ser/ pad+ma dkar/ lte ba ljang /nang gi khyams dang sgo khang gi nang / phyi rol gyi gzhi rnams ljang gu/ mthar re kha dkar bo dang bcas pa bya/ pad+ma'i lte bar mañdzi lta bu'i khar rin po che'i za ma tog dar dang me tog gis brgyan par rten snying gi sats+tsha bzhugs/ gtsang sbra la dga' ba dang dme ba spyod pa'i gdon che phra rnams kyi don du nang gi phyogs bzhir kham phor bzhir/ snum khur dang / dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ 'o thug /'bras chan/ sran chan/ zho/ 'bras yos sogs gtsang ma'i zas rnams lo ma lta 61

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bu'i snod so sor rtsal te bshams pa'i steng rnams gdugs dkar pos brgyan/ mtshams bzhir kham phor du gong bzhin lo ma sogs kyi snod so sor/ la phug /lan tsha/ sgog tsong / nas chan/til gyi tshig ma dang phye ma/ sha btsos rjen/ khrag /chang / kham phor thams cad du chu dang bcas bshams shing rin po che dang dar zab sogs kyang bzhag /de'ang dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs phyogs bzhi'i kham phor gyi gtor ma'i rdzas phal cher mtshams bzhi'i kham phor du'ang 'jug la/ sha khrag sogs mtshams bzhi'i kham phor gyi zas rnams phyogs bzhi'i kham phor du mi 'jug pa khyad par ro/ /gtor ma rnams zhag ma lon na bzang ngo / /khyams kyi phyogs bzhir kham phor du mchod yon dang me tog sogs nyer spyod rnams tshar bzhi'am/ bsdu na tshar gcig bshams/ phyi'i ra ba'i nang gi shar dbus su khang pa bkod legs 'jim sogs las byas pa'am bsdu na shing byang lta bur bris nas btsugs pas kyang chog /grong khyer lta bu'i ched yin na khang ba'i gzugs brnyan yang khyim gyi grangs dang mnyam pa byed/ khang ba'i kha dbus su bstan/ de mdun gos rgyan bzang bos spras pa'i glud gzugs 'khor ji ltar rigs pa bcas dang / lo ma'i snod sogs su dug rigs min pa'i me tog dang / shing thog bzang po dang / gtsang ma'i 'bru sna sogs ji ltar rnyed pa'i rdzas rung ba sbyar ba'i chang bu dang / ril bu ci mang bkod/phyogs gzhan gsum la ci bder bshams pas chog kyang / dper brjod lta bur/ lhor rta bres dang / phyugs bres kyi rnam pa'i ra ba so sor/ rta phyugs kyi gzugs gang mang / nub tu ras snam dar zab sogs las byas pa'i rkyal chung 'bru snas gtams pa dang / shog bu'am zan gyi sgrom gzugs gos dang rin po ches bkang ba mang po brtsigs thabs su bkod pa/ byang du sa nag rlon pa bag tsam bkram par/ gshol gyi rjes lta bu ci rigs bris pa la/ nas/ gro/ 'bras/ sran ma sogs gtor ba dang / smyug thur phra mo sogs kyi rtser zan gyi snye ma'i gzugs 'bru snas sbags pa mang du btsugs/ rta phyugs kho na'i bsrung ba lta bu yin na/ phyogs bzhi ka de dag gi gzugs brnyan 'ba' zhig gis bkang yang rung / gzugs brnyan thams cad gsal zhing skye mched dod pa gces la/ nam rgyang mda' 'phang shing ris sogs kyang lha 'dre'i mthun rdzas khyad par can yin pas bar mtshams ci rigs par bshams na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur/ ha 62

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7sgecang spros pa la dga' na phyi'i ra ba'i khar/ bya rigs sna tshogs dang / 'dod yon lnga'i gzugs brnyan mang po/ de'i phyi rol du ljon shing gi phreng ba dar thag gis sbrel ba/ bar bar du ri dwags kyi gzugs mang po bkod pa yang rung zhing / dbus kyi rten snying gi sats+tsha'i steng du dar gyi bla bre yang bre bar bya'o/ /༄7/ /'don 'grigs dngos la gzungs chog 'don tshul dkyus gsal las gzhan med/gtor chog gi skabs su dul zhing zhi ba'i sems la gnas pa shin tu gal che bas byams pa ci nus su sgom/ gang yang 'byung po'i dkyil 'khor na/ sogs kyi tshe spos gsur gyi dud pa gtong zhes par/ spos la gu gul dang gla rtsi sogs med pa dgos te/ 'di ni gong du nyer spyod nang gi spos la'ang 'dra'o/ /nang du dkar gsur tsam gtong zhing / dmar gsur rigs phyi rol thag ring por gtong ba legs/ glud gtor kha gso byed pa dkyus su ma smos kyang / byed na shom gyi skabs glud dang chang bu zas sna dar sna sogs slad nas bsnan rgyu zur du bzhag la/ zhi zhing byams pa'i sems su mdzod/ ces pa'i 'phror rten snying lan gsum dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa'i dge sbyong chen po'i bden pas mchod sbyin gyi yo byad 'di dag nam mkha' gang ba'i longs spyod mgron rigs so so'i dbang po'i spyod yul du ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /ces byin rlabs byas nas sde tshan re re bzhin gso/ 'on kyang srin po dang sha za sogs kyi skabs ma gtogs spyi khyab tu sha chang sogs mi blugs/ byung dgu glud la 'pho ba dang / zhes pa 'di nad spo gdon spo zhes 'dul ba lung gi drang srong dung dang / bres pa'i sngon rabs thad kyi lung khungs dang 'brel ba'i gnad chen yin pas dmigs gnad nan tan bya/ bden stobs kyis gso ba'i mjug tu srung skud 'dogs na gzungs sgrub kyi dus nas sngabs skud legs par bsngags la skabs der sbyin par bya ste 'dul ba lung las sngags skud 63

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpung pa g.yon du gdags par gsungs/ mdos lam bstan pa'i mgor mdos dkyil dbus kyi rten snying gi sats+tsha blangs la mchod thal du 'jog /gzhan dkyus kyi yig chung du gsal bas zur du ma bris/ /༄༅/ /khram dbyi'i cho ga 'chi ba'i 'jigs sgrol ni chig rkya pher ba'i cho ga yin gyi mdos chog dang sbrel rgyur byas pa min mod/ 'on kyang gnyis ka sbrel nas bya bar 'dod na/ mdos chog gi mgron 'bod pa'i mthar / 'di ltar las dang sogasanas/ ri mo'i gzugs su dbab bo/ mtshan ma btab bo/ zhes pa'i bar lo grangs sogs kyis khram btab/ de nas/ bdag gi bde ba la ltos pasasogs nas/ bden stobs kyis gso ba'i bar 'don/ de mtshams/ 'di ltar las dang sogs nas/ zhi zhing rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar lo grangs sogs kyis khram dbyi zhing / shing byang bkrus la rten snying bri ba rnams byas te mdos lam bstan pa man chad bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rigs sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug nam mkha' rin po che'i mchog sprul dpon slob kyi thugs bzhed skong phyir smras rim bzhin/ ma ti dharmās yi ger bris pa dge/ /gal te 'byor ba dman pas gtor ma'i yo byad ji bzhin ma 'byor na ci tsam rnyed pa la brten nas byas kyang nyan no/ /maṅgalo bha ba tu// //༄/ /rin po che'am rdza'i snod du chang bu ci 'byor bshams/ glud gzugs dkor cha dang bcas pa'ang 'du bya/ chang bu rnams la chab bran/ las sngags dang / swa bha bas bsang sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa/lan chags kyi mgron rnams kyi dbang po drug la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'char zhing nam yang zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter chen por gyar/ oṃ a hūṃ/ cimang brjod/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo//dkon ༄ 'amachog gsum gyi bden pa dang / bka' sdod chos skyong ba rnams kyi mthu 64

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zhedapung dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs kyis bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la dngos dang brgyud nas gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i steng gdon gza'/ 'og gdon klu/ bar gdon rgyal bsen thel 'gong so/ so'i sna khrid sdong zla rgyab rten dang bcas pa lan chags glud kyi gtor ma len pa'i slad du sbur ma rlung gis ded pa ltar skad cig nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum sogs brjod/ de nas saṃ bha ra bdun dang / mtshan bzhi tshar gcig /se gol lan gsum brdab cing /nyi zla kha sbyor las gsungs pa'i/ khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams/ /sred dang chags dang zhen pa dang / /dran dang gzung dang bsam dang reg /klod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ /tshar gcig de 'dra ba lan grangs ci rigs kyis chang bu rnams bsngo/ de nas glud gzugs sogs la dmigs te/ bsang sbyang / stong ba'i ngang las ngar phye'i mi gzugs phung khams tshang ba/ bzhin mdzes la skye mched dwangs pa/ nga long gi phyag rgya can/ gos 'phyor rgyan bkrag shigs se ba/ lha 'dre'i mig sngar bu bzhin sdug pa/ 'dod yon longs spyod kyi dkor nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod snga gas gsum brjod/ 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor bzang po 'di/ /'byung ba sa chu me rlung brag dang shing / /nam mkha' la brten lha srin 'byung po'i tshogs/ /snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre'i tshogs la bsngo/ /sha khrag drod dbugs rtsa rgyus pags pa dang / /lus ngag yid gsum glud du 'di khyer 65

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khu74la/ /bu lon lan chags gnod 'tshe kun bral nas/ /rang gzhan bde legs lam la 'khod gyur cig /ces bsngo/ glud gzugs mang bo yod na de nyid bskyar/nad spo gdon spo ni/ phyags ma thogs la/ dkon mchog bden mthu mi bslu bas/ / nad rnams phyungs la gdon rnams thon/ /nad gdon nyer 'tshe glud la spo/ /'phos nas phyir mi ldog par shog /ci mang brjod mthar ngar mi la nad pas ha gdab/ slar yang / bgegs dang log 'dren gyi rigs su gyur pa/ pho gdon rgyal po/ mo gdon bsen mo/ klu gnyan sa bdag /gna' 'dre rnying ba/ da 'dre gsar ba/ yul 'dre 'khyams po/ pha rol gyi rbad 'dre/ gson gyi bdud dang gshin gyi lcags byed pa/ zas nor gyi g.yang la rku ba/ nad sna dang god sna 'dren pa/ mi kha dang 'khrugs rtsod slong ba/ 'phral yun gyi phung khrol mang po'i tshang 'cha' ba thams cad so so'i nad dang bcas/ te dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthu dang chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis rgya khab kyis tsher ma blangs pa ltar rang dbang med par phyir phyungs te glud la spo zhing glud la dbab/ glud du bstims nas rgyas gdab par bgyi'o/ /nad sna thams cad glud la bsgyur/ mi las thon te glud la zhugs/ gdon kha thams cad glud la bskor/ mi las bgrol te glud la dkris/ nad gdon glud gsum 'grogs la song /song nas phyogs 'dir ma 'khor dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'o/ /gsum mam gcig bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i byur dang skal 66

rten snying skor/ pod/ 74 ba ngan pa bkra mi shis pa thams cad glud la 'pho bar gyur cig glud kyis khyer bar gyur cig /phyir ma ldog cig /gsum mam gcig gi mthar/ gtor glud rnams kha phyir bsgyur te btegs la/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i/ /'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang / /gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang / /sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa/ /mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su/ /thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ /sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/ zhes 'dre lnga gnas pa'i sa phyogs rang lganas mi mthong bar bskyal/ sher snying sogs srung ba 'don/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o/ /chang bu la glud kyi tha snyad sbyor ba mi 'thad snyam na/ glud kyi don ma go ba yin te/ mdo sde las brgya ba las glud blu rin gyi don du bshad cing / mi'i blu rin la mi gzugs cig dgos pa'i nges pa med pa'i phyir sogs smros/ ho ho/༄7/ /rten 'brel snying bo la brten nas khram dbyi'i cho ga 'chi ba'i 'jigs sgrol bzhugs so/ /dpal shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel snying po la brten nas khram dbyi'i cho ga sems can 'chi bas skrag pa rnams la phan gdags par 'dod pas/ dang po la sangs rgyas rjes su dran zhing dad pa chen po bskyed/ de nas/ 'di yod pas 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye ste 'di ltar ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam shes/ rnam shes kyi rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa/ sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/ len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre 67

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs pa rnams rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'byang bar 'gyar ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi mdo'i :de ra /(1 thedu spupodon yid la dran bzhin par/ 'a ltar las dang —na ngas da gyur na / /sems can rnams ni 'khor bar 'gro 'gyur la/ /las dang nyon mongs med na 'khor ba las kyang ldog /bden pa de yis bdag gi bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo / /dge 'dun la phyag 'tsha la lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lan bdun bklags/ de nas/ ba dag gam bdag gi 'khor la ming 'di zhes bya ba la 'chi bdag gi mtshan ma btab pa dang / de las byung ba'i ltas dang /rmi lam sdig pa dang / nad dang / yams nad dang / nye bar 'tshe ba'i 68

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zhe d+kurnam pa ci mchis pa thams cad/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bden pa'i zhags pas rang dbang med par drangs te/ ched du mngon par bsam pa'i rten 'brel gyi glegs bu 'di la ri mo'i gzugs su dbab bo/ /mtshan ma ba tab bo/ /zhes brjod cing pho'i don du byed na pho'i ming can dang / mo'i don du byed na mo'i ming can gyi shing bu la dbyug gu bsnol ba lta bu'i ri mo'i mtshan ma bya/ de 'dra ba skyes bu'i lo grangs song ba dang / 'di med pas 'di mi 'byung la/ 'di 'gaṭa pa'i phyir 'di 'gaṭa ste/ 'di ltar ma rig pa 'gag pas 'du byed 'gag /'du byed 'gaṭa pas rnam shes 'gag /rnam shes 'as/ṭa pas ming dang gzugs 'gag /ming dang gzugs 'gaṭa pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gaṭa pas reg pa 'gag /reg pa 'gaṭa pas tshor ba 'gag /tshor ba 'gaṭa pas sred pa 'gag /sred pa 'gaṭa pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gaṭa pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gaṭa pas skye ba 'gag /skye ba 'gaṭa pas rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs pa rnams rab tu 'gag par 'gyur te/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar du yid la byed cing / yang / 'di ltar las dang nyon mongs yod gyur na/ /sems can rnams ni 'khor bar 'gro 'gyur la/ /las dang nyon mongs med na 'khor ba las kyang ldog /bden pa de yis bdag gi bsam pa 'grub 69

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po'ikhunyalo70zhegyur cig /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo / /brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon 'gro'i rten snying lan bdun brjod de/ bdag gam bdag gi 'khor ram ming 'di zhes bya ba la 'chi bdag gi mtshan ma btab pa dang / de las byung ba'i ltas dang / rmi lam sdig pa dang / nad dang / yams nad dang / nye bar 'tshe ba'i rnam pa ci mchis pa thams cad 'chi ba med pa'i lam gsungs pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bden pa'i gzi brjid kyis dbyi'o/ /bcom mo/ /med par bgyi'o/ /zhi zhing rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod cing ri mo'i mtshan ma dang po dbye/ de kho na'i tshul gyis ri mo mtha' dag phyis zin pa na shing de thub pa'i sku gzugs la gsol ba'i khrus chus bkru/ byur slar yang mi ldang bar bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgyas btab par bsam la shing de'i logs la rten 'brel snying po bris te sgo'i steng du bzhag go/ /der yang de kho na nyid yun ring du bsgom mo/ /mjug tu yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa sogs las gsungs pa'i shis brjod kyang bya'o/ /70

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7t+yāde las bsdus pa byed na/ thog mar/ 'di ltar las dang sogs lan gsum dang /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo sogs lan gsum bton la/ rten snying nyer gcig bzla/de nas sngar bzhin bden stobs brjod bzhin par khram ris lo grangs dkyus gcig kho nar btab/ dbyi tshul yang des 'gres te shes par bya'o/ /'di la sngon du rten 'brel snying po srog ldan gyi sats+tsha lo grangs las mi nyung ba btab ste/ de'i spyan sngar mchod pa ji ltar 'byor ba dbul bar bya ba ni gal shin tu che'o/ /zhes pa'ang sprang rgan bstan nyis sngar rang nyid na tshod chung ngu'i dus rten snying khram mdos zer ba'i ban min bon min zhig rtsed mo'i tshul du bris pa 'khos chung 'ga' zhig de phyag len du 'debs pa'ang thos nas shin tu yid phyung ste/ de las 'di 'dra byas na cung zad dga' 'am snyam nas/ rgyal ba'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen la sbyar ba mchog tu dge bar gyur cig /maṅga lo/ / —71

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /rten snying gtor chogan mo shākya mu ni ye/ rten snying gi gzungs zlo ba'i cho ga'i ngag 'don mdor bsdus ni/ gang dag gis ni chos bstan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la sangs rgyas gus mdzad pa'i/ /dam chos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la phul na don che ba'i/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bdud rtsi'i rnga chen po brdung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rta thul la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung las skyes pa'i sras nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal tshab byams pa dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan rin po che dpag du med pas brgyan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa dang /sred med kyi bu dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / dri za'i rgyal po gtsug phud lnga pa la sogs pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams la 72

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7khyo trad+kud+kuphyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo byang chub sems dpa'i zhu ba lung bstan pa lha dang mi rnams kyis mchod rten gyi za ma tog tu bkur ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di brjod par bgyi ste/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du bdag gis gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di 'grub par gyur cig swā hā/ tar+ya thā oṃ ye dharmā sogasagazungs bzla/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo 'di ni ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas sgo sna tshogs nas byin gyis brlabs shing dpal gyi mgul nas/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku ste sus 'di mthong ba des/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ngo / /zhes bsngags pa sasungs pa yin te bdud rtsi'i mdo sde de lta bu brjod pa'i byin rlabs kyis bdag cag rnams kyis tshe rabs brgya stong mang bo nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa ci dang ci mchis pa thams cad yongs su byang ba dang zad pa'i mthar thug par gyur cig /phyi phyir tshe yang rnam par 'phel bar gyur cig /nad thams cad dang / rims thams cad dang /gdon thams cad dang / gdug pa'i rigs sngags thams cad dang /ltas ngan pa thams cad dang / sdug bsngal thams cad dang / gzhan yang 'jigs pa'i phyogs gang ci yang rung ba de dag thams cad nye bar zhi zhing phyis kyang mi 'byung bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar 73

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du/ dbang po gsal zhing rnam par dag pa dang / 'khor dang yo byad mthan pa dang / snying rje chen po dang / shes rab kyi rtsal thogs pa med pa ༄la sogs pa 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal thams cad rtag tu nye bar gnas par gyur cig /thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi 'di nyid la brten nas sems can phongs shing sdug bsngal ba mang po skyob pa'i slad du bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyang bde blag kho nar yang dag par 'byor bar gyur cig /de dag gi tshe sngon bcom ldan 'das las chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa'i lha rnams kyang dgos pa mtha' dag grub pa'i slad du brtson par gyur cig/ces pa'ang chos 'di la lhag par mos pa'i sprang rgan bstan pa'i nyi mas so//༄7/ /bla ma rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel snying bo la brten nas rnyed sla'i gtor ma bsngo ba'i cho ga ji ltar bgyi ba'i tshul la gnyis/ rdzas 'du bya ba dang / bsngo chog dngos/ dang po la/ rdzas bshams pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa gnyis/dang po snod gtsang mar zan ril me tog la sogs pa'i rdzas dang sbyar ba dang / chu dang dri dang me tog phreng ba dang / mon sran la sogs pa'i sa bon dang / mar dang sbrang rtsi la du sogs gdon rigs spyi la mthun par gsung ba rnams ji ltar rnyed pa bshams/ gnyis pa/ ye dharmā:dge sbyong chen po'i bden mthu dang / /mdo sde dkon mchog byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas 'dir mchod sbyin don slad du/ /bshams pa'i gtor ma 'di dag rnams/ /nyes skyon thams cad yongs byang nas/ /mgron rnams 'dod pa ltar 'char zhing / /sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel byed pa'i/ /74

rten snying skor/ pod/ 74she longs spyod nam mkha' gang bar shog /lan gsum/ gnyis pa la/ mgron 'gugs pa/mchod sbyin dngos/ bden stobs kyis rang gzhan gso ba/ rjes la lam bstan pa ste bzhi/ dang ngo ni/ ye dharmā: dge sbyong chen po'i bden mthu dang / /mdo sde dkon mchog byin rlabs kyis/ /sa 'og rnams dang sa steng dang / /de bzhin sa bla'i 'jig rten du/ /gzhan gnod bgyid cing rgyu ba yi/ /lha dang klu dang lha min dang / /dri za grul bum gsang ba pa/ /'dab bzang mi'am ci dang ni//lto 'phye che dang smyo brjed dang //mtshun dang tshangs pa'i srin po dang / /grib gnon gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / /sha za zhes bya'i gdon la so bas/ /dgos su bdag cag la gnod pa'i/ /'byung po gang dang su mchis pa/ /thams cad gtor ma len slad du/ /mngon par dga' nas 'du gyur cig /lan gsum/ gnyis pa la/ gtam gyis mtshams sbyar ba dang / mchod sbyin dngos la 'jug pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag gi bde ba la ltos pas/ /'byung po thams cad srog la sdug /'gro ba zas kyis gnas pa'i phyir/ /gdon yang nge la sems pa ste/ /nye 'khon med pa'i byams pa yis/ /bdag 'dir sbyin la yang dag 'jug /de phyir rab tu dga' ba yi/ /sems su gyis la legs par 'khod/ gnyis pa la/ zang zing dang / chos kyi sbyin pa gnyis las/ dang po la rnams grangs nyer gnyis kyi/ dang po/ 'byung bo mang po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /gang dag lha las gyur ba'i gdon/ /chen po'am chung ngu su 'khod pa/ /deng 'dir bdag gam yon sbyor gyi/ /rdzas las dngos su bstabs pa yi/75

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gtor ma kha dog dam pa dang / dri dang ro bda' phun sum tshogs/ / bzang po'i btung ba rnams su bcas/ /sbyangs shing bsgyur nas rab spel te/ /mchod kyis ci bder longs sa spyod/ /dge sbyong chen po'i ༄bden mthu dang / /mdo sde dkon mchog byin rlabs kyis/ /lha rnams bgo skal dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med par tshim pa dang / /rtag tu srog chags thams cad la/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig byed gyur cig /ye dharmā: gnyis pa/ 'byung po mang po'i: gang dag klu las: chen po'am chung ngu.oṃ deng 'dir bdag gam: rdzas las dngos su: gtor ma kha dog: dri dang ro bda': bzang po'i btung ba: sbyangs shing: mchod kyis ci bderaglo dge sbyong chen po'i: mdo sde dkonaglo klu rnams skal ba dman mchog gi/ rnam dbye med par: rtag tu srog chags: bde ba 'ba' zhig: ye dharmāglo gsumapa/ 'byung po mang po'iwo gang dag lha min las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am chung: deng 'dir bdag gam: rdzas las dngosaglo gtor ma kha dogaglo dri dang ro bda'awo bzang po'i btung:sbyangs shingaglo mchod kyis ciglo dge sbyong chen: mdo sde dkon: lha min bgo skal dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med par: rtag tu srog chags: bde ba 'ba': ye dharmā: bzhibar/ 'byung po mang po'i: gang dag rlung lha las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am chung: deng 'dir: rdzas las dngosaglo gtor ma khaglo dri dang ro bda': bzang po'i btung —76

zangaze bya 27 //ste//byed/ //khye/:rwa// ////shā spro// /rngo/rgosprerwaḥ// rdotāshā/sbya ngas shing: mchod kyis ci bderaglo dge sbyong : mdo sde: rlung lha'i skal〉 rnam dbye med: rtag tu srog: bde ba 'ba' zhigawo ye dharmāglolnga bar/'byung po: gang dag mkha' lding las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am:breng 'dir: rdzas las: gtor ma: dri dang : bzang po'i: sbyangs shing rte mchod kyisawo dge sbyong : mdo sdewo mkha' lding skal basmo rnam dbye: rtag tu: bde ba 'ba'awo ye dharmā: drugapar/ 'byung po: gang dag dri za lasaglo chen po'amaglo deng 'dir: rdzas lasawo gtor ma:dri dang glo bzang po'i: sbyangs shing: mchod kyisaglo dge sbyong : mdo sde/ dri za'i skal ba: rnam dbyeglo rtag tu: bde ba: ye dharmā: bdun pa/ra/ 'byung bo mang bo'i: gang dag mi ci las gyur gdon/ /chen po'amalo deng 'dir: rdzas lasaglo gtor ma: dri dngawo bzang bo'iwosbya/ngas shing : mchod kyis: dge sbyong : mdo sde: mi ci'i skal ba dam/na mchog gi rnam dbye med: rtag tu srog chagasaglo bde ba 'ba' zhig ye dharmā brgyadapar/ 'byang bo mang bo'i gang dag lto 'phye chen srubs ༷na riri shi rtagi gipo'i gdon/ chen po'am: deng 'dir: rdzas las: gtor maglo dri dngawo bzang bo'iglo sbyang shing : mchod kyis: dge sbyong : mdo sde:lto 'phye'i skal ba: rnam dbye: rtag tu: bde ba wā ye dharmā〉 dgu bar/'byung bo: gang dag gnod sbyin las gyur gdon/ / chen po: deng 'dir: rdzas las: gtor maglo dri dang〉 bzang bo'itshe sbyang shing :77

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mchod kyis: dge sbyong : mdo sde: gnod sbyin skal ba: rnam dbye med: rtag tu: bde ba: ye dharmā: bcubar/'byung bo: gang dag srin po las gyur gdon//chen po'am: deng 'dir: rdzas las: gtor ma〉 dri dang bzang bo'i sbyangs shing mchod kyis dge sbyong mdo 0) gi 0gyi gi tswasnyi gi 0) gi ཿgyi gisde: srin po'i: rnam dbye: rtag tu: bde ba 'ba' zhig〉 ye dharmā:bcu gcig par/ 'byung po: gang dag yi dwags las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am: deng 'dir: rdzas las: gtor ma: dri dang ro bda':bzang po'i: sbyangs shing: mchod kyis: dge sbyong : mdo sde: yi dwags skal baglo rnam dbyewo rtag tuglo bde ba: ye dharmā: bcu gnyis par/'byung po: gang dag sha za las gyur gdon/ chen po'am: deng 'dir: rdzas las: gtor ma: dri dang ro bda': bzang po'i:sbyangs shing : mchod kyis: dge sbyong : mdo sde: sha za'i skal ba dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye: rtag tuglo bde baspe ye dharmā〉 bcu gsum par/ 'byung bo: gang dag 'byung bo las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am: deng 'dir: rdzas las: gtor ma: dri dang : bzang po'i: sbyangs shing: mchod kyis: dge sbyong : mdo sde: 'byung po'i skal ba dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye: rtag tu: bde ba: ye dharmācha bcu bzhi bar/'byung po mang wo gang dag grul bum las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am:deng 'dir: rdzas las/ gtor ma: dri dang ro bda': bzang po'i〉 78

zla shā kya par //he//tre// //snye/15pa/ //rdo shārwa se/ /rdo//2ཿཿ// rwa/mi sbya ngas shing : mchod kyis: dge sbyong: mdo sde: grul bum skal ba dman mchog gi//rnam dbye: rtag tu: bde ba: ye dharmāwo bco lnga bar/'byung po mang glo gang dag srul po las gyur gdon//chen po'am: deng 'dir: rdzas lasaglo gtor ma: dri dang : bzang po'iglo sbyangs shing smi mchod kyis: dge sbyong : mdo sde: srul po'i skal ba dman mchog bi/rnam dbye: rtag tu: bde baglo ye dharmā: bcudrug par/'byung bo mang 〉 gang dag lus srul las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am: deng 'dir〉rdzas las: gtor ma: dri dang: bzang po'i : sbyangs shing tshe mchod kyis dge sbyong mdo sde lus sral skal ba dman mchog gi//rnam ste tswa ji zu sa rigazi dbye: rtag tu: bde ba: ye dharmā: bcubadun par/ 'byung po mang :gang dag skem byed las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am: deng 'dir: rdzas las: gtor ma: dri dang : bzang bo'itshe sbyangs shing : mchod kyis: dge sbyong : mdo sde dkon mchog: skem byed skal ba dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med paraglo rtag tu srog chags〉 bde ba 'ba' zhig: ye dharmā: bco brgyad par/ 'byung po mang po'i: gang dag smyo byed las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am chung : deng 'dir bdag gam: rdzas las dngos su: gtor ma kha dog dam pa: dri dang ro bda'〉 bzang ngo/'i〉 sbyangs shing : mchod kyis: dge sbyong chen po'i: mdo sde dkon mchog: smyo byed skal ba dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med par:79

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rtag tu srog chags: bde ba 'ba' zhig: ye dharmā: bcudagu bar/'byung bo mang po'i: gang dag grib gnon las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am chung : deng 'dir bdag gam: rdzas las dngos su: gtor ma kha dog〉 dri dang ro bda': bzang po'i: sbyangs shing : mchod kyis ci bder:dge sbyong chen po'iglo mdo sde dkon mchog: grib gnon skal ba dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med paraglo rtag tu srog chags: bde ba 'ba' zhig: ye dharmāglo nyishubar/ 'byung po mang po'i: gang dag brjed byed las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am chung ngu: deng 'dir bdag gam: rdzas las dngos su: gtor ma kha dog: dri dang ro bda': bzang po'i btung ba: sbyangs shing bsgyur nas: mchod kyis ci bderatshe dge sbyong chen po'iglo mdo sde dkon mchog: rjed byed skal ba dman mchog gi//rnam dbye med par: rtag tu srog chags: bde ba 'ba' zhigaglo ye dharmātshe nyeragacig par/ 'byung po mang po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /gang dag gnon po las gyur gdon/ /chen po'am chung ngu su 'khod pa/ /deng 'dir bdag gam yon sbyor gyi/ /rdzas las dngos su bstabs pa yi/ /gtor ma kha dog dam pa dang / /dri dang ro bda' phun sum tshogs/ /bzang po'i btung ba rnams su bcas/ /sbyangs shing bsgyur nas rab spel te/ /mchod kyis ci bder longs su spyod/ /dge sbyong chen po'i bden mtha dang //mdo sde dkon mchog byin brlabs kyis//gnon po'i ༄ 80

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7trazheskal ba dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med par tshim pa dang / /rtag tu srog chag/sa thams cad la/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig byed gyur cig /ye dharmā: nyer banyis par/ 'byung bo mang po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /gang dag mdangs dang mngal la za/ /srog 'phrog gtor ma za ba dang / /sha za ba dang khrag 'thung dang/ /zhag dang tshil bu za rnams dang / de bzhin rkang dang btsas pa za/ /dri dang me tog 'bras bu dang / /lo tog sbyin sreg za ba dang / /rnag dang phyi sa'i zas can dang / /gcin dang mchil ma ngar snabs za/ /snabs dang lhag ma za ba dang / /skyugs pa rnams dang mi satsang za/ /stor khung nas 'bab 'thung ba'i gdon/ /chen po'am chung ngu su/ 'khod pa/ /der 'dir bdag gam yon sbyor gyi/ /rdzas las dngos su bstabs pa yi/ /gtor ma kha dog dam pa dang / /dri dang ro bda' phun sum tshogs/ /bzang po'i btung ba rnams su bcas/ /sbyangs shing bsgyur nas rab spel te/ /mchod kyis ci bder longs su spyod/ /dge sbyong chen ngo/'i bden mthu dang/ /mdo sde dkon mchog byin brlabs kyis/ /gdon rnams bgo skal dman mchog gi/ /rnam dbye med par tshim pa dang / /rtas/ tu srog chags thams cad la/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig byed gyur cig /ye dharmā/ gnyisapa ni/ chos gang rgyus byung de dag gi/ /rgyud dang de 'gog kang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bstsal te/ /de skad bsung ba dge sbyong che/ /sdig pa ci yang sogs/ spro na gtor chog rgyas pa'i chos 81

21rngad/ 17 lngardo sdispyithab khur:drotha/thag byaspurngasno rngasgabastazud rta):re ba//sduspyang 'o/dra/zug/ 〈mesbyin ltar bya/ gsam pa ni/ ye dharmā/ dge sbyong chen po'i bsod nams dang/ /ye ༄shes tshad med bden mthu dang / /mdo sde dkon mchog byin rlabs dang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi snying rje dang / /byang sems nyan thos thams cad dang / /lha rnams kun gyi gzi brjid kyis/ /nyin gcig pa dang nyin gnyis sogs/ /rims rnams thams cad zhi gyur cig /shu ba me dbal la sogs pa/ /gnyan rnams thams cad: klad nad gzhoṭa phyed na ba sogs//nad rnams thams cad: lha dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa/ /gdon rnams thams cad: grib dang 'byung pos byas la sogs/ /rigs sngags thams cadawo rtsa ba mche ba'i dug la sogs/ /dug rnams thams cadaglodagra dang rgyal po'i chad pa sogs/ /'jigs pa thams cad: sdig pa'i rmi lam sna tshogs sogs/ /ltas ngan thams cadatshe zhi nas bdag cag 'khor dang bcas/ /tshe ring nad rnams med pa dang / /dbang phyug bde ba dpe med shog /de bzhin 'byung po thams cad kyang / /rtag tu byams pa la gnas shing / /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /gang mang bzla/ spro na khrus kyang bya/ bzhi ba ni/ de ltar mchod sbyin dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'byung po thams cad spyan drangs nas/ /brngan sbyin rgya cher byas zin pas/ /dus shes gyis la gzhan du dengs/ /shing gcig lha khang stong ba dang / /dur khrod la sogs 'byung bo'i gnas/ /ji ltar bde ba de dang der/ /phyi mig ma lta dga' mgur song / /zang zing sbyin pas rab mgu zhing / /chos sbyin 82

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7trashepo〉 bzang pos dul ba'i sems/ /phan tshun rtsod pa ma mchis shing / /kun tu kazhan gnod med par song / /su dag zhi ba'i yid can dang / /phan par 'dod pas gnas pa ni/ /ci bde bar ni spyod cing 'khod/ /de kun don yang 'grub par shog /'byung po gang dag gdam na yang / /byams pa'i dron la mi sems shing / /bden pa'i tshig la mi brtsi na/ /de dag mdo sde'i zhags pas brlag /gang dag mchod sbyin gyi cho gas legs par brngan zhing riṭa pa'i tshig gis bgo yang mi 'gro zhing slar la mi phan par sems pa de dag legs par gsung pa'i gzi brjid kyis nyams nalge rab tu pham par gyur cig /ye dharmā bzla/ shis brjod kyi mdo sde klog pa sogs kyang bya'o/ /rten 'brel snying bo la brten nas rnyed sla'i gtor ma bsngo ba'i cho ga rtsi sman ljon pa thes bya ba 'di'ang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas gtor chog rgyas pa nas bsdus te bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ //83

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /rten 'brel snying po la brten nas glud gtor bsngo ba'i cho ga byams chen sprin gyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo marjo/ shrī ye/ zab mo chos kyi dbyings gsungs pa'i/ /rgyal ba de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rnam dag mdo sde'i rjes 'jug pa'i/ /yid 'ong gtor ma'i cho ga bri/ /'dir rten 'brel snying bo la brten nas glud gtor gtong ba'i cho ga ji ltar bgyi ba'i tshul la gnyis/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi shom dang / cho ga dngos kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byams pa'i sems dang gtsang spra'i kun spyod la gnas nas/ dben pa'i phyogs su ba byung gis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal mda' gang ba la sogs pa ji ltar 'tshams pa byas la tshon phye las khang bzang gi rnam pa bri/ de'i dbus su gzhung nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma rnams gos dang gdugs la sogs pas brgyan te bkod/ mtha' bskor me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod bshams/ rgyas par byed na bsgrub bya'i glud gzugs gtso 'khor khang khyim rta phyugs zhing mtha' 'khor dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan dang / ma grub na ji ltar rigs pa shar nas brtsams te bsgrigs/ phyi rol du mu khyud kyi rwa ba bya/ gong du mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal la rten snying nang gzungs su bzhugs pa'i mchod rten/ mchod pa'i yo byad/ khrus bum rnams bsham mo/ /gnyis pa la/ gtor chog gi sngon du bya ba/ dngos gzhi gtor chog /de'i rjes la bya ba'i rim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzungs bzla ba'i cho ga la brten nas mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lan mang du bklag /mchod pa'i zhing rnams gshegs grub nas 'di la 'jug go/ /gnyis pa la'ang / glud gtor byin gyis rlob pa/ mgron 'gug pa/brngan sbyin gyis 'khon pa sbyang ba/ bden stobs kyis gdon dang nad pa gso ba/ lam bstan nas phyi mtshams bcad pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ ye dharmā he tu bra bha wā he turnye ṣān+ta ga to h+ya ba nga.o/ ce ṣañtsa yo mi ro za e waṃ pha bi ma ho shra ma ṇaX chos moḥ/ / /74 76 tshoḥ/ / sna/ (rwa/ tshorwasgo/ moḥ/ (me84

mi shāmi ////(35sdo //khye/:rdospro/ //rdo shāḥpa(/ / yas4ཿཿda/ 07)/dbyings shin tu rnam dag pa/ /thugs su chud nas 'di gsungs dang / / gang gis ye shes mig sbyangs pa'i/ /tshad med bsod nams phang po de'i//༄bden pas dkyil 'khor khang ba dang / /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di dag dang / /me tog la sogs yo byad rnams/ /mi mthun rdzas dang spyod lam gyis/ /sbags pa'i nyes skyon yongs dag nas/ /mgron rnams dbang po'i spyod yul du/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'byung zhing / /sdug bsngal thams cad sel byed pa'i/ /longs spyod nam mkha' gang bar shog /lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa la/ mgron 'bod dngos dang / bag phab nas 'khod du gzhug pa ste gnyis kyi/dang po ni sngar bzhin/ ye dharmāsogs/ thugs rje chen pos chos 'di yi/ /bsdu bas tshogs rnams drangs mdzad pa/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /bsdu ba rnams kyi mchog yin pa'i/ /bden pa'i tshig ni de yi mthus/ /ga/nga dag gzhan gnod bgyid pa yi/ /'byung bo sa 'og rgyu ba dang / /sa steng ri dang nags tshal dang / /kun dga' ra dang skyed mos tshal/ /rgyal po'i pho brang grong khyer dang / /tshong khang rnams dang rta yi bres/ /gnag lhas sho gam gnas rnams dang / /'brog dang khang stong sogs gnas dang / /de bzhin sa blar rgyu ba yi/ /lha klu lha ma yin pa dang / /dri za grul bum gsang ba pa/ /'dab bzang mi'am ci dang ni/ /lto 'phye che dang smyo brjed dang / /mtshun dang tshangs pa'i srin po dang / /grib gnon gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / /sha za zhes bya'i gdon la sogs/ /'jig rten 85

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skyong ba rnam bzhi dang / /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje yi/ /sde dang ris sa ༄gtogs dgu cog /sgos su bdag dang sbyin bdag gi/ /lus srog 'byor ba la sdang ba'i/ /'byung bo che phra ci mchis pa/ /phyogs 'dir sbyin pa'i mgron la 'dus/ /gang dag mchod sbyin 'di yi sgra/ /g.yeng bas ma tshor srid na yang / /phan tshun gcig la gcig sbran nas/ /ma tshang med par 'du gyur cig /lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi bde ba la ltos pas/ /'byung po thams cad srog la sdug /'gro ba zas kyis gnas pa'i phyir/ /gdon yang de la sems pa ste/ /nye 'khon med pa'i byams pa yis/ //bdag 'dir sbyin la yang dag 'jug /de phyir rab hu dga' ba yi/ /sems su gyis la legs par 'khod/ /gsum pa la zang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa bya ba gnyis/ dang po la'ang / bsngo tshig gis rgya cher bkrol ba dang / so sor tshims pa'i bden stobs brjod pa gnyis/ dang ngo ni/ spos gsur gyi dud pa gtong bzhin pas/ gang yang 'byung bo'i dkyil 'khor na/ /rang rang las kyi rdzu 'phrul can/ /lus che bzhin yang rnam par 'gyur/ /yan lag mang la khrag gis bgos//sna tshogs mdog 'chang gnod sbyin dang / /bya dang gcan gzan rnam pa sogs/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs ni sna tshogs can/ /mi rnams 'brog dang bas mtha' dang / /dur khrod rnams dang khang stong sogs/ /gcig pur gnas sam rgyu ba na/ /mdun du lus mngon snang bar byed/ /de nas mi snang lam 'dug dang / /shas cher mtshan mo sgra sgrogs shing / /bu ga darga 86

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7trashel4 nas se gol gtogs/ /nyal ba rnams la phyis gnon byed/ /sdug pa'i bud med gzugs kyis ni/ /lhan cig 'dod la bsten par bgyid/ /rmi lam sdig pa mang po dang / /gzhan yang bkra mi shis pa ston/ /'jigs dang sdig las spyod pa dang / /sngon gyi las yongs smin pa dang / /mchod par 'os rnams spangs pa dang / /gtsang sbra tshul bzhin mi byed sogs/ /srog chags rnams kyi kun spyod la/ /glags skabs rnam pa sna tshogs 'tshol/ /rigs sngags drag shul can dag gis/ /dpag tshad stong nas rab tu 'dren/ /de dag ba spu'i sgo sogs nas/ /'jug bzod phra ba'i lus can te/ /gsod 'dod gtor ma 'dod pa dang / /kha cig rtsed mo'i phyir du yang / /glags dang bcas pa'i mi rnams kyi/ /lus la 'jug cing kun tu spyod/ /de dag lus la bab pa na//khro dang dgod dang glu la dga'//rtag par mang du smra byed cing //ngu zhing phyogs su 'phyan par bgyid/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin sogs/ /de dang de yi spyod pa ston/ /nyin bzhi rtag pa'i rims la sogs/ /rims dang nad rigs mang po gtong / /skyes pa bud med byis rnams dang / /phyugs dang rta rnams la yang 'tshe nad dang nad kyi mtshan ma yang / /phyin ci log tu snang bar 'gyid/ /dmag dang 'thab mo rtsod pa 'byin/ /me dang chu yi 'jigs pa dang / /sa g.yo skar mda' ltung ba dang / /gza' skar 'jigs pa sna tshogs ston/ /grong dang yul 'khor khang khyim 'jig /dug dang bcas pa'i rlung gtong 87

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhing //chu dang rtsi tog ma rung byed/ /chu char dus bzhin 'bab pa la/ /bgegs byed sad dang ser ba gtong / /khyim du zhugs nas rdzas 'phrog cing / /zas dang nor gyi g.yang la rku/ /yang dag 'jog gi gnas rnams su/ /sgra cher 'don zhing de dag na/ /gnas pa'i sems ni rnyog par byed//su dag skal ba dman pa yi/ /mi de rnams kyi yid bsgyur nas/ /nag po'i phyogs rab 'phel bar byed/ /mdor na mi yi 'jig rten na/ /sdig dang gnod 'tsher bgrang ba'i phyogs/ /rnam pa mang po ston bgyid pa'i/ / 'byung po gang dang ji snyed pa/ /de kun 'jig rten spyi dang ni/ /bye brag bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /log par sems pa'i bsam ngan dang / /des bskyed sbyor ba ngan pa'i rigs/ /mtha' dag rnam kun spong ba'i phyir/ /chos bzhin yang dag brngan pa dang / /gzhan yang bdag gam sbyin bdag gis/ /su sngon srog las phral ba dang / /sdug pa'i gnyen dang phye ba dang / /gnas rten bcom dang longs spyod phrogs/ /de dang de la sogs tshul gyis/ /khyed la gnod pa ci bgyis pa'i/ /mkhon 'dzin cha bcas sbyang ba'i phyir/ /ser sna'i gtan pa ma mchis pa'i/ /mchod sbyin 'dod yon lnga ldan 'bul/ /gang zhig yi dwags 'jig rten du/ /mi bzad las yongs smin pa'i lus/ /ljon pa keng shu ka 'dra ba/ /chu rgyus mang pos shin tu sbrel/ /sol ba mig sman lta bu'i mdog /skra yis kha bzhin mun ltar khebs/ /mig khung zab la mchi mas g.yogs/ /sen mo 88

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zhesgo〉skor+sha43ring zhing mdog mi sdug /ba spu ring la gzing ba'i nang / /sbrang bu sha sbrang mchu rnon sogs/ /zhugs nas khab ltar 'bigs shing za/ /lus kun 'bar ba'i phreng bas dkrigs/ /lhag par bkres shing smre sngags 'don/ /skom pas nyen nas phyogs bcur rgyug /chu med ri brag 'brog rnams su/ / ngu skad 'don cing rkang lag rdol/ /de dag skyabs yod ma yin zhing / /dpung gnyen gyur pa 'ga' yang med/ /brgya lam zhig na tshegs chen pos/ /rnyed kyang tshims par mi 'thob cing / /cung zad de yang mod la skyugs/ /drod dus tsha ba brgya 'gyur dang / /grang tshe lhags pa brgya 'gyur du//brnag dka'i tshor ba skyed par byed/ /de dag chu la 'thung na yang / / rgashin rje'i skyes bu mig dmar zhing / /mchu dang lto ba rab 'phyang la ha ha'i sgra sgrogs mtshon cha thogs/ /cha byad bsgyur ba 'chang rnams kyis/ /spyo zhing shin tu rdeg par byed/ /de bzhin klu rnams kha cig ni/ /mkha' lding khro bo'i 'jigs pa dang / /me dang rig sngags bye tshan sogs/ /'jigs pa mang pos kun tu khebs/ /de sogs 'byung po thams cad la// lhan cig skyes dang glo bur gyi/ /'jigs dang sdug bsngal ci bdog pa/ /thams cad thams cad nyer zhi nas/ /rtag tu bde ba 'thob bya'i phyir/ /tshogs chas sman dgu bsdus nas 'bul/ /lus dang skye ba sna tshogs ltar//bsam pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pas/ /so so'i bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /mthun pa'i rdzas rnams ci bder bzhes/ /de yang bdag dang yon sbyor 89

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyi/ /nor las dngos su bshams pa dang / /bden pa'i stobs dang mos pa'i mthus/ /sbyangs shing bsgyur nas spel ba yi/ /khrus dang dril phyis spyad pa dang / /me tog phreng ba sna tshogs dang / /byugs pa dri zhim mang po dang / /a ka ru sogs bdug pa'i spos/ /bza' ba snum khur gsar ba dang / /mar dang bu ram la sogs su/ /bcas dang ma bcas 'bras chan dang / /de bzhin sran ma mud ga dang / /mon sran las bgyis tshod ma dang / /nas chan mar dang me tog bcud/ /bu ram shing gi bca' ba dang //shing tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /la phug lan tshwa til gyi phye/ /til gyi tshig ma'i zas dag dang / /rjen dang btsos pa'i sha rnams dang / /'o thug zho dang mngar ba'i khu/ /khrag dang chang dang chu'i btung ba/ /la sogs than mong mthan rdzas dang / /so sor sgos su 'tshams pa yi/ /gtor ma ༄ ༄ bzang la mang ba rnams/ /gser sogs bzhu dang mi bzhu ba'i/ /rin po che yi bye brag dang / /de dag rgyan du bgyis pa dang / /gos kyi khyad par du ma dang / /gdugs sogs gang la gang mthun du/ /sbyar nas ji ltar 'byor ba dang / /ci ltar nus bzhin yang dag 'bul/ /bdag gam sbyin pa'i bdag po yi/ /gnas sam lus dang longs spyod la/ /lhag par zhen zhing mi gtong na/ /dngos las bzo bkod bzang ba yi/ /khang khyim yul 'khor bcas pa dang / /gzugs byad mi las lhag pa yi/ /glud gzugs rgyan dang ldan pa dang / /rta phyugs dbyig la sogs pa rnams/ /ji lta ba 90

thongaXr /re///tre// //khye/1ཿ// ////shāḥspro// /rngo/rgo2ཿཿni/ (3mi/bzhin de las kyang / /lhag pa'i bar du byin brlabs nas/ /phul bas bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshabs sam dod du dgongs la snom/ /zhi zhing byams pa'i sems su mdzod/ /gnyisapa ni/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyar dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthas/ /lha 1do 111 /rā/ spyor spre11 ra mi 157ga na dang rnams dang / /lha sa bu sa bu mo dang / /lha yi rgas sku rgas mo dang / /lha 'khor pho dang mo rnams kun/ /spyi sgos mthun pa'i rdzas 'di dag /bzhes nas tshims shing rangs bar shog /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /bsam dang sbyor ba log pa'i dug /byung dgu glud la 'pho ba dang / /slad kyang 'byung ba med par mdzod/ /ye dharmā sogs/bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i ma/thus/ /klu gdon pho dang mo rnams dang / /klu yi bu pho bu mo dang / /klu yi rgas po rgas mo dang / /klu 'khor pho dang mo rnams kun/ /spyi sgos mthun sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /lha min pho dang mo rnams dang / lha min bu pho bu mo dang //lha min rgas po rgas mo dang / /lha ma yin 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos mthun sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang //mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /rlung lha pho dang mo rnams dang / /rlung lha'i bu pho bu mo dang / /rlung lha rgas po rgas mo dang / /rlung lha'i mngag gzhug pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di 91

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /mkha' lding pho dang mo rnams dang / /mkha' lding bu pho bu mo dang //mkha' lding rgas po rgas mo dang / /mkha' lding g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /dri za pho dang mo dag dang //dri za'i bu pho bu mo dang //dri za rgas po rgas mo dang / /dri za'i g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgo sa sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang //mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthas/ /mi ci pho dang mo dag dang / /mi ci'i ba pho ba ris mi rig mi nini/mo dang / /mi ci rgas po rgas mo dang / /mi ci'i mngag gzhug pho mo rnams//spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /lto 'phye chen po pho mo dang / /lto 'phye'i bu pho bu mo dang / /lto 'phye rgas po rgas mo dang / /lto 'phye'i g.yoka 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /gnod sbyin pho dang mo dag dang / /gnod sbyin bu pho bu mo dang / /gnod sbyin rgas po rgas mo dang / /gnod sbyin mngag gzhug pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ /ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /srin po pho dang mo dag dang / /srin po'i bu pho bu mo dang //srin po rgas po rgas mo dang //srin po'i mngag gzhug pho mo rnams//92

zangaḥ〉phangaḥmi /sde///35/ //khye/:ཿpa/ ////shā spro// /rdorngo/1ཿཿ// (tāshā/spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /yi dwags pho dang mo dag dang / /yi dwags bu pho bu mo dang / /yi dwags rgas po rgas mo dang / /yi dwags mngag gzhug pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /sha za pho dang sha za mo/ /sha za'i bu pho bu mo dang / /sha za rgas po rgas mo dang / /sha za'i g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus//'byung po pho dang mo dag dang / /'byung po'i bu pho bu mo dang / /'byung po rgas po rgas mo dang //'byung po'i g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dha rmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ grul bum pho dang mo dag dang / /grul bum bu pho bu mo dang / /grul bum rgas po rgas mo dang / /grul bum mngag gzhug pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dha rmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /srul po pho dang mo dag dang / /srul po'i bu pho bu mo dang / /srul po rgas po rgas mo dang / /srul po'i g.yog 'khor pho mo dang / /spyi sgos sogs/ yedharmā sogs/bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthas/ /lus sral pho dang mo dag dang / /lus sral bu pho bu mo dang / /rang rig nor 93

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lus srul rgas po rgas mo dang / /lus srul mngag gzhug pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /skem byed skem byed mo dag dang / /skem byed bu pho bu mo dang / /skem byed rgas po rgas mo dang / /skem byed g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /smyo byed pho dang mo dag dang / /smyo byed bu pho bu mo dang / /smyo byed rgas po rgas mo dang / /smyo byed mngag gzhug pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /grib gnon pho dang mo dag dang / /grib gnon bu pho ba mo dang / /grib gnon rgas po rgas mo dang / /grib gnon g.yog 'khor ༄ pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /brjed byed pho dang mo dag dang / /brjed byed bu pho bu mo dang / /brjed byed rgas po rgas mo dang / /brjed byed g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /gnon po pho dang mo dag dang / /gnon po'i bu pho bu mo dang / /gnon po'i rgas po rgas mo dang / /gnon po'i g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams/ /spyi sgos sogs/ ye dharmā sogs/ bka' 'di gzhan du mi 'gyur 94

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7dang / /mdo sde legs brjod bden pa'i mthus/ /mdangs 'phrog pa dang mngal la za//srog 'phrog gtor ma za ba dang / /sha za ba dang khrag 'thung dang //zhag dang tshil bu za rnams dang //de bzhin rkang dang btsas pa za//dri dang me tog 'bras bu dang / /lo tog sbyin bsreg za ba dang / /rnag dang phyi sa'i zas can dang / /gcin dang mchil ma ngar snabs za/ /snabs dang lhag ma za ba dang / /skyugs pa rnams dang mi gtsang za/ /stor khung nas 'bab 'thung ba rnams/ /spyi sgos mthun pa'i rdzas 'di dag /bzhes nas tshims shing rangs par shog /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /bsam dang sbyor ba log pa'i dug / /byung dgu glud la 'pho ba dang / /slad kyang 'byung ba med par mdzod/ /gnyisapa ni/ yedharmā sogs/chos gang rgyus byung de dag dang / /rgyu dang de 'gog gang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' bstsal te/ /de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che/ /'jig rten bde sdug mi mnyam pa/ /'di kun rgyu med ngo bo dang / /dus dang rang bzhin las skyes min/ /sna tshogs las kyi bzo bos byas/ /sa bon rtsub mo btab pa las/ /'bras bu rtsub mo rnam par smin/ /de bzhin sa bon dge ba las/ /rgya dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'byang / /rwa rwadza 45rig rigazi 45rig rigasi rmangs pa ldag la dga' ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal nyad dus sdug bsngal rgyu//phan tshun 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin/ /rgyun mi 'chad du rjes su 'jug /khyed kyang bsod nams ma yin pa'i/ /sngon byas las kyis 'dir skyes te//95

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/da dung gzhan la gnod bgyid na/ /shi 'phos 'gro ba ji ltar 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi 'tsho ba phrogs nas su/ /bdag nyid 'tsho ba lhur len rnams/ /zas kyi dgos pa tsam gyi ched/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas su yun ring brlag /ji ltar bdag la srog phangs pa/ /de ltar kun la srog phangs pas/ /rnam kun gzhan la mi 'tshe ba'i/ /tshul khrims mang du goms par mdzod/ /spron/yan lag bye brag bcu gnyis gang / /thub pas rten 'byung gsungs de dag sogs/ dbu ma rten 'brel snying bo'i gzhung bklag /sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs /bstan pa yin/ bzhi ba la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs dang / gdon rnams kyi bdag po'i bden stobs brjod pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ ye dharmā sogs/ de phyir rkang gnyis 'jig rten na/ /sangs rgyas mchog yin bden pa'i tshig /de bstan kho nar chos kyi mchog /'dod chags bral yod bden pa'i tshig /chos de mngon sam bgyis pa rnams/ /tshogs kyi mchog yin bden pa'i ༄ tshig /dkon mchog bden mthu bsam mi khyab/ /mdo sde'i nu sa pa bsam mi khyab/ /bden las mthu stobs che ba gzhan/ /'jig rten kun na ma mchis te/ /bden pas me dang chu gter dang / /sprin yang 'dod pa bzhin du byed/ /'jig rten dka' thub grub rnams kyi/ /dmod pa'i mtshon yang mi bzad na/ /bla med ye shes brnyes rnams kyi/ /gsung gi nus pa smos ci 'tshal/ /de ltar bden pa 'di dag dang / /bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ /rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur dang / /bad kan 96
