rten snying skor/ pod/ 7khyoshesgo74'dus las gyur ba yi/ /nad rnams thams cad zad pa dang / /zhi zhing rab tu zhi bar shog /mthong dang reg dang kha rlangs dang / /dmod pa rig sngags las gyur sogs/ /dug rnams thams cad nges par bcom/ /sadon kun byams dang ldan par shog /chu dang me dang gnam lcags dang / /bshes bral rnams dang dbul phongs dang / /g.yul dang rgyal po'i chad pa dang / /sdig pa'i mtshan ma sna tshogs sogs/ /mi dang mi min las byung ba'i/ /'jigs pa'i rang bzhin ji snyed pa/ /legs gsung mdo sde 'i gzi brjid kyis/ /bcom nas ldog tu med par shog /bdag dang gzhan gyi gzi byin dang / /stobs dang g.yang la brkus pa rnams/ /mdo sde'i nus pas slar phrogs nas/ /zhi dang bde legs 'gyur bar shog /gdon rnams rang rang las rjes su/ /'brel ba'i sdug bsngal ci mchis kyang / /mdo sde'i bdud rtsi 'di nyid kyis//nye bar zhi nas bde gyur cig/yul 'khor 'di dang grong 'di dang / /nad pa 'di zhes bya la sogs/ /ji ltar dmigs bzhin bsrung ba dang / /bskyab dang gzung ba 'grub gyur cig /ces brjod de gzungs chab dang / ston pa'i sku gzugs la khrus gsol ba'i khrus chab kyis bsgrub bya bkru zhing / 'byung po'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su'ang 'thor/ de 'dra ba lan ci nus bskyar/ gnyis pa ni/ ye dharmā sogasamathar/ rgyal ba nyid las mngon sum du/ /mdo 'di sngon chad thos pa yi/ /tshangs dang legs ldan sred med bu/ /dbang phyug che dang rdo rje 'chang / /dri za gtsug phud lnga pa sogs/ /mthu 97

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/che rdzu 'phrul che ba'i lha/ /de rnams kun gyi gzi brjid dang / /ming dang dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang / /nyin gcig pa dang nyin gnyis sogs/ /rims rnams thams cad zhi gyur cig /shu ba me dbal la sogs pa/ /gnyan rnams thams cad zhi gyur cig /klad nad gzhoṭa phyed na ba sogs//nad rnams thams cad zhi gyur cig /lha dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa/ /gdon rnams thams cad zhi gyar cig /grub dang 'byang pos byas la zi pa zurar rig zurang 4zer sku'i mjug zurangasags/ /rags sngags thams cad zha gyur cag /rtsa ba mcha ba' dug la sogs/ /dug rnams thams cad zhi gyur cig /dgra dang chom pos 'tshe ba sogs/ /'jigs pa thams cad zhi gyur cig /zhi nas bdag cag 'khor dang bcas/ /tshe ring nad rnams med pa dang / /dbang phyug bde ba dpe med shog /de bzhin 'byung po thams cad kyang / /rtag tu byams pa la gnas shing / /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /ces ji ltar 'tshams pa bzla/lnga pa ni/ mdos dkyil bskul te/ de ltar mchod sbyin dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'byung bo thams cad spyan drangs nas/ /brngan sbyin rgya cher byas zin pas/ /dus shes kyis la gzhan du dengs/ /shing gcig lha khang stong ba dang / /dur khrod la sogs 'byung po'i gnas/ /ji ltar bde ba de dang der/ /phyi mig ma lta dga' mgur song / /snying brtse phyogs su ma lhung bas//ci 'dod phangs pa ma mchis par/ /bstabs pa'i rdzas 'dis mgu byos la/ /phan tshun rtsod pa med par dengs/ /zang zing sbyin pas rab mgu 98

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7tshar zhing //chos sbyin bzang pos dul ba'i sems/ /mthun pa'i spyod yul 'ba' zhig nas/ /gzhan gnod ma byed drang por song / /su dag zhi ba'i yid can dang / /phan par 'dod pas gnas rnams ni/ /ci bde bar ni spyod cing 'khod/ /de kun don yang 'grub par shog /'byung po gang dag gdams na yang / /byams pa'i drin la mi sems shing / /bden pa'i tshig la mi brtsi na/ /de dag mdo sde'i zhags pas brlag /de dag lus la sha bkra dang / /phol mig mi bzad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de yi bu pho thu bo yang //mdo sde'i chad pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mthu chen rgyal po sde bzhi yi/ /gzhal med khang ba nyams dga' dang / /nyams dga'i 'byor ba rgya chen kun/ /mthong bar yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /'byung po mang po'i zas gral du/ /stan dang chu yang mi 'thob ste/ /de dag rgyal po'i chad pa yis/ /gnas nas gnas su smrod par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i g.yog 'khor rdzu 'phrul can/ /bzhon pa sna tshogs la zhon nas/ /phyogs bzhi yongs su skyong rnams kyang / /mtshon cha mang po 'phen par byed/ /de phyir bden pa'i tshig nyan nas/ /grong khyer bsrung ba 'di thongs la/ /byin pa'i mdos glud 'a di nyid bzhes/ /da lta nyid du so sor dengs/ mdos btegs la/ spos dud rol mo'i sgra la sogs pas mdun bsus te/ 'byung po gang dag mchod sbyin gyi cho gas legs par brngan zhing rigs pa'i tshig gis bgo yang mi 'gro zhing slar la mi phan par sems pa de dag legs par gsungs pa'i gzi brjid kyis 99

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tranyams nas rab tu pham par gyur cig /ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥsogs ci rigs bzla/ glud gtor rnams srang mdo dang chu klung la sogs pa 'byung po 'du ba'i phyogs su skyel bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gser la sogs pas bris pa'i rten 'brel snying bo'i glegs bam rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te spos rol dang ba dan la sogs pa mchod sprin chen po dang bcas pas grong khyer ram khyim mam yul 'khor gang bsrung bar 'dod pa de skor zhing / de dang de'i dbus su mchod ston rgya cher bshams pa'i dkyil du btsugs la dge 'dun rnams mdun du 'khod de yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa nas gsungs pa sogs bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa bklag /rgyal mtshan bkur snyi chen po dang bcas pas rang gnas su spyan drangs par bya'o/ /de ltar ma grub na'ang shis brjod kyi mdo sde klog pa sogs bya'o/ /'gro mang sdug bsngal las skyob phyir/ /gso chog bzang bo 'di sbyar bas/ /sems can thams cad byang chub kyi/ /bde ba mi zad la reg shog /rten 'brel snying bo la brten nas glud gtor bsngo ba'i cho ga byams chen sprin gyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'di'ang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas rang nyid bgrang bya nyer drug tu son pa lcags stag rgyal gyi nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa phyi ma la legs par grub par bgyis pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad bde legs kyi dpal la longs spyod par gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga lam̐/ /100

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7r+sha༄/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i gzungs bzla ba'i cho ga sprin chen rnam par rol ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang thub dbang shākya seṅge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cho ga 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu bsam pa nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres shing / sbyor ba gtsang sbra dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dus bzang bo chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bzhi lta bur/ gnas khang byi dor bya zhing chag chag gdab/ spos kyi maṇ+ḍal chen po'i dbus su tshon nam phye ma'am me tog gis sazhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'gram loṭa med pa'i sgo khyud can rtsig pa'i steng na bre phul gyis btegs pa'i rgya phis bzang bos mdzes pa/ phyi rol skyed mos tshal tha gru yangs pa la khrus rdzing dang / nags tshal/ me tog brdal ba sogs bkod pa mang bos spras pa/ pha gu sgo khang bzhi bas mtha' brtsigs pa/ pho brang gi dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pas mtshan pa zhig bri/ pad+ma'i lte bar gzungs bum bzang po drug dang tsan+dan dang ga bur la sogs pa dri bzang gi chab kyis rgatams par 'bras bu can gyi shing gi kha rgyan btsug pa bkod/ de'i steng du mnywa'i khar rin po che'i yol go'i nang du skabs 'dir rten snying zlos bzhin par btab pa'i sats+tsha gzungs ldan lnga la sogs pa gser gyis byugs te bzhag /'dab ma rnams su'ang re re/ de'i mdun ngos su gzungs bum 'jog /gang ltar yang phyogs bzhir bum pa gang ba bzhi dang / gra bzhir pog phor bzhi 'god/ gzhan yang mchod yon dang me tog sogs mchod pa bzang la mang bas mtha' bskor/ steng du 'phan gdugs bla re sogs kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /bar 'dir rgyal ba'i yum drug po gang rung dang / zla ba sgron me dang / rten 'brel gyi mdo la sogs pa gsung rab khyad pa/ra can mang bo klog cing gzhan la yang klog tu 'jug /de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin 10/

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyis mi skye mi 'gag pa'i de kho na nyid la yud tsam mnyam par bzhag ste/ kye ma chos kyi dbyings ni 'di ltar rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag kyang de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can byis pa long ba lag nyug byed pa lta bu rnams 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga ba 'di nyid du shul lam ring bor dub pa'i mgron po bzhin du nyon mongs par mthong nas/ de rnams kyi ched du re zhig bdag gis phyogs 'dir thub dbang rgyal ba sras bcas gdan 'dzoms par gsol nas gzungs sngags kyi cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskang bar bgyi ste/ phyis ni bdag nyid thabs kyi rol ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don la 'jug go snyam du legs par bsam la/ cho ga dngos ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar gyur ba'i gzhir/ gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa legs pas mdzes shing lhun stug pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i lte bar de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i mchod rten rgyan dang bkod pa tshad med pas mngon par 'phags pa mang pos rom mer dkrigs pa'i nang khongs su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ mtha' bskor kun tu 'phags pa so so'i mnga' thang 102

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zhe'amaskuradang 'tshams pa'i gdan khri grangs med pa dang / phyi nang kun tu'ang cha rigs dang 'tshams par lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang / na bza' dang / rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs pa phung bo gsum pa'i mdo dang / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan pa 'byung bar gyur cig /rten 'brel snying bo lan bdun dang mchod pa/'i sprin gyi gzungs bzla/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de de bzhin du gyur cig /cesabarjod/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan sogs nas/sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa chen po'o/ /bar dkon mchog rjes su dran pa'i mdo'i dum bu 'don/ de nas langs la spos snod dang ril ba thogs bzhin pas/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis deng bdag cag gis theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang gzungs sngags zab cing rgya che ba bklag cing / de gzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i mchod rten bgyi ba'i cho ga gzugs brnyan tsam zhig bsgrub pa 'di gleng gzhir mdzad nas/ bdag cag la thugs brtse ba dang skye bo mang po la sman pa 103

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tradang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos brgyan pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bshams pa 'dir rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de/ byin gyis rlabs par ci gnang / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon sogs/ gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /zhes mgon po sras bcas mngon sum du byon pa lta bu'i nges shes skyed cing rol mo'i dbyangs sgra rgya cher bgyid du stsal/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa sogs nas/ bzhugs su gsol/ /khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi: de bzhin gshegs pa: rnam dag sku mnga': ye shes rgya mtsho: grags pa: mgon po mchog gyur khyod la sku khrus gsol/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul ni rab bzung nas/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad gyur pa/ /rab dga' la sogs sa la bzhugs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la sku khrus gsol/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong ba dang / /dgra bcom rigs gyur skyes bu 104

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zhekhyozung bzhi dang / /tshogs na spyod dang bse ru lta bu yi/ /'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la sku khrus gsol/ /zhes shwa lo ka phyi ma bzhi bo'i mtshams su khrus chab bzed zhal du phul/ de dag sku la: sku phyi'o/ /zhes me long la ras kyis phyi/ de nas de la kha dog: rgyan mchog brgya phrag dag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /zhesan bza' phul/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i sogs/ bzhugs su gsol/ /sto nga gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas/ /bde zhing yangs pa 'bul lags na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol//'es bzhugs gsol gdan bstab bgyis mthar/ rang gi stan las langs te phyag byed bzhin pa sa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang rkang bar ldan pa/ bde bar kashegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i zhabs kyi pad+ma rnyog pa dang bral ba la yan lag mchog gis btud de phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bskyar/ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag gi spyan sngar dngos su bshams pa dang / gzungs dang / rig pa dang / mos pa'i stobs las byung ba'i/me tog dang / bdug spos dang / mar me dang / byugs pa dang / phreng ba dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla re dang / sil snyan dang rdza rnga/ dung dang rnga bo che la sogs 105

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgo〉zhepa rol mo'i khyad par mang po dang / zhabs rten dang / gzim cha dang /gtsug lag khang dang / kun dga' ra ba dang / 'chag sa dang / snyun gyi gsos sman dang / bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / btung ba dang /bldag pa'i bye brag rigs mi gcig pa/ bzang zhing gya nom pa mang pos chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bkang ste/ bsnyi stang du bgyi'o/ /btsun par bgyi'o/ /ri mor bgyi'o/ /mchod do/ /gsol lo/ /rim gror bgyi'o/ /rten snying bzla zhing rol mo 'bud dkrol brdung ba'i rigs thams cad bya/ de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas phul na mchod pa chung ngu gang mang zhing rgya che bar 'gyur te thabs la mkhas pa'i le'u las shes par bya'o/ /yan lag lhag ma lnga ni/bdag gis 'khor ba thog ma'i mtha' thug pa ma mchis pa nas bzung ste/dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang / 'phags pa la skur ba btab pa dang /dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor phrogs pa dang / pha dang ma dang mkhan po dang slob dpon la gnod pa bgyis pa dang / sems can kyi khams lta ba log pa la btsud pa dang / sems can yang dag pa'i sgrub pa la gnas pa rnams kyi bar chad bgyis pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba log par bsngo ba sa bsngos pa dang / mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la zhugs pa dang /'jug tu bstsal pa dang / 'jug pa la rjes su yi rang pa la sogs/ sgrib pa gang gis bsgribs nas bdag mi dge ba'i phyogs mngon du 'gyur zhing dge ba'i phyogs la mi 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / sems can 106

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7tra dmyal ba dang / yi dwags kyi 'jig rten sogs ngan 'gro log par lhung ba'i skye gnas rnams su mchi bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi nongs pa gang lags pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mthol lo//'chags so//slan chad kyang sdom par bgyi lags so//gang sngon dang da ltar gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams sbyin pa dang /tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub cing sgrub pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las skyes pa'i rig pa dang rnam par grol ba khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang / bsam gtan dang mngon par shes pa rtogs par 'gyur ba dang / ngan 'gro'i 'jig rten las yang dag par 'da' ba dang / tshe ring ba dang / nad med pa dang /kazugs bzang ba dang / gzi brjid che ba dang / dbang che ba dang /longs spyod dang shes rab che ba la sogs pa mngon par ma tho ba'i yon tan gyi khyad par yongs su 'dzin pa dang / tha na de bzhin gshegs pa la dmigs nas/ thal mo gcig sbyor ba dang / me tog gcig 'bul ba dang / sems dang ba gcig tsam skyed pa'i sems can gang lags pa de dag thams cad la rjes su yi rangs ste/ rjes su yi rang ba'i mchog gis rjes su yi rang ngo / /phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi 107

21rngad/ 11 lngardo /spyirngab 'o/:drothanathag byaspudzod ngas/rtozud rta):re pe/sdosapang 'o/dra/zug/ stanakhams na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bla na med pa'i ye shes bdud rtsi lta ba brnyes kyang sems can gyi khams 'di bka' blo mi ༄bde bar mkhyen nas cang mi gsung bar thugs khral chung ngur thugs/ 'jog par mdzad pa de dag la bdag bskul ma 'debs te/ skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba dang / skye bo'i tshogs mang po'i don dang / lha dang mi rnams la sman pa dang / bde ba'i slad du sa gsum na dge sbyong dang bram ze/bdud dang tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i skye dgu'i 'jig rten sus kyang sngon chad yongs su ma bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba skor du gsol/ chos kyi dung kun nas 'bud du gsol/ chos kyi rnga bo che rdung du gsol/ chos kyi sgron me 'bar bar mdzad du gsol/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams dpag tu ma mchis pa rnams na sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad de/ sems can gdul ba'i tshogs smin par mdzad pa dbang du gyur ba/ /dbang du ma gyur ba rnams 'dus byas kyi dngos po la yid 'byung ba bskyed pa'i slad du/ mya ngan las 'da' bar thugs gzhol zhing sku tshe 'dor bar mdzad pa de dag la bdag gis gsol ba 'debs te/'jig rten lam gol ba la zhugs shing / sdig pa'i grogs pos zin pa/mi shes pa'i mun nag chen pos khebs pa rnams la thugs brtse bar 108

tro rten snying skor/ pod/ 7zhezhesgo〉dgongs te phyi ma'i mu mthar sku tshe'i 'du byed rnams byin gyis brlab tu kasol/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzoms pa'i spyan sngar phyag mchod phul zhing bsod nams kyi phung po gsum mngon par 'du bgyis pa sogs la brten nas/ bdag gi skye ba nas skye ba/ tshe rabs kyi phreng ba kun tu snying rje chen po yongs su mi nyams pa dang / byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mason gyis rjes su bzung ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam gyi rgyun mi gcod cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzogs smin sbya/nga ba'i spyod pa thams cad ring por mi thogs par yongs su rdzogs te/nge/ bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang lus mnyam pa dang / ngag mnyam pa dang / ye shes mnyam pa dang / phrin las mnyam par gyur cig /spro na mchod pa/ rma/na chad kyi yan lag phyi ma drug po'i tshig ris kyang lan gsum rer bskyar/ de nas thugs dam bskru la zhing smon lam gdab pa ni/ deng 'dir bdag cag gis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzoms pa chen por gyur ba'i spyan sngar/ che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du gsol zhing mchi na/ 'phags pa'i byin rlabs dang thugs rje tshad med pa mnga' ba rnams kyis/ de de bzhin du 'grub par byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / bdag cag rnams la sngon gyi sdig pa'i las sna tshogs kyi rnam par smin pa yang rung / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur kyang rung ste/ da ltar gyi 109

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lus 'di la nad kyi rnam pa mang pos gdung ba dang / mi dang mi ma yin pas ngan du bgyis shing gtses pa dang / tshe thung ba dang / sdug bsngal mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / 'khor dang yo byad mi mthun pa dang /don nyams shing bar du gcod pa mang ba la sogs pa gnod pa dang /mi bde ba dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / ngan pa dang / sdig tor bgrang ba thams cad zhi zhing gtan du mi 'byang bar gyar cig /'phral du yang tshe zudag pha rig skur mag sna rigang ()(1 zugacig zi porang ba dang / nad mad pa dang / 'khar dang byad mthun zhang 'byar ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin tu 'grub pa la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig /tshe rabs thams cad du yang byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i lus dang / longs spyod dang / 'khor dang / grogs dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan te/ rtag tu theg pa chen po'i chos dang 'phrad cing /thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i sgo nas don mngon sum du bgyid par gyur cig /mdor na sems can thams cad kyi don bgyi zhing /'phags pa'i lam sgrub pa la yo byad ci nas kyang mi bzung zhing / thabs mkhas pa dang / shes rab kyi mthu thogs pa ma mchis pa'i shugs kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che thams cad bde blag kho nar nyams 'og tu chud par gyur cig /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 110

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7khyot+yā yongs su rdzogs pa g.yung drung gi sku sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang chen po myur du thob nas sems can thams cad srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la 'god par gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpar gyur ba na rlabs po che'i smon lam 'di skad du/ sems can gang dag bdag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung rnams la rin po che rnams dang / rol mo'i sgra dag gi bar gyis mchod pa bgyid par spro ba skye bar 'gyur ba dang / tha na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gcig tsam dang / phyag lgecig tsam dang / bskor ba gcig tsam dang / thal mo sbyar ba gcig tsam dang / me tog gcig tsam gyi rgyus mchod par bgyid par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du theg pa gsum po dag/ gis slar mi ldog par gyur cig /sems can gang dag bdag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bstan pa la tha na bslab pa'i gzhi lgacig tsam 'dzin par 'gyur ram/ ji skad bstan pa bzhin du yang dag par blangs nas gnas sam/ tshig bzhi ba'i tshigs su bcad pa kacig tsam gyi bar dag kun chub par bgyid dam/ klog gam/ gzhan dag la yang ston par 'gyur ba dang gang gis thos nas sems rab tu dang bar 'gyur zhing / tha na dam pa'i chos smra ba la me tog gcig tsam dang phyag gcig tsam gyis mchod pa bgyid par 'gyur ba de dag thams 111

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cad kyang bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du theg pa gsum po dag gis slar mi ldog par gyur cig /ces byang chub sems dpa'i ngag bden pa'i zha'/ gyis bzhes pa dang / dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnas su lha dang mi'i 'jig rten bsod nams 'dod pa rnams la thugs brtse nas/ gzungs sngags kyi rgyal po chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo'i yon tan las brtsams te/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo'i gzungs sngags byin gyis brlabs shing / dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'di lta ste/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku yin te/ sas rten cing 'brel ༄bar 'byung ba mthong ba des de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ngo / /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can gang la la zhig gis mi gnas pa'i phyogs su mchod rten ni skyu ru ra'i 'bru tsam/srog shing ni khab tsam/ gdugs ni ba ku la'i me tog tsam zhig byas la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi tshigs su bcad pa nang du bcug na de tshangs pa'i bsod nams skyed par 'gyur te/ zhes bka' bstsal ba la sogs te/ mdor na ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis bka' lung tshad mar sgrub pa dang / 'phags pa so so'i sngon gyi thugs dam rlabs po che yongs su bskang bar gtso bor dgongs shing /112

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7trad+kudakon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs dang / gzungs rnams kyi mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang du mdzad de/ ji ltar smon pa'i don thams cad 'phral du 'thob par byin gyis rlob par ci gnang / zhes snyim pa'i me tog gis mchod cing lan gsum bzla/ de ltar 'phags ji/ sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa ma dag pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sto/bas kyis/ deng bdag cag gis legs par bshams shing brgyan ba'i sanas 'dir/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo'i tshigs su bcad pa'i gzungs dang chos kyi sku'i mchod rten 'di dag byin gyis rlob par mdzad de/ bdag sogs 'gro ba mang po'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad par gyur cig chos kyi sku'i mchod rten la sazungs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i yig 'bru gser gyi phreng ba bzhin du gnas pa dang / 'phags pa rnams kyi sku las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ des 'phags pa thams cad sems can gyi don la bskul zhing ngan song gi gnas thams cad sbyangs te sems can tham/sa cad mtho ris dang thar ba'i go 'phang la 'jug par gyur cig / 'od zer des bdag cag rnams la khyab pas 'gro don dpag med sgrub nus pa'i mthu thob ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang sku gsung thugs mtshungs par gyur cig /yang 'od zer de dag gcig tu 'dus 113

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nas bum pa'i gzungs chab la khyab ste reg pa tsam gyis gnod pa dang /bkra mi shis pa dang mi bde ba thams cad zhi bar byed pa/ dpal dang bde legs thams cad skyed par byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i dag byed du gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa bsgrub bya'i lus dang 'khor dang yo byad thams cad la khyab ste/ nad dang gnod pa thams cad ni bsal/ lus sems kyi skyon thams cad dang ni bral te chos kyi snod rung du gyur cig /bdag cag gis sems kyi dmigs pa 'ga' bskyed pa dang / gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'bru 'ga' brjod pa yang 'phags pa rnams kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sna tshogs dang / tshig 'bru mtha' yas pas rdzogs shing rnam par dag par byin gyis rlob par gyur cig /ces lan gsum bldab/ de nas/'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab sogs/ 'phags pa sa lu'i ljang bu dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa'i mdo dang / spro na mdo'i dum bu gzhan yang klog /de lta bu'i sgo nas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la yid mngon du phyogs par bzhag ste/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /'gags pa med pa sogs/ dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod nas gzungs bzla ba dngos ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ ye dharmā nye tu pra bha wā he turnye ṣan+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ tshogā / dzorwab/bā di ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/ zhes stong phrag la sogs pa bzla/ bsgrub bya dmigs bsal ba yod na dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du ku sha'i stan la gos dkar bo gtsang ma bgos te bzhag /de 1 14

phangashāmi /sde//(35sdo //khye/15shā/ ////shāḥspro// //sdos4ཿཿni/ rdokāskyu/bzhin gshegs pa la phyag dang me tog 'bul du bcug /gang la ser sna rnam chag sa pa sogs 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo'i dum bu dang / 'jig rten 'di'am gang dag 'das pa dang sogs stong chen mo rab tu 'jom pa las gsungs pa'i shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis khrus bya/ khrus gsol dang gzungs chu'i bdud rtsi gnyis ka 'thung du gzhug/de lta bu mi nus na'ang bar 'dir gzungs chab 'thor 'thung bya/rjes la mchod pa/ kha gso zhing / ji snyed su dag sogs/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi ā hūṃ sogs/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ nyi ma zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ston pa bcom ldan 'das sras dang slob mar bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa chen por gyar ba'i spyan sngar 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thags rjes rini mi rig pho'agro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol sogs nas/ gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse rno/ra rgya mtsho yi/ /rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin kān/ nas rgyas pa'i snying bo la/ /lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rmad 'di 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgyar legs gnas pa/ /kun tu bzang bo'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul ba'i mchod sprin 'di/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun 115

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ khyertseshikun la khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid bar/ /rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal bo rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas/ /kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pa'i mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig /me tog dam pa sogs nas/ phyir bsngo'o/ /bsdu na maṇ+ḍal phul ba kho nas kyang rung / ji ltar yang mthar/ deng 'dir bdag cag gis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom par spyan drangs nas/ phyag mchod phul zhing sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can las/ gleng te gsol ba btab pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ bdag cag la sogs/ pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying bo'i mthar thug gi bar du phyi dang nang gi 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal/ mtha' dag zhi zhing bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan nga/ra gyur cig /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ rnams kyi phyag gser gyi kha dog can spyi bor 'jog cing / dran pa ma/ nyams pa'i rgyud kyis bde bar shi 'phos te sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar pad+ma'i snying bo las rdzus te skye zhing gdams ngag thob nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /phan bde'i rtsa lag bde bar gshegs pa'ibyudam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas shing yi ger 'bri ba dang /mchod pa dang / klog pa dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa'i sgo sna tshogs nas 'jig rten thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa dang / de 'dzin gyi skyes bu 116 di

rten snying skor/ pod/ 7trapo'idam pa rnams kyang sku tshe dang phrin las zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /ces gsol ba btab/ de nas bzod gsol bya ba ni thal mo sbya ra ba btud de/ 'phags pa gdan 'dzoms pa chen po dgongs su gsol/ngeng 'dir phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa thams cad gdan 'dzom par spyan drangs nas bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad par sasol ba'i skabs 'dir/ bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma dag pas ma 'tshal ba dang / bag ma mchis pa'i dbang this lus ngag yid kyis sbyor ba nyon mongs pa dang 'dres pa dang /mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing gtsang sbras ma phyed pa dang / gzungs sngakas kyi cho ga tshul bzhin ma lcogs pa la sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs nga/ra gyur ba gang lags pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang lda/na pa rnams la bzod pa dang tshangs par gsol te mthol zhing 'chags par khum na/ thugs brtse bar dgongs te bzod par bzhes thing 'phral dang yun du bdag cag gi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin kyis brlab tu gsol/ gshegs su gsol ba ni/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ 'phags pa thusas rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba nyam thag pa mang po'i don mdzad cing bka' drin bstsal lags te/da dung yang bdag cag la thugs brtse bas yang dang yang du gdan 'dzom par mdzad par dgongs shing so so'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams 117

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/su 'gro ba mang po'i don la gshegs pa stsol tu ci gnang / de nas rgyas par spro na bzang bo spyod pa'i smon lam mam bsdu na/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang bo de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang bo spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa ji ltar riṭa pas/ mtha' brgyan/ rdul tshon chu bor gshegs shing lhas zhus pa sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad mang bos klu rnams la phan gdags/ de ltar brtson pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rgyud byin gyis rlobs shing / tshangs pa dang / sred med bu dang / brgya byin rdo rje can la sogs pa gzungs 'di phyag mtshan du bzhes pa'i lha rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams kyang mngon par dga' nas rtag tu bsrung ba dang mgon bgyid pa'i mthus/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye she4 dang gzi byin dang rigs brgyud la sogs pa srid zhi'i dge mtshan mtha' dag gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang / sdig pa dang ltas ngan dug dang bgegs dang dbul phongs la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i rkyen ngan thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang myur du rig sngags kyi las thams cad 'grub pa la sogs pa brtsam pa don yod pa'i yon tan mthong ba'i chos la dmigs par 'byung ba ni rig sngags 'chang bum pa bzang bo grub pa bzhin no/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo'i gzungs bzla ba'i cho ga sprin chen rnam par rol ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'ji ni rang gzhan mang po la phan gdags pa'i slad du mdo khams pa kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang bos rang lo nyer lnga pa bi ro rnyi zhes pa sa rlo/ glang gi lo'i sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa'i nyin mdo sde gnyis dang dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho'i gzhung la brten nas rgyal rong brag lha mgon po'i gnas dang nye ba'i sa'i cha 1 18

21rngad/ 17 zerdo /spyorngaku 'o/:dropo/thag byaspuspyad ngas/lngazug rta)stu) po/ṭa/khung khuradra/zug/ 4〉༄/ /bstan pa'i byung ba cung zad brjod pa bzhugs so/slob dpon rin po ches rje 'bangs rnams kyi brjed byang du man ngag lta phreng mdzad par grags shing / de dus sa rgyan gnyis dang mdo btus/ phar phyin bsdus pa bslab btus/ spyod 'jug rin phreng sogs bstan rim mang bo dang / phal chen sogs shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod du ma la bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa'i kha byang da lta yang glegs bam 'a/ 'byar bzhin pa dang / de dag dang mthun pa'i brjed byang sogs bstan bcos kyang mdzad pa mang la/ dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / de'i legs bshad dbu ma rgyan la brten nas bstan pa'i sgrom bzung bar gsal lo/ /phyis hā shang gis yid la mi byed pa bstan pa na yang bai ro 'a sogs pa'i sngon gyi rje 'bangs chen po rnams kyis than mthong ba ltar mdzad de/ kā ma la spyan drangs nas bstan pa dag ther mdzad du bcus pa'i skabs su/ jo bos bod du bstan pa la byi dor bya ba'i slad du lam sgron mdzad pa'i dod ni sgom rim gsum dang rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzangs 'grel sogs yin pas/ lta phreng gi than mong lam rim yang nge ra༄༄mi rig midag gi 'gros su bshad par bya'o/ /sna nam ye shes sde'i lhag ma thong si 120

bstan pa'i byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ pod/ 7r+shatsuyi ge sogs na lta ba'i 'jog mtshams zhi 'tsho'i lugs kho na ltar yod cing / tshig gsal dang 'jug pa rtsa 'grel sogs de dus bsgyur ba mi sna nga bas/ deng sang thal 'gyur lugs la phyogs mos byed pa'i dod po rmi rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rang rgyud la mdzad par nges so/ /gter chos zol/ med rnams su yang thun mong la lam rim spyi ltar 'byung zhing / phyis kun mkhyen klong chen pas rdzogs chen gyi bstan pa gzhi nas gso skabs kyang thun mong gi bstan rim lam sgron ltar mdzad nas/ de'i bla brgyud sem/sa nyid ngal gso'i khrid yig tu 'dren pa na yang bka' gdams brgyud pa bgrangs snang bas/ deng sang bka' gdams lam rim nas 'byung ba'i lam gyi 'gros 'di rnying ma ba rnams kyi lugs cher min zhes smra ba la ni bdag mi dad de/ snga 'gyur ba byed na de'i dang po'i khungs rnyos mas ma bslad pa de rtsad bcad nas de dang bstun na mdzes kyi/ngan rtogs bye ba brgyas sbags nas mgron po phyogs bslad lta bur song ba'i dus phyis kyi rnying rlom phal dang mi bstun te/ 'di ni bdag gi bla ma/'i man ngag go/ /de bzhin du rgyud sde'ang sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bya spyod kyi skor rgyud dang bcas pa rnying ma yin pa(a ba ta ra)sogs dang /bla med kyi gsang 'dus kyang 'gyur gsar rnying gnyis ka yod pa sogs ltar gung sgrig shes dgos te/ gsar rnying 'di 'gyur gyi khyad kho nas phye bas/ sngags kyi rgyud sde la gsar rnying gang yang min pa mkha' 'gro ma'i 121

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/〈ri'ajig rten na bzhugs pa'i sngags rgyud phal cher lta bu sogs mu bzhi'ang brtsi btub par gsal/ gu ru nyid thun mong gi snang ngor ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma yin pas lta ba'i bzhed pa'ang de ltar mdzad cing /de dus bod du sde snod kyi srog shing mdzad pa'i slob dpon zhi 'tsho'i bzhed pa dang sgo bstun pa sogs kyi dbang gis lta phreng 'di dang / bde/ 'dus pad+ma gsung gi tha ram sogs las nyan rang gis chos kyi bdas med ma rtogs pa la sogs pa gsungs pa yin te/ grub chen lwa ba pas bde mchog gi gzhung du/ sems tsam lugs kyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes zhal gyis bzhes pa 'dra zhes bod kyi shing rta chen pos gsungs pa dang /bdag sgrub pa las kyang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i gzhung bzung ba lta bu yin no/ /des na kho bo ni/ de dag rnying ma ba'i thal 'gyur lugs yin zhes mi smra'o/ /'on kyang thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba 'dzin pa dang / gsang sngags rnying ma pa yin pa ni cung zad kyang mi 'gal te/ gsang sngags rnying ma ni mdo sgyu sems gsum sogs yin la/de dag gi lam srol 'dzin pa dang thal 'gyur ba yin pa gnyis la 'gal ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan du na 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs pa la yang rang rgyud pas khyab par thal lo/ /snga 'gyur dang / gsang sngags snga 'gyur ni mi gcig ste/ mdo sde dang / phar phyin gyi bstan bcos snga 'gyur yod pa'i phyir ro/ /bstan pa snga dar phyi dar dang /122

bstan pa'i byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ pod/ 7tra trasas/ra rnying yang don mi gcig ste/ snga ma ni 'dul ba'i bstan pa la ltos nas 'jog cing phyi ma gsang sngags la ltos te 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gang yang glang dar mas bstan pa la rked nyag ches chen po btod pa'i dbang gis so sor phye ba byung ngo / /rgyud sde so so'i man ngag rnams phan tshun sre mi rung yang / snga 'gyur dang phyi 'gyur byas pa tsam gyis tsha grang ltar 'dzin dgos par go ba mang bas chos rgyus zhib pa gal che'o/ /'phag/sa yul gyi paṇa grub bod du byon pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la yang / rgya gar du bzhugs dus dang / bod du brtsams pa sanyis dang / phyi ma la'ang / dang po legs sbyar du brtsams nas gdod bsgyur ba dang / dang po nas bod skad du brtsams pa gnyis yod de/ phyi ma/ 'di gnyis rtsom gyi rus tshugs ches mi 'dra bar snang ngo / /lhag par skad bsar bcad kyis phogs ma phogs gnyis la gser dngul mdog 'don byas ma byas kyi khyad tsam ga/da' 'o/ /mchan/ /glang dar mas rgyal bstan bsnub pa'i dbang gis da lta sgyu 'phrul sogs sngon dus bsgyur ba'i rgyud sde rnams kyi man ngag satsa nga ma bka 'a brgyud bar ma chad pa las 'ong ba ci la yod snyam na/de skabs kyang khyim pa gos dkar gyi rten la gsang sngags sgrub pa'i mkhus grub dag ni nang gi de nyid rgyal blon gyis ma rtogs shing / rab byung gi rtags med pas gnod pa ma byung ba ches mang ste/ 'gos lo chen pos/ de ltar 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung mod kyi theg pa 123

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/spre 42〉chen po gsang sngags ni deng sang gi bar du nub ma myong la/ zhes gsungs pa'ang de la dgongs so zhes lnga ba chen pos bshad de/ /'thad pa che'o/ /ring brgyud bka' ma zhes pa'ang bla ma'i bka' las bla ma'i bkar brgyud pa zhes bshad rgyu yin par gter gsar du gsungs te/mthun snang rags pa dang sgrigs dgos so/ /gter chos gyi khungs ni da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum pa dang / bden pa po dang / bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa dang / chos yang dag par bsdus pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde'i shes byed dang / /dpal mchog sogs kyang bzhugs te cung zad sla/ de la nye brgyud yod tshul ni glegs bam rnyed pa tsam dang de rnyed rjes kyi zhal gzigs lung bstan sogs tsam 'di tsam la 'jog na gter brgyud dang dag snang brgyud pa la khyad gsal bar 'byed rgyu med par 'gyur ro/ /la mi 'jog go/ /'o na ci zhe na/ sngon slob dpon rin po che sogs las chos bka' de dang de snod rung gi dbang bskur mtshan nyid tshang ba bcas thob nas dam tshig dag par bsrung ba'i rgyu mthun gyis skye ba gzhan du'ang sngags kyi tshul khrims ma 'chal zhing tshul khrims ldan pa'i smon lam chud mi za bar gsungs pa ltar gyi smon lam sngon song yod pa'i gnad gyis da lta gsang sngags kyi chos gter de dang de lag tu 'ong ba yin la/ de'ang chos kyi shog ser mthong ma thag la sogs par dran gso'i skud mdud sogs mthong ba ltar sngon de dang de'i dbang 124

maḥ〉 /ba/rtozug spras:re /bye/kyang /ba sde:kyang canarngod /ba:dz+dzarngod/ /ku/ 1rngos/rnga// rwa'i/gdams ngag thob pa'i bag chags gsal bor sad par 'gyur ba ni rang gi las 'phro dang / bla ma mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyi lag rjes yin no/ /'di ni bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs dang rang shar gyi dbang chu'i babs lugs lo rgyus gnyis ji bzhin du mgrin gcig par/ /de ltar dbang gi chu bo bye brag ma lus par o rgyan pad+ma bdag la babs shing :khro rgyan bdag gis ni bal yul yang le shod du zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang sgo bi ma mi tra la phye nas bskur ro: bod kyi sgrub gnas brgyad du bka' brgyad bye brag gi dbang las can brgyad la so sor bskur ro:bsam yas dbu rtser rje 'bangs nyer lnga la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang mo che bskur ro: de rjes rje 'bangs grogs gsum la sogs pa snying gi bu dgu la gsang ba yongs rdzogs thams cad kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba'i dus na da lta dbang gi chu bo bar chad med par babs pa'i tshul bshad pa yin la: phyi ma'i dus na yang dbang gi chu bo bar chad med par 'byung ba'i lung bstan nas: nga yi thugs sras byang chab sems dpa'i gter ston ni da lta dus 'dir dbang gi cha bo chen riri bye ri ringapo babs pa'i las can khyed rnams kyis bka' babs spyod de: de'i tshe las can gyi bu smo rnams nga yi gter chos 'di rnams dang 'phrad pa'i tshe: da lta o rgyan nga yis dbang chen yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba'i bag chags sad par 'gyur ro: nga yi gter 'di dang rje 'bangs 125

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/grogs gsum gyi mnog chos la sogs pa rnams kyi gter sgo yang 'byed par 'gyur gyi: dbang gi chu bo babs so la phyi rabs rnams the tshom ma za bar sgrubs shig: ces shin tu gsal bar gsungs so/ /gter gsar lam rim du: da lta'i ngang tshul thams cad kun: rmi lam bzhin du yad yud dran: sogs kyang de kho na ltar ro/ /rim pa dbang gi chu bo bskur thabs ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo 'grel ṭika stong thun dang bcas pa/ snyan rgyud gdams ngag gi chu bo gnad yig dmar khrid dang bcas pa/ phyag bzhes phrin sgrub kyi chu bo bstan srung drag sngags dang bcas pa ste snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi ka la bag chags sos lugs de dang 'dra bas gter brgyud la ring brgyud dang 'dra ba'i khungs su byed pa yin no/ /gter chos la brgyud pa drug tshang tshul ni gter bdag gling ba'i mkha' 'gro snying tig gi khrid yika ltar na/ sku tshe snga ma la dgongs brgyud nas brda brgyud dang / brda nas snyan khung du brgyud pa'i dbang gdams kyi chu bo brnyes pa ni dang po gsum tshang tshul zhes 'chad chog pa 'dra yang / gzhan mang po ltar na nge/ /tswa)/ /rwa(1 shāXbye/ /bro/khro zu mi /rngo/gsum yang ga ra brgyud na sgos sa ltar brtsas snang bas 'a ltar dgongs rgyud ni gu ru rin po ches chos de gnas skabs der spyan 'drong ba'i ched du skal ldan la dgongs pa gtad yod pa'i gnad kyis des gter yig la dbang sgyur nus kyi sngags kyi rtogs pa thod rgal du 126

po〉 thababastacad 95:re /bye/sprang thab //stethab 21cad /bsgyujotshod 25/ 151rngarnga// rwashā/rnyed pa ste/ de ni gu ru'i dgongs pa rgyud la babs pa'am shar ba zhes bya'o/ /brda brgyud ni/ brda yig lde mig tu gyur pa'i sgo nas sngags kyi zab don mang po 'byed nus pa'o/ /de lta na dpe bltas kyis chos shes tshad la'ang brgyud pa de ci ste mi rtsi zhe na/ slob mkhan med par mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris rnams gter ston gyis klog shes pa dang /brda ris yig 'bru re la brten nas kyang sngags kyi chos mdzod mang po rang khrol ba dang / shog ser gcig la'ang brda bsgyur rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i rim pa mang po bya bar yod pa dang / gter shog mthong ba tsam gyis bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'char ba sogs ni gter yig gi rdzu 'phral yin te/ /mdor na shog ser de la snyad btags nas dpa' bo ḍā /khro/ rtsejordo / spyo shāX /rteto ༷drorto hāX/ /sre)ka gsang ma da la sabs pa ༄ gatsho ra ma ༄da grol ba sangs rgyas — byin rlabs mngon sum du zhugs pa yin pas ga la mtshungs/ snyan brgyud ni/ gter yig sprul skur gsungs pa ltar dus der rig 'dzin ḍā ki rnams brda ris la zhugs shing / gter ston gyis kyang gter yig la tha mal ba'i snang ba log nas sangs rgyas sprul ba'i sku dngos kyi 'du shes skyes te/ brda de las tshig don gang shar thams cad kyang sprul sku dngos kyis gdams ngag bstsal ba yin par nges shes skyes pa'o/ /'di sanyis ka shog ser las brgyud pa rtsi bar 'dra yang / rig 'dzin la brgyud lugs ltar brda brgyud du 'gro ba dang / gang zag la ltar snyan 127

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brgyud du 'gro ba'i ldog cha tha dad pa'o/ /bka' babs lung bstan ni/gter ston gyi skye ba sngon ma'i tshe gu rus chos de dang de'i skal ldan du mkhyen nas bka' babs kyi bdag por dgongs pa gtad pa'i byin rlabs rgyud la smin nas ye shes khyad par can skyes stobs kyis/ phyi ma'i dus su'ang chos 'di khyod kyi longs spyod du 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan brnyes pa ste/ 'di ni sngon dbang gdams de dang de brnyes pa'i bag chags sku tshe 'dir gsal bar sad nges kyi las 'phro mthu chen yod tshul lo/ /smon lam dbang skur ni/ bag chags de rdzogs par sad pa'i cha rkyen du gter ston gyi sku tshe snga ma de nyid la gu ru rin po ches ma 'ongs pa'i dus su gter yig dang mjal bar bden tshig smon lam gyis dbang skur zhing de'i tshe rang nyid kyis kyang / bdag slad ma'i dus su gter 'dir gter yig ces ma brjod par gter chos byas pa 'dis/ mtsho rgyal gyis gter zhabs bsdam dus sogs dang mi 'grigs pa'i dogs pa'ang chod do/ /chos 'di dag dang 'phrad par gyur cig /phrad ma thag tu da lta dbang dang man ngag 'di ltar thob pa'i bag chags gsal bor sad par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas theb pa ste/ phyi ma 'di ni gter chos de rang rgyud kyi dge rtsa'i dran thor sngon mtshan mar bzung tshul yang yin no/ /mkha' 'gro gtad rgya ni/ sngon rabs kyi dus der rdo rje'i gnas kyi mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal 'chang ba rnams la/ gter dpe 128

bstan pa'i byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ pod/ 7tratratra'adi gdul bya 'di'i tshe phyi ma la las kyi 'phro mthud pa'i cha rkyen du byin cilga ces gu ru dang mkhar chen bza'i bkas gtad de/ de'i dbang sis sku tshe 'dir chos bdag mkha' 'gro rnams kyis shog ser dang mjal ba'i phyi nang gi rten 'brel sgo du ma nas bsgrigs te/ gtad rgya stsol ba yin no/ /'di dag ni dgongs 'dus snying gi me long dang / zab don rgya mtsho sprin/ dgongs 'dus rnam bshad sogs bltas nas bshad do/ /rje'i zhal rgyun du/ bka' ma las kyang bka' babs lung bstan so/gas brgyud pa'i khyad par gsum gyis 'phags shing zhes 'byung ste/'di bshad ltar na de'i dgongs pa'ang brgyud pa dang po gsum po'i rang ldog tsam nas gter ma'i dgos khyad du mi 'gyur ba la bshad dasgos so/ /dgongs gter la brgyud pa drug 'dren lugs kyang / dang po lgesum du shog ser gyi dod la gzhon nu ma la pra phab pa lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rang snang gi brda yig 'jog pa'i khyad tsam ma gtogs 'dra la/bzhi ba'ang 'dra/ tha ma gnyis la/ phyir dgongs gter rnams kyang dpe rgyud brag ri lhun chags dang g.yu mtsho gtan 'khyil sogs na bzhugs thing / snyan rgyud dgongs gter du byon pa'i phyi nang gi gter dpe sanyis re yod par mngon pas/ sngon skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog /ces smon lam mdzad pa ltar da lta gter chos dang mjal tshul la/ gter dpe dngos su mjal ba dang / des rnam pa gtad 129

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /tshemapa'i rang snang gi glegs bam dang mjal ba gnyis te/ gang ltar yang smon lam de'i lag rjes su 'dra bas lnga ba dang / de bzhin du sngon mkha' 'gro rnams la bkas gtad tshul ltar/ phyis su mkha' 'gros gtad lugs la'ang / gter dpe dngos rang gtad pa dang / de'i gzugs brnyan gyi rnam pa lta bu'i snang ba khyad par can bstan pa gnyis te/ gang yang brda yig tu bzhugs pa'i chos de mkha' 'gro mas gtad par khyad med pas drug pa'o/ /dge'o/ /130

r+shakhyo pod/ 7gyi/ /brjed tho sna tshogs bzhugs so/ /byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma yin pas/ 'di'i sgo nas rang nyid skal ba mchog ldan du byin gyis brlabs shing / sngar lha dang mkha' 'gro'i byen rlabs g.yel zhud du song ba sogs kyang legs par gsos te/ de nas yi dam du bsgyur nas sgrub na bar chad med cing dngos grub shin tu myur la/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pas bogs dbyung bar byed pas/rtsa gsum sgrub thabs kyi gzhung bkod pa'i rim pa'ang legs pur sanas so//des na dang por bla ma'i sgrub lugs nyid la brtson par bya ste/ras la dang por 'byar rtsi brgyab ste/ gdod tshon chur bcug na ji ltar 'dod par tshon 'dzin du btub pas kha dog bzang po 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de'ang gsang rdzogs las/ sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi lha'i 'khor lo dngos su mthong mi nus pa'i gdul bya'i don du/ dkyil 'khor kyi bdag po he ru ka brgyad po nyid rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bo'i tshal du ༄snang zhes 'byung ste/ bka' so so ba'i rig 'dzin pad+ma gsung gi nā ga dzu na sogs brgyad dang bka' brgyad spyi dril gyi rig 'dzin pad+ma ka ra'i zha bas nyid du bshad do/ /de ni gzhan las/ longs sku dang mchog sprul dngos dang mi mjal ba rnams la/ sangs rgyas rnams slob dpon gyi 131

rjesaspred/ 11 jordo /spyorngaku khur:drob/thag byaspurngasno rngaku/lngazud rta):re tha//thusprang 'o/sdo/zug/ ṅka lus la zhugs nas rjes su 'dzin par gsungs pas/ slob dpon la /rtogs pa mtho dman gyi rim pa mang du yod pa las/ ches mthon po //'ga' zhig gi khyad par ro/ /des na sku'i rnam pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku pad+ma gar dbang dang he ru ka sogs kyi rnam par mthong ba'i nus pa ma rnyed pa'i gdul bya mang bor dngos su zhal bstan nas/gsang sngags bla med kho na'i lam nas 'a khrid pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mdzad pa'i phyir/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyis rang nyid kyi sku lus de ltar ched du byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/ yi dam gzhan las 'grub thag nye ba ste/ byin rlabs dngos grub khyad par myur 'dod na:rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma nga nyid sgom: zhes ye shes snying bor ro ji skad bshad pa'i gnad kyis sku'i rnam 'gyur 'di'i 'khrungs rabs thams cad kyang rnal 'byor bla med pa'i kun spyod nyag cig gi steng nas song yod pas/ gar mkhan rnga mkhan gyad dang rol mo mkhan/ zhes sogs lta bu'i bzo skye'i sprul sku gzhan dang yang mi mnyam ste/ sprul sku mchog dman ni rgyud tshod las min gyi/ mdzad spyod kyis phye ba'i phyir ro //bla med kyi sngags pa'i nang nas kyang / gtso bor pad+ma'i rigs kyi sgrub pa po dang / grub chen gyi gzugs su bstan pa'i sku yin te/ bltams dus nas mtshan mkhan rnams kyis de ltar mtshan bsgrags pa dang / mkha' 'gro kun dga' mo la dbang bzhes pa dang / ma ra ti ka dang / o rgyan 132

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7trashizherang byung gi phug tu sgrub pa mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang / gter phyogs kun na chos sku 'od mdzad/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs/ sprul sku pad+ma zhes sa/sungs pa dang / sha bug thugs rje chen por/ gu ru nyid rigs thams cad las pad+ma'i rigs su sgrub na sngon smon gyi dbang gis lhag par myur bar gsungs pa sogs mtha' yas pas shes pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i sku nge/ nyid gling bzhi ba'i 'jig rten 'di nyid kyi rnga yab gling na da lta'ang dngos su bzhugs pa dang / bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang dang / sgrub kanas/sku tshab/ sku dang phyag zhabs kyi rjes/ tshes bcu'i dus/ gter ston /kater gnas sogs nas/ tha na bod kyi lha 'dre chen po rnams gu ru rin po che rjes dran gyi sgor song 'dug pa'i bar du rjes dran gyi mtshan ma bzhag pa dang / rgyud 'bum bsgyur zhus/ jo bo rje/ mi tra/ snying bo'i zhabs sogs sprul ba'i mdzad pa/ bka' nas bkar brgyud pa/ gter brgyud/dag snang gi brgyud pa'i rgyun bsam gyis mi langs pa btsugs te/dbang lung man ngag gi lam srol brgyud mar phye ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas bod kyi yul 'di lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhes pa la legs par bsam na/ bod kyi bla ma'i skal ba gu ru nyid: ces pa'i bka' la nges pa ster ro/ /bka' brgyad kyi sgrub chen dus zhag rer byin 'bebs lan drug re dgos par gsungs pa'i byin 'bebs rig 'dzin brgyad dam dgu'i 'bebs chog la byed pa yang ma la ya'i nags kyi dri bsung gi kha 133

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lo rlung gis bsgyur nas 'ong ba ltar/ dpal he ru ka'i dngos grub bla rnga/ rig 'dzin gyi byin rlabs kyis sna drangs te 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /nyang gi mkha' 'gro chen mo'i chos skor slob dpon pad+ma'i gsol 'debs chen mo las/ phyi rabs kyi gang zag slob dpon gyi gter dang phrad pa mo/ma/sa/ bkra shis par bya ba dang : byin rlabs che bar bya ba dang : dngos grub myur bar bya ba'i don du: slob dpon pad+ma'i gsol 'debs 'di la don bcu ste: zhes dang / 'dis ni sgrib pa sbyang ba dang : dngos grub thob pa dang : slob dpon gyi chos gang bsgrub kyang 'grub pa dang : dus phyi ma'i slob dpon gyi gter gyi chos/ dang phrad pa'i gang zag la byin rlabs dang dngos grub myur du 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir: slob dpon pad+mar lung zhus nas: mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger bkod: slob dpon pad+ma'i chos dang gang phrad de: slob dpon pad+mar mos pa che ru mdzod: byin rlabs dngos grub ya mtshan thob par 'ong : zhes gsungs so/ /'di dag gis ni rtsa gsum gyi dang por bla ma sgrub pa gal che ba dang / khyad par du/ thugs rje chen po zhi khro bsgrub na o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub pa gal che ba dang / pad+ma'i brgyud 'dzin yin na de'i rtsa ba'i thugs dam/ dbang chen zhi khro la yi dam byas na sngags rgyud byin gyis brlabs yod pas dngos grub che zhing myur ba kun bstan to/ /gsang sngags kyi bla ma'i mtshan nyid rnams kyi gtso bor 134

phang〉raḥmi /spro/rjerje/ཿpa// 1dro /blo/ /grit+na/ཿsa/lhas// 1rdo//sprerwaḥ// (7mi rnam dag dbang gi cha bo'i mdzod 'chang ba zhig dgos te/ sngags kyi ༄skabs 'dir dbang ni rgya chung chung zhig min gyi bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi sgrom chen po yin no/ /de'i rigs pas bla sgrub kyi rjes 'brel la yang dbang gi bka' babs dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs 'jug chog cig k+shin tu gal che yi/ las tshogs gzhan de tsam mi gtso'o/ /de'i phyir bsnyen pa thems nas ni 'di'i bdag 'jug la 'bad pa gces so/ /yang mkha' 'gro chen mo'i rta phag gi gsang sgrub bka' rgya can las/ lha sbo ma pa'i dang por rang tha mal pa'i spyi bo'i steng du bla ma bka' drin che ba gcig bsam: de yang yi dam dang tha mi dad bsam: dkon mchog sasum gyi rtsa ba bla ma yin snyam du 'dun pa drag po bya'o: des sgrub pa la bar chad mi yong zhing : byin rlabs myur du 'grub par byed pa yin no / /zhes kyang byung /sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar 'chad tshul gyi sbo mtha' yas kyang / gtso bo ni rig 'dzin slob dpon kyi rnam pa can yi na pas rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i sgrom nas 'chad pa 'di yin te/dang por o rgyan gyi rgyal po'i srid spangs nas dur khrod brgyad du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus pa dang /sa gsum gyi dregs pa rnams bran du bkol ba dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs zhal gzigs pa sogs ni rnam smin rig 'dzin la bzhugs 135

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shepa'i skabs dang de nas brag phug mā ra ti kar man+da ra la brten nas lam mchog yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe dbang brnyes te sa ho ra dang o ṭi yā nar rdzu 'phrul chen po bstan pa dang / rdo rje gdan du mu stegs kyi rgol ba ngan pa rigs pa dang sngags kyis btul ba sogs ni tshe dbang rig 'dzin la bzhugs dus kyi mdzad pa dang / yang le shod du shākya de bi dang lhan cig phyag rgya chen po grub ste/ bod du mi dang mi min gyi gdul bya dpag tu med pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam nas smin grol du mdzad pa dang mtha' dbus thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas chen mang pos bkang ba dang / chos dang / nor dang /grub pa'i rdzas kyi gter kha grangs med pa bcug pa sogs ni phyag chen rig 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang / lho nub rnga yab gling gi ris pa 'dzin pa'i gnas khyad par can na rig 'dzin gyi 'khor los sgyur ba mchog gi gzugs su bzhugs pa ni lhun grub rig 'dzin dang / srin po'i 'jig rten thams cad sgyu 'phrul gyi rol ba tshad med pas 'dul ba dang / bod du sprul ba mang po 'gyed cing skal ldan gyi don mdzad pa sogs ni lhun grub rig 'dzin la bzhugs tshul bstan pa'i mdzad pa ste/ 'di gal che yang shes mkhan ni nyung gsung / slob dpon 'di ni shin tu gdul dka' ba'i gdul bya shas cher 'dul ba'i phrin las can te /'phags pa'i yul dang / 'gro lding gi yul dang / bod yul dang / srin 136

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7tratra po'i rgyal khams rnams snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma gdul zhing rgya che bar rje btsun tā ra nā thas bshad/sngags kyi go cha'i skabs/ gnas gsum byin rlabs 'di go cha'i rnal 'byor du ngo 'phrod pa nyung yang / thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang skabs/phyag rgya gcig pa'i gnas gsum du: yi ges mtshan pas rnam rtog srung :zhes pa lta bu'i gter lung smos kyis mi ldang zhing / sgyu 'phrul las kyang thun mtshams kyi lha'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bsgoms nas/ badz+ra kā ba tsi rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes brjod par bshad de/ 'dus pa'i dkyil chog sogs sasar ma'i gzhung tshad ldan du mar yang / mig sogs skye mched byin rlabs dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs gnyis rgyas bsdus tsam las 'dra bar bshad pa la sogs pas shes nus/ des na ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bskyed rim pa'i sku gsum sgrub pa de nyid bgegs kyi mtshon chas mi k+shigs par byed pa'i go cha'i rnal 'byor gzhan thams cad gnas nusum srung ba nyid la 'du bar dgongs 'dus rnam bshad du'o/ /pa/d+ma'i lam rim las kyang / srung 'khor drug gi thad du/ gnas gsum gyi 'bru gsum je cher song / lus kyi phyir thon nas rdzong dang go khrab kyi tshul du g.yogs par bsam par bshad do/ /rlob byed thog med nas grub pa'i rgyal ba thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rigs su bsdus nas/ de sasum 'bru gsum du shar ba'i rgyas btab par bsgoms pas ris med 137

sprusprojid/ 11 lngardo sdispyirngaku khur:dropo/rdog byaspurngasno ngasartagazug rta):re ba/sdosangang 'o/dra/zug/ mnapa'i de pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs kyi go cha'am srung bar 'gyur bar ni/ sgyu 'phrul skor na/ oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis bskul bas sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar byon/ oṃ la thim/ de pa thams cad kyi sku dang gnyis su med par gyur sogs spyi'i lugs so/ /'bru gsum de nyid brlab bya rang gi lus ngag yid gsum/ dang dbyer med du blta dgos pa yin la/ de nyid rang gi sgo gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nyid dam bdag nyid du brlab pa ste bsgyur ba'i don du'ang go dgos so/ /'di la'ang bskyed chog rgyas bsdus mang ste gnad 'dra'o/ /gang brlab bya'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad kyang gsang srog gsum du ngo sprod tshul rig 'dzin yongs 'dus las/ thabs ni oṃ la shes rab āḥdabyer med ngo bo hūṃ du 'dus: snang ba oṃ la stong pa āḥ zung 'jug ngo bo hūṃ du 'dus: zhes dang / snod ni oṃ la bcud ni āḥ ngo bo gcig pu hūṃ du 'dus: zhes sogs ltar shes nas/ de nas yi ge gsum po de rgyal ba rnams kyi/ khyed kyi sems lus lta bu dang / sogs dang / kun tu dbu dang phyag ldan gyi/ sogs ltar ro mnyam gyi rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du mos te/ de ltar byas pas rang gi sgo gsam sogs snod bcud kyi dngos ༄snang thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi gsang srog gsum zhugs nas byin gyis brlab par bltas na rang gi gnas lus longs spyod thams cad 138

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7tratralo〉'bru gsum gyi sgrom du bcug par 'gro'o/ /sgyu 'phrul gyi 'bru gsum go babo/'i skabs su/ thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyis kun la khyab/ /ces dang / gsang rdzogs ma hā sgom khog tu/ oṃ snang ba sku yi dkyil 'khor du/ āḥsgra grag gsung gi/ hūṃ dran rtog thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dag pa'i rgya rtags su sgom par bshad pa la shin tu 'ogrigs pa yin no/ /go cha dang srung 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin 'di rnams spyir dus thams cad dang / khyad par du thun mtshams dang / de las kya/nga srod dus sogs la sgom/ gnas gsum gyi go cha 'dis lus nad mtshon dug gsum sogs las skyob pa dang / ngag byad du chud pa sogs las srung ba dang / bzlas brjod kyi nus pa skyed pa dang / smra ba gsal ba dang / tshig btsan par byed pa dang / ngag gis rang gzhan la phan thos/sa pa dang / kun gyi yid du 'ong zhing mthun pa'i ngag 'thon pa dang /yid rmongs pa dang / smyo 'thib/ brjed ngas/ phyin ci log gi rtog ngan sogs las srung ba dang / ting nge 'dzin brtan pa dang / spobs pa'i stobs sam gzi brjid mi chom pa skyed pa sogs mtha' med pa 'phrul dung ngo / /de'ang yi ge de dang de'i 'od zer gyis lus thams cad bkang bas tha mal gyi snang zhen lag rjes dang bcas pa mun khung du nyi zer zhugs pa ltar dag par dmigs par bya'o/ /bzhin lag rnam can gyi go cha'i lha med kyang / go cha'i lha med mi dgos te/ 'bru gsum de rdo 139

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rje gsum gyi lhar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ sdom 'byung las/ sngags nyid rnal 'byor ma yi gzugs/ /sngags kyi gzugs can rnal 'byor ma/ /gal te go 'phang mchog 'dod na/ /de dag dbye ba brtag mi bya/ /zhes lha la sngags kyi dang / sngags la lha'ang rgyal 'jog par gsungs so/ /sems can dus kyang bzhin lag ma dod kyang gang zag tu yod pa ni/ nur nur bo'i dus kyi sems can lta bu yin no/ /sman mchod mthar/ gnas gsum gyi lha de dag mchod pa'i bsam pas/ so so'i gnas su thig le byas pas shin tu mnyes shing sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bskang bar bsam par bshad de/ go cha'i lha gzi brjid skyed pa'i cho ga ste/ bdud rtsi'i che ba brjod pa na: lha la phog na dgyes pa skyed: mched la phog na g.yar dam skong : bgegs la phog na rdul du rlog: ces mkha' 'gro chen mo dang / gter gsar bi ma'i bla sgrub sogs mang po las gsungs pa ltar nges pa skyed/'phags pa'i phyag mtshan thams cad kyi gtso bo ni/ nyid kyi mtshan la'ang phyag na pad+ma zhes grags pa dang / mtshan brgyar/ pad+ma dri med phyaka gi dbus na bsnams/ /zhes pa ltar pad+ma yin te/ lha 'di pad+ma'i rigs/ /|/ /15 711 (1) /bye/ zurar /dre/:bye/ :)she :de/de 'a ra sa sgyur ba na nga / rags mtshan ma thun na yin pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje rigs kyi 'khor sgyur lag na rdo rje'i phyag mtshan rdo rje bzhin no/ /don zhags dang phyag stong gi cho ga zhib mo las pad+ma'i 140

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7tratralas tshogs ngo mtshar ba gsungs shing / de nyid bsdus pa dang / rdo rje snying bo rgyan las pad+ma'i rigs kyi dngos grub rab 'byams thams cad pad+ma la brten nas sgrub tshul rab 'byams bstan to/ /de la pad dkar gyi de nyid slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel ba ltar bkral na/ 'grel ba der/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gdan pad dkar 'chad pa na/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su dag pa'i mtshon byed du bshad kyang / gtso che ba'i dbang du btang na/rna/ma snang gi gdan gyi skabs pad dkar bsod nams kyi tshogs su sasu/ngas pa ltar ro/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs su bshad pa 'di gdan kho na'i min pa ni/ yo gar/ ji ltar pad+ma dmar bo 'di/ /zhes sogs dang bshad tshul mi 'dra ba'i dogs spong mdzad pa dang / rta mgrin gyi rgyan gyi pad+ma la yang de ltar gsungs pas shes so/ /gdan gyi thad du/ sa bcu dang phyin drug gi grangs tshad kyis sor bcu drug par bya bar bshad pa sos/sa slob lam skabs dang sbyar mod/ de kho na min par de'i rgyu mthun 'a/sa byung ba sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bsod nams la yang bya ste/ spyan ras sazigs 'di longs sku yin par rgyud de'i bsdus don du/ phyag na pad+mo/'i lus 'dra ba/ /zhes sogs rgyud tshig gis bsgrubs shing dkyil 'alor rim pa nang ma la 'god pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis shes la/ pad+ma dang rdo rje sogs thugs mi zad pa bkod pa'i rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor du bsdus 141

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgedon las gsungs pas sangs rgyas nyid kyi thugs mtshon byed yin pas so/ /de'ang bsdus don der/ yi ge'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi pad+ma la dbang skur bar gsungs pa'i thad na/sems can gyi don la rjes su chags kyang / nyes pa thams cad kyis mi gos pa'i mtshon byed du bshad pa 'di dang bsgrigs nas/ ji ltar me tog pad+ma ni rlan gyis yongs su gang ba'i rlon par dmigs te/ de bzhin du 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs pa yi/thugs ni thugs rje byung ba dang / thugs rje chen pos thugs brlan par/sangs rgyas snga mas gsungs pa'ang dran/ zhes pa ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi bsod nams kyi sdong po yang snying rje chen po'i rlan gyis shin tu non pa dang / pad+ma ni chu ste rlan las skye zhing / chu'i nang kho nar 'phel gyi gzhan du ma yin pa ltar/ sbyin sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs rnams kyang 'khor ba la brten nas skye zhing / yun ring por 'khor ba na gnas te bskyed bsring bas shin tu rgyas par 'gyur ba yin gyi/ gzhan du ma yin pa dang / pad dkar gyi kha dog zla ba ra ri med pa ston gnam la shar ba ltar dag pa'i tshon du byung la/ chu zhag dang nya lcib dang dri nga ba sogs chu'i nyes pa kun gyis ma bslad par skye ba ltar/ bsod nams kyi tshogs de yang chos thams cad rang bzhin dag par rtog sa pa'i shes rab kyis kha dog bsgyur bas/ bde na zhen gyi dri ma med pa'i shin tu 142

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7 trad+ku trakacang ma kho nar skye ste/ 'grel ba der pad dkar bsod nams kyi tshog/sa tsam la ma sbyar bar bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su dag pa dang sbyar ba'ang de ltar yin te/ yongs su dag pa ma smos na dkar po'i don ma tshang ngo //yo ga las pad+ma dmar bor bshad pa dang 'gal spong skabs/r+shas rab kyis chos thams cad shin du dag par rtogs pa'i mtshon byed du dkar bor bstan ces pa tsam las mi gsal yang / 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang sngags ni/ las kyi bye brag dag las dkar/ zhes pa'i 'grel bar/ sor rtog ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pas spyan ras sazigs kyi lha sngags sogs dkar bor bshad de/ rgyud 'dir pad ka/dan sogs dkar bo gang byung du rnam par dag pa'i mtshon byed ces ba/shad kyang / sor rtog ye shes la sbyar ba ni lha 'di'i sgos chos te/ de'i go/nga du'ang / spyan ras gzigs sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid dang /ston pa rnam snang nyid chos dbyings ye shes/ phyag rdor bya grub ye shes sogs su bshad pas so/ /pad+ma chu dang 'grogs pas ches yid du 'ong ba'i lang tsho rgyas par 'gyur gyi chu'i nyes pas cung zad kyang mi gos pa ni de'i ma 'dres pa ste/ de bzhin du theg mchog bsod nams kyi tshogs rnams 'khor ba'i rnyog pa thams cad kyi nang du spyod kyang de dag gis bag tsam yang mi gos shing / slar la kun tu bzang po'i gzi mdangs 'bar bar 'gyur ba ni thabs mkhas kyi che ba ste/ chenu/ ya mtshan pa'o/ /143

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyotrapad 'dab kyi grangs ni brgyad du byed par spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor bris thad kyi 'grel bar/ rdo rje de'i steng du pad+mo chen po 'dab ma/ brgyad pa bris te/ zhes so/ de'ang rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa'i ye shes kyi ldog pa brgyad la so sor bsod nams kyi tshogs de grogs su 'brang ba'i cha brgyad dam/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs de ye shes kyi ldog pa brgyad kyi sgo nas rgyas pa mtshon/ yang na dkar ba'i de nyid du 'ong rgyu'i sor rtog ye shes de nyid ye shes kyi ldog pa brgyad kyi bdaka nyid du dgongs pa ste/ 'di yang rgyud 'grel nyid la brten pa'o/ /pad+ma'i ze ba'i de nyid ni/ 'grel bar/ ze ba rnams ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyu'i yon tan ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs dang rnam par thar ba dang stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i mtshan mar brtags pa/ yin la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs de yon tan de rnams dang ldan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di rnam snang gi gdan gyi thad du bshad pa ste/ de'i gdan pad+ma la byed pa ni pad+ma'i de nyid kyi 'byung khungs can yin pas so zhes bshad pa'i rigs pas/ pad+ma'i ze ba la bzhugs pa yang rnam snang nyid ze ba'i de nyid las bltams pa rgyu mtshan du byed par mngon la/gzugs sku'i 'byung khungs chos sku yin pas chos sku'i phyogs kyi yon tan kho na ma gtogs mtshan dpe sogs ze ba'i de nyid du mi bshad pa'ang de'i gnad kyis yin nam snyam ste/ de bzhin du 'dir yang phyas 144

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7tratramatshan thugs kyi gsang ba'i mtshan mar bshadabyupas/ thugs ye shes chos sku'i phyogs kyi yon tan dang sbyor ba 'thad do/ /'dir 'o na rnam snang yang pad+ma'i rigs yin nam zhes pa'i dogs pa'ang bcad par bya'o/ /nga/d+ma'i mdzes sdug gis skye dgu'i dga' ba skyed pa'i de nyid ni dngos zin de dag tu mi gsal yang / de nyid snang chen las/ rab dga' de nyid don ni mdzes pa'i de kho na nyid de/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i don la/ de skad ces bya'o/ /rdo rje pad+mo zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyi pa rto'i phyag rgya la bya'o/ /rab dga' byed ces bya ba ni/ rang bzhin gyis rmam/ par dag pa'i chos nyid kyi ye shes kyis sems can rnams shin tu sbyong bar 'di sems dbang du gyur pa mthar son pa'i sor rtog gis rang rgyud la shin sbyang tre dba' bde phul byung 'dren pa'i don du bshad dgos/ mchan/ mdzad pas na rab dasa' byed do/ /zhes bshad pas dpag na/ dag cing dge ba ni 'dir mdzes pa'i don dang / de 'dra ba'i dpal gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi yid du 'ong zhing / sems kyi rnyog pa dang bar byed la/ zang zing med pa'i dga' ba dpe las 'das pas rgyud tshim par byed pa zhes bshad du rung ngam snyam/ gzhan yang rnam snang mngon byang las/ sangs rgyas rna/ma/sa ni thams cad dang / de'i sras blo ldan rnams kyi gdan/ pad+ma yid la/sa byung ba'i mchog /bkra shis 'jig rten rnams kyis bsngags/ zhes bkra shis pa dang / kun gyis bsngags pa'i yon tan gsungs shing phyag 145

21rngan/ 17 lngardo sdispyings khur:drob/thag byasatshog thab/sdizud rta):re tha/sdosajing khu/dra/zug/ trero'i rgya'i le'u las/ rgyal ba rnams byang chub brnyes pa na pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te 'tshang rgya zhing / byang sems chen po rnams kyang pad+ma las 'khrungs/ zhes pad+ma la che brjod mdzad do/ /yang de nyid las/ dbus su pad+ma dkar po mchog /de ni snying bo zhes su bsgrags/ /dkyil 'khor snying rje 'byung ba kun/ /des ni snying bo can du byas/ /zhes gsungs te/ don ni/pad dkar ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dag pa'o/ /rkang pa gnyis pa'i snying bo zhes pa ni 'byung 'di snying rje chen po ste bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rigs dang bsod nams kyi tshogs thams cad bsdus pa yin pa la bshad nas de pad dkar nyid dang sbyar na'ang 'gal ba ma mthong / de ltar byed na pad+ma bsod nams kyi tshogs yin zhes pa'i bsod nams tshogs ni snying rje chen po'o/ /mchan/ ba'i gnas te/ skad dod kyi steng nas so//de'ang bsod nams kyi tshogs de de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po 'byung pa'i gnas so zhes pa'o/ /snying rje de las dkyil 'khor 'di 'byung bas rkang ba gsum pa man chad do/ /rkang pa gnyis pa'i don ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin de nyid chos dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi dgos pa mtha' dalge skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du rdzogs par bya ba la yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhin du 'byung ba ni/ sngon bskal ba dpag med du bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po sbyangs pa las byang zhes pa ste/ snying rje chen po 'byang hāX//13 hāXre /de/ rmoje/ :dre/ /ste/ rteXdza sir+shab 'u ༄ klad nas sa so/ / spya ltar na 'a ra yang / tsho nga ras 'gro ba 146

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7trad+ku zhe skyong ba'i rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyi bshad par/ snying rje chen po'i rlan de nyid bsod nams kyi tshogs dag pa'i pad+ma dkar bo dang 'brel na sen/sa can thams cad dga' bar byed nus zhes bshad pa la nges pa thob bo/ /yo ga las rnam par snang mdzad pad+ma'i de nyid kyi rnam par thukas rtse gcig tu mdzad pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sazugs 'dzin par gyur bar dang / de slob lam du pad+ma'i de nyid bsgo mas pa las 'khrungs pa'i phyir pad+ma skyes zhes brjod par gsungs pa ltar gtso bor pad+ma'i de nyid las grub pas na pad+ma'i rigs sam skye sanas par 'jog pa ni 'dra'am snyam/ de'ang pad+ma'i rang ldog gi de nyid las mang du bsgom na/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'jig rten kusu/ma dbang du 'gyur ba sogs shas cher 'thob cing / dkar ba'i de nyid kyi steng nas bsgom pa gtso bor byas na dran pa dang shes rab 'phel ba dang / tshe rabs thams cad du 'khor ba'i rnyog pa dang mi 'dre ba la sogs pa shas cher 'thob bo/ /srong btsan gyis mdzad pa'i bstod par/ phyag g.yon pad+ma dkar bo bsnams/ /'gro drug gnas su don ma/dzad kyang / /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos rtags/ /rje ye sangs rgyas phyas 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'ang 'di dag gi don bsdu lta bur snang / yo kar sangs rgyas rnams kyis pad+ma phyin nas rdo rje spyan nam spyan ras sazigs zhes ming rdo rje'i cod pan btags te dbang bskur bar 147

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshimabashad pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gzhan yang dran par bya'o/ /('di 'bri ba la zhugs tshe khyad mtshar gyi ltas kyang byung gsung)/ /gdung pad+ma las 'khrungs pa ni rang nyid kyang pad+ma'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par go dgos te/ nas kyi rigs las skyes pa'i 'bru nas yin pa'am gdung shākya yin na rang nyid kyang shākya yin pa bzhin no/ /'phags pa nyid pad+ma lta bur 'jog lugs ni dper na/ dkon mchoka sprin las/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' pad+ma dang 'dra ba nyid yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ma gos pa rnams yin/ sdig pa chung ngu dang yang lhan cig mi gnas pa rnams yin/tshul khrims kyi dri zhim pa rnams yin/ gtsang ba rnams yin/ bzhin 'dzum pa rnams yin/ mi rtsub pa nyid yin/ mthong na bkra shis pa rnams yin/ blo rnam par phye ba rnams yin/ blo yongs su smin pa rnams yin/ shin tu yongs su bzung ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma gos pa rnams yin pa nas ji ltar na shin tu yongs su bzung ba'i bar du yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad+ma ni chu'i nang nas 'byung yang mi chags par skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de'i chos nyid thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba'i chu las 'byung yang mi chags par skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de'i thabs dang shes rab kyi chos nyid thob 148

phang〉phangami — /spro/rte/jo/ཿཿ// 111 //// ///lngaḥs//sa// /rngon/sprerwaḥ// (3)/pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa ni'akhor ba na spyod kyang 'khor ba'i nyes pa dag gis ma gos te/ de'i thabs de ni shes rab kyis yang dag par zin pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad+ma la ni cha'i thigs pa chang ngu yang mi chags so/ /de bzhin du byang rabye ra chub sems dpa' la sdig pa chung ngu yang mi chags so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa'i phyogs gang du pad+ma skyes par gyur pa'i sa'i phyogs de dris khyab par 'dug go/ /de bzhin du yul dang yul gyi phyogs sang na byang chub sems dpa' gnas pa de thams cad tshul khrims kyi dris khyab par 'dug go/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad+ma ni sa'i phyogs gar skyes pa'i sa phyogs de gtsang zhing bram ze dang rgyal rigs dang grong ba dang yul gyi mi thams cad kyang 'du ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' gar skyes kyang rung / 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims dang / gtsang sbra kun tu spyod pas gtsang ba yin te/ lha dang klu dang kanod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa 'du ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dgongs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rab tu bsngags pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na pad+ma ni kha phye na 'di lta ste/ sems can rnams kyi yid du 'ong bas 'dzum pa lta bur snang ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' 149

21rngad/ 1) lngardo /spyib 'o/:drogs byaspud bstan nyi:re ga/sang 'buzug/ haṃyang khro gnyer med cing dbang bo shin du dang bas bzhin rtag tu 'jum pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad+ma ni rang bzhin gyis/ 'jam zhing mi rtsub pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang rang bzhin gyis 'jam zhing dal gyis smra ba yin mi brlang zhing mu cor mi smra ba'i rang bzhin can yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad+ma ni rmi lam dang ltas dang yud tsam dag la mthong na yang 'di lta ste/don 'grub pa'i phyir bkra shis shing rab tu bsngags pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba yang 'di lta ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya ba la dus thams cad du bkra shis shing rab tu bsngags pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad+ma ni nan/ skyes pa de na rnam par phye ba zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang nam shes rab dang byang chub kyi yan lag me tog rgyas pa nge na blo rnam par phye ba zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad+ma ni nam yongs su smin par gyur ba de na bltas na mig gi dbang po tshirnga/ par byed do/ /mnyan na rna ba'i dbang po tshim par byed do/ /bsnams na sna'i dbang po tshim par byed do/ /reg na lus kyi dbang po tshim par byed do/ /sems rab tu dga' ba sa yid kyi dbang po tshim par byed do//de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang nam shes rab kyi snang ba yongs sa smin par gyar ba de'i tshe bltas na mig gi dbang po yongs sa das rib bye ribasi༅ ribasi༅ 150ji

(2〉phuḥmiphang〉 /spro//rje/snangasdo 121 /blo/ ///lngaḥs//sa// /rngo//sprerwaḥ// rwalha/par byed/ mnyan na rna ba'i dbang po yongs su dag par byed/ tshul khrims dang yon tan gyi dri bsnams na sna'i dbang po yongs su dag par byed/ reg pa dang bsnyen bkur byas na lus kyi dbang po yongs su dag bar bye da/ yon tan brjod pa rnam par bsam pas yid kyi dbang bo rnam par dag par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad+ma ni skye ba'isnga tshe 'di lta ste/ mi dang mi ma yin pa dag gis shin tu yongs su bzang ba yin te/ de bzhin du byang chab sems dpa' yang skye ba'i tshe shā/dun rigaci sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang de ma yin pa gzhan brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba dag gis shin tu yongs su bzung ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma bos/ pa nas shin tu yongs su bzung ba'i bar du yin te/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu bo de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' pad+ma dang 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /slob dpon rin po ches dang por au ḍi yā na'i skyed tshal zhig tu bsnyen sgrub zla drug mdzad pas/ thog mar khyim zhig pa dang / tshal la me cor ba sogs ltas ma rung ba mang du byung yang de'i dbang du ma btang bar bsgoms pas re zhig na 'dod pa'i dngos grub brtan po brnyes par gsungs shing / dpal mar me mdzad kyis kyang / gzhon nu'i dus nangs shig sdig pa ra tsa'i phung bo zhig mdun du hrigs kyis 'babs pa 151

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzigs/ des thugs ma g.yos pas phyir nang 'phags ma sgrol mas mngon sum du byin gyis brlabs shing / 'khor rnams kyis dus der jo bo'i mdun du atal gsar ba'i chan po che ba zhig mthong bar bshad pa/rabyepa ra༅'phags bod kyi skyes mchog rnams kyi lo rgyus na 'di 'dra ches mang du 'byung bas mtshams sgrub sogs kyi tshe glo bur ye 'grogs na tsha dang ltas ngan sogs ci byung yang khyi rdo rjes su snyegs pa lta bu'i re dogs kyi tsab tsub mi bya bar dge sbyor gyi rang sa 'dzin nus na rnal 'byor mgo rgyal du 'gro ba'i gnad cig de na yod do/ /bka' brgyad rang shar gyi lha khrid las/ lha yi dam gang mos pa gcig la bde gshegs kun don 'dus tshul ni: dper na lpags rlon chus bkang ba khad de gnas pa la 'dzum mos stod smad gang na mnan sar chu byo ba lta bu: yi dam gang mos gcig la bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin par byas na: bde gshegs yongs kyi byin rlabs 'byung zhing : phrin las thams cad 'grub bo:ci'i phyir lung lasaḥ thams cad ngo bo mnyam nyid sku gsung thugs:chos skur gcig phyir gcig 'grub kun gyi ngang : ces gsungs so:zhes so/ /gzhan la dbang bskur ba sogs kyis sngags kyi nus pa nyams pa rten 'brel snying bo'i gzungs sgrub kyis gso bar 'bri gung chos grags kyis bshad pa'ang mkho/ de'ang rab gnas kyi gzhung ltar bya'arnga/ dpyad/ lha'i byin rlabs zhud pa zhes bya ba ni/ byin rlabs 'dred pa zhes 152

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7trazhesnamapa'i don te/ srin dug shor ma la srin sman mi thebs pa'am mi zug par dar zhud 'then pa ltar song ba la sman 'dred pa dang dred par 'jog choka pa lta bur mngon/ de la rkyen gang gis g.yel zhud du gyur ba yin yang gtor tshogs dang bskang bshags kyis gso bar chos dbang gi srid pa'i gter khyim las bshad de/ don du bdag gnas yo byad la 'byar rtsi rgyags pa gal che zhing / 'byar rtsi yang tshogs gsogs yin pa dang / de 'byar rtsir 'gro ba ras gzhi'i dri ma sbyong ba lta bu'i sdig sbyang la ltos par dgongs pa ste/ byur dang mi shis pa sbyong ba'i cho ga gzhan rnams kyang gal che ba 'dra'o/ /sgom bzlas kyis dngos grub mthong chos 'a/ 'a grub pa ni dag pa'i snang zhen 'grus pa dang rgyun mi 'chad par bo/ma/sa pa'i mthu yin par bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel bar gsungs k+shing / gzhan du gtsub shing ngal gso zhing gtsub pas me mi 'byung ba'i dpes gsungs pa dang / gzhan du g.yengs bas sems kyis ni/ /bskal bar bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes gsungs te/ dkyus gcig la byas pa min pa'i bsnyen pas bsnyen pa'i go mi chod pa dang / g.yeng bzhin bzlas pa'ang de dang 'dra ba dang / thun mtshams su'ang dran 'dzin chen po bsten nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor las mi 'da' ba byed dbo/sa pa kun de 'i gnad kyis yin no/ /bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi chings lnga las/ chos lo legs pa'i snye ma 153ji

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ shi 0mthong ba'am bu chung me tog gi tshal du sleb pa ltar gang byas na dranu gam gang nyams su blang na drag gam snyam nas 'dam res kyi ngang du mi tshe bud pa ma tshor ba 'byung srid pas: de ltar ma yin par rang nyams dang bstun par chos gang dad pa zhig gi phu thag bcad de spang len thang slod re dogs gnyis 'dzin med par rtse gcig tu nyams su blang :de ltar bskyed rdzogs la sogs gang yin gcig la brtan pa thob ja na chad chos thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon nas gcig shes kun la mkhas/ par 'gyur ro: zhes dang / pad+ma'i gsang sngags lam rim gyi rang 'grel/ las kyang 'di kho na bzhin nan tan du gdams so/ /'di ni skyabs/ rje gter chen bla ma rnam pa gnyis kas yang dang yang du gdams par mdzad cing / sngon gyi mkhas grub chen po rnams kyi spyi lugs gal bo cher snang ngo / /rang gi yi dam gyi lha dang gdams ngag la gnyis 'dzin mi bya bar rnam pa thams cad kyis thams cad du blo hril gyis gtod pa ni srog ltar gces so/ /sems nyid ngal bso rtsa ba'i phrin las su/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: snying po yi ge brgya ba yang : thun mtshams rnams su nye bar bzla: sgrib dag nus pa mchog tu 'gyur: zhes gsungs shing /gzhan du mar yang yig brgyas chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi ba dang / byin rlabs brtan par byed par gsungs pas thun mtshams su bzla ba 154
