brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7t+yātrasaces so/ /'di g.yel zhud skor srung ba la zab par de nyid bsdus pa 'a sa gsungs/ /zab gter chen po rnams la sgrub 'bras mthong chos su 'byin pa'i 'bras bu'i dus dang / nyams len tshad ldan byed pa re mang yod pa'i sgrub pa'i dus dang / dbang lung khrid gsum gyi rgyun tsam rnal ma yod nga 'i lung gi dus dang / de'ang nyams pa rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus kyi rem pa so sor yod par rje bla ma gsung / de ni gter kha gong 'og dang /bi ma dang mkha' 'gro'i snying thig /byang gter sogs kyi lo rgyus la brtag na shes pa yod do/ /de'ang rat+na'i gter lung las/ shin tu zab ba'i mthar thug snying bo rnams: spyir yang bod rnams gsar ngas che ba dang : snyigs ma'i 'gro la lhag par snying brtse bas: mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhag: las can bu dang phrad pa'i smo na lam btab: zhes pa ltar bod na sngags kyi gdul bya mang ba dang /nge'i nang nas kyang mang bo zhig smon lam gyi mthu can yin yang gsar ngas che ba yin pas/ de la snyad btags nas gsung rdo rje pad+ma saṃ bha was gter chos rnams la thad ka thad ka'i 'bras bu'i dus re byin gyis brlabs par snang ste/ gsang sngags kyi chos kyi byin rlabs ni gdul byas dad gus dang gsang rgya sogs gces spras ma nyams pas lhag par 'gyur la gces spras de'ang gsar ngas can gyis ni gsar ba la sgrim 155

casarngad/ 11 lngardo sdispyings khur:drotha/05 byaspurngasno nga//mizug rta):re ba/sdosaji(khurasdo/zu// stan2〉 r+shazhing rnying ba la lhod pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na gter chos gsar ba rnams la mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ngad pa ma yal ba'i chos 'es/ gcigs cher 'dzin te/ chos dbang gter byon mkha' ri'i zhus lan du'ang / bod 'dir thugs gter lnga dang / gter chen brgya rtsa/ gter phran bye ba sbas par gsungs nas/ de tsam du mang ba sbed pa'i rgyu mtshan bod kyi rgyal khams gsar ngas che ba'i phyir ro zhes bshad/ snyigs ma'i gdul bya brtson 'grus dang shes rab dman pa rnams la slob dpo'o/ rin po che nyid bka' drin zla med par byed do/ /gter dpe las chos bsgyur dus rtog pa gzhan gyis gtan nas bar ma chod pa dgos te/ nge chod na des phar bcos phog pa'i nyams kyi 'char cha dang / bla ma mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyis tshur gtad pa'i snang ba gang yin 'byed mi nus par song nas tshig don la bslad skyon zhugs 'gro bas/ gter chos nge la lhad zhugs ma zhugs gter ston rang gis kyang nges dka' ba lta bur yod ces gsung rgyun du 'byung ste/ chos rgyal rin chen gling ba'i gter chos sogs la'ang lhad can yod par mkha' 'gro yang tig las gsangs pa de 'dra la dgongs kyi rdzun lab zer ba min no/ /'di la ni ༄nang ting nge 'dzin shin tu brtan pa dang / phyi bla ma mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs smin tshabs che ba dgos te/ gter ston brgyud pa'i gsang tshika gcig go/ /des na gter gsar gyi nang nas kyang bde ba chen po'i rnal 156

phang〉 /spro///ji/snarnga// 1dro// //// /gri/rdo:spro//lha/ba// /rdo/rgo1ཿཿ// (71/'byor las rung mthar son pa rlabs po che'i gter ston gyi chos la gtso bor bya dgos so/ /gter gsar dus kyi lo tog brje ba ltar brgyud mar 'byung ba'i sgo nas gu ru bka' drin che bar byed pa'i tshul da dung bshad na/ ring brgyud rnams snod min la 'phel bas bka' 'chal ba dang / dam sel gyis bar bcad pa dang / gzu lum rang bzo'i lhad skyon zhugs pa dang / brgyud pa la 'dre sogs bar chad 'jug pa'i srol dod pa dang / bar skabs su brgyud 'dzin brtson 'grus chung bas legs par ma bsgrub pa'i nyes pas bsgrub 'bras thob pa ma byung nas yun ring song ba la sogs rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gis dngos grub shi na tu 'grub par dka' ba'i dus na gter brgyud gsar ba la brten nas sasang sngags sgrub sla bar mdzad cing / de'ang mi thog re gnyis la de 'dra byung ba tsam min par ma 'ongs phyi ma phyi ma'i dus mtha'i bar du tshul des gsang sngags kyi bstan pa gso ba'i phrin las rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba la bsams na dus ngan snyigs las cher snyigs 'di lta bur mtha' 'khob kyi yul du skyes pa'i sngags kyi gdul bya rnams la ma ltar brtse ba'i mgon po 'di dang mnyam pa su zhig rnyed de/ ngam shod rdor sems kha byang las/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: gdong dmar rgod kyi rgyal khams su: mdo sngags chos kyi sgron me sbar: nyon mongs dug lnga'i mun pa bsal: ma 'ongs skye bo byol nyog pasaci gzu lum ras/ 157

rjesprokhud/ 11 zerdo sdispyirngaku khur:drothanabazhi byaspurngasno ngas/lngazud rta):re pe/sdosang( 'o/sdo/zug/ lo3chod dar ba'i tshe: zab chos phal kyi nus mthu yal: bsgrub kyang don med ngal bas na: brtse chen 'gro la phan bzhed nas: zab mo'i gdams pa ji snyed pa: bka' rgyas btabs nas gter tu sbas: dus rtags gdul bya 'dzoms pa na: rim bzhin bton nas don byed par:smon lam gtad rgyas gnyer du gtad: ces so/ /'di dag o rgyan rin po che'i byin rlabs dang / de'i spyan sngar smon lam mthu chen thebs pa'i gter ston rnams kyi las smon gnyis 'dzoms pa las byung bas/ gter ston sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi bka' drin du'ang sbyor chog go/ /gu ru rin po ches bod yul 'di lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhes tshul ni/ phyogs 'dir bstan pa la 'gal rkyen byed pa rnams tshar bcad pa ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam du/ sprul pa gcig ni lha 'dre 'dul du 'gro/ /zhes pa ltar rgyal ba'i phrin las la bar chad byed pa'i lha 'dre chen po rnams btul/ nang bod khams rang dang / phyi rol kla klo sogs bstan pa la sdang ba'i mi rnams dang phyi dus gsar skyes kyi lha 'dre nag phyogs pa rnams tshar bcad phyir drag sngags mang po bstan cing gter du bskungs/ chos 'gal gyi bon rnams bsnubs/ sdom gsu ma ra ba dbyer/ rgyal po khyod kyi bod yul 'di/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byang ༄gnas kyis/ /sogs ltar brtan ma bcu gnyis la bod du mu stegs pa mi 'jug pa'i gnyer gtad mdzad pa sogs so/ /bstan pa'i mthun rkyen 158

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7zhekhyo'adu mdzad pa ni/ phan bde'i rtsal lag bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing rab gnas mdzad/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs las/ gnas 'di pho brang chen po ltar byin gyis rlobs pa zhes pa dang tshul mthun par/ dkyil chog dang / tshogs 'khor mang bo/ lta phreng nyan bshad/ zab gter sbas pa sogs kyi sgo nas mtha' dbus kyi sa cha mang ngo/ rdo rje'i gnas yul du byin gyis brlabs nas sangs rgyas mthong ba'i lha dang / sngags bstan klu la chu g.yang ltar chags pa'i rig 'dzin ḍāk+ki rmams dbyar sprin bzhin 'du ba'i rtsa gsum srung ma'i bla chags kyi kanas su mdzad/ nyid kyi'ang sku tshab dang phyag zhabs kyi rjes sogs k+shin tu mang ba bstan pa'i btsas su brlabs te bzhag /yul mi'i ṭas ma spyod ni yul bdag byed pa'i lha srung gi dbang gis sgyur bar bshad cing / lhag par bod ma sang 'dre'i yul zer ba ltar rtag chags kyi yu/la lha sham po dang thang lha sogs ni bod 'dir dbang che ba yin ji sa/ de rnams skyabs 'a gro dang brtul zhugs kyi gzhi lnga la bkod de/sem/sa bskyed phog /dkyil 'khor du bcug nas gsang sngags kyi srung rnga/ra brkos pa ni/ phyogs 'dir bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag bstan pa'i nying khu sngags bstan rgyas shing nub dka' ba'i thabs mkhas chen po'o/ /chetsho sgrub dang nor sgrub/ dbang sdud sna tshogs/ chos ldan rgyal bo sogs kyi rilgas brgyud dang mnga' thang gso ba la sogs pa'i ga ter kha zad mi 159

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shes pa rnams kyang mthun rkyen no/ /bstan pa nyid gsal bar mdzad tshul ni/ zhi 'tsho dang / bla chen po/ dpal ldan a ti sha rnams kyang gu ru 'di nyid yin par bka' gdams glegs bam du 'byung la/ der/ sprul ba gcig ni mdo khams smad du 'gro/ zhes pa rje btsun tsong kha bar grags te/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen chos rgyan sogs kyis kyang bshad do/ /des na de dag gis bstan pa spyir bskyangs pa'i mdzad pa rnams kyang 'di'i mdzad par nges shing / sku'i rnam 'gyur 'di'i dbang du na/ lam rim du/ pad+ma saṃ bha bas bstan pa'i srol btsugs/ zhes te/jo bo'i rnam thar na/ slob dpon pad+mas mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas rdzu 'phrul gyis blang bar mngon/ zhes dang / de dus kyi bstan pa 'dra ba rgya gar na'ang dka'/ zhes pa ltar sngags rgyud khyad par can mang po spyan drangs shing / bsgyur zhus mdzad/ sgyu 'phrul dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor /bka' brgyad la sogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor te rgyud sde rab 'byams la mkhas pa dang / dngos grub brnyes pa'i skyes mchog be+e ro dang nam snying rma lo sogs bgrang bar dka' ba'i bstan 'dzin bskrun cing bstan pa'i rgyun bzhag /gter brgyud kyis sngags bstan brgyud mar gso ba'i zhal bzhes bstsal ba ltar bden 'bras mngon sum du bstan/de srid du gu ru nyid kyi gdul bya'i 'phro skyong zhing phrin las kyi rgyun gso ba'i chos kyi rgyal tshab re'ang rgyun mi 'chad du 'byang ba yin no/ /de'i ༄160

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7traphyir sa paṇa gyis/ brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma saṃ bha ba/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de la dgongs nas dpal ldan zhi 'tshos/ pad+ma saṃ bha ba zhes bya ba 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rigs sngags mkhan zhig yod/ de spyan drangs na chos rgyal nyid dang smon lam gcig pas don 'grub par 'gyur zhes khri srong la lung bstan no/ /lar gu ru zhi ba byang chub ster ba dang / drag po bar chad 'dul ba la bsngags/dang po 'di la gter phyogs su za hor ma shas che bas/ de'i rgyu mtshan bshad na/ bka' gdams glegs bam las bla ma dri ma med pa rgya gar du grub thob lnga bcur grags tshul gyi thad na/ thams cad kyang nyan thos kyi cha byad kho nar ston no/ /zhes pa ltar/ chos gos gsol ba ni dkyus ma'i cha byad yin te/ snga nas rab byung gi chas su bzhugs pas so/ /gsang phod ber 'dung pad zha rnams ni za ho ra'i rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyis rang gi zhwa gos gsar ba che rtags su phul ba'i dus kyi sku chas so/ /de'ang slob dpon rin po che 'dzam gling yul dbus kyi mi'i skye bo bgrang bar dka' ba 'i mdun du mthun snang la sngags kyi theg pa rgya cher bshad par gsol ba 'debs pa po'i thog ma ni rgyal chen gtsug lag 'dzin yin la/ des gang gi tshe gsol ba btab pa ni/ yul der sngags kyi kun spyod dang 'brel ba'i rdzu 'phrul chen po bstan pa na'o/ /tshul ji ltar btab na/ dpag tshad du mar khyab pa'i mi'i khrom tshogs kyi dbus su za 161

11spred/ 17 jordo sdo/rngaspro 'o/:drob/05 byasasprad pagastagazug rta):re bkasdosajing khuradra/can/ ra〉2〉ho ra'i rgyal srid phal zhing / de'i rtags sa rang gi zhwa thod zab ber nodang rig misogs sku la gsol nas so/ /de'i tshe lha'i dbang bo brgya byin 'khor bcas kyis kyang bstod dbyangs rol mo dang bcas pas mchod de/mdor na mi dang lha yul ba'i gtso bo dag gis dregs pa'i ral ba dus gcig tu bsnyil nas btud do/ /der gu ru nyid kyis kyang / rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir chas 'di dag bzhes pa'i steng nas sngags kyi chos 'khor khyab bdal du bskor ro/ /'di skabs ni skal ldan brgya'am stong sogs smin grol la bkod pa tsam min gyi/ za hor ma smin bar du bsdad kyis gsungs: zhes dang / sems can ma smin pa ni gcig kyang med: ces yul 'khor chen po'i mi tshogs sangs rgyas kyi sa la khyu ded btang ba'i mdzad chen no/ /thun mong ba'i snang ngor sku tshe 'dir 'gro 'dul gyi phrin las rgya cher rgyas pa'i thog ma ni de yin par gter phyogs zhib tu bltas na shes so/ /'di zangs gling ma dang /dgongs 'dus lo rgyus shel gyi me long dang / chos dbang mdzad pa bcu gcig mar ma ra ti kar tshe dbang bsgrubs rjes kyi dang / shel brag mar ma bsgrub gong gi mdzad pa ltar bshad/ dge slong gi rnam par ni de gong nas bzhugs pas chas de ni mdzad chen de bstan rjes su dang ma bstan gong gnyis ka'i sku chas thun mong ba yin la/ cha byad 'di ni de tshun ma gtogs med pas thun min te/ des na gu rus rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 162

mdzubasto /rdoX///jo/ཿpa// 1dro// //// /blo/rdorngog /lha/pa// 11rngo/2ཿཿ// (71/khyab bdal du spel ba'i mdzad pa bstan rjes kyi sku'i rnam pa bye brag tu mtshon nus pa la 'di kho na bzang bas/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi phrin las thun mong ma yin pas rjes su 'dzin par 'dod na 'di gtso bor byed dgos so/ /cha byad sna tshogs bsres pa 'dis 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i 'phrul mtshan dang / mdzad pa sna tshogs can du'ang mtshon/ de dag gi phyir gter sbed kyi mdzad pa ston dus kyang cha byad 'di bzhes par bshad de/ des na gter sbed kyi gleng gzhi dang 'brel ba'i cha lugs 'di yin pa'i gnad kyis gter gzhung rnams su 'di mang ba yin nam snya ma/ phyag mtshan la/ mnyam bzhag thod pa can sogs kyang yod mod de/'dir ni rdo rjes dngos grub kyi bar chad tshar gcod pa dang / bum thod sgrub pa po dngos grub kyis rjes su 'dzin pa ste/ phyi ma la'ang / bde chen me shes kyi dngos grub ster ba dang / de la brten nas 'chi med kyi dngos grub ster ba'i mtshan mar thod chang dang / tshe bum rim bzhin no//dngos grub brtan gzigs su/ rdo rje las gur drag dang / thod bum las lha mo mgyogs ma spro bar bshad pa'ang 'di dang mthun/ sku 'di dang bor pad+ma'i mtsho gling du bltams dus nas phyag mtshan rdor thod can du byung bar zangs gling ma las bshad cing / phyis kyang de dang mthun pa'i ma/dzad pa can du byon par snang ste/ lha srin dam 'dogs sogs snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i phrin las ni/ rdo rje bsdigs mdzub kyi dang /163

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skal ldan grangs med la dgongs pa gtad cing / bde ba chen po'i lam dbang rim gnyis bcas bstan nas 'chi med kyi go 'phang la sbyar ba ni mnyam bzhag bum thod kyi'o/ /zhal zhi 'dzum khros pa'i nyams su bshad pa'ang 'dis bshad nus/ pad zhwa'i skabs/ pad zhwa gang yin za hor ma'i chas su byed dgos pa ni min te/ pad+ma kha 'bus kyi lo rgyus sogs kyis shes so/ /des na gu ru za hor ma yin min kun la pad zhwa lhub chen sogs pad zhwa re gsol ba ni/ zhwa byas kyang don du pad+ma'i rnam pa'i cod pan 'chang ba ste/ pad+ma'i rigs su ston pa'o/ /bsnyen mtshams skabs/ sngon du dkon mchog la mchod pa/ sdig ltung spyi dang khyad par nyams chags bshags sbyangs/ gsung rab sgrogs pa/ sats+tsha gdab pa/ srog bslu ba/ lam 'phrang 'chos pa cha gsum dang chu gtor sogs gtor ma'i rnal 'byor gyis mtshon dge ba'i dpung ci 'grub bsgrub par byas na rgyud 'byongs shing bar chad mi 'jug pa dang /dngos grub myur du 'thob par gsungs/ ma grub kyang chad skyon du mi 'gyur/ de nas gnas byi dor bya stan 'og tu 'bras sam sa dkar pos g.yung drung g.yas bskor 'bri/ ku sha'i gding ba bkram/ sngar sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyang ma song ba'am song yang kha gso'i tshul du byed na/dus bzang bo'i dgong mo bdag bskyed phyag rgya gcig pa'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa'i bar gyi mthar/ bsdu ldang byas te/ phyogs skyong sde brgyad ga'i 164

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7tratrabadag sogs dkar phyogs pa la gtor ma phul nas phrin las bcol/nag phyogs pa la bgegs gtor byin nas bka' bsgo sngags thun so/gas kyis bgegs bskrad byed/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas blo ldog bzhi ci nus su bsgoms pas rgyud bskul te/ skyabs sems yig brgya maṇ+ḍal rnams dang / bla rnams kyi yan lag bcu ba dang / gsol 'debs/sidzhai rnams thun du bcad de shar sgom gyi tshul du ci 'grub bya/ maṇ+ḍal bla rnams su bcug kyang rung ba 'dra/ thun re bzhin sngon 'gro kha tshang re satong ba'i lugs te/ thun bzhi bya/ de ltar zhag gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig sogs 'bad/ de song nas yang bdag bskyed/ dkar gtor/bgegs gtor bgegs smrod rnams sngar bzhin btang rjes/ rgyal tho'i cho gas tho gzugs/ srung 'khor rgyas par bsgom/ 'di nas bzung sngar dmigs 'og tu ma bcug pa'i ngo gsar dang mi 'phrad cing chas ka'i gtong len kyang spangs/ de nas bshams bkod gtsang dag bya/ de ka'i dgong mo las gzhung mi srong na byin 'bebs/ mchod rlob/ shis brjod bcas thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal gyis byas na'ang legs snyam/ 'phro rnams sla/ sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyang 'bum lnga skor gsog mi dgos na ni mtshams gcod thang gnyis mi dgos te/ lar gzhung las/ med du mi rung lam stegs so: zhes gsungs pas sngon 'gro'i skor gsog ni nge sa par gsog dgos so/ /yang ril sgrub dang gtor bzlog sogs shin tu 165

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ gzab spro byed skabs ni/ sngar bsnyen sgrub song tshar yang khag so'i bsnyen sgrub them par byas la gdod brtsams par bya ste/ lhag par dbang gi skabs la bsnyen pa kha gso gal che'o/ /gtor zlog gi dus sngon du lha srung mchod gtor gyis mnyes pa dang / 'byung po gtor mas brngan pa gal che bar gsang rdzogs gtor zlog tu bshad de/ de'ang dkyil 'khor pa rnams thugs dam skong dgos tshul las zur du bshad/lar yang srung ma la gtor ma mi sbyin pa dang / byin yang chung zhing ngan pa dang / khyad par du gtor ma med par las bcol nan gyis byas na sngags pa ltogs shing dbul phongs 'ong bar bshad/ g.yang sgrub mkhan po kha cig rdzas cha dang bse rag bkar ba sogs gzab nas byed kyang sbyin bdag sogs je dbul du 'gro bar snang ba yang gtor tshogs zhan pas yin nam snyam/ char 'bebs la'ang dang bor klu gtor bzang mang gtsang sbra thon pa re bsngos na char mod pa dang mtha' bzang bas gnad yod pa 'dra ste/ klu dbul po la char slong byas na 'bebs kyang mang ngo mi 'byung zhing / de la ha cang char byung ches na klu rgud nas yul gyis bcud la gnod par bshad yod/ klu bum sbas nas sa bcud gso ba'i go don yang / sa bdag chu bdag byed pa'i klu rnams la bum pa bzang bo'i dngos grub byin nas phyug dar bde skyid 'dzom pa'i go 'phang 'a/ bkod pa'i sgo nas phyi snod kyi dpal 'byor gso ba yin par snang / yang 166

phang〉 /pa/snye//rdoḥ// 121 //// /blo/mi:spro/lhas// /rdo//spre pa// (7)/pad+ma gsung gi slob dpon la/ thabs la mkhas pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / bzlas brjod la rtag tu dga' zhing brtson pa dang / spyod lam thams cad du seng ge ltar spyod pa dang / glu gar rol mo rnams la dga' zhing / mchod pa'i bye brag la mkhas pa dang / lha dang bla ma'i bka' bzhin du byed pa las mi 'da' ba dang / spun la gdung zhing sems can la 'dud pa dgos pa dang / de'i slob ma la yang / 'gro ba'i sems mi dbyung ba dang / glu gar rol mo sna tshogs la brtson zhing mkhas pa sogs dgos par nges par 'byung ba phyi ma'i rgyud las gsungs so/ /thugs srog hrīḥ yig gi don ni/ de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu gsum pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin kashegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje chos kyi dam tshig las byung ba'i byin gyis brlab/ pad+mo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig ces bya ba de bzhin rgashegs pa thams cad kyi snying bo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /trīḥde nas de phyang ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thags risi mi //bye/ 1)bye ris bka nas pad+ma lta bu 'od rur kha dog dang gzugs dang rtags dang spyod 'a/ma dang 'od rnam pa du ma byung ste/ 'jig ten gyi khams thams cad du 'dod chags la sogs pa rnam par dag pa dang / chos nyid kyi ye shes yang dag par sbyangs nas yang slar log ste 'phags pa spyan ras 1 67

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stanagazigs kyi dbang po'i thugs kar zhugs so/ /zhes gsungs te/ snying bo 'di la de pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig ces gsungs pa'i chos ni pad+ma'i rigs rnams te/ rang bzhin dag pa'i chos mkhyen pa'i sher phyin gyi ngo bo nyid yin pas so/ /dam tshig ni rgyu'i don te/ rigs de sprul pa'i rgyu yin pas so/ /de pa thams cad kyi snying bo zhes pa ni thugs ka'i sems dpa'i rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid yin pas so/ /de byung ma thag tu sogs kyis ni trīḥzhes bya ba'i snying bo 'dis pad+ma'i rigs thams cad sprul tshul dang / sprul nas rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa mdzad tshul rnams ston te kun snying ltar byas so/ /dpal mchog las kyang / nge nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ngo bo nyid dag pa'i chos nyid thob pa yang chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di gsungs te/ 'dod chags thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid kyis 'jig rten na zhe sdang thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro//dri ma thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid kyis 'jig rten na sdig pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad rnam par dag pas 'jig rten na sems can thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /shes pa thams cad rnam par dag pas 'jig rten na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ de 168

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7tratra nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don gyi gnas 'di nyid yang rgya cher ston cing bzhin rab tu 'dzum dmul te pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dri mas mi gos pa la lta zhing / 'gro ba thams cad kyi phyir pad+ma'i sa/zugs sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ /hrīḥ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis pad+ma chen po de las de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i gzugs thams cad bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dang 'dra ba'i pad+mas mtshan pa'i gzugs can nges par byung nas bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rim pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs par gyur to/ /zhes gsungs te/ don gyi gnas 'di nyid ces pa ni/ 'dod chags rnam par dag pa sogs gong gi sazhung tshan bzhis bstan pa rnams te/ yang rgya cher ston cing zhes pa ni trīḥzhes bya ba'i yi ge sprul ba'i sgo nas slar yang ston par mdzad pa'o/ /'gro ba thams cad ni pad+ma'i rigs rnams te/ de yongs su rdzogs par skyed pa'i phyir snying bo 'bru gcig 'di gsungs pa'o/ /pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs pa zhes pa ni snying bo'i yi ge hrīḥzhes pa 'di'i ming ngo zhes dpal mchog 'grel chen las so/ /pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i snying bo zhes pa 'di la (kun snying gi mchan/)sher dum gyi 'grel bar/'gro ba thams cad kyi gzugs su snang bas na gzugs sna tshogs dang /169

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+shade ltar snang yang 'khor ba'i nyes pa rnams kyis mi gos pas na pad+ma/ nge/ 'dra'i snying bo dngos ni gzugs thams cad nges par ston pa'i ye shes nyid yin yang / de mtshon par byed pa'i hrīḥyig la btags nas bstan gsungs/ 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis sogs ni/ snying bo 'di'i mthus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa thams cad pad+ma'i rigs kyi rnam par gyur nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag mtshan pad+mo las byung zhes pad+ma'i rigs spro byed du gsungs pa'o/ /man snye las/ hrīḥ ni gsa'/ bar gyis shig pa ste/ nye ba ma yin pa nye bar gyur pa gsal bor gyis/ shig pa'o/ /zhes skabs gzhan du bshad de/ sher phyin gyi sa bon yin ji/ dang / gsal bar byed pa la sbyar ba gnyis gnad 'dra bar mthong zhes dam pa dag 'chad/ de dpal mchog dang bsgrigs na/ pad+ma ltar gos/ ji/ med pa'i sher phyin gyi rigs kyi gzugs sna tshogs gsal bar gyis zhes/ par bshad dgos pa 'dra/ grol thig gter gzhung du chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' dang dbus med par ston par byed pa'i yi ge hrīḥzhes pa ltar na/ rgyud bla mar/ gzhal med grangs med mi mnyam dang sogs ngo bo nyid sku khyad par lnga ldan du gsungs pa ltar/ sher phyin gyi mthus chos kyi dbyings kyi gting g.yogs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i tshul gyis nu/ ler gsal bar gyis shig ces 'chad tshul yang yod dam snyam/ g.yung 170

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7khyeshesnasgeyon drung (do ha grong )'khyil ba gsum gyi zhal gdams dang / ye shes 'od mchog gi bshad tshul gzhan du ltos/ yig drug gi sngags don la/ oṃ a u ma gsum gyis sku gsung thugs gsum mtshon la/ de gsum gcig tu sbya ra ba'i oṃ yig gis rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i go 'phang mtshon te/sngas/sa don de ltar dran nas brjod pas mchog 465 zhing bsod nams len pa'i phyir nor bu 'dzin pa zhes rdo rje rtse mor ro/ /de nas ni/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga par yig drug 'di nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags su gsungs pa'i 'grel bar lha'i rigs kyi blo gros chen pos/myori/ ṇi zhes bya ba ni shin tu rin thang med pa'i nor bu dang 'dra ba'i so so ra rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /ci ste ye shes so sor rtog pa yin na rtog pa dang bcas par mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ pad+ma zhes bya ba smos te ji ltar pad+ma 'dams kyis ma gos pa ltar ye shes de rtog pa'i skyon gyis gos pa med do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nyid kyi phyir hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba smos te/hūṃ zhes bya ba ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pas stong ba'i yid do/ /phaṭa ces bya ba ni rnam par rtog pa 'dral ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ sor rtog ye shes nor bu'i rgyal po dang 'dra tshul ni/ mdo rgyan las/ so sor rtog nga/'i ye shes ni/ /shes bya kun la rtag mi thogs/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi/ /gter dang 'dra ba kho na yin/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ni/ /'byor ba thams cad ston mdzad pa/ /the tshom 171

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+shathams cad gcod byed pa'i/ /chos chen char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /zhes/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la brten nas bshad do/ /ye shes de so sor rtog pa yin na/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su mi 'thad do zhe na/pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang chu zhag dang nya lcib sogs 'dam gyi nyes nga/ rnams kyis ma sbags pa ltar/ ye shes de ming tshig yi ge'i rnam pa can gyi rtog pa yongs su gyur pa las skyes kyang / phyin ci log gi cha thams cad log pa'i phyir gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i rtog pa gtan min zhes pa ste/rtog pa ni mi gsal ba ste/ 'dam gyis sbags pa'i nag nog tu 'gyur ba dang 'dra'o/ /ye thes 'di ni sor rtog yin yang shes bya thams cad mngon sum du blta ba la bzang zhing shin tu gsal ba'i yon tan gyis mdzes pa'am/ 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi gnyid ma lus pa sad pa sa shin tu rgyas shing kha phye bas na pad+ma lta bur bshad ces 'chad dam brtags/ mchan/ sangasmo/ rgyas la zhen rig gi rtog pa gtan med kyang / tha snyad byed pa'i blo ris yod dgos te/ so rig bzhis shes pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gnyis snang si 'khrul ba'i rab rib mtha' dag dang bral ba'i so sor rtog pa'i spyan shin tu gsal ba yin zhes hūṃ gis bstan to/ /'di ltar na sor rtog/ ye shes gcig po de gdul bya'i bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad pa'i cha nas/ nor bu dang / de nyid gdul bya'i bsam pa tha dad pa dang / de la ji ltar 'tshams pa'i chos kyi longs spyod sna tshogs pa thams cad ma 'dzing bar 'byed pa'i sor rtog yin yang / rtog pa'i skyon gyis ma gos par mi 172

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7tranyapo〉'alga la ba'i cha nas pad+ma ste gnyis kar 'jog par gsal lo/ /da dung go bange/ bar bshad na/ sor rtog ye shes ni rnam par rtog pa med pa'i phyir dang / 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i mthu phul du byung ba'i phyir ma ṇi ste nor bu'i rgyal po'o/ /de rnam rtog med par mi 'thad de/ sor rtog yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de rtog pa las skyes kyang / rtog pa'i dri mas ma lhad par skyes te/ pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyi nyes pas ma gos par skye ba bzhin no/ /der ma zad sor rtog de nyid kyi mthus gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i g.yeng ba'i gnas ngan len gyi cha ma lus pa 'joms shing 'gog pas na hūṃ zhes so/ /bde chen shes rab snying rje mchog /ces pa'i sgrub thabs su dpal mi tra dzo kis ni/ oṃ ma ṇi t+t+waṃ/ shes rab chen po dri ma med//rnam par shes kun mtshan nyid de/ /ma skyes mi gnas 'gag pa med/ /kudod nas rnam grol mngon sum pa/ /oṃ ā hrī pad+me hūṃ/ snying rje chen po lhu na gyis grub/ /dmigs pa kun gyi mtshan nyid de/ /mi phyed mi 'gyur 'bral ba med/ /skyo med re ba rnam spangs pa'o/ /zhes bshad de/ ma ṇi ni thes rab kyi phar phyin te rnam rtog med cing / mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /pad+ma ni snying rje chen po ste/ 'dam rdzab lta ba'i 'khor ba la brten nas sam dmigs nas skye ba dang / sems can thams cad dga' bar byed ba'i phyir ro/ /de'ang byang sems kyi mnyam bzhag tu ni snying rjes zin pa'i shes rab mngon gyur du 'jug ste spang bya dngos su 173

sngasarngad/ 11 jordo sdispyirngaku khur:drob/thag byaspucad rngan/lngazug rta):re tha/sdosarngaza khurasdo/zug/ 〈chospong ba sogs la 'di kho na dgos shing snying rje'i mthu dang byed las gzhan yang de la yod do/ /rjes thob tu ni shes rab kyis zin pa'i snying rje ste/ dmigs med kyi snying rje chen po mngon du 'gyur te/ gzhan don gyi bya ba dngos su sgrub pa sogs la 'di kho na dgos shing / shes rab kyi mthu dang byed las gzhan yang de la yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa na ni de gnyis ka blo gcig la mngon gyur du ldan pas srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i byang chub ces brjod pa yin te/ 'di dag ni lam dang 'bras bu'i dus kun tu ma ṇi dang pad+me gnyis mi 'bral bar phan tshun grogs su 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ /theg chen gyi bsam sbyor gnyis las bsam pa snying rje chen po pad+me dang / sbyor ba'am spyod pa'i gtso bo dang rab mchog sher phyin ma ṇir bzhag pas/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba dang sa bcu bar bshad pa'i smon lam 'bum phrag grangs med bcu sogs pad+mer sdud cing / sbyin sogs phar phyin snga ma lnga ma ṇir bsdu ba 'dra/ phyi ma cung zad bshad na/ dper na ma rig pa ni ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa tsam du ma zad kyi/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i sgo sna tshogs dang sdong nas phyi phyir stobs rgyas par 'gyur bas/ chags sogs de dag ni ma rig pa'i dpung grogs so/ /de bzhin du sher phyin yang rang rkyang tsam sgom pa min gyi/ sbyin sogs rgya che ba'i spyod phyogs thams cad des ma zin pa med par byas te sbyangs pas/ sgo sna tshogs shig nas sher 174

dzaḥjimo swā /spro//rjernoḥpa// )rdo// /gri/ ///lngarnga//lhasag/ /rdo//sprerwaḥ// (3)/phyin stobs rgyas par 'gyur te/ des na rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ces ri mo mkhan du mas 'khor sgyur gyi gzugs gcig 'dri ba'i dpes mdo dang rgyud bla mar bshad pa'i rigs pas mtshan nyid yongs su/ rdzogs pa'i sher phyin gyi rtogs pa rnyed pa ni tshogs mtha' yas pa la ltos pas tshogs de dag ni de'i don du gsungs so/ /rkang ba gnyis pa rga/nyis kyi don ni/ ma ṇir 'jog rgyu'i shes rab de shes pa rnam par dag pa rang don phun tshogs zab pa ye shes chos sku'i ngo bo nyid dang /pad+mer 'gro rgyu'i snying rje de dmigs pa'am shes bya rnam par dag pa gzhan don phun tshogs rgya che ba gzugs sku'i mtshan nyid dam 'jog byed yin pa ste/ de ltar na sngar phyag mtshan thad du brjod pa ltar byas lang 'grigs pa yod/ de'ang theg chen gnyis kyi than mong ltar yin la/2ngete/ ris mi da dung bya rgyud pa'i zab dang rgya che'i lam gnyis sgrub tshul nas/ sngags bla med pa'i shes pa 'od gsal dang / shes bya ye shes kyi sku sgrub lugs kyi bar so sor sbyar nas bshad na rlabs che'o/ pad+ma zhes bya rgyu la/ pad+me zhes sbyar ba ni bod pa'i don te/ nor bu pad+ma zhes spyan ras gzigs la nye ba'i sgo nas bod pa'i don min pas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud rang la nye ba lta bu yod par bsgom la bzla zhes rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtshos bshad/ yang sgrub thabs de nyid las/ rnal 'byor rgyal po the/sa rab thabs/ /rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /dpal ldan pha rol phyin drug dngos/ /cho ga'i dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/175

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rtsonagasang sngags rgyal bo yi ge drug /lugs 'byung ba dang lugs ldog las//rgyud drug 'gog dang lam drug sbyong / /'bras bu drug la rab sbyor nyid/ /de bzhin rgyud drug skyed pa dang / /lam drug la ni sbyor ba dang / /'bras bu drug ni mngon du bya/ /gzi brjid drug pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes yi be drug po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi ngo bo nyid dang / 'gro ba drug sbyong byed sogs su gsungs te/ 'di ni srong btsan bka' 'bum dang bka' gdams glegs bam sogs su'ang bshad do/ /srong btsan bka' 'bum na gzhan yang rdo rje dang rin po che la sogs pa rigs lnga rigs thams cad bsdus pa dang bcas pa'i drug gi ngo bor sbyor tshul dang / ye shes lnga lhan skyes ye shes dang drug la sbyar ba dang / sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i byin rlabs so sor 'bebs pa/ byin rlabs thams cad thogs med du 'byung ba dang bcas pa'i drug la sbyar ba dang / duka lnga nyon mongs spyi dang drug sbyong byed du sbyar ba/ 'byung ba lnga so so dang /thams cad 'dus pa ste drug la sbyar ba sogs ches mang du gsungs shing /phyin drug dang sbyor tshul la yang oṃ sbyin pa nas hūṃ shes rab kyi bar bo rim bzhin du sbyar ba dang / oṃ shes rab/ ma bsam gtan/ ṇi tshul khrims/pad brtson 'grus/ me sbyin pa/hūṃ bzod pa dang sbyar te bstan pa sogs yod de de nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /lhan skyes rol bas mdzad nga/'i sgrub thabs su/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying bo rtogs pa'i sngags kyi 176

zang〉 /pa///rje/ཿpa// 1rdo// //// /bro/mi:spro///bab// /rdo//2juḥ// (7)/rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di mtshan ma med pa'i sbyor bas blta 'ing bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me t+t+waṃ zhes sogs rgya gzhung rnams las yig drug kho na 'byung yang / gter phyogs su yig bdun mang la de'i rgyu ma/tshan yang / byang gter las/ phyi ni srog sbas zhi ba'i tshul: yi ge drug pa rdo rje sgra: zhes pa nas/ gsang ba srog gi mtha' rten can: snyigs ma'i dus su srog mthar rten: zhes gsungs te/ spyir yig drug rang yang thugs srog bskul ba'i sngags las ma 'das mod/ 'on kyang skul byed yig drug dang / bskul bya srog yig gnyis ka dngos su sbrel nas bzlas na thugs rje gnad nas bskul ba la lhag par rno bas sngags 'grub par dka' ba'i dus su 'di gtso bor bzung zhes pa yin nam dpyod/ /de nyid snang chen dang dpal mchog 'grel bar/ sems can gti nu/ga shas che ba rnams sbyong byed du shes rab kyi phar phyin 'jig rten dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor du sprul bar gsungs pa dang / rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la sor rtog ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa'i cha nas spyan ras gzigs su brjod tshal dang / sgyu ma lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo rang ra༄1 dang don zhags sogs mang bor sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgos lhar bsngags pa dang / rnam snang mngon byang dang yo ga dang bla med rgyud kun tu sor rtog ye shes kyi lha mthar thug tu bshad cing ye shes de sngon chos bstan pa'i rgyu las byung ba dang / chos kyi longs spyod rgyas pa'i byed 177

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyolas can du mdo rgyan las gsungs pa dang / gsang 'dus sogs las 'di nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i ljags lha'i gzugs su shar bar gsungs te ljags ni gsung rab thams cad kyi bdag po yin tshul bsngags 'os bsngags bstod kyi bcu gcig pa ltar/ de sogs mang pos dpyad na 'phags pa 'di blo 'phel gyi lha phul du byung ba yin zhing / rdo rje snying bo rgyan las/ 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid ni/ /sogs dang / bshes spring las/ 'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzad nas/ zhes pa rtsa 'grel dang / yo ga'i mkhas pa gsum gyis pad+ma'i de nyid la gzigs pas khams gsum gyi dbang po brnyes tshul rgya cher bshad pa sogs dbang byed kyi lhar bsngags pa'i mtshon bshad rgyu mang yang / sgrub thabs phal cher las snying rje'i lhar bsngags pa shas che/ dbang byed kyi lhar bsngags pa yang phu gtugs na 'di dang gcig /de yang za ma tos bkod par 'phags pa 'di'i rnam thar thams cad sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams la rjes brtse mdzad tshul 'ba' zhig gi steng nas gsungs shing / sdong bo bkod par/ bde gshegs sras po ngas ni rnam thar gcig bsgoms te/ ye shes snying bo rgyal ba kun gyi thubs rje sdug /'gro ba thams cad bskyab cing yongs su bsdu phyir byung / zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa'i gong 'og gnyis su rje btsun 'dis ston pa'i spyan sngar rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa na snying 178

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7khyosherje chen po nyid kyi steng nas brjod pa dang / spyod 'jug tu bdag gces 'dzin boms pa'i dbang gis rang la mi snyan pa chung ngu'ang mi bzod pa ltar/ brtse ba goms pa'i shurgas rgyas pa na gzhan gyi mi bde ba phra mo yang mi bzod pa'i dper rje btsun 'di'i rnam thar drangs te/ de bas ji ltar sogs nas/ mtshan yang byin gyis brlabs/ ces pa'i bar ro/ /snying rje pad dkar las spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i mtshan 'di yang snying rje chen po'i yon tan gyi sgo nas sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis btags par kasungs pa dang / lag na rdo rje dbang bskur gyi gleng gzhir sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis rje btsun la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thukas rje chen po'i stobs kyi rdo rje pad+ma'i mchog gi snying bo byin nas sazhi dang snying bo me tog gi rgyan bkod pa'i zhing 'di lus kyi sprin rnams kyis bkang nas snang bar byed du btang bar bsungs pa dang /de/ nyid bsdus par bdag cag gi ston pa rnam snang nyid snying rje'i nyams kyis 'dul ba'i sems can gdul phyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur bstan par 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi thad du gsungs pa dang / spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i sgra bshad kyang sor rtog ye shes kyi spyan gyis rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la rtag tu gzigs pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis 'jig rten thams cad la gzigs pa lhur len nga/'i phyogs nas bshad tshul gnyis de nyid snang chen dang / ko sa la'i rgyan/ dpal mchog 'grel chen rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel ba rnams 179

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stan shisu gsungs pa'i phyi ma dang / legs grub tu yang / sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ yon tan dam pa kun bsags pa/ spyan ras gzibs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas so/ /ri dwags kriṇ+ḍa'i pags pas nu g.yon bkab par bshad pa'ang de ltar yin te/ dbu ma snying bor/ snying rje'i pags pa gnag 'chang zhing / zhes par 'dra'o/ /'dir lam gyi gtso bo snying rje chen por byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / mdo sngags khyad 'byed skabs gzhan don bzo khog dang / rdzogs byang sgrub pa'i lam thams cad de'i cha lag tu byed pa la theg chen gnyis 'dra bar bshad pa bzhin/ tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab gzungs spobs mngon shes sogs yon tan thams cad snying rje chen po'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi 'khor kho nar zad pas/ rin chen bdun gyi bdag po 'khor sgyur yin pa ltar/ yon tan de/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i bdag po snying rje chen po yin no/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan thams cad kyi gtso bo'am bdag po'ang skye la thugs rje chen po yin te/ 'bras dus kyi rnam gzhag mang po sngon gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgo nas byed par gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de'ang slob lam du snying rje chen po de theg gsum gyi rtogs rigs mtha' dag dang 'brel bar sbyangs pa'i mthar son pa na brtse chen gyi blo mngon gyur ba de nyid lam gyi rnam pa ma lus pa'i ngo bor skye ba la gegs su gyur ba'i 180

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7khyor+sha sanas ngan len gyi cha thams cad rgyun mtha'i rdor ting gis bcom nas/de'i rnam grol lam la slar yang snying rje chen po mngon gyur du 'byung ste/de ni stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa'i mtshan nyid can du skye'o/ /dngos grub kyi snying bo nge ltar ngos zin nas de nyid rgya gang che nas bsgrub dgos kyi/ gzhan du dper na bla ma mkhas grub chen po dang mjal yang skar ma'i dpyad lta bu'i don dman pa zhig las ci yang ma dris na gdams pa'i mchog rmams zur tsam yang mi thob pa dang 'dra'o/ /spyir yang sgo thams cad nas snying rje la mang du gnas par bya ba ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags pa'i khyad par gyi dam tshig yin par phyag stong spyan stong gi mdo dang /rgyal bo bka' 'bum/ kun bzang thugs gter sogs las nan tan du tsosu/ngas te/ de la brtson na 'phags pa dang brtul zhugs gcig la sanas par 'gyur bas 'phags pa dgyes de'ang spyir snying rje sgom pa tsam gyis mi chob si/ de 'phags pa dgyes pas ched du dmigs nas sgom pa zhig dgos te/ 'di'i dam tshig khyad pa da bar 'gro lugs shes pa'i steng nas so/ /mchan/ pa'i dka' thub kyi nor can te/ rjes 'dzin gyi gnad ches chen po'o/ /ha rlung / ra gtum mo/ a bde ba/ i don dam/ ha longs sku/ ra sprul sku/ a i sbyar ba chos sku'o/ /nge ltar na rlung gis gtum mo bskul bas bde stong gi ye shes skyes pa la brten nas sku gsum gyi go 'phang la sbyor zhes pa tshe sgrub ye shes 'od 181

21da/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ r+shar+sha6snyosgemachog ltar ro//༄༅/ /gcod kyi brjed tho/ /sems tshol kyis gzhi rtsa chod par byas nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings la shes pa gtad de dbyings rig sre ba la sbyang na mi rtog pa'i dbyings de stong nyid kyi rang bzhin du je gsal la 'ong ba yin gyi/ gzhi rtsa ma chod par yum don ngo 'phrod lusas med/de nas dbyings rig sre ba dngos la/rig pa phung bo'i gzeb kyis btum nas gcer bur 'bud mi thab pa de/ dmigs pas rten dang ///gle dmi ༅phral ( gcer bur bton nas dbyings la sre ba ni/ /rig pa rten med du phyungs nas dbyings rig sre ba zhes par 'gyur te gcod kyi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa yin gsung / sems kyi thig le mas rim nas spar te lus sems phral lugs 'di la rigs drug gnas sbyong yang tshang zhes 'brug chen gsung / de ltar dbyings rig sre ba tshad ldan zhig byung na de'i steng nas gzan skyur byas na lus la rang lus su mi 'dzin par rtsa dang rtsig pa lta bu'i blo 'char bde bas gces 'dzin gyi 'khri ba btsan thabs su gcod pa'i man ngag gi ral gri rnon po'o/ /dbyings rig sre ba byang tshe lus sems ma phral bar yum don bskyang na'ang 'dra gsung //de'ang nam ma kha' sgo 'byed dus dbyings rig bsres thog der rtse gcig bzhag /de la mi gnas na gzan skyur gyis zhen 'dzin bcad de/de ka'i ngang la yang dbyings rig sre ste/ 'di'i dmigs rim thams 182

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7khyo r+shacad yum don skyong ba'i rnam 'gyur dang rtsal sbyong yin gsung / yum don gyi rtogs pas bdud bzhi gcod tshul la/ phye na mang du yod kyang /mdor dril na/ /bdud thams cad snyem byed kyi bdud la 'du/ snyem byed ces pa snyam du sems par byed pa ste rnam rtog des na 'dzin zhen gyi rnam rtog nyid snyem byed kyi bdud du 'jog dga' sdug re dogs sogs kyi rnam rtog ci lta bu byung yang de'i rjes mi gcod/ cho 'phrul/ ltas ngan/rmi lam/ 'dod yon longs spyod sogs skyid sdug gi yul rkyen gang dang phrad kyang rtsis gdab mi bya bar shes rgya bskyed/ khong lhod de chos nyid kyi ngang la glod nas bzhag pas rang grol du song ste/ blo bde 'bol/ nyams dga' yal/ bag dro 'ur 'gro ba ni snyem byed kyi bdud gcad lugs dang chod lugs yin/ yul gang gi thog tu gcod kyang gcad rgyu dngos ni snyem byed kho na ste/ zhe sdang pho gdon/ 'dod chags mo gdon/ gti nu/ga klu gdon sogs thams cad de'i bye brag go/ /phaṭa kyi don yang snyem byed bcad/ snyem med kyi rig pa hur phyungs te dbyings la sre ba'o/ /lta ba rtogs kyang spyod yul thams cad dang ma bsres na yul rkyen drag po byung tshe 'jigs sar skyel mas bor ba lta bur 'gro/ gnyan sa gcig chod pa lta bu rkyen snang gcig la ro snyom nus kyang / de tsam gyis chog the/sa byas na rtsal phyogs med du rgyas mi thub pas ro snyom gyi nya mas len rtag 'grus su sbyong zhing / yul rkyen thams cad la sri ba gal che/ snyem 183

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byed kyi bdud drag po rgyu ba'i yul de nyer bcug nas de'i thog nyid du snyem thag bcad nas dbyings rig gi rtogs goms gdeng du 'gyur ba'i phyir gnyan sa gcod pa yin/ der 'dre lhong ba ni dbyings rig sre ba'i sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor zab mo'i gzi brjid mi bzod nas yin gyi//drag gcod dgos pa'i nges pa med ces 'brug chen no/ /lhong tshad thon dus skrag pa dang dogs pa sogs byung na yengs nas snyem shor ba yin pas de ma thag ngos bzung la snyems sam rnam rtog bcad de dbyings rig bsre ba'i ngang la bzhag /mdze pho dang / dam nyams sogs la bcad pas dbyings rig gi nyams myong dang bar du snyem zhugs pas chod shor na sems rmugs 'thib dang / skrang ba/ nad 'go ba sogs yod/ de la gang gis lan pa de nyid dang slor (slar)bsres la snyem dang ma bral bar du nyams su blang bas rang zhir 'gro/ lar thog brdzis kyi go don/ thag khra sprul du mthong nas skrag tshe thag khra de nyid kyi thog tu phyin nas bltas pas 'jigs skrag de rtsad med khungs med du chod pa ltar/ gang la nyam nga zhing bag tsha ba'i yul rkyen de nyid la thog 'gel btsan 'gyel byas nas yum don bskyang bas sngar nas snang ba sems dang / sems stong bar ngo 'phrod zin pa ltar snang sems mtha' dag dmigs med kyi dbyings su nye bar zhi ba'i 'jigs med kyi gdeng chen thob pa ste/ le lag las/ dper na smig rgyu chur mthong ba/ /thog tu phyin pas chu med 184

brjed tho sna tshogs/ pod/ 7trabazhin/ /lha dang klu dang nyam grib sogs/ /de thog bsgyur bas yod mi srid/ /ci phyir rang gi sems yin pas/ /de na snyem med lhug par zhog /ces gsungs te/ 'di la/ nad pa 'dre la gtad pas gnyis med rang sar grol/ /skyel ma dgra la gtad pas 'jigs med mtha' ru bskyal/ /lam khyer rkyen la byas pas mi mthun 'gal rkyen med/ /rkyen ngan srid du chod pas yul na dgra med 'dra/ /zhes gsung ngo / /gcod 'di rkyen ngan lam khyer la shin tu rno yang / bzang rkyen lam 'khyer mi 'dug snyam na/dga' brod kyi bdud ngos 'dzin dang / de gcod tshul/ chod mtshams sogs ltos dang shes par 'gyur/mtha' gtad ces pa/ dper na rngon pa rnams kyis thang lta bu la ri dwags ji ltar byas kyang ma zin na brag la sogs pa'i mtha' gcig la gtad nas ded pas gzhan du 'gro sa med nas zin pa bzhin/ gnyan khrod du na tsha lta ba'i lha 'dre'i lhong byung ba na ma chod par snyem byed mgo rgyal du shor bas/ gzhan du byol ba dang / yas stag byin pa sogs byas kyang mi phan pas/ slar kho gnas pa'i sa gnyan brko/ chu gnyan dkrugs/ shing gnyan bcad/ thab gzhob chen po btang ste/ snyem byed bcad nas chos nyid kyi ngang du glod la bsdad pas rang zhir 'gro/'dir ri dwags kyi dpe dang sbyor rgyu gnyan sa'i lha 'dre la byas na go ba chung bas snyem byed kyi bdud la bya'am snyam ste/ dpe don 'di le lag 185

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ las so/ /gcod pas ri khrod gnyan sa dben pa rnams bsten/ grong yul du mi sdod/ tshogs pa mi skyong / ldom bu yang yun ring mi bya ste/ de dag gis sems g.yengs te/ nyams myong shor/ drod tshad yal ba'i nyen che bas so/ /mi ma yin dbang du 'dus pa/ dam la thogs pa/ gdon thul ba sogs ci byung yang dga' brod mi bya ste/ de nyid dga' brod kyi bdud ces bya ba'i snyem byed chen po yin pas so/ /gcod pa'i gol sa gsam ni/༄gcod mo/(sman)'dod yon/ drag sngags su shor ba rnams te/ dang po ni / sngar ltar gnyan khrod 'grim zhing nyams len bskyangs pas rig pa dwangs snyigs phyed de gsal snang la/ 'dre gnod mi gnod dang / nad pa 'tsho 'chi sogs shar te/ gzhan la bzlas pas rno mthong gi rgyus tshor nas mi kun yang yang 'drir 'ong / de la g.yeng bas nyams rtogs yal 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsod nams snyan grags sna tshogs byung bas mgo 'khor te sgom g.yeng bas khyer ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sher phyin gyi nyams myong bskyang ba'i byin rlabs kyis nad pa dang / 'dre can rigs la byin rlabs byas pas sar song ste/ yon bdag mang pos bos nas grong kha 'grim pas nyams rtogs 'grib/ byin rlabs yal/ de nas 'dre 'dul drag sngags la re dgos pa 'ong ba'o/ gcod kyi myong ba ches mthon po yin na 'di 'dra'i dogs pa mi dgos sam snyam ste dam pa rgya gar bzhin no/ /gcod pa la gdon bgegs bar chad kyis mi tshug/sa 186

phang〉 /pa/snye/rje/ཿpa// sta/// //ste/ ///lnga:spro//lha/sa// 1rdo//ཿཿཿ// rto74/pa'i gnad ni/ bram ze ar+ya de bas/ de ltar nyams su len pa la/ /pha rol phyin pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chos rnams stong bar rtogs pa des/ /bar chad 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ /stong ba nyid la stong nyid kyis/glugs rnyed pa lta ga la srid/ /ces/ ma zhig na bar gyur la bu ni sogs sdud pa las gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal yum gyi byin rlabs dang / don dam pa'i srung ba khyad par can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis gsungs/ dbyings rig sre ba la rang gi lus sems dang / sbyin yul lha 'dre sogs snang srid thams cad sher phyin gyi klong du ro gcig par sre ba yod pas/ rnam shes lus las bton kyang 'pho rab tshe thung ba'i nyen mi 'byang ba yin mutshor rī ri charadapa ra nam/'ad na khungs ma rnyad pas dpyad dgas/ dga'/ /yang tshom las/ skyid la 'bral bar mi phod dang / /sdug la spyod par mi phod dang / /lha la mi phar mi phod dang / /'dre la lus skyur ma phod dang //rang khyim spong bar mi phod dang / /gnyan sa 'grim par mi phod dang / /nad dang rims la sogs pa la/ /mi phod bzhin du thog brdzis na/ /ro snyom spyod pa khyad par 'phags/ /kun kyang yon tan mnyam par 'gyur/ /dgag sgrub rtog pa chung bar 'gyur/ /dgag sgrub med pa'i don rtogs na/ /btang snyom chen po'i ngang bzhag go/ /zhes so/ /bgegs dang stong nyid kyi dbyings gnyis kyi bar du snyem byed zhugs dus gnod nus kyi/'drer 'dzin gyi rtsa ba bcad de stong ba'i dbyings las ma g.yos na/187

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bdud kyi spyod yul brgal te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul na gnas pa yin pas/ lha 'dre yod kyang ci gnod de/ spyod yul shin tu bskal ba'i phyir te/rmi lam gyi khyis sad dus kyi rje ngar mi 'bigs pa'am/ rgya gar gyi duka sbrul bod la mi gnod pa bzhin no/ /zhes bya'o/ /gcod 'di'i yum don skyong lugs/ phar phyin pa'i stong nyid la dmigs pa'i lhag mthong sgrub lugs ni min te/ dpyad sgom rtsal du 'don phyogs gtan min pa'i phyir ro/ /stong nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas sgrub tshul tsam yang min te/ de tsam gyis rgyud yongs su grol mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang sngags phyi ba min te/ bla med thun min gyi lha khros nag dang 'brel ba dang / tshul 'dis 'chi ba 'od gsal ngos zin par nying tshom dang le lag tu bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bla med spyi 'gros min te/ bskyed rdzogs kyi 'gros spyi ltar brtsi rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzogs chen ltar yang min te/ sems rig 'byed pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /sems mi rtog par bzhag pas 'od gsal sgom par 'gro na ha shang yang rdzogs rim mkhan po yin par thal lo/ /grub thob kyi lam srol ma nor ba ni yin 'dug pas ji ltar gzung zhes pa rnams ni dogs pa bslang ba'o/ /de'i lan la gzhan tshos ci 'debs ci shes/ rang gi go tshod ltar na/ sems tshol dus stong nyid kyi lta ba ma nor ba zhig rnyed dgos/ de nas nam mkha' sgo 'byed dus 'bum dang nyi khri sogs nas 188

pha mi /pa/snye/rje/ཿpa// 1lnga// //// /blo/rdo1skyu//lhas// /rngo//rdo pa// rto71/bstan pa'i sher phyin dang / sngags bla med pa'i 'od gsal thams cad rang sems mi rtog pa'i ngo bo 'di las gzhan na med par thag bcad de/'od gsal 'char dus stong nyid sgom tshul dang mthun par bskyang bas rgyud yongs su dag pa na/ sems kyi cha rnams dag ste rig pa'i ye shes nyag gcig tu go 'pho bas/ yum don dang po skyong dus nas 'od gsal dmigs khongs su chug pa dang / 'od gsal gyi stangs byas nas sgom pa dgos so/ /mi tra'i phyag chen sogs phyag chen skor mang por sems kyi kazhi rtsa bcad de ci yang yid la mi byed par rten med du bzhag pas/rim gyis lhan cig skyes pa'i 'od gsal kyi dbyings su sems ngal sos yong bar gsungs pa thams cad 'di ltar red de/ dper na lte ba dang spyi bo'i 'khor lo la gnad du bsnun tshul tsam las ma bshad pa'i rdzogs rim/ mang po snying ka'i sdud rim la gzhol ba ltar/ dang po nas sngags kyi 'od gsal yin zhes rtsal 'don med kyang / 'di ltar bskyang bas nam zhig na bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs rgyud la smin nas sngar bsgom pa'i yum don de'i steng nas rang bzhin lhan skyes ngo 'phrod yong bas/'di bzhin dang po sgom dus nas sgom 'di'i khong nas sngags kyi 'od gsal mi gsal ba'i tshul kyis skyong lugs yod par mngon no/ /de'ang 'di'i dbyings rig bsre thad/ shes pa rten med du bzhag pas glo bur ba'i dmigs rten can gyi blo'i spros pa shas je chung la rim gyis song nas/189

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ rten med kyi shes rig gnyug ma'i cha zhig rjen la bud yong / de ka bzo med rang babs su bskyang ba las lhag pa ni rdzogs chen khregs chod la yang ma mthong ngo / /rdzogs chen nas kyang / tha mas thog mar zhi gnas 'ba' zhig btsal/ zhes sogs rig thog tu sna 'khrid lugs mang bo bshad do/ /gcod kyi 'di zhi gnas skyong tshul dang yang mthun mi mthun dpyad dgos te/ 'di la shes pa rten med du dbyings la 'jog pa yod kyang / gnas cha 'tshol lugs bshad pa mi gsal/ da dung dpyod dang shes yong /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam ni mchog sgrub kyi rgyal bo yin pas thun mong gi dngos grub phran tshegs tsam gyi phyir don du gnyer bya ma yin mod kyi/ de nyams su blang bas lo legs na phub ma zhar la 'byung ba ltar thun mong gi 'dod don gzhan yang 'bad med du 'byung ba las/ re zhig nad kyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i man ngag tu 'gro lugs 'char gzhi tsam smos na/ lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo sprod thebs pa rnams kyis/ rtsal thog tu gtan ma shor bar rang babs gnyug ma'i rig pa dbyings la bsres te bzhag pas/ re zhig na tsha nyid ma zhi yang de la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sems dang / de las byung ba'i re dogs kyi sgrog mdud zhig pa'i dbang gis rig pa gcer bu bag yangs su ngal sos nas na tsha de mi tshor ba lta 190

zla shāmi /rdo//snye/jo/ཿpa// 1dro// //// /grit+na/:spros/lhaspros// /rdo/rgo2rwaḥ// (7mi bur zil gyis mnan pa dang / der ma zad rang lus na tsha dang bcas pas mtshon gang snang thams cad zang thal rjen pa'i rig pa 'ba' zhig tu song ba lta ba'i ngang la bde phril ler gnas pa 'byang / de ni nad rig mi ra pa dang nad kyi gzhi snyigs ma'i 'byung ba thams cad ka dag gnyug ma'i bde dbyings su thim par gyur zhes ched du dmigs pa'i rtsol ba ma byas kyang / don gyis de lta bu'i bsdu rim gyi rnal 'byor khyad par can du song yod la/ de'ang rang babs kyi gnad mthar thug la brten pa yin pas thabs des rlung dang de'i rtsa ba can gyi nang 'byung thams cad dul zhing las rung gi dngos por gyur nas rang babs su 'jug pa la tshegs me/da cing / de ltar nang gi khams rnams rang babs su gnas pa'am rnal du gnas pa de la rnam par ma gyur ba'i bde ba zhes nad med pa'i bde ba'i gnas skabs 'dogs so/ /de'ang nad rtsa thig rlung gsum la brten/ de gsum yang rtsa ba gnyug sems la brten pas gnyug sems las su rung na sa la gting drod babs tshe kha dar rang shugs kyis zhu ba bzhin gzhan rnams ngang gis khong mnyen cing lhod du 'gro ba chos nyid yin no/ /nad de dang de rnam pa thams cad du zhi bar bya ba'i bsam pas rig pa dbyings la gtad na ni don de dmigs phug nas sgrub par 'gro ste/ lug sa 'dir phrin las rnam pa bzhi gang byed kyang gnad kyi man ngag 'di kho na yin par bshad do/ /sgom dus rtsal thog tu shor 191

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phan chad/ nad gdon sogs kyi me ro gsos pa yin pas zhi bar 'dod kyang ngal ba tsam ste/ chu dkrugs pas rnyogs ma dwangs su re ba bzhin no//des na a tsha a na zhes rig pa dang na tsha'i bar du sems kyis brda sbyor ba'i sgo nas nad gsal 'debs pa dang / cung zad zhi ba na da be sbyor gyis nad la dwangs skyed thon pa yin nam snyam pa sogs rtsal thog shor ba'i 'phrang la gzab dgos so/ /mnyam bzhag gi mthus rtsal rang mal du thim pa'i lam rnyed nas las rlung ye shes kyi khams su dag ste/phung po'i zag pa zad cing phra rags sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho brgal ba'i tshul ni phyogs 'di'i gzhung chen po rnams las shes par bya'o/ /o rgyan sman gyi bla ma dgyes pa'i rol mor spros so/ /yig 'bru'i tshul/ zhes pa/ gong du le'u gsum pa bzhi ba'i 'brel ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi mnyam pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin mtshon brjod las 'das kyang de nyid mtshon byed kyi yi ge ming tshig du mar shar nas chos ston pa'i tshul gyis/ /sems nyid skye ba med kyang de nyid rol ba lha'i sku gsung thugs su 'char zhes mdzub mos zla ba ston pa ltar byed/des mi lo na/ yi ge la brjod don mtshon rgyu med kyang / brda dang tha snyad kyi ngor don sna tshogs ston byed du 'char ba ltar/ sems nyid kyi rang bzhin la skye ba med kyang / ming brdas btags pa'i tha snyad tsam du sku gsung thugs kyi rol ba tshad med par snang / zhes pa 'di dag gang rung 192

dzeḥji /spro///ji/ཿpa// 1dro// //// /blo/mi/bab/lhas// /rdo//2ཿཿ// (7mi os red/yang gsang bla sgrub las/ chos bdag gsum gsung pa ni/ zhabs drung yang steng pa rwa ston/ lcags zam rin po che/ bo dong sbyor ra rin po che rnams te/ grub pa'i gtso dang / snyan ngag mkhan so sor 'grigs shing /'di nas lo gsum sogs dang yang 'grigs/sku sh+ka tshad zhe lnga yin kyang / mtsho rgyal gyis nyer lnga byin zhes lgasungs pa ni/ zhe lnga ba chu mo sbrul/ de lor mtsho rgyal bla mtsho'i brda bsgyur phyag tu son/ de'i lung bstan na/ rten 'brel ma 'chol las can skyes bu'i tshe/ /sogs 'byung ba sku che'i lung bstan yin 'dug pas/ma/kha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo'i chos gter gyi skabs der rku tshe bsring bar gsal/mkha' 'gro'i gad rgyangs ni/ rdzogs chen sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas brtul zhugs lam 'khyer gyi ched du phung po gzan skyur tsam bstan pa ste/rgong 'og tu yum don skyong ba thams cad khregs chod kyi dbyings rig sre ba'i cog bzhag gi gnad kho nar byed cing / bdud bzhi dbyings kacod kyang de nyid kyis byed pas/ 'di'i lugs la khregs chod sgom pa min pa'i yum don ngo sprod nam mkha' sgo 'byed sogs zur ba med do/ /des na 'di nyams su len mkhan gyis dang por ka dag khregs chod kyi rtogs pa'i gdeng ci rigs re thob dgos so/ /de'i phyir gcod gzhung 193

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/spyi dang 'di gnyis la thun khyad kyi khyad par che'o/ /'di yang rje nyid kyi phyag bris ji lta ba bzhin bcos bslad med par spar du skrun pa dge legs 'phel/ /194

pod/ 7༄/ /skyid sdug lam 'khyer bzhugs so/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/ /gang zhig rtag tu pha rol bde bas bde 'gyur zhing / /gzhan dag sdug bsngal gyur pas mchog tu 'o brgyal ba/ /thugs rje chen po'i yon tan shin du bsgrubs pa gang / /de ni rang gi bde sdug spangs te 'dug pa yin/ /zhes ji skad rgasungs pa'i yon tan rjes su dran nas phyag byas te/ dam pa rnams kyi nyer mkho'i lag cha 'jig rten na rin thang dang bral ba skyid sdug lam 'khyer gyi man ngag cha tsam brjod par bya ste/ de la gnyis/ sdug bsngal lam du 'khyer tshul dang / skyid pa lam du 'khyer tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ kun rdzob dang / don dam la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems can dang sems can ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba nam byung du sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes 'ba' zhig 'jog pa la blo goms na yul rkyen phra mo res kyang sems kyi zag rnga ches chen po skyed de/ bde sdug gi 'du shes gang la ༄ ༄ goms pa de 'phel 'gro ba chos nyid yin pas so/ /de ltar rim gyis rgoms pa'i stobs 'phel te/ ci zhig na gang snang phal cher yid mi bde 'dren pa'i rgyur song nas bde ba'i go skabs ye med pa zhig 'ong / de rang gi blo goms tshul gyis lan yod pa mi shes par phyi rol gyi yul rkyen 195

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kho nas nyes par bzung bas phyi phyir khong khro sogs las ngan sdug bsngal gyi me lce thug med du mched par 'gyur te/ snang ba dgrar lang ba bya ba yin/ snyigs ma'i sems can sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i rgyu mtshan so sor rtog pa'i stobs dman pa 'di la thug yod pas zhib tu shes dgos /de'i phyir dgra dang nad gdon la sogs pa'i bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa'i don ni/ nad sogs de dag byung ba ldog pa dang / phyis mi 'byung ba la mi byed kyi/ de dag lam sgrub pa'i bar chad du skye mi nus pa la bya'o/ /de ltar 'ong ba ni/ rang sdug bsngal ba la mtha' gcig tu mi 'dod pa'i blo dgag pa dang / sdug bsngal de byung ba la dga' ba'i blo skyed pa gnyis kyis sgrub dgos pa'i/ dang po ni/ sdug bsngal la mtha' gcig tu mi mthun pa'i rnam par bltas nas yid mi dga' ba'i bze re ci tsam byas kyang dgos nus med cing / nyes dmigs che ba'i tshul la nges pa yang dang yang du drang la/ deng phan chad sdug bsngal ji lta bu byung yang bze re mi bya'o snyam du 'phen pa drag po mang du goms par bya zhing /snying stobs cher skyed pa la bslab bo/ /de la dgos nus med pa ni/ sdug bsngal de bcos su yod na mi dga' ba bya mi dgos shing / 'chos su mi btub na mi dga' ba byas kyang phan pa med pa'o/ /nyes dmigs che ba ni /bze re ma byas na sems stobs kyis sdug bsngal chen po yang ras bal ltar yang zhing srab par tshor nas 'khur sla ba yin pa la/ bze re byas 196

skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ pod/ 7byer+shapa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal chung ngu yang yid mi bde'i tshor ba mi bzad pa bsnan nas shin du bzod dka' ba'o/ /de'ang dper na mdzes ma'i ma/tshar sdug la rtog bzhin du 'dod chags dgag lo byas kyang ngal ba tsam du zad pa ltar/ sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba'i rnam pa la yid shas cher gtad nas bzod sran skyed mi nus pas dbang bo'i sgo sdom pa'i man ngag rnams las 'byung ba ltar/ sdug bsngal de la yid shes kyis mtshan mar mi bzung bar blo rnal du bzhag la rang so gzung ba zhig boms dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdug bsngal la lam gyi grogs su bltas nas dga' ba sgom pa ste/ de'ang sdug bsngal gang byung rang gi blo'i nus pa dang bstun pa'i dge sbyor re dang bsre rgyu med na/ spyir thabs mkhas dang ldan na sdug bsngal la brten nas phan yon 'di dang 'di lta bu 'thob tu yod do zhes pa tsam zhig mang du bsam kyang / nam mkha' dang ni sa gzhi'i bar yang ring / zhes pa ltar song nas dgos pa 'grub dka'o/ /des na re zhig sdug bsngal la brten nas nges 'byung gi bsam pa sbyang ba ni/ ji srid dbang med du 'khor bar 'khyams pa de srid 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni mi 'os pa zhig byung ba ma yin gyi 'khor ba'i ngang tshul de lta bu yin no snyam pa dang / re zhig bde 'gro na spyod pa'i sdug bsngal nyi tshe yang 'di ltar bzod par dka' na/ ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal lta ci smos te/ kye ma'o 'khor ba ni gting mtha' med pa'i 197

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho yin no snyam du skyo ba bskyed de/ yid thar ba la phyogs par bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sbyang ba ni/ de ltar tshe rabs brgyud mar 'jigs pa 'di lta bus yang dang yang du nyen pa la mi bslu ba'i skyabs su gyar pa ni dkon mchog gsum kho na yin pas cis kyang de kho na la riri ca ///de /rdo/tshebarten par bya nga / de gsum ci la babs kyang gtang bar bya'o snyam du nges par byas nas skyabs 'gro sgom pa'o/ /dregs pa bsal ba ni/gong du bshad pa ltar rang la dbang med cing / rtag tu sdug bsngal gyi gzhan dbang can las ma 'das pa'i tshul la brten te/ legs tshogs 'joms pa'i dgra bo nga rgyal dang / gzhan khyad du gsod pa'i blo ngan tshar gcad par bya'o/ /sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ sdug bsngal 'di lta bu dang //'di bas ches che ba dpag tu med pa ni sdig pa 'ba' zhig las byung ngo zhes las nges pa dang / 'phel che ba dang / ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa dang / byas pa chud mi za ba bzhi'i sgo nas legs par bsam la/ de'i phyir sdug bsngal mi 'dod na de'i rgyu mi dge ba spong dgos so snyam du sngar bsags stobs bzhis bshags shing / phyi ma bsdam pa la 'bad do/ /dge ba la dga' ba ni/ sdug bsngal log pa'i bde ba la dga' na de'i rgyu dge ba la 'bad dgos so snyam du rgyas par bsam la sgo du ma nas dge ba'i phyogs ci 'phel bya'o/ /snying rje la slob pa ni/ bdag bzhin du sems can gzhan yang sdug bsngal de lta bu dang / de las ches che bas 198

skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ pod/ 7tramanar tshul rnams bsam la de dag kyang sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung snyam du sbyang ngo / /bde bas phongs pa la dmigs nas byams pa sgom tshul yang des shes so/ /bdag bas gzhan gces sgom pa ni/ bdag 'di ltar sdug bsngal gyis mi gtong ba ni thog ma med pa nas rang gces par bzung bas lan pas/ da ni bde legs kyi 'byung rganas gzhan gces 'dzin kho na la gnas par bya'o snyam du sgom pa'o/ /de'ang gdong thug dus shin du dka' bas/ rkyen ngan dang bsre rgyu'i dge sbyor de dag snga nas 'dris pa gal che zhing / rang nyid gang la soms pa gsal ba zhig gtso bor bzung ste bsres na khyad che'o/ /sdug bsngal dge sbyor gyi grogs su song ba gcig pus kyang mi chog gi de ltar song ba de legs par ngo shes nas des drangs pa'i dga' ba shugs drag la rgyun brtan por 'jug pa zhig nges par dgos pas ji skad bshad pa nge dag gang gi tshe yang / 'di ltar sdug bsngal 'dis bdag la shin du rnyed par dka' ba'i mtho ris dang thar ba'i bde skyid bzang la mang ba sgrub pa'i grogs rgya cher byas shing / tshul 'dis da dung yang byed par 'gyur bas 'di ni rtsub kyang mchog tu dga' ba'i gnas te/ sug smel na le sham bsres pa'i/ sha kha ra yi la du bzhin/ zhes pa lta bu'o snyam du de'i tshul zhib tu yang yang bsam la yid bde ba goms par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas bde ba'i yid byed lhag pa'am shas che ba'i dbang gis 199

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khye dbang shes kyi sdug bsngal mi mngon pa lta bur song ste/ des sems la gnod mi nus pa ni bzod pas nad zil gyis non pa'i tshad yin la/des dgra 'dre sogs zil gyis non ba'i tshad kyang shes par bya'o/ /gong du bshad pa ltar sdug bsngal la mi 'dod pa'i 'du shes zlog pa ni sdurga bsngal lam du slong ba'i rten gzhi yin te/ bze res sro shi zhing rgyud 'khrugs bzhin du sdug bsngal lam du slong bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /sdug bsngal lam khyer dngos la sbyang bas kyang snga ma la bogs dbyung bar byed de/ sdug bsngal gyis dge sbyor 'phel ba myong thog tu khel bas phyi phyir spro ba rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag sdug bsngal chung rim nas sbyang na sla ba'i go rim zhes pa ltar mthar gyis chen po la'ang 'byong bar gsungs pas de ltar dgos te/ rang gi rgyud tshod dang mi 'tshams pa'i myong ba rnyed dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /thun mtshams rnams su bla ma dkon mchog la sdug bsngal lam du longs ba'i ched du gsol ba 'debs pa dang / blo'i mthu cung zad cher song ba na dkon mchog dang 'byung bo mchod nas bdag gi dge sbyor rtsal sbyong ba'i phyir rkyen ngan thong zhig ces las 'chol bya zhing / dus nam yang dga' spro'i gdeng tshad dang ldan par bya'o/ /dang bor slob dus 'du 'dzi rgyang bsring nas sgom pa'ang gces te/ 'du 'dzi'i gseb tu sdug bsngal dang brnyas smod sogs ga la bzod zer ba'i grogs ngan mang ba'i shan 'go ba dang /200

skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ pod/ 7zhedagra gnyen longs spyod la brten pa'i sems khral mang bos shes pa rnyogs shing dbang med du 'khrugs nas lang la 'chor ba dang / de las kazhan yang g.yeng ba'i yul rkyen sna tshogs kyis phrogs nas 'gro zhing /dben pa'i gnas su de dag med pas rig pa shin du dwangs la/ de'i dbang gis blo bkol bar sla ba'i phyir te/ gcod yul ba rnams sdug bsngal thog rdzis kyi yid byed sbyong ba na/ dang bor 'du 'dzi'i nang du mi'i gnod pa la brten nas sbyong ba bzhag ste/ dur khrod gnyan sa dben par lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul la brten nas sbyong ba gtso bor byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di yin par bshad do/ /mdor bsdu na/ rkyen ngan/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyis sems la mi gnod pa ra ma zad/ de dag nyid kyis bde ba'i yid byed 'dren thub par byed pa la/ nang gi nad dang /phyi'i dgra 'dre dang gtam ngan sogs de dag mi 'dod pa'i rnam par 'char ba bkag ste/ yid 'ong gi rnam pa kho nar 'char ba lob dgos/nge 'ong ba la nyer 'tshe de dag skyon gyi phyogs su lta ba dgag cing / yon tan du lta ba 'bad pa thams cad kyis bslab dgos te/ yul de yid 'ong yin min ni blos 'dzin tshul la thug pa'i phyir te/ dper na 'du 'dzi'i nyes dmigs kyi phyogs nas mang du bsam pa rnams 'khor dang longs spyod sogs ci tsam rgyas pa de tsam du sun snang cher 'gro zhing /'du 'dzi la phan yon du lta ba rnams ni mnga' thang rgyas pa la yid smon 201

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshun chad byed pa bzhin no/ /de ltar blo sbyangs pas rgyad 'jam/ khog zi rdzu larang lag sna /grobye skur mchog dzorangayangs/ 'grags na bad/ khang dpa'/ sa la bar chad mad/ rkyan ngan thams cad dpal dang bkra shis kyi phyogs su 'char/ rtag tu zhi ba'i bde bas rgyud tshim pa 'byung ste/ snyigs ma'i dus su lam sgrub na go cha 'di lta bu med du ye mi rung ngo / /de'i tshe bze re'i sdug bsngal med pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gzhan rnams kyang dmag mi lag cha ltung ba lta bur 'gro bar ma zad/ nad sogs nyid kyang phal cher rang log tu 'gro ste/ sngon gyi dam pas gang la'ang mi dga' ba dang yid mi bde ma byas pas sems mi 'khrugs/ de ma 'khrugs pas rlung ma 'khrugs/ de'i dbang gis lus kyi 'byung ba gzhan yang mi 'khrugs/ des kyang sems mi 'khrugs pa sogs bde ba'i 'khor lo 'khor bar gsungs pa dang /rta bong sgal rma can la bya rnams glags rnyed pa ltar 'jigs pa'i rang bzhin can la 'dre rnams kyis glags btsal sla zhing / ngang brtan pa rnams thub par dka' bar gsungs pa la sogs pas shes so/ /de ltar na mkhas pa ni skyid sdug thams cad sems la rag las par mthong nas /bde skyid sems kyi steng nas 'tshol te/ skyid kyi rgyu tshogs rang la tshang bas phyi rol la rag ma las shing / sems can dang sems can ma yin pa'i gnod pa gang gis kyang brdzir med pa dang / 'chi ba'i tshe yang rjes su 'brang ba sogs yin te/ dus rtag tu rang dbang thob pa yin no/ /— 20 2

skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ pod/ 7trabyang chub sems dpas chos thams cad bde bas non pa'i ting nge 'dzin yang 'di ltar sgrub pa yin la/ blun po ni bde skyid phyi rol gyi yul las tshol du re nas rgyug ste/ de la ni skyid che chung gang sgrub kyang /dbang mi lag co to shing lag zer ba ltar song nas/ ma sleb pa dang /ma 'dzom pa dang / tshod ma thig pa sogs thog tu ma 'khyol ba kho na mang zhing / dgra rkun sogs kyi gnod pa'i glags dang bcas pa dang / snyad 'dogs cung zad res kyang bral nas 'gro bas bya rog gis khu byug gi bu ci tsam gsos kyang rang gi bur 'ong mi srid pa ltar yid brtan mi rung ba sha stag tu zad pas/ lha 'o brgyal la/ 'dre nyon mongs pa rang sdug bsngal ba zhig las med de/ gnad brgya 'gag gcig la dril ba'i snying gtam yin no/ /lam sgrub pa'i dka' spyad kyi sdug bsngal dang du len lugs dang / zhi byed sogs las bshad pa'i nad gdon lam khyer gyi man ngag gzhan yang mang du yod mod/ 'dir ni sdug bsngal dang len spyi khyab tsam 'phags pa zhi ba lha dang de'i rjes 'brangs mkhas pa'i ga zhung la brten nas go bde bar bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtha' bzhi'i skye 'gog la sogs pa'i rigs pa'i 'phrul gyis rkyen ngan sdug bsngal lta ci/ de dag gi ming tsam yang mi rnyed pa'i gnas lugs stong pa nyid mchog tu zhi ba la yid drangs te bzhag cing / de las langs pa na'ang sngar 'jigs skrag dang zhum pa sogs skye dus kyi blo ngor sdug bsngal 203

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'char lugs ltar ma yin par/ ming tsam gyi gsog tu lta bas zil gyis mnan par bya ste/ rgyas par ma brjod do/ /gnyis pa la'ang gnyis kyi/kun rdzob la brten pa ni/ bde ba dang bde ba'i yul rkyen byung ba'i tshe de'i dbang du shor na kheng dregs dang / rgyags pa dang / le lo sogs 'phel nas lam la bar du gcod par byed de/ pha dam pas/ mi rnams skyid la khyag chung / sdug la khyag che/ gsungs pa ltar 'di'i dbang du mi 'gro ba dka'o/ /de'i phyir dngos po de dag mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba'i rnam par sgo du ma nas bltas la skyo shas chen po bskyed de yid bag med las bzlog pa la 'bad cing / yang 'di snyam du/ de ltar srid pa'i bde 'byor thams cad mnog chung la nyes dmigs mang po dang 'brel ba yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'ga' zhig la yon tan yod de/ ston pas sdug bsngal gyis rang dbang nyams par byas pa'i mis byang chub sgrub pa ni ches dka' zhing / bde bar gnas pas byang chub sgrub pa ni ches sla bar gsungs te/ bdag 'di ltar skyid kyi ngang nas chos sgrub tu yod pa ni bsod nams che ba yin gyis/ dus 'dir ci nas kyang bde skyid 'dis chos nyo zhing / chos las kyang bde skyid brgyud mar 'byung ba'i tshul gyis chos dang bde ba gnyis phan tshun grogs su 'gro ba la sbyang bar bya ste/ gzhan du na shing gi snod du btung ba bskol ba ltar dang po gang yin de nyid tha ma'i gnas skabs su 'gyur ro snyam du bsgrim la 204

mdzojis ཿmi /skyi|/:pa// //sduḥ// tshopa/(54 tshorwardo|///shā se/ /rngo//4ཿཿ// (77/bde skyid gang byung chos dang bsre bas snying bo blang dgos te rin chen phreng ba'i dgongs pa'o/ /skyid kyang de ngos ma zin pas chos sgrub pa'i 'a/lga char mi 'gro bar da dung bde skyid zur pa cig 'ong du re nas don dang bya ba mang bo'i ngang la tshe gtugs pa'i gnyen por yang de rnams ji ltar mthan mthan du sbyar la chog shes kyi bdud rtsi bsten par bya'o/ /༄ ༄dkon mchog gi bka' drin dran pa dang / byang chub sems sbyong gi gdams pa la brten nas skyid pa lam du 'khyer tshul sogs gzhan yang yo da mod de/ re zhig de tsam mo/ /'di yang dben pa brten nas bsags sbyang dang sbrel mar sbyang dgos pa ni sdug bsngal lam khyer dang 'dra'o/ /don dam la brten pa'ang snga mas shes so/ /sdug dus de'i sems las kyis chos mi nus shing / skyid dus de la chags nas chos mi nus na/ de nas chos byed dus shig yong thabs med pas chos byed na 'di las thabs chag pa med cing / 'di yod na gnas dben pa dang grong yul gang du bsdad kyang / grogs bzang ngan su dang 'grogs kyang /'byor rgud bde sdug ci byung yang / gtam stod smad legs nyes gang thos kyang rang nyid nyams su dogs pa'i 'jigs pa med pas seng ge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa bya ba yin te/ ji ltar byas kyang blo bde la gu yangs pa/ zhe gtsang la mtha' bzang ba/ lus ma dag pa'i zhing na gnas kyang sems dag pa'i zhing gi rgyal sras ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bde ba'i 205

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpal la rol ba yin te/ bka' gdams rin po ches/ skyid kyi kha gnon sdug gi mjug sdud/ gcig pur 'dug na skyo grogs byed/ na na nad g.yog byed/ ces gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs so/ /dper na gser mgar gyis gser me la bsreg nas dri ma sbyang / chus yang yang bkrus nas mnyen par byed pa ltar/ sems kyang skyid pa lam khyer gyis gdung bar byas/ sdug bsngal lam khyer gyis dang bar byas na lus sems las su rung ba'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rnams bde blag tu 'grub la/legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par byed pa'i man ngag la'ang 'di rang zab par go ste/ skyid pa la ma chags pas rab du byung ba'i tshul khrims khyad par can gyi rten gzhi byed cing / sdug bsngal la mi 'jigs pas tshul khrims de yongs su dag par byed pa'i phyir te/sbyin pa tshul khrims kyi rten dang / bzod pa tshul khrims dag byed du gsungs pas shes so/ /da lta 'di ltar sbyangs pas lam mthon por sleb pa na/ de yis chos shesarab kun sgyu ma lta bu dang / /skye ba skyed mos tshal snying rje 'gro ltar rtogs nas/ /'byor ba'i dus dang rgud pa'i dus na'ang 'di/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal dag gis 'jigs pa med/ /ces pa ltar 'byung ba yin no/ /ston pa'i rnam thar dang sbyar na/ byang chub ma brnyes gong du 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal srid rtswa ltar spangs pa dang / nai rañdza 206

skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ pod/ 7zhe nar dka' spyad drag po la ci mi snyam par bzhugs pas rang don bdud rtsi rtogs pa la skyid sdug ro snyom dgos par bstan la/ byang chub brnyes nas 'og min gyi bar gyi lha dang mi'i dbang bo rnams kyis zhabs spyi bor blangs shing bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur bstabs pa dang / bram ze bha ra dh+wa dzas spyo ba brgyas spyos pa dang / bram ze'i bu mo dregs mas mi tshangs spyod kyis skur ba btab pa dang / rgyal po mes byin gyi yul du zla ba gsum du rta chas kyi nas rul pa gsol ba sogs la thugs mtho dman du 'gyur ba med par ri rab rlung gis mi sgu la ba lta bur bzhugs pas sems can gyi don byed pa la ro snyoms dgos par bstan to/ /'di jo bo bka' gdams pa/ sdug na skad ngan mi 'don zhing / skyid na skyo shas che ba/ zhes pa'i rnam thar can rnams kyis 'chad rgyu zhig yin/ bdag 'dras bshad na rang gi lces kyang khrel lam snyam pa de red kyang / rang nyid chos brgyad ro snyom la bag chags 'jog phyir dmigs nas sprang rgan bstan nyis bya mang gi nags su bris pa'o//207

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ༄༅/ /gtam tshogs bzhugs so/ /gsung mchog rdo rje sin+dhu'i chu gter klong / /rga shi med pa'i lang tshor yongs smin pa/ /o ṭi yā na'i rig 'dzin slob dpon che'i/ /zhabs pad bdag gi mgo bor mdzes gyur cig /dri med mkhyen pa'i 'od zer cha rdzogs pa/ /rang byung rdo rje gsum gyi nyin mor byed/ /kun tu bzang bo'i gzhan phan snang ba can/ /mnyam med bla ma snying dbus thig ler bzhugs/ /rtsod ldan mkha' la 'od gsal snying thig gi/ /rang lugs nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rtar bdag /rig 'dzin ḍāk+kis byin rlabs dbang bskur zhing / /dam can rgya mtshos g.yel med phrin las4 sgrubs/ /zhes dge legs kyi tshigs su bcad pas byings drangs te/ gleng bar bya ba ni/spyir bod kyi yul 'dir/ sa dge rnying gsam/ kar 'brag bon gsam/jo raring ri༄pho rig zhal bo dong sogs kyi lugs srol mang po yod kyang / gangs can gyi ljongs su bstan pa rin po che'i srol spyi dang / khyad par gsang sngags kyi lugs srol dang por phye ba ni snga 'gyur rnying ma yin cing / de'i brgyud 'dzin la grub chen rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang / zur ba mes dbon rnam gsum nas bzung / chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i bar du rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang gi phreng ba gser gyi nyag thag lta bu byung yang phyi ma'i 208

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7r+sha stsedus su ston chen dang sde dgon phal cher mnga' thang dang 'khor slob kyi sa/zi byin 'gran zhing / dbyangs rol dang mdos gto tsam la snying bo re nas/ rnying bstan ri mo'i mar me ltar gyur pa na/ kun tu bzang bo'i smon lam gyi mthu grub cing masmo pa'i ye shes kyi rtsal 'chang ba khams gsum chos kyi rgyal bo chen po rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas bshad sgrub las gsum gyi phrin las rlabs po ches grub mtha' gzhi bzhengs su bslang ste/ stod mon bal nas smad rgya sog gi yul gru tshun chad slob brgyud kyis bkang / mon 'jigs med kun grol/ kong smyon sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu sogs dngos slob dang /khrams rdzogs chen rin po che dang rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas/mazhi sprul rin po che 'jigs med ye shes rdo rje/ shar rdzogs chen pa chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje/ dpal dge rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo/ rje thams cad ma.o pa 'jigs med ma.o brtse'i zlos gar sogs yang slob grags pa don ldan gyi mkhas grub chen po rnams kyi drin las da lta'i bar du snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bshad sgrub kyi srol ma nub par gnas pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i brgyud pa thams cad kyi nang kun mar+ṣa bla ma gnyis pa lta bu'i bstan pa'i chu mgo ni o rgyan rin po ches gter lung du mar rjes su bsngags shing / shar phyogs kyi rgyud du pad+ma'i ring lugs spel bar thugs bskyed smon pa'i 'bras bu'i 209

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/2chirtsal rdzogs pa grub pa mchog gi dbang po 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer yin la/ rje btsun 'di'i gdan sa ni/ rong ston pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i gter lung bzhin/ shugs chen 'gro don lhun grub/ brag chen yar lung pad+ma bkod/ gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling dang gsurnga/ du byung ba las/ da lta ni phyi ma gnyis tsam gnas pa ste/ de'ang rje rang bi gsung na/ nga'i sgrub sde 'di 'khos ka la bltas na/ phyug po'i lhas mal tsam las med de/ rnying bstan gyi rtsa ba gnas pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams sprin bzhin 'du bar 'dug ces gsungs pa ltar/ stong ldir gyi 'ur mi che yang / da lta'i bar du snying bo'i bstan 'dzin bar ma chad par byon pa zhig yin pas/ de dag gi rjes su skyes pa'i rang re rnams kyis kyang brgyud pa'i bla mi 'tshong tsam re cis kyang dgos par 'duka rung / mi bsam rang bsam mthun mi mthun sna tshogs shig yong bar snang ba/ de bzhin byed tshe dam pa gong ma'i phyag rjes chud zos su 'gro bas/ gal che nges kyi bca' tho rags pa tsam 'god par bya ste/ de la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spong klog gnyis kyis 'dzin dgos pa la/ ming bstan pa la zhugs par btags nas yig ngo shes pa tsam nas dbyar ston gyi nam zla thams cad grong chog la zad/ dgun dpyid kyi zla ba byung tshe sgye kha dang rkyal kha'i gnyer ba la btang na/ khang gog stong pa sha staka gis shākya seng ge'i bstan pa mi zin cing / ban+de'i pha khang gtsug lag bi 210

tho ཿmi :spro////'o//byepa/ ///2/spro///spros// /111sgyuḥni/ rtotāshā/khang ba yin pas rang gi pha thob kyi ral gri thang la ma 'chor bar ma mtha' byas kyang dgun zla gsum la dgon khang nang du stan chags pa dang / 1 der yang shes rab dang brtson 'grus mi dman pa rnams kyis spyod 'jug dang / sdom gsum rnam nges/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod sogs la bslab sbyangs la 'bungs/ de ltar mi nus pa rnams nas kyang theg pa chen po'i lam gyi 'gag sdom thams cad sngon 'gro'i khrid yig dran pa nyer bzhag tu tshang bas de tsam nges par bslab/ 2 gzhung 'u/gas kyi sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas rang nyid bstan pa ris med du song na ma gtogs/ gsar bu'i dus su gzhung lugs sra sre mang po la mi 'jug cing / 'chad spel nus mkhan tshos kyang nyan pa po'i blo nus dang bstun nas sde snod spyi'i bshad pas khog phub ste/ gnad rang lugs kyi 'gag la sgril zhing 'chad pa lta bu rang gzhung shes pa'i yan lag tu byed na ma bkag /de las gzhan du kun mar+ṣa yab sras kyi bshad srol bag la zha ba'i rgyur gtogs rgyu'i bshad pa gsar ba khyab bdal du mang na rang nyid col chung ba'i nang cha bstan par ma zad rdo rje snying bo'i bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren du 'gyur bas de ltar ma song bar bya/ 3 de bzhin du 'tshogs 'don la'ang grub dbang bla ma'i sku dus nas rgyun tshags pa'i chos spyod rigs la rung mthan brtsis pa zhig ma gtogs so rigang rab miso'i snang bar gang dran gyi gsar lugs mang po mi byed/ 4dal 'byor 211

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma〉rnyed dka' nas bzung sems bskyed bar gyi khrid rim la go ba cung zad chags pa dang / sngon 'gro'i nyams len 'bum lnga'i bsags sbyang dang bcas pa gnad smin gtong / de nas rab rtsa ba gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub dang de ltar ma grub na'ang rigs 'dus dang 'gro 'dul sdug bsngal rang grol gang rung la bsnyen pa byed rgyu sogs sgrub sde ming don mi 'dzol ba'i thabs tshul la 'bad/ 5 de rnams gtso bor dgun bca' byed tshul yin/ dus rgyun du yang bla rnam dang / rtsa gsum gsol ka chags med dang / byang sems kyi rtsa ltung dang sngags kyi rtsa ltung sdom tshis blo la bzung nas nyin re bzhin bsngo bgrang dang bcas kha ton du bzung ba gal che ste/ mnga' ris paṇa chen dang kun mkhyen bla ma sogs kyi phyaka bzhes kyang yin/ 6 ban+des skya chas gyon pa lar yang bstan pa'i mig ltos la shin tu gnod cing / khyad par du 'tshogs gral dang dgon pa'i nang du khyim pa'i chas 'jug pa mang po mthong na gdol spyod kyi skye bos kyang khrel ba dang / bstan pa la mi gus pa'i chag sgo chen po'i gzhir 'gyur bas/ rgyun par slag skya dang rke rags sngon dmar 'chang ba/ gos brdze bcing byed pa/ dgra dogs med pa'i sar yang gri thung dang shang lang 'dogs pa sogs gtan nas mi byed/ 8 tshogs gral du skyes pa bud med nyal po byed pa'i gtam sogs khyim pa sun 'byin gyi kun spyod ngan pa'i rigs la mi 'jug cing / gal srid 'jug mkhan byung na rgan 212

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7trapa rnams nas bstan pa'i la rgyar bsams te gleng dran thongs/ 8 dge 'dun pas dmar chog dang / btsun pas khe spogs chen po dang khyad par bshas tshong byed pa/ dgon khang du ser khyim 'dzin pa sogs sangs rgyas kyi bla 'tshong zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa la than skyel ba/'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi rkang 'dren cing / lha dkar phyogs skyong bas mthong na dmod 'debs pa'i spyod ngan rnams reg phung gi dug bzhin ring bo bas kyang ches ring bor spongs/ 9 me dang thab kha bud shing gi tshogs pa rnams ya ma bral na g.yos bskol yong ste/ so sor byas na mi yong ba ltar dgon pa'i spyi chus brtan mi brtan thams cad dge 'dun gyi thugs blo mthun mi mthun 'di la rtsa ba thug 'dug pas chos mthun kyi bya ba che chung gang la yang bzang po zur thon dang / ngan pa mgo rgyal du mi 'gro bar blo sems gcig dril dgos pa bcas/ 10 dge bcu'i grangs ldan gyi rtsa tshig nye 'khon med par sman pa drang srong ri ṣi'i dkyil 'khor lta bu 'di nyid gsung rdo rje pad+ma saṃ bha ba dngos dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i mang thos da ri tra 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun tu khyab pa'i dpal gyis lhag bsam bzang bos bris pa mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i phrin las kyi grogs su gyur ba rtsa gsum rgya mtshos dge bas byin gyis rlobs shig gu//༄tsho/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan rin po 213
