pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/che'i 'byung gnas/ thar ba'i lam gyi sgo mo che/ bde legs mtha' dag gi rtsa ba dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i rnam bzhag bsdus te bstan pa la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro tshul/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya/ de'i phan yon bshad pa ste bzhi las/ dang po la skyabs yul ngos bzung ba dang / skyabs de nyid rigs pas sgrub pa ste gnyis las/dang bo ni/ spyir 'jig rten pa'i skyabs gnas tshangs pa dang dbang phyug la sogs pa 'jig rten na skyabs su grags pa mang mod kyi/ srid pa sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin rmang nas sgyel ba la mtshungs zla ma mchis pa ni/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyag gcig yi na la/ de'i phyir de nyid dang / des bstan pa dam pa'i chos dang / de'i sras slob ma dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs yang dag tu bzung ba ni dngos po'i don dang mthun pa yin pas/ 'dir dkon mchog rin po che gsam gyi yon tan mdo ༄tsam dang bcas pa'i ngo bo dang dbye ba 'chad na/ shes bya thams cad la mkhyen pa dus gcig tu 'jug pa'i ye shes dang / de dang ldan pa'i 'gog bden mthar thug dang / de dag rgyud ldan gyi gang zag sangs rgyas dkon mchog ste/ 'dus ma byas sogs yon tan brgyad ldan gyi skyabs gnas mthar thug de nyid do/ /de la yon tan brgyad ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid rang bzhin med pa'i mtshan nyid can de nyid rgyu rkyen gyi rtsol sgrub las ma byung bas 'dus ma byas/ gnyen po'i 214

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7 'bad rtsol gyis spang bya ched du bkag mi dgos par/ snga nas chags thog gi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs zin pa'i lag rjes sa glo bar gyi sgrib pa ra༅ ༄kazhar yang ma mchis pa'i ngo bor lhun rdzogs pas lhun gyis grub pa/ de nyid kyi don 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis yul dang yul can gnyis su med pa'i tshul du mthong ba ma gtogs par rang rang gi ngo bo sgra rtog tha snyad kyis dngos su mthong bar byar med pas gzhan rkyen gyis rtogs med/phyorga/sa dus srid dang zhi ba'i tha snyad kyi shes bya snga phyi'i nges pa la ma ltos par sems kyi skad cig gcig la gzigs kyang chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gshis su mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes de yang mi 'dor bas na thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'gog pa yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mdzad kyang / mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi khams la snying rje chen po'i 'jug pa rgyun mi 'chad par su ni rgud/ su ni nyam thag su zhig ni dgrol bar bya zhes dgongs zhing sras sgra gcan 'dzin bzhin du snyo/ma par brtse bas na brtse ba/ smon lam gyi mthu dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sto/bas dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo zad mi shes pas sems can tshad med pa rnams rang rang gi skal pa ji lta ba bzhin du smin cing grol bar mdzad pas na mthu ldan/ gang zag gang zhig gi rgyud kyi chos nyid glo bur gyi nyes pa kun las grol ba'i chos mchog mya ngan med pa'i go 'phang 'dus ma byas sogs yon tan gsum ldan ngo bo nyid sku/ 'bras bu chos 215

11rngad/ 11 jordo /spyirngab khur:dropo/thag byaspurngasno rngababastazud rta):re ba/sdosasprang khurasdo/zug/ 2〉sku'i nang tshan ye shes chos sku gzugs kyi sku rnam pa gnyis dang bcas pa mkhyen pa sogs yon tan gsum ldan gzhan phan phrin las kyi bad sa nyid de/ dbye ba drug dbye gzhi gnyis dang brgyad do/ /'phags pa rnams kyi ye shes gzigs pa dang / de dag gi thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa'i 'gog bden so sor brtags pa las thob pa ni chos dkon mchog ste/bsam med sogs yon tan brgyad ldan gyi rnam byang bden pa'o/ /yon tan brgyad ni/ yod dang med pa/ gnyis ka dang gnyis min te mtha' bzhi'i mtshan ma thams cad chos nyid mnyam pa nyid du rnam par das cing don dam gzigs pa'i mdun na gzod nas ma skyes pa'i rang bzhin yin la/ 'gog bden don dam pa'i bden par bsdu ba'i phyir bsam med/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung ci rigs gtan du zad pa'i bdag nyid yin pa dang / rang gi ngo bo shes dang shes bya'i gnyis snang dang bral bas na gnyis med/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid 'a/ byed pa'i nyes pa kun gyi rgyu ba shin tu zad pas na rnam par rtog med /de'ang mthong lam la sogs par ma dag sa bdun gyi bar chad med lam du tshul min yid byed kyi rgyu ba kun 'dzad pa zhig dgra bcom rtogs pa sngon song ma gtogs pa med mod kyi/ de dag gi 'gog bden ni/ tshal ༄min yid byed thams cad las 'das pa yin te/ 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang 'di la so so skye bo'i chos nyid 'gog bden du 216

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7thal ba 'gog pa'i phyir sngar gyi kun zhes pa ci rigs pa la snyegs par bya'o/ /'phags pa'i ye shes gzigs pa ni rang rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya rtsa ba dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams slar mi skye ba'i tshul du spangs pas dag la/ shes bya'i de kho na nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i chos kyi milga/ rdul med pa yin pas gsal ba/ de'i bar chad med pa'i lam gyis rang gi spang bya dngos su 'gog shing / rnam par grol ba dang rjes la thob pa'i lam rnams kyang de'i phyogs su gyur pas gnyen po'i phyogs/shes pa dang gzugs dang ldan pa min pa'i 'du byed gang du'ang mi gtog sa pa'i rnam byang bden pa gang zhig bsam med sogs yon tan sasum gyi dbye gzhir gyur pa 'gog bden/ shes pas bsdus pa'i rnam byang bden pa gang zhig dag gsal sogs yon tan gsum gyi dbye gzhir gyur pa lam bden te brgyad do/ /'phags pa nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / 'phags pa nyan thos theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor la gnas pa rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ste/ rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i rigs gnas kyi 'phags pa'o/ /yon tan brgyad ni/mnyam bzhag tu chos rnams kyi rang bzhin stong zhing bdag med pa ma nor bar mngon sum du gzigs pas ji lta ba rig pa/ rjes la thob pa'i ye shes kyis tha snyad phung po khams dang skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos 217

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyekhyernams rtogs par khong du chud pas na ji snyed pa rig pa/ zab rno/ sto/nga ba dang rgya che ba rten 'byung gi tshul gdod nas ro gcig/ par shes tring rtogs pas nang ye shes rig pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa kun btasas dang lhan skyes kyi phyogs ci rigs pa rnam par zad de kun sbyor gyi rgyu ba gting nas chad pas chags sgrib las grol ba/ shes bya'i sgrib pa phra ba dang rags pa'i tshogs ji ltar rigs pa gnyen po ye shes kyi rdo rjes nges par bcom pas thogs sgrib las grol ba/ de'ang nyan rang dgra bcom man chad kyis thogs sgrib spang ba dgra bcom pa gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol min pa med la/ gnyis rnam grol bas kyang 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa spang ba tsam zhig las/ 'jika rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis shes sgrib skor dgu'i bye brag spang ba ni med de/ nam zhig na de dag kyang theg chen gyi sa bcur zhugs pa'i tshe gdod sa dang po nas bzung shes bya'i sgrib pa phra rags bcu spong ba yin no/ /rang don lhur len pa spangs te sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi nges pa la zhugs pas na dman sgrib las grol ba/ 'phags pa ye shes nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pa'i spyod yul can chos rnams kyi gnas lugs dang mthun par zhugs pa ji lta ba rig pa sogs yon tan gsum ldan/ ye shes de dag nyid kyis chos dbyings smra bsam brjod med yang dag par rtogs pa'i gnad kyis 218

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7r+shatratrazhekyazhezas pa gnas ngan len dang bcas pa ji ltar rigs pa bzhin du bkag jis chags grol sogs yon tan gsum ldan grol ba ste brgyad do/ /nge'ang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan phyi ma gsum/ chos kyi yon tan drug dang /nga/se 'dun gyi yon tan grol ba gsum ni me dang tsha ba bzhin du ldan chos dang ldan gzhi don du gcig par rung la/ gzhan drug ni gang zag lnga na min 'du byed du bzhed pa rnams kyi lugs ltar na/ dge 'dun gyi sasu ma po sa bon dang des bskyed pa'i nus pa bzhin du so sor gcad cing 'bral du med mod/ blo dang ldan min du phye bas gzhi gcig pa'ang ma/ yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gsum ni ngo bo nyid sku dang sbyar ba na chonu/ dkon mchog gi skabs bzhin dang / sangs rgyas 'phags pa dang sbyar na dge 'dun dang rig pa gsum sbyar ba bzhin no zhes pa kho bo'i 'khrul rtog tsam mo/ /de dag gi sgra bshad ni/ rgya dper/ dkon ma/chog gi skad dod rat+na tra yā ya zhes pa rin chen rnam gsum du bsgyur rgyu yin yang / dkon mchog zhes pa rin chen rnam gsum dpe ming don 'a 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan drug po'i thog mtha' bsdus pa ste/ rgyu mtshan drug po ming tsa ma smos na/ rnyed dka' ba dang / dri ma ci rigs zad pa dang / yon tan chen po'i mthu mnga' ba dang / 'jig rten na phan pa kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa dang / rnam par grol ba'i gnas ster ba dang /'a gyur ba med par rtag tu phan pa mdzad pa'i mchog yin pa'o/ /bye brag 219

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sku3khyotra 0gi sgra nyung ngur bshad na/ chags thogs kyi sgrib pa'i mun nag chen ngo/ sangs pa dang / yon tan gyi snang ba gsal ba rab kyi mthar thug pan rgyas pas na sangs rgyas/ bdag med yang dag par rtogs pa'i thabs/ kyis srid las rnam grol zhi ba'i sar 'dzin pas na chos zhes spyi ming bye brag la btags shing / bdud bye ba khrag khrig gis kyang mi phyed pa'i dang pa brtan pos dkon mchog gsum 'khur bas dge 'dun te blo dase ba dang 'dun pa la bya'o/ /'di'i dad pa ni slob dpon sa'i rtsa las sis shes nas dad pa zhes bshad cing / shes nas dad pa ni/ mdzod las/bden gsum mthong na tshul khrims dang / /chos la shes nas dad ji/ 'thob/ /lam mngon rtogs na sangs rgyas dang / /de yi dge 'dun dku la yang / /zhes 'phags lam brnyes pa'i tshe 'thob par bshad do/ /'asdi skabs su bshad dgos pa shin tu mang yang yi ge nyung ngur 'dod pa dang / tshong bas 'o ma btsong ba'i dpe ltar 'gyur du dogs nas ba'as go/ /gnyis pa la/ spyir dkon mchog gsum yod par sgrub pa dang / nge nyid skyabs yang dag tu sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyir 'jig rten na su zhig 'khrul ba'i nyes pa du ma'i gzhan dbang du song ba de das thams cad kyang rkyen snang glo bur ba'i mthu las gyur ba ma gtogs/ ji/ sems kyi rang bzhin de lta bu ma yin zhing / ngang gis phyin ci ma loku ji/ kho na ste/ gegs phyi'i mun pa dang / nang gi mig mi gsal ba la so sas 220

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khyod+kung/'i dbang gis thag khra sbrul snang gi shes pa ltar don dang mi mthun pa rgang zag 'ga' zhig la 'byung mod kyi/ de 'gal rkyen de med du zin na thag pa dang sbrul la don bzhin du 'dzin pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na srid pa'i snang ba rnams kyang dri ma glo bur ba'i dbang gis byung ba ma sa/togs sems kyi gshis su zhugs pa ma yin la/ dri ma de nyid sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs med na de glo bur ba yin kyang rnam par dag pa'i sanas mi rnyed mod kyi/ nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba ma rig pa dang rnam pa 'gal ba'i ye shes bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab yod de/ 'dis sgrib pa spong bar 'grub lugs ni/ dpe zhig gis ston te/ nor bdag dang rkun po gnyis rtsod cing shags 'gyed pa na/ rkun pos ngas rdzas de ma brkus zhes byas tshe/ nor bdag gis bya wang la mjug sgro yod do zhes bya ba sogs brjod pas kho mi pham gyi/ khyod kyis brkus so zhes dam bca' ba 'dzin dgos so/ /de ni rkun po'i tshig dang rnam pa 'gal mi 'gal gyi dbang gis yin la/ de'ang rnam pa 'gal tsam gyis rkun po mi pham gyi/ nor bdag la bden yod pa zhig ci nas kyang dgos te/ tshig phugs med kyis gtam khungs can mi thub pa'i phyir te/ dngos po sto bas zhugs kyi rigs pa yod med 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du byams pa la sogs pa'ang srid rtsa dang rnam pa 'gal ba ma yin zhing /bdag med rtogs pa'i blo ni ma rig pa'i ldog phyogs kyi 'dzin stangs 221

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/la la can yin pa dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin mnyam pa'i gnad kyis bdag med rtogs pa tshad mar grub cing / bden zhen ni rtsa ba mi brtan pa'i log shes su grub bo/ /bdag med mkhyen pa de'ang nan tan du thabs dang bcas te bslab na 'dod 'jigs goms pa'i snang ba bzhin du blo snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma nus pa mthu can du byed cing blo'i rang bzhin tshad med pa nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas pa'i tshul du mngon par snang ba 'grub par 'gyur zhing / sgrib pa ma lus pa yongs su srab pa dang / rab tu byang ba dang /shin tu zad pa'i mthar thug par grub bo/ /de tsa na mkhyen pa de nyid thog mar sgom pa'i tshogs sbyor gyi lam dang /bar du gsal snang thon pa 'phags pa slob pa'i lam dang / de nyid mthar phyin pa thams cad mkhyen pa ste/ bar ba chos dkon mchog 'ba' zhig pa dang / phyi ma sangs rgyas dang chos su grub bo/ /mkhyen pa des srid rtsa spangs pa'i 'gog bden 'phags pa slob lam pa'i thug/sa rgyud na bzhugs pa chos dkon mchog kho na ba dang / de mthar phyin pa chos dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gnyis ka yin pa ngo bo nyid sku'o/ /mkhyen pa de dang 'gog bden de dag rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yod pas/dge 'dun dkon mchog kho na ba slob pa 'phags pa dang / nyan rang mi slob lam pa gnyis/ sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun gnyis ka ba sangs rgyas 'phags pa dang bcas yod par grub bo/ /don 'di rgya cher rnan/ 22 2

〉 bye〉 :spro///////rdo / ///mi/spro///sde // /rdo/rgo45ཿshe/ rdotāshā/'grel las rtogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can thams cad kyi skyabs yin te/ mtha' med pa'i sems can thams cad kyi khams dbang bsam pa'i khyad par phra zhing phra ba dang / de dag gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs cha dang bcas pa thams cad mar+ṣa cing gzigs pa'i phyir dang / ma gcig po'i ba sdug ༄bzhin du sems can thams cad la rtag tu gzigs pas sems can kacig gi phyir yang bskal ba khrag khrig mang por brtson 'grus kyi go cha sra ba mnabs pa'i thugs rje chen po mthar phyin pa'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas kyi stobs tshad med pa la 'gal rkyen byed pa'i sgrib pa thams cad bsal te rdo rje'i stobs bla na ma mchis pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir te/ma.o pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las gsum dang ldan na gzhan don mi nus mi srid do/ /dam pa'i chos dkon mchog ni sems can thams cad kyi skyabs yin te/ sus srid pa rmang sgyel gyi la ma nyams su blang zhing / mya ngan las 'das pa rdul med bsil ba'i go 'phang rgyud la bsten pa de dag ni rgud pa gzhi dang bcas pa gtan du ldog nus pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun ni 'gro ba rnams kyi skyabs yin te/ sus skyabs su song ba thams cad nam du yang slu bar mi mdzad pa'i phyir dang / tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab zag pa dang bral ba'i byin rlabs tshad med pa mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /de 223

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lta na srid pa'i 'gro ba zhing rdul las kyang ches mang ba 'di rnams dkon mchog gi byin gyis rlabs pas ci'i phyir grol bar mi mdzad nge//dngos rgyu nus pa thog med tshang ba'i phyir zhe na/ rtags ma grub ste/ rnam par grol ba ma rnyed pa'i sems can rnams la phyi'i rkyen skyabs gsum ma tshang ba med kyang / nang gi rkyen sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la sogs pa dge ba'i tshogs gong nas gong du spel ba med pa'i phyir te/ chu zla'i rnam/ pa gtod byed kyi zla ba yod kyang / gtad yul chu snod med na zla ba'i gzugs brnyan mi 'char ba bzhin no/ /mdor na phyi rol ba'i skyabs gnas drag po la sogs pa ni kun 'byung gi chu bos khyer bas bdag/ nyid ma smin pa'i stabs kyis 'jigs pa dang bcas pa yin la/ dkon mchog gsum ni de kho na nyid dang mtshungs par zhugs pa'i mthu mnga' ba ste nam mkha' dang lag mthil mnyam zhing skad cig dang bskal ba mnyam pa'i cho 'phrul gyi rol mo zad mi shes pa mnga' bas byin rlabs kyi khyad par shin tu zhugs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ skyabs 'gro 'byung ba'i rgyu dang / skyabs 'gro dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag nyid 'jigs pa dang bcas par shes nas ci nas kyang de las thar bar 'dod pa dang / de las skyob pa'i skyabs gnas tshol ba dang / skyabs de dkon mchog gsum 'ba' zhig tu yid ches pa dang / de dag la skyabs su ma song na skyabs gnas bzang yang bdag nyid skyob pa'i yul du mi 224

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7zheshi'agyur bar shes pa rnams tshogs na skyabs su 'gro ba skye'o/ /de'ang skyes bu chung ngu ni ngan song gi 'jigs pas skrag 'bring ni de tsam du ma zad 'khror ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyis skrag chen po ni de yang ma bas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag gis skrag nas gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /skyes bu gsum ni/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs tsam don du gnyer ba dang / rang don tu zhi ba don du gnyer ba dang / lhag bsam rnam dag thob pa ste gsum po go rim bzhin te/ zhar la 'ongs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo la/ slob dpon dbyig sanyen zhabs kyis mngon mdzod rang 'grel du/ ngag gi rnam par rig byed dge ba zhig yin par bshad cing / slob dpon 'ga' zhig dang /spru la cher dkon mchog gsum la dpung gnyen du re ba'i sems par ngos 'dzin pa sogs yod kyang / shing rta chen por skyes bu 'bring gi skyabs 'gro 'chad pa na/ nyan rang ni rang don du srid pas 'jigs nas dad pa gsum bskyed pa'o/ /zhes rgyu srid pa la skyo zhing 'jigs te 'bras bu skyabs 'gro skye bar bshad par bzhed nas/ de skad gsungs 5'i phyir dad pa nyid du dgongs so/ /don du mi gang dag 'jigs pas skrag nas rgyal po la sog sa pa la skyabs 'tshol ba de'i tshe/ rgyu dang dus kyi kun slong gi shes pa ngag gi rnam par rig byed dang bcas pas 'bangs su dam bcas pa de tsam gyis skyabs su song ba yin pa ltar/225

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4mepha'ishelanadakon mchog gsum la dpung gnyen gyi 'du shes bzhag ste re ba dang dad pas ngag tu skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod pa kun kyang skyabs 'gro yin pas/ skyabs 'gro gzugs dang shes pas bsdus pa gnyis ka yod kyang mi 'gal lo/ /'on kyang rgyal po la sogs pa la ni yid kyis skyabs su song ba tsam gyis skyabs 'gro'i go mi chod mod/ dkon mchog gsum la yid ches kyi skyabs 'gro gcig pus kyang skyabs su song bar 'jog pa ni mkhyen pa nus mthu thogs med dang ldan mi ldan gyi khyad par sotwas/ las yin no/ /gzhung dag las skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo re ba dang bcas pa'i sems pa dang / dad par ngos bzung mdzad pa ni/ yid kyi rnam shes 'khor dang bcas pa khab len la lcags bzhin du skyabs kyi rjes su g.yo/ bar byed pa ni sems pa yin la/ de nyid dge bar sgyur ba'i gtso bo ni rgyu'i skyabs 'gro dang ba'i dad pa dang / 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro 'dod pa'i dad pa yin pas skyabs 'gro'i gtso bo gnyis kyi dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /skyabs 'gro de la dbye na rgyu dang 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/de la rgyu'i skyabs 'gro ni/ gzhan rgyud la byon zin pa'i dkon mcholge gsum la 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i dpung gnyen du skyabs 'tshol ba ste /'o skol shākya'i khyu mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba lta bu'o/ /'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro ni/ rang rgyud la 'byon 'gyur gyi dkon mchog gsum la thob byar re ba ste/ 'o skol 'tshangs rgya bar 'dod pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa la/ rtsa 226

zla ཿmi :spro//////the pa/ /bye/1:spro///spros// 11114ཿཿni/ (tāshā/ba'i bslab bya dang / yan lag gi bslab bya gnyis/ dang po ni spyir dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum ni tshe rabs thams cad du dpung kanyen du skyabs su gyur pa yin la/ tshe 'di'i srog dang nor dang gnyen bshes thams cad ni cha'i cha bar bzhin du g.yo zhing mi brtan pa yin te/༄ ༄༄skye bo mdzangs pa rnams ni rnam par bzhag pa 'di la gnas dang srog ngang bya dga' la sogs pa srid pa'i phun tshogs gang gi phyir yang dkon mchog gsum spong bar mi byed de/ de spang bas ni zhi bsil mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i thabs mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir dkon mchog gsum la snying nas yid o shes kyi dad pa brtan pos de las gzhan na mthar thug gi skyabs gnas med par yid ches pa zhig rtsa ba'i bslab bya yin pas/ de'i ldog phyogs dkon mchog gsum blos dor ba dang / dor ba tsam min kyang blo mi khel ba ste gnyis po gang byung yang skyabs 'gro rtsa ba nas gtong bar kun ma.o chos kyi rgyal po dang / tsong kha ba chen po gnyis kas bshad do/ /de'i phyir deng sang shākya'i sras ngur smrig gi 'od kyis nam mkha' dmar por 'gro ba tsam du gzi byin bskyed nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes ci tsam brjod kyang ba spu'i 'khri shing gcig kyang mi slong bar/ tshong spog khe skyed kyi bun long kho nas dus 'da' zhing btsan phyug gi skyes bu'i gtam gcig tsam thos pas kyang rlom sems kyi 'gram chu ldang ba rnams dang / mdang sum gyi rmi lam rtswa 227

24rngad/ 11 :rdo /spyirngan 'o/:drotha/thag byaspurngasno ngakustagazud rta):re tha/༷saspreb khuradra/zug/ 〈cho'akhrul shing 'khrul/ 'khrul ba'i yang 'khrul gyi mtshan ma ngan pa gcika gis kyang yid 'chum zhing / drang srong bden par smra bas rang gi slob ma'i tshogs la thugs brtse bas lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che rnam nga gsum la brtson pa'i phan yon/ ma bslab pa'i nyes dmigs sgo du ma/ nas legs par bstan pa'i gsung rab 'jig rten gyi dmigs bur gyar pa la'ang bka' 'gyar zhes phyag po'i khyim rten du re ba tsam 'i/lge )( zibyu char )dri byer yigar mi'i 4byusnyang par byad pa las dag ldag ga spang blang zhab mar byas nas rnam smin sdug bsngal ba 'thob bo zhes dogs pa dang bag tsha ba cung zad tsam yang med cing / kha na ma tho ba phra raṭa la'ang mi 'dzem par jar rgyag nyar rgyag tu gtong ba tsho la ni dpa' rtsal spyang grung gi skye bo zhes btags pa ma gtogs/ bde bar gshegs pa'i chos kyi sras po zhes 'phags pa'i skye bo sus kyang bsngags par mi mdzad do/ /skyabs 'gro btang ba slar gso ba ni spong sems dge ba nam skyes pa dang / yid ches kyi dad pa nam sor chud pa na yin zhes shing rta chen por bshad do//'chad par 'gyur ba'i 'jig rten pa'i lha la skyabs 'tshol ba'ang rtsa ba'i bslab bya dang dngos 'gal du 'gro bar snang ngo / /gnyis pa yan lag gtso bor gyur pa'i bslab bya dgu phrug ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha la skyabs mi 'tshol/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la gnod pa'i las srog gcod brdung brdeg la sogs 228

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7 pa mi bya/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas mu stegs can nam/ de dang phyogs mthun dkon mchog la yid mi ches shing sdig spyod kyis dus 'da' ba'i grogs ngan pa dang mi 'grogs pa ste/ spang bya spong tshul las bzhag pa gsum dang / sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la gus pa bya bar ma zad/ ston pa'i sku gzugs chag dum tsam la'ang mi smad cing spyi bos mchod/ chos la skyabs su song nas dam pa'i chos la bkur snyi bya bar ma zad/ gsung rab yi ge'i ris ma la'ang mi 'gom zhing 'jig rten na rnyed par dka' ba'i mchog tu dad pa bzhag dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams rjes su dran zhing gus par bya bar ma zad/ gos ngur smrig bgos shing dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan shes pa tsam la'ang lha dang mir bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi 'du shes 'jog de'ang gzhan de lta ba rnams ༄la de ltar bya ba yin gyi/ bskal ba bzang po'i ja 'dren/ dus tshod ngan pa'i dpe 'then du khyer nas rang nyid kyang de dag gi gral na byung rgyal byed na ni/ las kyis nongs pa'i gang zag la/ sman byin pa yang dug tu 'gyur/ zhes pa ltar yin te/ rgyas par sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo sder ltos shig de gsum ni bsgrub bya gsum zhes grags la/ sangs rgyas dang cha 'dra bar yang dag pa'i lam ston pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sangs rgyas ltar gus pa bya ba dang /229

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lo74rnam byang bden pa'i mthun pa'i rgyu dam pa'i chos nyan pa rjes su mi gtong ba dang / 'phags pa rnams dang rjes su mthun pa'i tshul khrims dang lta ba rnam par dag pa la slob pa ste gsum ni cha mthun gyi bslab bya gsum mo/ /bzhi ba phan yon ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis skabs phye ba ma gtogs par de bzhin gshegs pa la dmigs nus pa su yang med par mdo sde las bshad na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan shes pa dang / de la yid ches pa dang / rtag tu skyabs su 'gro bar byed pa ni shin tu rnyed dka' ba dang / rnyed na don chen po yin te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun pa/ kun gyis mos par dka' ba yin pa'i phyir dang / de la mos pa ni dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rigs pa tshad ma'i lam nas nges par grub pa'i 'dzin stangs mthu che ba'i phyir dang / de bzhin gshegs pas kyang chos kyi skus rab tu phye ba'i sku rnam pa thams cad pa dran pa dang yid la byas pa thams cad don dang ldan par byed pa'i bdag nyid sngon gyi smon lam gyis yang dag par bsgrubs zin mthar phyin pa'i phyir dang /skyur ba'i ro dran pa las kyang 'gram chu ldang ba bzhin du rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i nus mthu ni shin tu tshad med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na phan yon mdor bsdus na/ 'jig rten 'dir tshe ring ba dang / nad 230

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7po〉 sped pa dang / bgegs rnams kyis mi tshugs pa dang / bdud rnams kyis mi thub pa dang / phyin ci log gi blo sna ngan pa mi skye ba dang / bde ba'i 'byor tshogs chen po 'thob cing 'chi kha yang gnad gcod mi 'byung ba la sogs pa dang / 'jig rten pha rol tu yang bde ba nas bde ba bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten rnams su bde ba'i tshal nas bde ba'i tshal du 'gro ba ltar bde zhing bde ba'i dge mtshan nam yang mi nyams pa'i legs tshogs rnam par 'phel zhing mthar thug mya ngan las 'das pa rdul bral zhi ba dam pa'i go 'phang la reg par 'gyur ro/ /blo chen mkhas pa rnams kyis bsngags bsngags shing / /blo chung yid kyi zhing sar sman sman pa/ /blo ldan skyes bu'i nyams len yig chung 'di/ /blo dman rang 'dra'i blo dang 'tshams par brjod/ /de dge kun phan zla ba ltar bsil bas/ /ma lus 'gro rgyud chos kyi lam 'gyur zhing / /'phags pa'i yon tan 'phags pa nyid bzhin du/ /thob nas 'jig rten kun la phan byed shog /ces pa'ang dge rgan nye bar gnas pa btsun tshul yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i shākya'i sras ma ti bha dra'i bzhed bskong mi ldog pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang blo gsal las dang po ba 'ga' zhig la phan par bsam te sprang smyon/ kun bzang 'jigs med pas gang dran smyo sa/tam du lab pa 'dis kyang yongs 'dzin dam pa'i bzhed pa skong zhing gzhan la phan thogs par gyur cig /maṅga lam// //༄༅/ /gang gi dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje yis/ /mtha' klas 231

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khusnyenasrid pa'i 'gro rnams skyob mdzad pa/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la phyag byas te/ /skyabs 'gro'i rnam bzhag nyung ngu'i tshig gis spro/ /de la skyabs 'gro'i yul/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ skyabs su song ba'i phan yon bshad pa dang lnga las/ dang bo yul ni/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub snying bor mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi//zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum las/ dang po sangs rgyas dkon mchoka ni/'gog bden mthar thug pa ngo bo nyid sku dang / lam bden mthar thuka pa ye shes chos sku ste/ 'di dag mnga' ba'i skyabs gnas mthar thug pa de yin/ de la ngo bo nyid sku zhes pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi chos nyid stong ba nyid glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i cha de yin/ ye shes chos sku zhes pa sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi rnam mkhyen la zer/ de dag nyid dang gzhan yang chos de dag mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa sogs kyang sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin/ chos dkon mchog ni 'gog lam gyi bden pa gnyis te/ 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud kyi ye shes lam bden/ 'phags pas sgrib pa ci rigs pa bsal ba'i cha 'gog bden yin/ bsal ba'i cha zhes pa'ang 'phags pa rnams kyi steng gi stong nyid de dri ma las grol ba'i cha la go dgos/ dase 'dun dkon mchog ni 'phags pa bzhi sogs 'phags pa rnams la bya 232

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7tratraste/ lar 'phags pa zhes pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes thob pa'i gang zag rnam/sa yin/ 'phags pa bzhi ni/ nyan rang byang sems 'phags pa kasum dang sangs rgyas 'phags pa rnams so/ /de dag las gzhan 'phags pa phung sum pa yang yod do/ /gnyis pa skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo ni/dkon mchog gsum ni ba dag gi dpung gnyen yin no snyam pa'i re ba chen po zhig 'jog rgyu 'di yin/ de'ang don du sems byung sems pa zhig yin/ de lta na'ang grogs sems pa de dang lhan cig pa'i dbang sis de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung gzhan ma rnams kyang de'i rnam par 'char ba yin no/ /gsum pa nges tshig gam sgra bshad ni/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo 'gro zhing g.yo ba'i phyir na skyabs 'gro zhes bya ste/ chu 'thung ba'i don du 'dun pa 'gro zer ba bzhin te/ mdor bsdu na re ba dang bcas pa'i sems pa skyabs yul la song ba'o/ /bzhi ba dbye ba ni/ gzhan rgyud la byon zin pa'i dkon mchog la tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i dpung gnyen du re ba 'cha' ba rgyu'i skyabs 'gro dang / ma 'ongs pa na rang gi rgyud la dkon mchog kyasu/ma 'byon pa'am 'thob par 'dod pa'i blos 'bras bu skyabs gnas de la thob bya'i dpung gnyen du re ba 'cha' ba 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro ste gnyis yod/ lnga ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas 'phral du tshe ring sogs mtho ris kyi yon tan dang ldan zhing / ngan 233

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gro'i sgo 'phar gcod pa sogs dang / phugs su nges par legs pa'i yon tan gyi gzhi 'deng ba la sogs pa'o/ /de skad skyabs su 'gro ba 'i gtam gyi bcud/ /nyung la go bde'i ngag gis bshad pa 'di/ /blo gsal dbang drag zhes bya'i bzhed skong du/ /blun phrug 'jigs med ces byas gang dran bris/ dge'o/ /༄tsho/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo blo ldan mchog sred la na mo/ de yang ji skad du/rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon chen po tsan+t+ra go mi'i zhal snga nas/zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar yon tan gsal bar rdzogs/ /nyes pa'i mun pa sel mdzad gcig pu yid du 'ong / /'jig rten phan la brtson pa rab tu gsal ba 'byung / /de shar zla ba bzhin du 'gro ba bsil bar mdzad //zhes gsungs pa ltar smra ba'i zla ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thabs mkhas shing thags rje chen po mnga' ba des/ skye dgu ma rig pa'i man pa riri ༅ riri byedang / sdug bsngal gyi tsha gdungs mi bzad pas shin tu nyam thag pa rnams la rjes su brtse bas/ dam chos bdud rtsi'i snang ba mtha' yas pa zhig spro bar mdzad pa rnams kyi bstan don lam gyi rim pa thams cad mdor bsdu na/ mtho ris dang thar ba sgrub pa'i thabs tshul gnyis su 'du zhing de'i nang nas phyi ma la'ang thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen nga/ gnyis kyi nang nas thar ba tsam sgrub par byed pa theg pa chung ngu dang /thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub par byed pa theg pa chen po ste gnyis yod la/234

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khye de thams cad las spang bya phyogs re tsam ma yin par spong ba dang /yon tan phyogs re ba tsam ma yin par sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas kyi gnad ma tshang ba med pa'i sgo nas rab dang phul dang mchog tu gyur pa ni theg pa chen po yin par lung dang rigs pa du mas bsgrubs shing / theg pa chen po la yang / gter chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'gro 'dul gling pas/sku dang zhing khams 'khor dang mdzad pa ni/ /yongs su dag pa'i ye shes lam nyid du/ /byed dang mi byed sngags dang pha rol phyin/ /zhes gsungs ji/ ltar 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i thabs mkhas yod med kyi dbang gis phar phyin theg pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su gsungs so/ /'on kyang khyad par de ni bsam sbyor gnyis kyi nang nas/ sbyor ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sgrub tshul gyi steng nas phye ba red ma gtogs/'jug sgo bsam pa'i ngos nas khyad par cung zad kyang med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsang sngags kyi sdom pa bzung ba'i cho ga'i skabs mang por/byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis skyed par bgyi/ /zhes sasungs pas/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal rnams la yang nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang / de kho na nyid kyi lta ba sogs mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan yid 'phrog pa mang po yod kyang / de dag la theg pa chen po'i lan/ gyi ming tsam yang mi 'thob pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ zin byed byang chub kyi sems rin po che med pa'i gnad kyis yin la/ tshul de ni lha sgom pa 235

24spred/ 17 therdo /spyirngaku 'o/:drotha/bzhi byaspucad rngakubastazud rta):re tha/sdosarngab khuradra/zug/ 4midang / sngags bzla ba sogs la'ang shin tu mtshungs pas/ theg pa chen po lam gyi 'jug ngogs gcig pur gyur pa ni byang chub kyi sems yin cing /de'i rtsa ba yang snying rje chen po yin pas/ theg pa mchog ni snying rje chen pos khyad par du phye bar 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis gsungs te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ rang gi don la mi lta bar/ /gzhan don ro gcig dga' ba gang / /yon tan 'byung gnas theg chen te/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar na snying rje'i rtsa ba can gyi sems bskyed sgom tshul mdor bsdus zhig rang blo goms pa'i phyir du bshad na/ dpal dī baṃ ka ras/ rang rgyud gtosas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /yang dka zad par kun nas 'dod/ /ces dang por sdug bsngal rang nyams dang sbyar nas sems dgos par gsung ba bzhin/ rags pa'i sdug bsngal ngan song gi sdug bsngal la sogs pa dang / phra ba'i sdug bsngal khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal legs par bsam ste/ yid 'khul ba'i myong ba khyad par can skye bar byed/ de nas sems can thams cad yid du 'ong ba'i blo bskyed par bya ste/ de'ang 'di ltar dang por rang bi nye du dang / mdza' bshes dang / de nas bar ma/ dgra sogs nas rim gyis sgom par gsungs shing sgom pa'i tshul ni/ da lta rang re rnams mngal zhugs tshun chad kyi zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po 'di nyid rgyu 236

ma bstatre pa〉 1spro///shā//the pa/ /bye/dzosnab//lha/ba// /rdo//2rwaḥ// rtotāshā/las dang nyon mongs pa las ma byung na ni/ rgyu med pa'i dngos por yod par smra ba/ du ba me la mi ltos par skye bar khas blang ba lta bur 'gro la de rang gi mthun pa'i rgyu las byung na ni/ rgyu de tshe snga ma'i skabs kyi las dang nyon mongs las gzhan du mi 'thad cing / de lta de ltar tshe snga ma dang / de'i yang snga ma sogs la sbyar nas yar ded du dpyad pa na skye r+sha'i 'khor ba 'di la thog ma'i ya mtha' 'jog rgyu zhig gtan nas mi srid par 'grub la/ de 'grub na skye shi'i phreng ba de dag gi skabs kyi pha ma dang spun zla mdza' bshes sogs kyi ya mtha' yang mi srid pa kho na ste/nge/ ltar thog ma med pa'i dus nas ma bu'i brtse ba la goms pa'i dbang bis/ 'jig rten na blun pa'i mthar thug phyags rnams kyang rang gi bu lhas hāre rabyeXte/ the2/lnga byams pa dang / gso —nga bya ba thabs sa pa la gas pa sus kyang ma bslab par ngang gis 'ong ba yin te/ skyes rabs las/ blo yi yothu stobs nus pa med pa dang / /dbang po rnams kyang blun pa'i rang bzhin can/ /byung ma thag tu sus kyang ma bslab par/ /kha zas gzhan la slo bar byed pa 'dis/ /skye ba gzhan la goms par byas par grub/ /ces/ gsungs/ de yang tshe 'di'i pha ma dang spun zla la sogs pa kho nas nye du dang mdza' bshes bskyar mar byas pa tsam min par/ nam mkha'i mthas gtug pa'i sems can thams cad re re nas de ltar 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin du gyur pa'i tshul/ sa'i dngos gzhir mdor drangs pa 237

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las/ yun ring bor 'das pa na sems can gang khyed kyi pha'am ma'am/phu nu'am/ sring mo'am/ mkhan po'am/ slob dpon nam/ bla ma'am/ bla ma'i gnas lta bu ma gyur ba de ni ngas mthong bar dka'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / dkon brtsegs kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa dang / drag shul can gyis zhus pa dang / dkon mchog sprin sogs mdo sde gzhan mtha' yas par yang de dang 'dra bar gsung / rigs pas dpyad na yang dgra gnyen bar ma sogs ni sngon gyi las bsags tshul gyi khyad par las so sor byung ba kho na yin la/ las de gsog tshul yang / da lta rang re rnams kyis sems can re re la dmigs nas kyang skabs 'gar ni chags pa la sogs pas bskyed pa'i gnyen du 'gyur ba'i las dang / skabs la lar ni zhe sdang sogs kyis bskyed pa'i dgrar 'gyur ba'i las sna tshogs zhika lo dang zla ba re re'i khongs sa yang go rim ma nges par gsog pa myong ༄ bas grub pas/ de dang mthun par 'bras bu grub pa'i tshe yang da lta dgra bor gyur pa'i sems can gcig kyang res 'ga' nye du dang dus gzhan dang gzhan du mdza' bshes brtse dung can du 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis dbyar dgun bzhin du brje bar nus pa yod de/ tshul 'dis mtha' yas pa'i sems can re re nas rang gi spun zla dang / tsha bo sogs gnyen bshes kyi khyad par gang du bsgrub kyang 'grub la/ sher phyin 'bum pa las kyang sems can thams cad phar 'du shes pa dang / spu na 238

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khyezla dang sring mor 'du shes pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs mod/ 'on kyang gnyen thams cad kyi nang nas snying brtse ba'i mthar thug ma yin pa'i gnad kyis/ gtso bor mar shes pa'i sgo nas sems can la yid 'ong sgrub par shing rta chen po rnams kyis gsungs te/ man ngag rgyu 'bras bdun ldan gyi dang por mar shes zhes ming 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /de ltar sems can thams cad mar gyur res kyis rang re rnams la drin chen pos bskyangs ba sha stag yin par yang /slob spring las/ byis pa pang na btsa' ba ci yang mi nus pa/ /gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis gzags 'thung ba/ /ngal ba mang bsten byams la brten pa de dag 'dir/ /shin du ma rabs shig na'ang spong bar su zhig spro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mir gyur pa'i 'gro ba la mtshon na/ dang por 'gro ba gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i lus rten bzang po byin cing / de nyid zla dus mang por mngal du bskyangs/ btsas pa'i 'og tu yang / mig 'byed 'dzum dang / zas khar 'jug pa tsam yang mi nus pa'i byis pa mi gtsang ba'i khrod kyi srin bu ltar nyam chung ba nge// sor mo bcu'i kha la g.yeng / 'jam pa'i sha drod la bcar/ zas lces bsnyo da/ pang gis khrus khang byas nas/ dka' ba stong dang bsdos te bskyed bsring / ma rang nyid sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad dang bsres kyin bsags bsags pa'i zas nor longs spyod gang yod thams 239

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mo'izhecad mi phang bar byin/ rang gis shes tshod dang mthun par phun tshosas sgrub tshul dang rgud pa las srung tshul/ tha na zas za lugs dang / zos nas kha 'byid lugs yan chad g.yo med par rtsal sprugs su bslab/ mig gis blta lugs dang / ngag gis 'bod lugs tshun chad kyi sgo nas bu'i yid dang ci mthun byed/ yul dang dus gang du phyin yang bu la sems pa'i brtse gdung gi yid 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da'/ bu na ba las rang nyid 'chi ba 'dams shing / bus log sgrub dang / bu'i don du ngal dub kyi sdug bsngal ji lta bu byung yang ji mi snyam pa sogs bshad kyis mi rdzogs/ ma bu'i brtse ba de ni mi kho na la lhag pa yang ma yin te/rang nyid ches shin tu blun cing nyam chung ba'i bya dang byi'u dang / thin tu gtum zhing ma rung pa'i yid can gyi gcan gzan khro bo rnams kyang tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i dus kyi lan dang rnam smin gang la'ang re bas ma yin par/ bu la byams pa rkyang ba'i dbang gis rang nyid kyi nus pa ci yod nas gso skyong dang gces spras byed cing / tha na rang gi srog kyang bu'i ched du ltos pa med par btang ba la mtha' med/ tshul de lta bus sems can re res kyang sa chen po'i rdul snyed las kyang mang ba'i tshe rabs kyi phreng bar phan btags pa sha stag yin par bshes spring las re res rgya mtsho bzhi ba'i ches lhag pa'i/ /'o ma 'thung ste da dung so so yi / /skye bo'i rjes su spyod pa'i 'khor ba pas//de bas ches mang ba zhig btung 240

ma bye〉 /spro////'o//rgya// /blo/lha:spro//lhaspros// /rdo//4ཿཿni/ (7)/'tshal lo/ /zhes rkang pa snga ma phyed gnyis kyis sngon chad drin gyis bskyang ba'i tshul dang / de man chad kyis da dung yang skyong bar 'gyar ba'i tshul :de:re :sgo rte/rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa bstan/ ༄ d+nghar 'o skol rnams rjes sems can de dag phrag pa'am spyi bo'i gtsug tu btegs te/ stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams 'di bskor ba'i bsnyen bkur bstab kyang / de dag gis byas pa'i 'bum gyi cha tsam la'ang lan mi lon par sde snod du ma las gsungs/ de ltar yun ring po nas gnyen du gyur ba'i sems can de dag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi phung po'i gnas 'dir ltos med du bor nas rang nyid gcig pu thar ba'i bde ba tsam zhig don du gnyer bar byed na yang sngon phan btags pa mi dran pa'i byas pa mi shes pa dang / de la phan lan mi skor ba'i byas pa mi gzo ba kho nar 'gyur bas/slob spring las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya ma.au khong du chud gyur cing / /klung thi nang du lhung ba lta bur snang bzhin du/ /skye shi 'phos pa'i ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med/ /ces kasungs so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa'i theg dman dgra bcom pa yang rgyal dang de sras kyi smod gnas su gyur bas skal ba dman par gsungs te/ dpal mchog dang po las rang gi bu la'ang mi chags pa'i/ /nyan thos rnams ni skal ba dman/ /sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i/ /skal bzang phyag na rdo rje dpal/ / 241

21rngan/ 17 lngardo sdispyings 'o/:drotha/bzhi byaspusprad rnga'e/mizud rta):re po/sdosang( 'o/dra/zug/ (3skorazhes gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / sems can kho rang tsho'i res la babs tshe/ khong tsho'i nus tshod kyis phan 'di ma btags bya ba dang /gnod pa 'di las ma bskyab bya ba med pas/ da ltar rang re rnams kyang byang chub gsum gang 'dod kyang bsgrub tu yod pa'i gnas skabs su ched du bya ba gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs la mi brtson na/ de dag bi re ltos su la 'cha'/ de dag sgrol ba'i res kyang gzhan su la 'bab snyam du sgo du ma dang / 'bad pa du mas legs par bsam/ ji skad bshad pa/'i tshul gyis mar shes pa dang /drin dran pa dang /drin du gzo ba ste gsum po go rim bzhin du sbyang bas sems can yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa can gyi blo ngang ngam shugs kyis skye ba na/ slar yang sems can gyi sdug bsngal spyi dang bye brag dmyal ba ba rnams mtshon cha dang nad la sogs pa phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal shugs drag la rgyun ring zhing bar mtshams med par 'byung ba rnams kyis mnar ba dang / de bzhin du yi dwags rnams kyang bkres skom dang tsha grang dang ngal dub la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas gzir zhing dud 'gro rnams gcig gis gcig za ba dang bkol spyod kyis 'tshe ba sogs dang mi rnams tshe thung zhing longs spyod nyams pa dang / 'dod lha rnams gzhan gyis tshar bcad pa dang / spa kong ba dang 'chi 'pho ltung ba sogs kyis nyam nga zhing srid rtse man chad kyi 'khor ba mtha' dag 'du byed kyi sdug 242

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 70khyebasngal las ma 'das pa'i tshul rnams rgya cher bsam nas de dag sdug bsngal de las bral bar 'dod pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po bskyed dgos/nge'ang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang thun mong pa'i brtse ba sems can sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi rnam pa can la blo 'khul thub pa tsam gyis mi tshim par/ 'jug pa rang 'grel las/ bcom ldan 'das ma snying rje chen po sangs rgyas nyid kyi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa dang sems can 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa skyabs med pa ma lus pa yongs su skyob pa'i mtshan nyid can zhes gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba sdug bsngal mtha' dag las sgrol ba dang phan bde mtha' dag sgrub pa'i ngal ba rang si khur du len pa'i skyob 'dod kyi rnam pa can gyi brtse ba lhag bsam rna/ma dag bsgrub par bya dgos/ de grub nas gzhan don phun tshogs sgrub pa la tshong ba khe spogs 'dod pa dang / dbul pos rin po che'i kater 'dod pa lta bu'i don gnyer rkang gi khong nas skye ba nas/ de'i thabs la rtog par 'gyur la/ de ltar brtags pa na/ dpal chos kyi grags pas/ brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom pa'i phyir/ /thabs rnams la ni mngon sbyor mdzad/ /thabs byung de rgyu lkog gyur pa/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ /zhes thob bya thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang dang / thob byed theg pa gsum gyi rnam bzhag rnams rang gis ma rtogs par gzhan la ston tshul med par gsungs pa'i rigs pas/243

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ khyelam̐gadul bya rigs can gsum po'i skal ba dang 'tshams par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sgo nas gzhan don sgrub pa la/ de'i med na mi 'byung gi thabs rnam mkhyen 'thob dgos shing go 'phang de thob na gdul bya 'dul ba'i phrin las skad cig kyang dus las mi yol ba'i tshul/rgyud bla ma las/ gdul bya'i khams dang 'dul ba'i thabs dang ni/ /gdul bya'i khams kyis 'dul ba'i bya ba dang / /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ /khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug /ces gdul bya'i khams dang / de dag 'dul ba'i thabs dang / btul ba'i 'bras bu/ thabs de la 'jug pa'i tshul la sogs pa thams cad rtos med yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i bya ba bzhin du 'jug par gsungs pa rnams legs par mthong nas/ nges par de lta bu'i go 'phang zhig thob par bya dgos snyam pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa rgyun chags su goms par byas pas bcos min gyi myong ba spyod lam rnam bzhi'i skabs kun du bsre nus pa sems rang dbang med par gzhan don dang byang chub don gnyer gyi dbang du song ba nam byung ba na bla med byang chub kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu sa bon lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che zhes bya ba de rgyud la skyes pa yin la/ sems de skyes nas skad cig re re yang sgrib pa sbyong ba dang tshogs bsags pa'i thabs mkhas mkha' ltar yangs pa sgrub nus shing / sems des zin pa'i dong tse gcig gi sbyin pa 244

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7r+shakhyotsam yang rgyal sras kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro bas na/ dge tshosas thabs kyis zin par byed pa sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa zhes dam pa gong ma rnams kyis gsungs so/ /༄༅/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa'i chos gang zhika 'chad nyan sgom sgrub gang byed kyang de nyon mongs can gyi kun slong dang 'dres na rnam par grol ba'i dngos rgyur mi 'gyur te/ yon tan mdzod las/ rtsa ba dug yin myu gu smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir blo bcos pa 'di gal che ste/ spyod 'jug las/ dang po rang gi sems brtags nas/ /brtan pa'i rigs pa ldan par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyer/ de yang mi dge ba'i rtog pa thams cad bsal nas dge ba'i kun slong bcos dgos/ de las kyang theg dman gyi blo chung rang don yid byed tsam ma yin par skyes bu chen po'i kun slong bcos tshul gnyis yo da pa las/ 'dir rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas bshad pa la/dang po mar shes pa ni/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ rnam shes min pa rnam thes/ kyi/ /nyer len min pa'i phyir yang grub/ /ces bshad pa ltar thug med kyi rigs pas gzhal na blo thug med blo thug med bzhin lus thug med lus thug med bzhin ma thug med kyi tshul bshes spring las/ ma yi thruka mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ril bu bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 245

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+shar+shamama'agyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa drin dran ni/ slob spring las/ byis pa pang na btsa' ba ci yang mi nus pas/ /gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyi gzags 'thung ba/ /ngal ba mang bsten byams la brten pa de dag 'dir/ /shin tu ma rab tha shal zhig na'ang spang bar su zhig spro/ /zhes pa ltar/ thog mar mngal du bzung / bar du nu zho bsnun/ tha mar grags pa bsgrub/ 'jam pa'i gos bskon/ zhim po'i zas sbyin/ byams pa'i mig gis blta/ brtse ba'i ngag gis 'bod/ phan pa'i bya bas skyong bar byas pa ste/ bshes spring las/ re re'i rgya mtsho bzhi bas ches lhag pa'i/ /'o ma btung ste da dung so so yi/ /skye bo'i rjes su spyod pa'i 'khor ba bas/ /de bas ches mang ba zhig btung 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa drin gzo ni/slob spring las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khong du chud gyur cing / /klung gi nang du lhung ba lta bur snang bzhin du/ /skye shi 'phos pa'i ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med/ /ces pa ltar drin chen gyi 'gro ba de dag thams cad sdug bsngal gsum gyi rgya mtshor chud pa'i gnas tshul shes bzhin du/ rang nyid gcig pu'i don la gzhol na de ni ma rabs kyi khur chen 'dzin pa ste/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs bcad las/ rgya mtsho dang ni ri rab dang / /sa rnams bdalga gis khur min gyi/ /byas pa mi gzo gang yin pa/ /de ni bdag gis khur chen yin/ zhes so/ /bzhi ba byams pa ni/ de ltar yang yang bsgoms pa'i 246

lomikyang〉bye rumi ཿ///ste/25/ the11ཿ//lhas// cadrosasprerwani/ ///zhemathar/ sems can gang yang yid du 'ong ba grub pas pha bsad kyi shan pa mthong yang snying la mi sdug pa spangs pa sngar 'dris kyi mdza' bo dang 'phrad pa lta bu ste/mdo las/bye ba khrag khrig gtams pa'i zhing dag na//mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ji snyed pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la nyin rer rtag mchod pas/ /byams pa'i sems la grangs dang char mi phod/ / ces sogs yon tan brgyad ldan gang yin pa'o/ /lnga ba brtse ba'i snying rje ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i yid 'ong gi byams pa de nyid shin tu 'dris pas ji zhig na 'gro ba gang yang sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa mthong na rang yang sdug bsngal ba bu chung na ba las kyang bdag nyid 'chi ba 'dom pa'i ma lta bu ste/ spyod pa'i gzhung las/ /snying rje sdug bsngal mang gyur pas// /ci'i phyir nan gyis bskyed ce na/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsam byas na/ /ji ltar snying rje'i sdug bsngal mang / /zhes so/ /drug pa lhag bsam rnam dag ni/ de ltar goms pa'i gzha na phan don gnyer la myong ba thon kyang / byang chub don gnyer la myong ba ma thon pa byang sems ma yin pa'i skyes ba chen po'i kun slong gi skabs yin no/ /bdun pa rang ༄'bras bla med ni/ slob spring las/ nyi ma rlabs chen rta zhon rgyu ba snang byed gang yin dang / /khur la mi rtseg sa yis 'jig rten 'degs pa kung yin pa/ /rang don 'ga' med chen po rnams kyi rang bzhin de 'dra ste/ /de dag 'jig rten phan dang bde ba'i ro la gcig tu gzhol/ /zhes 247

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trayamagasungs pa ltar gzhan don du byang chub don gnyer la myong ba thon pa ste /spyod 'jug las/ de ltar rgyud ni goms pa yis/ gzhan gyi sdug bsnga'/ zhi dga' ba'i/ /pad+ma'i mtsho ru ngang pa ltar/ /mnar med par yang 'juka par 'gyur/ /zhes ches cher goms pa rnams kyi ngang tshul bshad pa bzhin no/ /de ltar snying rje chen po dang ldan kyang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bral na mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das mi 'grub ste/ do ha las/ snying rje dang bral stong ba nyid lta ba/ /des ni 'a/ma mchog rnyed pa ma yin te/ /'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom pas kyang //'khor ba 'dir gnas thar ba thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /des na 'dir ni bdag med sgom tshul gyi rnam bzhag mdo tsam bshad par bya ste/de'ang 'phags pa ting 'dzin rgyal bo'i mdo las/ ji ltar chu shing rlon pa'i sdong po dag /snying bo 'dod phyir skyes bus de gshegs kyang / /nang dang phyi rol kun na snying bo med/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin thes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar byas pa dang ma byas pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin bden par med de/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /de phyir stong nyid ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'i tshul yang gang zag gcig la mtshon na/ gang zag de'i gdag gzhi khams drug po de dag bden par grub bam ma grub/248

ma bsta /spro //shā//the pa/ /bye/tsho:spro///spros// / /rgo45ཿda/ (7skyu/grub na gzhi grub la cha bcas kyi khyab pas de'ang bden grub kyi cha can yo/da dgos/ de ltar na de'i cha shas dang cha can gyi bden grub gcig sam tha dad/ dang po ltar na gnod byed gnyis te/ dang po ni/ gang zag lhas sbyin chos can/ a la drug yod par thal/ a kyi cha shas drug yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ gang zag lhas sbyin gyi khams drug chos can/khyod gcig yin par thal/ a kyi cha can gcig yin pa'i phyir/'on te phyi ma ltar na lhas sbyin gyi khams drug bsal shul na lhas sbyin yod par thal/ de'i cha can dang cha shas gnyis bden grub kyi tha dad yin pa'i phyir/'di la dgongs nas mgon po klus/skyes bu sa min chu ma yin//me min rlung min nam mkha' min/ /rnam shes ma yin kun min na/ /de las kazhan pa'i skyes bu gang / /zhes gsungs so/ /'di las gzhal na chos thams cad bden med du 'jal nus so/ /de skad du'ang rje btsun lcang skya bas/ gzung 'dzin sna tshogs 'di a ma'i 'dzum bag /skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur 'di a ma'i rdzun tshig/bslu med a ma yis kho bo bslus so//jo jo rten 'byung des skyob par re'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /mdor na 'khrul snang bi 'char sgo thams cad snang yang bden par ma grub pa smig rgyu lta bu/brtags na ngo bo ma grub pa'i brag cha lta bu/ bden rdzun log shes kyis bskyed pa'i rmi lam lta bu/ mngon zhen bag chags kyis bskrun pa'i sgyu ma lta ba/ gnyis snang 'khrul shes su shar ba'i sprul ba lta bu/ nang gi 'khrul ༄249

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhetrartog gi rang gzugs su snang ba'i gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i rten 'brel 'di rnams chos can/ bden par med de/ bka chags 'jog byed kyi rnam pa las ma 'phos pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir dper na gzugs brnyan bzhin lta bu/ 'gro 'ong gnyis su mi dmigs pa'i dri za'i grong khyer lta bur rtogs par bya ste/ yon tan mdzod las/ yul lnga'i shes pa tshon ris ma 'dres lta'i/ /gzugs sogs 'dod pa 'i yon tan cha bzung ba/ /de la der 'dzin dgag sgrub blo rtog gis/ /'khrul snang sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad nyid du brtags/ /zhes so/ /don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas slob dpon 'phags pas/ me yi rang bzhin tsha ba dang / /chu yi rang bzhin gsher ba dang / /bu ram rang bzhin mngar ba ste/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin stong ba nyid du 'dod/ /ces bshad do/ /de ltar dge rtsa mtha' dag sems bskyed dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pas rang don don gnyer dang bden zhen gyis bcing ba'i nyes tshogs las sgrol ba yin la/ da ni dase rtsa gong 'phel du 'gro ba bsngo ba'i rnam bzhag 'chad de/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ bdag tu lta bas 'dar ba'i rnam dkar yang / /srid par lan gcig mtho ba'i cho nge ste/ /byang chub bsngo ba'i gser 'gyur rtsis thebs pa/ /'di ni ston pa gzhan gyi lugs la med/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dge ba gang zhig bsags pa thams cad bla na med pa'i 250

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7trad+nghabyang chub tu ma bsngos na lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor la smon pa tsam gyis rnam smin nyung ngur zad de/ mdo las/ mang po yang nyung ngur rigs par bya ste/ kun mkhyen du ma bsngos pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gang bsngo na dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa mtha' dag /gang du bsngo na mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob cing phan pa dang bde ba'i rtsa lag rgyal bstan sde snod rin po che rnams dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir bsngo ba nyid/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las/ sbyin pa 'dis bdag dbang bo'i gnas min tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'bras bu mi 'dod na/ /rlung gi shugs ltar na/gyogs shing g.yo ba rgyal po'i srid kyi dpal lta smos ci dgos/ /bdag sis gus pa chen pos sbyin pa 'di yi 'bras bu gang yin de yis ni/ /sem/sa la dbang byed mtshungs med byang chub thob cing sems can rnams kyang sgrol gyur cig /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bsnyi dang //bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig/ces so//lgenas skabs su yang gang na 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyang mdzad phrin yar zla ltar 'phel zhing dge 'dun gyi 'dus pa rgya mtsho mtha' dag tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang / shes rab dri ma med pa la dbang 'byor zhing / yang dag pa'i lam la gnas 251

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa dang thugs mthun par bya ba'i phyir bsngo ba yang / de nyid las/mkhas pa rnams ni bkur ba dang //bsod snyom dag kyang rnyed par shog/rgyud ni yongs su dag pa dang / /phyogs rnams kun du grags par shog /ces dang / rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog /ces so/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba thams cad byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du bde ldan zhing sogs dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob pa'i ched du bsngo ba la sogs pa ste/ de dag kyang 'khor gsum bden med du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa ni gal che ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /de yi byed pa mchog yin no/ /de ni mi dmigs rnam pa can/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do/ /ces so/ /de ltar bsngo ba la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung / /rgya mtsho ma skam bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang //byang chab ma thob bar du de mi zad/ /ces so/ /de dag gis theg chen ༄lam gyi snying bo khyad par gsum gyi rnam bzhag bsdus te gleng zin to/ /ces pa'ang sdom brtson gyi dge slong dam chos 'od zer gyis bskul ba ltar 'jigs med bsta na pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nye gnas shākya'i ba tsun pa blo gros bzang pos 'gyis pa'o/ /dge'o/ /༄khya/ /rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang 252

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7haṃlda/na pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir byang chub lam gyi rim pa la 'jug pa la/ thog mar lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ji ltar khrid pa'i rim pa bzhin du bstan pa la blo sbyang tshul gnyis yod/ dang po lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul ni/ bsten bya dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid/ de bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas ji ltar bsten tshul/ de bsten pa'i phan yon ma bsten pa'i nyes dmigs dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bshad pa yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ji ltar khrid pa'i rim pa bzhin du bstan pa ltar blo sbyang tshul de la dal ba'i rten la snying bo len par bskul ba dang / snying po ji ltar len pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa rga/nyis yod/ dang po dal ba'i rten la snying bo len par bskul ba ni/dal 'byor rnyed dka' sgom tshul gyis bstan/ snying po ji ltar len pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa de la/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam spyi'i rnam bzhag dang /bye brag so so'i lam gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa gnyis yod/ dang po de la skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi grangs nges/ go rim/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam du bshad pa'i dgos pa/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi go don dang bzhi yod/dang po ni lar sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba'i dgos pa ni sems can gyi don du yin la/ sems can gyi don la mngon mtho dang nges legs gnyis su grangs nges/ de'i phyir na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 253

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trapa rin po che yang gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug nges lesas sgrub pa'i thabs tshul gnyis su grangs nges/ de yang gnas skabs mngon mtho sgrub pa'i thabs tshul du gsungs pa'i chos skor rnams ni skyes bu chung ngu'i lam gyi chos skor dang / chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi chos skor ci rigs su ma 'dus pa med ni red/ nges legs la thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis las/ thar ba tsam sgrub pa'i thabs tshul du gsungs pa'i chos skor rnams ni/ skyes bu 'bring gi lam gyi chos skor dang 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi chos skor ci rigs su ma/ 'dus pa med pa yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i thabs tshul du gsungs pa'i chos skor rnams ni skyes bu chen po'i thun mong ma yin nga/'i lam gyi chos skor du ma 'dus pa med ni red/ de'i phyir na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs mdo hril gyis dril na skyes bu gsum gyi lam du grangs nges pa yin/ gnyis pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi go rim ni/ dang po skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyang /de nas skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyang / de nas skyenu bu chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam la blo sbyang ba ste/ go rim de ltar bya0/ na'’ sgo na dalo/sa sri7 yo7 rkya/tog0 ( dang ngo skyen bu chung 'abling dang thun mong gi lam la blo ma sbyang bar skyes bu chen po'i lam sgom du med pa yin ni red/ de'i rgyu mtshan skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi srog shing ngam/ 254

pha mi /spro////'o//spruspro/ /rdo/mi/spro//lha//// //sdos4ཿཿni/ rdotāshā/rtsa ba lta bu ni snying rje chen po yin pas/ snying rje de ni sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bdag gcig pus bsgral bar bya'o snyam pa'i blo kacig yin la/ blo de ni lar dang po rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul la bsam kyang 'jigs shing skrag pa'i blo cung zad kyang mi skye ba zhig la blo de gtan nas skye mi srid pa yin pa'i phyir na/ 'bring dang thun mong pa'i lam la blo sbyang dgos/ de yang 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong nas de las thar 'dod kyi blo shugs drag skye ba la rang nyid ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul bsam kyang ba spu g.yo ba tsam gyi 'jigs shing skrag pa'i blo yang med na 'khror ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong nas de las thar 'dod kyi blo de skye sa med pas na skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam la sngon du blo sbyang dgos ni red/ de ltar skyes bu gsum gyi lam yang go rim 'di ltar sgom dgos kyi/ de las gzhan du 'chol bar sgo ma na lam rgyud la skye mi srid pas/ go rim 'di kho na ltar sgom dgos ni yin gsang / gsam pa skyes ba gsam gyi lam du phye ba'i dgos pa ni/rang rang rathu rangaspyir rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mgon po klu sgrub la sogs pa'i shing rta chen po dag gis ni mngon mtho dang nges legs sgrub pa'i thabs tshul dpag tu med pa gsungs kyang / bstan pa yongs rdzogs skyes bu gsum gyi lam du dril te/ de kho na la rtsal tu bton te 'chad pa cher ma mdzad/255

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mtshijo bo rje a ti shas ni byang chub lam gyi sgron ma mdzad de/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs skyes bu gsum gyi lam du bsdus te/ de kho na la rtsal tu bton te bshad pa yin/ de ltar bshad pa la dgos pa gnyis yod nge/blo rab 'bring tha ma la phan che ba dang mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhi ba'i dbos pa gnyis yod/ dang po ni gang zag blo rab skye ba sngon du skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam nas bzung skyes bu chen po'i bsam pa'i bar rgyud la skyes pa zhig yin na skye ba 'dir skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong pa'i lam nas bzung ste blo sbyang na/ sngar lam rgyud la skyes zin ji/ rnams ni mngon du gyur sla zhing de ltar mngon du gyur pa tsam nas larnga/ phyi ma bsnan nas sgom chog pas de'i lam je bul dang lam log pa nyid du mi 'gro bar ma zad/ rang gi mngon par 'dod pa'i yon tan skye sla ba'i dgos pa yod pas blo rab la phan che ba dang / sngon skyes bu chung du dang thun mong ba'i lam tsam la'ang blo sbyang ma myong ba'i gang zag tha ma la ni/ dang po nas skyes bu che 'bring gi lam bstan na rmang med pa'i rtsig pa bzhin du de'i rgyud la lam gyi yon tan skye ba mi srid pa yin la/skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam nas bzung ste gdams ngag bstan na/ de'i rgyud la lam skye sla bas na blo tha ma la shin tu'ang phan che/blo 'bring skyes bu chung ngu dang 'bring gi lam gyi skal ba can zhig yin na /de la dang po nas skyes bu chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam rnams 256

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lged+kubastan na/ de'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu blor mi shong zhing / de la skur ba 'debs pa sogs don ma yin pa chen po 'byung bas na de la skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong gi lam nas khrid na/ de chung ngu dang 'bring gi lam gang gi skul ba can yin na yang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i lam der slob pa ma gtogs/ nyams 'og tu mi tshud pa'i lam rnams la ma bslab kyang chog pas de don ma yin pa las zlog par 'gyur bas na/ blo 'bring la'ang phan che bas na blo rab 'bring tha ma la phan che ba'i dgos pa zhes brjod ni yin/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhi ba'i dgos pa ni/ skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam ni 'di'o/ /skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam ni 'di'o/ /skyes bu chen po'i thun rno/nga ma yin pa'i lam ni 'di'o/ /zhes bshad pa na/ rang gi rgyud na skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam tsam yang med bzhin du skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi yon tan yang yod do snyam pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhi ba'i dgos pa yod ni red/ bzhi ba skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi go don ni dper na skyes bu chung ngus tshe phyi ma'i 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kho na don kanyer gyi blo dang / 'bring gis rang gcig pu zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo skyed pa lta bu ni/ skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi spang bya yin pas de dang thun mong min la/ 'dir gang yin na/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la 'jigs shing skrag ste/ de las thar 'dod kyi blo skyed pa dang / 'khor ba 257

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tratrashimatha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong nas de las thar ba'i thar ba don gnyer gyi blo skyed pa lta bu ni/ skyes bu chung 'bring gnyis kas kyang rang rang gi go 'phang de mngon du byed pa la lam de la blo rnga/ sbyang ba'i lta ba med la/ skyes bu chen pos kyang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam de skye ba'i stegs su de la nges par blo sbyang dgos pas lam nge la skyes bu chung 'bring che gsum gyi thun mong gi lam zhes brjod pa yin pas thun mong ba'i lam gyi go don ni de ltar yin/ gnyis pa bye bras so/ so'i lam gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa la gsum yod/ dang po skyes bu chung du dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa de la/ bsam pa 'jis rten phyi ma'i phun tshogs don gnyer gyi blo skyed pa dang / sbyor ba 'jis rten phyi mar bde bar 'gyur ba'i thabs bsten pa gnyis yod/ dang po bsam pa 'jig rten phyi ma'i phun tshogs don gnyer gyi blo ni/ 'jilga rten 'dir ring du mi gnas par 'chi ba bsam pa dang shi nas 'gro ba gnyis kyi bde sdug bsam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas blo de bskyed dgos ni red/sbyor ba 'jig rten phyi mar bde bar 'gyur ba'i thabs bsten pa de la/bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang /bde legs rnams kyi rtsa ba las 'bras yid ches kyi dad pa sbyang ba ste las gnyis la blang dor bya ba ste gnyis yod/ gnyis pa skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa de la thar ba don 258

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7trakhyoganyer gyi blo skyed pa dang / de bskyed nas thar ba'i lam dngos la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul gnyis yod/ dang po thar ba don gnyer gyi blo skyed pa la/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung bden pa la bsams te 'khor ba las nges par 'byung 'dod kyi blo skyed pa dang / rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi tshul bsams te 'khor ba las nges par 'byung 'dod kyi blo skyed pa gnyis yod/ de'i dang po la/ sdug bden 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la bsams te 'khor ba dang 'bral dgos tshul dang / kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim la bsams te 'khor ba dang 'bral nus chul gnyis bsams pa'i sgo nas thar ba don gnyer gyi blo mtshan nyid tshang ba rang gi rgyud la skyed dgos ni red/ gnyis pa de bskyed nas thar ba'i lam dngos la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul la/ sems rnam par g.yeng ba med par byed pa lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ sems mnyam par ma bzhag pa mnyam par bzhag par byed pa lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa// sems rnam par ma grol ba grol bar byed pa lhag pa shes rab kyi bsla/ba pa dang gsum yod/ de'i nang nas ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi bslab pa gnyis ni skyes bu 'bring gi lam rang dga' bar 'khrid pa'i ska bas yin na skabs 'dir 'chad dgos na yang 'dir skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi sngon 'gror bshad pa'i skabs yin pas skyes bu chen po'i rang gi thun mong ma yin pa lam pha rol du phyin pa drug la slob pa'i 259

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4zheskabs su phar phyin rjes ma gnyis la slob par 'gyur bas na skabs 'dir de gnyis 'chad par mi mdzad la/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa tsam zhig dam pa gong ma dag gis 'dir 'chad par mdzad ni red/gsum pa skyes bu chem/ po'i lam gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa de la sems bskyed kyi phan yon bsam pa/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed tshul/ de bskyed nas spyod pa la ji ltar slob tshul dang gsum yod/ dang po sems bskyed kyi phan yon bsam pa de la/ theg pa chen po'i yon tan dran zhing nge/'i 'jug sgo byang chub kyi sems nyag gcig yin pa'i tshul bsam pa dang /de las gzhan pa'i sems bskyed kyi phan yon bsam pa dang gnyis yod/gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i tshul la/ sems bskyed nyid ji ltar bsgo ma tshul dang ( de brtan par bya ba'i ched du smon sems cho yo/'i sgo nas ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul gnyis yod/ dang po la rgyal ba'i yum gyi dgongs pa slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mi dang / ka ma shi la sogs kyis bkral ba ltar rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul dang / sangs rgyas phal chen gyi dgongs pa slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha sogs kyis bkral ba ltar bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sbo nas byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul zhig dang gnyis yod/ gnyis pa de brtan par bya ba'i ched du smon sems cho ga'i sgo nas ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul bshad pa de la/ dang po ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i thabs 260

zla bye〉 /spro////te/(1pa/ /gri/lngalha///lha/sa// /rdo/rgo4ཿཿni/ (74/dang / thob zin mi nyams par bsrung ba'i thabs/ nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs dang gsum yod/ dang po la gang las blang ba'i yul/ gang bi/sa len pa'i rten/ tshul ji ltar len pa'i cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum dang bcas pa yod la/ cho ga'i dngos gzhi ni/ byang chub snying bo'i bar du rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ngo snyam pa'i sems bskyed dam bca' ba'i lcags kya gnyis pas rang dbang du byed tshul de yin ni 1111 ra mi//rngo| shāXrered/ gnyis pa sab zin nyams par bsrung ba ri thabs la/ skye ba 'dir sems bskyed mi nyams par gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i rgyu la bslab pa dang / skye ba gzhan du sems bskyed mi brjed pa'i rgyu la bslab pa gnyis yod/ dang po la sems bskyed la spro shugs 'phel ba'i phyir/dus drug tu sems bskyed kyi phan yon dran pa/ sems de nyid 'phel ba'i phyir dus drug tu byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba/ gang gi don du sems/ bskyed pa'i sems can blos mi gtong ba dang / sems bskyed gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i phyir tshogs sgo du ma nas gsogs pa dang bzhi yod/skye ba gzhan du sems bskyed mi brjed pa'i rgyu la bslab pa ni/ mchod 'os bslu ba dang / 'gyod med la 'gyod pa skyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la skur ba 'debs pa/ sems can la g.yo sgyu byed pa ste nag po'i chos bzhi'i gnyen po srog gi phyir du yang shes bzhin du rdzun mi smra ba la sogs pa'i dkar po'i chos bzhi la nan tan byed pa de yin/26/

21rngad/ 1) jordo /spyings khur:drob/bzhi cesarngasno ngas/smizug rta):re tha//kyiḥba'o/sdo/zug/ mamanyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs ni/ sems bskyed gtong ba dang /sems can blos 'dor ba gnyis gang byung kyang / sems bskyed gzhi nas bzung dgos ni red/ de las gzhan pa'i nyes pa rnams byung yang sems bskyed kyi gtong rgyu min pa dang / byang sdom ma blang ba'i gong yin pas ltung bar mi 'gyur na'ang / bar ma khas blang ba dang 'gal ba'i nyes spyod du 'gyur bas na gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags sdom byed dgos ni red/ gsum pa sems bskyed nas spyod pa la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul bshad pa de la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la slob 'dod sbyang ba/ de 'byongs nas byang sdom cho ga'i sgo nas ji ltar bzung tshul/de bzung nas spyod pa la bslab pa'i rim pa dngos dang gsum yod/ dang po la/ sems tsam bskyed kyang rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa la ma bslab na rdzogs byang thob mi srid pa'i tshul dang de yang spyod pa nor ba las/ mi 'byang ba rwa 'then pa las 'o ma mi 'byang ba lta bu dang / thabs shes ya ༄༄ /༷bye/ /spri// /rte// 1111bral lta bu —da pa ma tshang ba las 'byung ba sa na chu lud la sogs pa'i rkyen gcig ma tshang kyang myu gu bskyed mi nus pa lta bu'i tshul la bsam ste tshang la ma nor ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob 'dod spyir sbyang / bye brag byang sdom gyi skabs kyi bslab bya'i gnas phra raṭa thams cad la re re'i kha nas dmigs phugs te slob 'dod khyad par can skyed nga/ de nyid yin ni red/ de 'byongs nas byang sdom ji ltar bzung ba'i 262

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7tshul ni/ shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lugs srol gnyis la gang las blang ba'i yul slob dpon gyi khyad par/ gang gi len pa'i rten gyi khyad par/tshul ji ltar len pa'i cho ga'i khyad par/ blang nas bslab bya'i rkang grwangs kyi khyad par sogs mang du yod par dpal ldan sa skya par+bhe ta la sogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po dag gis bzhed ni red/ dge ba'i bshes rga/nyen sha ra ba la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang pos ni shing rta chen po kanyis kyi lugs la de 'dra'i rnam dbye mi bzhed par srol chen po gnyis kacig tu bsres pa'i rnam bzhag mdzad ni red/ gsum pa de bzung nas spyod pa la bslab pa'i rim pa dngos de la/ rang rgyud smin byed phar phyin drug la slob tshul dang gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la/ slob tshul gnyis yod/ dang po la phar phyin drug gi grangs nges/go rim/phyin drug dngos la slob tshul dang gsum yod/ dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mngon mtho la ltos nga/'i grangs nges/ rang gzhan gyi don thams cad sgrub pa la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ gzhan don rnam pa thams cad la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ theg chen thams cad sdud pa la ltos ba'i grangs nges/ thabs kyi rnam pa thams cad pa la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ bslab pa sasum la ltos pa'i grangs nges te grangs nges kyi sgo drug yod par gsung ni red/ go rim la/ skye ba'i go rim/ dman mchog gi go rim/ raṭa phra'i rgo rim dang gsum yod/ de ltar phyin drug gi grangs dang go rim la 263

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khye྾mkhas par byas nas/ phyin drug dngos la slob tshul la sbyin pa la slob tshul/ tshul khrims la slob tshul/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/shes rab la slob tshul dang drug yod/ dang po sbyin pa la slob tshul ni/rang gi lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa la kun 'dzin gyi 'ching bas bcings pa'i nyes dmigs dang / sbyin pa'i phan yon la bsam ste/spro sems khyad par can sgom pa de yin la/ tshul khrims la slob tshul rni/tshul khrims bsrung ba'i phan yon ma bsrung ba'i nyes dmigs la bsam te/ rang rgyud dran shes bzhin bag yod kyis legs par bsdam ste sems rgyud tshul khrims kyi phyogs la bsgyur bar byed pa la brtson par byed pa de yin/ bzod pa la slob tshul ni/ bzod pa la mang du yod kyang gnod byed la ci mi snyam pa'i bzod pa lta bu la mtshon na/ dgra bo bka' drin che tshul bsam pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud khong mi 'khrugs pa'i bzod pa la goms par byed pa de yin/ brtson 'grus la goms par byed tshul ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bya dka' ba dus yun ring por spyod dgos pa rnams la mi zhum shing snying stobs bskyed de spro shugs 'phel ba la brtson par byed rgyu de red/ bsam gtan la slob tshul ni/ mthun pa'i yul du gnas pa dang 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dang / bya ba mang po slong ba la sogs pa'i bsam gtan gyi tshogs la gnas pa'i gzhi bzung ste/ ting nge 'dzin dngos la 264

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7trat+yāslob tshul ni/ nyes pa lnga spong 'du byed brgyad bsten pa'i sgo nas ting nge 'dzin de bsgrub dgos ni red/ de la nyes pa lnga ni/ le lo/ brjed nges/bying rgod/ 'du mi byed pa/ 'du byed de lnga yin la/ de'i gnyen po 'du byed brgyad bsten tshul ni/ 'dun pa/ brtson 'grus/ shin sbyang rnams bsten dgos ni red/ de bzhin du brjed nges kyi gnyen po dran pa/ bying sgod kyi gnyen po shes bzhin yin/ 'du mi byed pa'i gnyen po sems pa/'du byed kyi gnyen po btang snyoms bsten pa ste/ de ltar nyes pa lnga spong /'du byed brgyad bsten pa'i sgo nas/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdo gas mi lcogs med sgrub dgos/ de tshul bzhin du grub pa na/ de la brten nas rim gyis bsam gtan bzhi yan lag gis 'da' ba dang /sazugs med bzhi dmigs pas 'da' ba'i tshul gyis bsam gzugs kyi hing nge 'dzin brgyad sgrub par byed pa de yin/ shes rab la slob tshul ni/shes rab de la ji lta ba rtogs pa'i shes rab/ ji snyed pa rig pa'i kanas lnga mkhyen pa'i shes rab/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i shes rab dang gsum yod pa'i nang nas gtso bo ni zhi gnas la brten te/ bdag med pa gnyis kyi de kho na nyid la lhag mthong gi rtsal sbyong bar byed pa de shes rab la bslab tshul gyi gtso bo yin ni red/ gnyis pa gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la slob tshul la/ zang zing gi bsdu ba sacig dang / chos kyi bsdu ba gsum yod/ dang po zang zing gi bsdu ba ni/265

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sbyin pa yin la/ de ni sbyin pa'i phar phyin la slob tshal gyi skabs bshad ༄ pa ltar yin/ gnyis pa chos kyi bsdu ba ni/ mos pa'i chos dang / sgrub nga/'i chos dang / de nyid rnam par sbyong ba'i chos kyi bsdu ba dang gsum yin/mos pa'i chos kyi bsdu ba ni/ snyan par smra ba dang / sgrub pa'i chos kyi bsdu ba ni don spyod pa dang / de nyid rnam par sbyong ba'i chos kyi bsdu ba ni/don mthun pa yin/ de la snyan par smra ba ni/ gdul bya sems can la phar phyin drug la slob tshul la sogs pa'i yang dag pa'i chos 'chad de /de rnams shes par byed rgyu de red/ don spyod pa ni pha rol pos chos shes pa de nyid bsgrub tu 'jug pa de yin/ don mthun pa ni gzhan la bsgrub tu 'jug pa'i chos de rang gis kyang 'bad pa ci yod kyi sgo nas sgrub par byed pa de yin/ de ltar na de dag gi sgo nas theg chen thun mong ba'i lam la slob tshul bshad pa de nyid song / thun mong ma yin ji/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam la ji ltar slob tshul ni bya spyod ga/nyis ka gang gi lam la bslab kyang byang sdom la brten nas chu dang cod nga/na la sogs kyi dbang bskur ba tsam zhig nod de rang gi lam la bslab na chog pas de la sngags sdom bzung ba sngon du 'gro mi dgos/ rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad kyi rgyud sde gang gi lam bsgom kyang / byang sdom la rten byas te sngags sdom rang gi rgyud la bzung / de nas rgyud sde rang rang si dbang bskur ba mtshan nyid tshang ba zhus te/ rgyud de dang de'i lam/ la 266

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lge slob dgos ni red/ de yang sdom pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin tu bsrung ba med na/ rgyud sde gang gi lam la zhugs kyang 'bras bu thob pa mi srid ni red/ sdom pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung ba yod na de las gzhan pa'i lam la brtson pa cher bskyed ma nus na'ang phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyis bskal chen grangs med pa sogs su sgrub dgos rgyu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de/ skye ba bcu drug tshun la nges par 'grub par kasung ni red/ lam dngos la slob tshul ni/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum la dang po mtshan bcas dang / de nas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas thun mong gi dngos grub sngon du bsgrub/ de la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub sgrub dgos/ de ltar thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa/ la ma ltos par mchog gi dngos grub sgrub mi nus ni red/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi skabs su gdul bya rin po che lta bu'i gang zag yin na/ de'i thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la ma ltos par yang / rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas snyigs dus kyi tshe thung ngu gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sgrub par byed ni red/ de las gzhan pa'i tsan dan lta bu la sogs pa'i gdul bya phal ba rnams kyi nang na dang po thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrubs te de la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'ang yod ni yin gsung ni red lags/ de ltar sa gsum gyi rin po che gcig pu byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sdom rags pa zhig /rje bla ma bka' drin mtshungs med a bhā 267

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phagalgeya'i zhal snga nas mdun 'khod 'ga' zhig la brtse bas gdams pa bzhin de dag gis zin thor btab pa ltar ha lam pa'i zhu dag byas nas gsung 'bum gral du bzhag pa'o/ /༄/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan gzungs kyi rin po che mi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang du bdud rtsi'i gtong ba don gnyer rnams/ /rin chen chos kyi 'byor ba kun 'grub pa'i/ /gzungs rgyal yon tan phung po legs brnyes pa/ /'jam dbyangs sgrol mdzad 'phags ma la btud nas/ /rang nyid dge ba rgya chen goms phyir dang / /skal mnyam gzhan la'ang don mang spel slad du/theg mchog gzungs kyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i tshul/ /mdo sde'i rjes 'brangs ji ltar nus bzhin bsdu/ /gang zhig gang la ci yi phyir 'jug dang / /thabs gang zhig gis ji ltar 'jug pa dang / /zhugs nas don thob rang gi ngo bo yis/ /brtan pa rnams kyi gzungs 'di shes par bya/ /'jigs rung sdug bsngal stong gis gtses pa yi/ /srid pa'i chu mtshor bying ba'i rang nyams la/ /bsam shing skyo bas rab drangs mdzangs pa rnams/ /dang por yid ni zhi la ldang bar 'gyur/ tho/zhi ba de yi lam tshul mgon med 'gror/ /rtag tu mngon phyogs ji bzhin nyid gsung ba'i/ /bde gshegs nyi ma 'jig rten kun gyi blar/ /gcig pu snang la dang ba'imig 'bur g.yo/ /'khor tshe pha mtha' yas pa'i sems can kun/ /bdag268

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7la dka' ba rgya chen mang bgyis par/ /mthong ste de dag rnams kyi rgud pa'i phyogs/ /kun kyang rang gi rgud pa lta bur rtogs/ /bde 'dod sdug bsngal mi mthun blo phyir las/ /bdag gces 'dzin pa'i rigs pa ka/zhan yod min//rang bzhin mnyam pa ches mang bor nas su/ /gcig cig srung bar sems pa ci yi tshul/ /bdag nyid sdug pa 'dod mang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /bde sgrub mthu med de gzhan spo na ni/ /de nyid dge ba mnyam me+ed gter rig nas/ /tshal de las kyang yid 'ong go 'pho thob/ /ji ltar ༄snying rje'i rtsa ba cher brling dang / /rgyal la dad pa mang du 'phel de ltar//byang chub che la 'dun pa mang 'gyur te/ /'gro ba skyob 'dod skyob nus der nges phyir/ /de mang de yi thabs la'ang 'dun pa'i shugs/ /lhag 'gyur 'ga' yang rgyu med mi mthun rgyus/ /'grub yod min la mos phyir de thabs ni/ /thos pa kun 'dzin sgrub pa'i snying bo can/ /gang phyir phra rab shes bya'i mun pa ni/ /thos pa'i mdzod bsags tshul sgo bsam yas kyis/ /sbyang ba'i blo can 'ba' zhig spong nus na/ /gzungs dang bral la thos pa'i mdzod de med/ /dran pa bul bas dus mang 'thob dka' ba'i//rlabs chen chos rab rnam 'byed rtsal de dag /ngal ba chung ngus nuzungs la gnas pa rnams/ /'thob phyir myur du rtogs pa rab mthar bgrod/ /gzungs kyi rgyan ldan rnams la de bzhin gshegs/ /'doms pa/'i dus mkhyen ting 'dzin sgo mo dang / /der 'jug chos kyi dbyings 269

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma〉shitshul rgyas pa'i gtam/ /gsung phyir sangs rgyas yul 'jug mig dang ldan//dpal stug gzugs sku'i legs mdzod yangs pa dang / /de rgyu sbyin tshul bzod pa'i bye brag dang / /de dag re rer 'jug sgo zad mi shes/ /thos pas 'byor ba nan tan mang ba yin/ /theg mchog rin thang che ba'i rgyus mkhas shing / /de 'khur rang blo stobs dang ldan rig nas/ /shugs draka spro ba mang du skye 'gyur te/ /brtson ldan de 'dra yon tan kun snod 'gyur//ye shes bsod nams tshogs kyis 'phel byed cing / /ye shes stobs kyis bsod nams dag 'gyur phyir/ /gzungs ni de dag yangs pa rab mchog dang / /rnam dag phul byung sgrub pa'i thabs su'ang bsngags/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i khang par rgyu rnams la/ /srod kyi mun pa 'byung ba gnas min ltar/ /kun 'dzin ye shes mtho la gnas bcas pa/ /dam chos nub pa'i smag la 'jigs pa med/ /de phyir tshogs de gnyis kyi rnam smin dang //rgyu mthun 'bras bu rgya che mu med du/ /'byin 'gyur rgyu dang 'bras bu'i phyogs dag kyang / /stag dang nags bzhin phan tshun srung ba byed/ /'di ltar thos sgrogs mchog gi yul min pa'i/ /rnal 'byor byis pa'i sar yang spyod bzod pa/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi ngo mtshar rmad byung ste/ /byis par brjod kyang de yi nyes las 'das/ /gzungs kyis brgyan pa sgra dang gtan tshigs dang / /bzo gso rig pa'i thabs tshul bsam yas kyis/ /gdul ba'i skye mang ji ltar 'os pa bzhin/ /tshar gcod rjes su gzung la 270

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7bag rab brkyang / /sangs rgyas gsung rab 'od kyis ljon pa'i chab /drang ltar 'gro ba dman rnams mtho ris 'jug /bsam gtan gnas dang thos sgrogs bse ru dang / /byang chub mnyam pa med shul kun nas ston/ /gzungs ldan dpa' bo rigs pa'i mar me ni/ /mang bor spro bas 'jig rten brgyan byed de/ /de tshe de la lha mi mkhas pa kun/ /'di ni 'jig rten sgron mar 'gyur zhes dga'/ /dga' ba de las phun tshogs mi zad pa/ /nges par 'thob byed bsod nams phung sog ste/ /che ba'i bdag nyid rnams la nyon mongs dang / /bcas pa'i yid zhugs pa yang bde byed gsungs/ /phyogs bcur rgyal ba rnams kyis gzungs thob la/ /bsngags pa'i phreng ba bzang zhing mang ba dang / /phul byung dpe yi rgyan dang ldan sogs kyis/ /sems can dpag med theg mchog spro bar mdzad//mdor na dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa'i sgo/ /gzungs yin bde bar sashegs pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /rgyal sras bslab kun 'du ba'i sdom yin phyir/ /de yi yon tan pha mtha' thug pa med/ /pha rol phyin min sems bskyed dgos mi rdzogs/ /chang rim ma bskyed gong ma mi 'thob phyir/ /༄brtan pa gzungs la ngoms pa mi skye zhing / /dman zhing phra ba la yang brnyas mi sems/ /de ltar yid ches mang du rnyed pa na/ /gzungs de skyed la 'dun pa yangs shing brtan/ /'dun pa'i dbang gis bskal ba brgya sto nga du/ /mi skyo brtson 'grus go cha sra ba 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa'i 271
