casajid/ 11 lngardo sdo/ngas khur:zub/thag byaspucad nga//stacad rta):reb//sbong 'o/dra/zug/ 5rimachirgyan gzungs kyi rin po che mi zad pa'i mdzod las/ gzungs sgrub pa/ la 'jug pa'i rgyu bstan pa'i gnas te rim par phye ba dang po'o/ /rgyus dbye rnam smin thos la goms pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin gzungs gnyis dang gcig rim bzhin/ /chung dang chen po'i phyogs 'dod skye ba las/ /thob dang sbyor byung dbye bas chung ngu'ang gnyis/ /de dag tshe gcig 'thob la rims pa'i tshul/ /'dir nges gnyis gcig dman mchog rim pa'ang yin/ /kun gzhi med kyang rnam par smin phung po/ /grub tsam nyid las 'thob phyir dang por brjod/ /rgyud kyi bye brag rnams la lhan cig skyes/ /thos pa gzungs mthu mi 'dra'i khyad mthong bas/ /sngon gyi sbyang ba'i khyad par tha dad du/ /grub ste 'dir goms dbye ba'i 'bras bur mtshungs/ /dam chos bklag dang dris dang kha ton du/ /goms par bgyis sogs dus dang bsam dbang gis/ /srid pa gzhan du thos pa 'dzin pa'i rtsal/ /so sor mngon 'byang rgyu ru 'gyar shes bya/ /tshig nyedra/ /jiXrdo /)kye /rje/ ri'i ༷te/ ra midang na tshul 'a—na la gas ba —mas nga / /mnyan bsam ngal ba bsten pas phye rim bzhin/ /nus pa glags te sgyu rtsal byang ba ltar/ /'dzin stobs myur ba rnam pa gzhan yin no/ /bsam gtan tshogs la gnas nas brtson 'grus can/ /mi mtho mi zhum dmigs pa brjed med par/ /bcing ba'i yid kyis shes rab nyer 'jog cing / /goms pas lus sems las su rung ba skye/ /sems bsdus shin tu sbyang ba rnyed 'og tu//272

mdzubasta〉 par shāspro//////()pa/ /rdo/lha1spro//lha/pa// /rdo//45ཿ// (tāshā/spro bas shin sbyangs dbang du bya phyir ni/ /spro bsdu mnyam pas shes rab bsgom bgyi ste/ /de las zhi lhag zung 'brel ting 'dzin 'grub/ /'dzin la gtsor bgyid zhi gnas dbang gis ni/ /thos pa'i yul la ri bo bzhin brtan cing / /lhag mthong shugs kyis gsal snang bzang po yis/ /'khyud pa'i mod la yang dag 'dzin pa 'thob/ /thos pa 'dzin gang rnam thar sgo kasum la/ /dmigs pa'i lhag mthong las skyes chen por gsungs/ /'di yi dbye ba byang sems dbang mdzad nas/ /sa mtshams la brten rnam pa ka/sum du bshad/ de ni chos dbyings lhag par mos spyod dang / /rtsol 'ing 'bad bcas mngon sum mthong 'jug dang / /rtsal 'bad phal cher zhi ba'i ye shes kyi/ /rgyu can phyir na chung dang che rim bzhin/ /sazangs gsum chung dang cher bshad chung ngu'i rgyu/ /gang yin chen po yi rari /༷༷/yang rgyur gsungs d+nghar/ /rnam par smin dang ting 'dzin las byung sogs//brjod pa de dag gtso bo'i rgyu las yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rnam sbyong zhing / /'dod pa'i bde ba ring btang chos kyi mdzod/ /ci 'i/ga gang las gang gi ched sgrub rnams/ /srung la khyad par brtson pas kazungs mchog rnyed/ /'jig rten mnog chung nyes dmigs mang rig nas/ /lhag par zhen med gzhan gyi sbyor mthong na/ /mi bzod mi bgyi yongs su bzung ba rnams/ /sbyin la slob cing 'dod yon don gnyer spong / /gzungs sogs mdo sde rgya chen bye ba'i mdzod/ /byang chub sems 273

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trashidapa'i sde snod gtsor bzung ste/ /shas cher gang bsten dbang po rtul 'gyur ba'i/ /gzhung la ngal ba lhur len yong mi bgyi/ /nyin dang ma/tshan du sngon 'dus bgyis pa yi/ /chos kyis phongs pa'i nong ba mthol bgyi zhing / /chos la sdang zhing chos spong mi bgyi ste/ /sdig de mtshams med bas kyang mi bzad gsung / /chos kyi yon tan sems shing gal te de/ /'dod bzhin ma thob na yang de tshol nyid/ /phan yon chen po'i sgor mthong 'dun pa'i stobs/ /rab drag brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar brtsams /thob pa'i chos la dga' ba cher bskyed nas/ /'bri mchod klog dang kha ton bya ba la/ /mi skyo gzhan la'ang chos spyod de 'dra ba/ /mthong na rjes su yi rang bsod nams sgrub/ lta dang tshul khrims ngan la gnas pa dang / /'dris pa spong zhing dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /rnyed dka' rin chen sbyin pa'i 'du shes kyis/ /ring na gnas kyang dka' ba stong gis tshol/ /smra mkhas de dag 'jig rten chos gnas kyang / /sangs rgyas phrin las gos pa med par spyod/ /de bas de la bsam bzhin 'khrul mi tshol /mngon sum mthong yang nyes pa gleng mi bya/ /des byin drin gyis khengs/ dang rgyags med par/ /bsgo ba'i rjes 'jug shin tu dka' ba'ang bzod///grong dang yul 'khor chos smra srung byed cing / /chos ston phyir ni gsol ba du mar gdab/ /chos las sangs rgyas rjes dran phyogs dang phyogs/ /bde bar gshegs kyi snyan pa brjod bya zhing / /dus gsum phyag bgyi thub 274ji

zla shāmi :spro//////the // /gri/1lhaspro//lhaspros// /rdo//2ཿཿ// rtotāshā/pa'i mchod rten la/ /mar me'i phreng ba la sogs rgya cher mchod/ /smon pa'i stobs sam brgya la las kyis kyang / /sangs rgyas sras rnams gang du ci 'drar ni/ /'byung ba shes par sla min tshul 'di yis/ /sems can kun la ston pa bzhin gus bya/ /de bzhin 'gro la byams pa bsam yas bskyed/ /bdag gi phun tshogs gzhan la sngar bstab pa/ /dran nas slob dpon dpe mkhyud mi bya zhing / /zang zing 'dod pa'i yid ni mi rgyu bya/ /snyo mas las med par dus bzhin chos 'chad dang / /de lta'i dge la srog chags gzhan yang 'dzud/ /bsod nams phung po dpal phreng seng ge'i sgra 'i/ /smon pas yongs bsngo bsam pa ji bzhin 'byung / /sgra kun tshul sa/cig 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor grus/ /gzangs kyi chu gter sul mang 1)/ 13she ༄༄mi 111'da' ba yang / /da tshogs ba dan 'dra ma na po rnams/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs rlung gis drang ba'i mthu/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan ka/zungs kyi rin po che mi zad pa'i mdzod las/ gzungs sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rab dbye bstan pa'i gnas te rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o/ /shin sbyangs phra bas brgyan pa'i yid can gyis/ /rnal 'byor dang mthun kun tu spyod gnas shing / /dpa' bo'i ting 'dzin kun tu snang ba yi/ /spyod yul rtog byed gzungs sgrub thabs su bshad/ /de la a zhes bya ba ma skyes phyir/ /chos kun sgo yin de ltar ra la sogs/ /yi ge'i sgo mo ji snyed de snyed dang / /bcu drug sogs sbyor mdo sde rnams las 'byung / /275

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ brjod par bya dang byed du snang ba'i gzhi/ /mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med tshul shes nas/ yi ge'i brda la kun tu brtags tsam zhes/ /'jug pa drang don mdo rjes 'brangs rnams bzhed/ /lugs der chos bdag me/da pa mi bzhed dang / /bzhed la gzungs sgrub gtso bor gnod med kyi/ /blo dbang las min brjod bya rjod byed dag /'gog la brten bzhed k+shing rta che srol gzhan/ /ji ltar shing tog khar bcang ma bcas dang / /bcas dag ro bro tshor la khyad yod bzhin/ /brjod pa spyi tsam so sor de nyid don/ /dmigs pas mthu rtul ba dang rnon por 'gyur/ /rnam grangs du mas don dang tshig dag la/ /sbyang ba lhur len nyi sh+ka mthu can gyi/ /yid gzhung rgal nas ring por 'gro 'gyur phyir/ /gzungs kyi sgo la yi ge mang por brjod/ /a sogs ma mo'i grangs rim brda sprod kyi/ /gzhung las rnam bzhag gzhan mdzad don dbang phyir/ /bstan bya ston dang nyan la rnam rtog pa'i/ /gnyen por 'bru brgyad sgo mtha' yas gsungs bzhin/ /skyes bu phung min phung las tha dad min/ /de la phung po'am phung la de brten min/ /phung dang skyes bu ngo bo nyid ldan min/ /de phyir skyes ba rang ///ne /rdordo) sa bcab na las 'thad/ /khams dang de yi yan lag dag kyang ni/ /gcis dang du ma'i rang bzhin bral ba yin/ /de bzhin dngos rnam sa bdag dang gzhan las sam/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med 'byung ba'ang min/ /yod pa'am med pa gang zhig skye 'gyur zhes/ /brtags kyang dngos po skye 276

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7sgeb 'ga' mi rnyed/ /gang tshe rang gi ngo bo mi mthong ba/ /de tshe de dag gzhan gyis bcos mar shes/ /rtog pas bcos ma rang bzhin stong ba'i tshul/ /gcig 'di rang gi gzhi las mang po ste/ /re re'ang cha la brten nas mang 'dogs phyir/ /yi ge'i phreng bar tshul mang spros nas bshad/ /sgra don sre la goms pa'i ngor byas nas/ /don las rjod byed nus pa tha dad du/ /dmigs par 'gyur te snyan dngags phreng ba la/ /sgeg dang dpa' ba la sogs nyams mthong bzhin/ /tshul 'dis de nyid don ston mi ge rnams/ /phur ba'i tshig gsungs bzod la spros pa yi/ /g.yeng ba bsdus pa'i shan phyir de yi phyir/ /dran pa 'byar ba yongs su mi 'phrogs yin/ /slu ba'i chos 'bigs gnyis su bgyir med pa'i/ /brjod byas rab brling rmongs pa rtsa gcod phyir/ /rdo rje'i tshig yin de slad rgyal po yi/ /phyag rgya bzhin du yi ge'i tshogs nang brjid/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i stong nyid snga ra bslab rnams/ /yig 'bru re rer nges pa'i tshig res kyang / chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor kun mthong ste/ /chos gcig gting mthong kun kyang thal ler snang / /dang po'i yi ge tshig don de de yi/ /mtshan mar 'gyur phyir gzungs kyi phyag rgyar brjod/ /de yang mtshan rme/ra byas nas nges pa'i tshig /yid byed blo yis don mngon brjod las 'gyur/ /ci 'dra'i rim goms de kho na bzhin du/ /'don pa mthong bas dbus mtha' mtshan ma min/ /mtshan mar bzung ba gsal brtan bul 27 7

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tragyi phyir/ /so sor rtog pa'i shes rab phra bas 'jug /yi ge gcig la rjod byed cha 'ga' yang / /mi 'dod tshig rnams don lung mi ston 'gyur/ /nge lta'ang ming dang ming min yi ge rnams/ /mtshungs par don dang ngo bos 'brel ba med/ /dbus mtha' dang po sgra rtsom dus su ni/ /mi 'drar bskyed min mang du sog med phyir/ /brjod pa'i 'og tu phyi rol 'gro med pas/ /sngar byung ba la bsnan nas phan 'dogs min/ /de ring nyid ni 'di'am 'di lta zhes/ /mi rjod bem po'i ngo bo nyid yin phyir/ /'dis ni thog ma dbus mtha'i yi ge rnams/ /'brel grub na yang don rjod mi nus bshad/ /gal te brda byed rnams kyi brjod 'dod las/ /rjod byed yan lag rang bzhin 'dod na ko/ /sems dang bral ba rjod 'dod dbang brten nas/ /don rtogs shes 'gyur de las mtshar ci yod/ /rang bzhin zhi yang rjod byed rjod byed cha/ 'phel 'grib mi mngon gang phyir 'jis rten gyis/ /brda dang tha snyad rang dgar bzo mthong gi/ /'dis 'di rjod mi nus snyam dogs med phyir/ /don rjod 'dod pas kun bslang dang bo'i sgra/ /sbyor na gnyis pa'ang dang po brda byed mkhan/ /gang rjes 'brangs nas brjod pa'i lugs ji bzhin/ /brjod bya gzhan du don nge shod mi 'gyur/ /gang phyir mi bslu don ston bya ba la/ /ltos nas yi ge rnams kyi ngo bo dang / /grangs dang go rim so sor rnam nges pa/ /grags las gzhan pa'i rigs pa 'ga' yod min/ /yi ge 'byung ba'i tshul dang 278

thordotā :spro////te//tre// ///lha1spro//lha/pa// / /rgo4ཿཿni/ (tāshā/yun tshad kyi/ /cha sogs rnam dpyad stong ba rjes dran zhing / /phyag rgya'i tshogs su rang bzhin 'gog pa'i gzhi/ /kun kyang de 'dra kho nar yid la byed/ /yig gcig mtha' yas skad kyis bsgyur bas na/ /chos kun sdud kyang rjod byed mnyam pa nyid/ /sgo yi don gnas re rer shes bya kun/ / mnyam bsdus de la brjod bya'i mtshan nyid med/ /de la sogs kyang dpe don sngar sbyar bas/ /dpe mthong kho nas don dran dmigs pa dang / /tshig dang de yi don dag de bas kyang / /nye phyir mtshan mar gzung ba'i yan lag 'gyur/ /'thad pa bzang dang ldan pa'i nges tshig gis/ /yi ge mngon sgrub pa la mkhas byas pas/ /nas kyi shun pa brje ba'i tshul gyis ni//ma thos brda la 'dris pa'i sgo gzhan 'jug /ming dang ming gzhan yi ge'i brda dang ni/ /tha snyad stug pos bar chod ring ba dang / /gal te yi ge rigs bsdus phyogs bsten na/ /brda gnyis btang snyoms 'dug pa lta bur snang / /phyogs de stobs ldan ming gcig la 'jug pas/ /rab 'byams ming gi yi ger sleb nus min/ /gal te thog 'dra so sor gcig sbyar nas/ /mtshan mar byed na'ang thug dang dgos nus med/ /de phyir ming tshig kun las brdas 'gyur gyi/ /lhag ma yi ge'am don 'gar nye ring med/ /'dod pa'i dbang brten 'ga' zhig kho na la/ /nges 'dis yi ge btus la brda yis phye/ /btu dang phye ba'i sgo gnyis phan tshan gyi/ / ༄ grogs gyur ba dag yi ge gcig las ni/ /yi ge 'bum 'jug pa dang 279

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khu〉ma〉'bum las slar/ /gcig la 'jug pa'i lam srang drang po yin/ /yi be'i sgron ma gcig btegs 'byams klas pa'i/ /de nyid dbye ba dran yul gsal byed phyir/ /thams cad snang ba'o spobs pa zab mo'i gter/ / skye ba'i sgo'i phyir sa bon tshig ces bya/ /ming gang sngon du nges don la 'jug pa'i/ /yi ge mi 'gro yod min kun nas sgo/ /thams cad rjes song gzungs dang brjod pa kun/ /sangs rgyas gsung bstan pa yang de ltar bshad/ /gzungs kyi rnam grangs dmigs pas rgyas 'gyur phyir/ /sgo tshul mtha' yas zhes kyang bzhed pa yin/ /phyogs 'dis rnam pa'i rjes su 'jug la sogs/ /mdo yi tha snyad gzhan yang bshad par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan gzungs kyi rin po che mi zad pa'i mdzod las/ bzod pa'i gzungs sgrub tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'i gnas te rim par phye ba gsum pa'o / /rang mthus bzung ba yun ring chud mi za/ /mthu de shas che bas na gzungs su brjod/ /de yi rang bzhin dran pa gsal ba dang / /brtan pa'i blo yin bsam gtan la sogs kyang / rgya cher dbye ba 'jig rten 'das le dang / /gzungs kyi rgyal bo'i mdo sogs sde snod las/ /bka' balcal mdor bsdus chos dang don dang ni/ /gsang sngags bzod 'thob byed pa'i gzungs bzhir bshad/ /shin tu rgyas gzhung rnams kyang ji lta bur/ /thos pa'i tshul las lhag chad mi 'gyur zhing / /rim pa mi nyams nge 280

zla shāmi :spros//shā//(15/ ///dzo1pa//lha/pa// //rngos4ཿཿda/ rto7)/'drar de dag gi/ /don 'dzin spyod pa'i sgo nas gnyis sa 'gyar re ༄ ༄re'ang sngar brjod gsum dbye gong nas gong / /sgo gsum dag gi khyad pa/ra zhugs 'gyur te/ /gzhung don rnam nges pa dang brtan pa dang / /thos mang gnas pa'i go skabs yangs pa yin/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba ting nge 'dzin dbang ngam/ /smon pa'i shugs kyis gang dang ci 'dra ba'i/ /sngags su bzung ba gzhan du mi 'gyur bar/ /zlos la don yod 'gyur phyir kazungs su 'dod/ /sngar sbyor chud mi za ba'i nus pa la/ /rag las min phyir snyan ngag byed mi mtshungs/ /sngags 'grub byed pa'i rjes su bslab dbang gis/ /yin shes phyir ni 'bras bu'ang rgyu yis btags/ /tshu la khrims la sogs grogs dang ngo bo nyid/ /ji tsam phul gyur de yis nyer brgos pa'i/ /sngags kyi byin rlabs brdzi bas mi 'jigs dang / /brtan dang rgya che bar ni 'gyur ba yin/ /bzod pas chos nyid rjod cing dbye ba'i sgo/ /ma lus yi ge'i sdoms su bsdus bsgoms pas/ /don dam bzod pa yi ge tsam nyid kyis/ /'drongs pa'i mthu grub blo ldan bzod pa'i gzungs/ /'dir yang dbye ba gong ma bzhin brjod bya/ /chos don mtha' yas gzhung dang yig gcig tu/ /bsdus nas 'dzin la chos don sazungs gnyis su/ /dbye dang mi dbye'i rnam dbye gsal bar 'dod/ /'di ltar ldog pa tsam gyis de phye min/ /gang ma bzung bar gang 'dzin yo/da min pa/ /ma yin phyis kyang 'bras bu'i dran pa la/ /tha dad mthong 281

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ t+yāzhe haṃphyir gnyis su 'gyur ba snyam/ /ji ltar de dag rgyun gcig go rim rnam/sa//nges sbyar mtshan mar byas pas mi 'khrul ltar/ /'di ni don gang yi tre gang zhig gis/ /mtshan la dmigs pas de der 'du ba nyid/ /nges 'byung lam med pa la'ang gsum thob yod/ de las gzungs gnyis rgyu yis lhag par mang / /gcig ni rgyal sras rnams kyi thun mong min/ /de ni thams cad nang na rgyus kyang nyung / /chos ni don shes thabs yin thos pa rnams/ /mthar phyin dbang mdzad phyir na dbus phal ba/ /de das bzod pa'i gzungs kyis rnam dag phyir/ /rim 'di mkhas pa rnam/sa kyis bzhed pa lta/ /blo ldan rnams kyi gzungs 'thob 'gyur ba'i ltas/ /gter chen me tog rdzing dang gos dkar phrugs/ /rnyed dang spyi bor lha yis gdugs mdzes pa/ /'dzin pa la sogs rmi lam dag na mthong / /ji ltar gzungs thob la brten rgyal sras kyi/ /bya ba dpag med rdzogs byed de sngar bshad/ /mdor byas yang yang gzhan dang bdag phan phyir/ /dam chos rab tu ston dang 'dzin las can/ /bskal dang ma bskal dus gzhan so so ru/ /thos pa'i chos dran rtsa lag 'byor ba bzhin/ /gnas shing gdams ngag dgos pa ma rnying ba'i/ /shing las phreng ba bzhin du brgyud mar rgyu/ /gdul ba'i dbang bzhin bshad bya de dang de/ /'brel zhing rgyun chags ma tshang med par ston/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis 'dri bas sangs rgyas dang / /sangs rgyas sras las chos kyi sprin 'byung byed/ /282

mdzubasta :spro///bye///ste// /bye/1/rdo /lha/sa// /1114ཿཿda/ rdotārti/dmigs pa chud mi za ba'i stobs thob pas/ /bshad bya phul byung 'chad la dbang byed phyir/ /gsang sngags byed pa'ang gzungs su bsdu 'os te/ /de phyir bden tshig 'ga' la'ang thal mi 'gyur/ /snral gzhi'i rgyud du ring por bstan sob/sa kyis/ /dran pa mi 'khrugs 'dod dang mthun byed pa/ /zil gyis mi non rang dbang thob las te/ /de ltar skye ba gzhan du'ang yongs mi g.yo/ /bskal pa du mar zab dang rgya che'i gnas/ /katan 'bebs smra ba'i spobs pa thug mi 'gyur/ /rnam dag ngag gi yon tan mi zad phyir/ /gzhan gyi yid 'phrogs spobs pa'i sa bon skrun/ /'gro ba'i ris dang yul gyi skad sna tshogs/ /ji ltar rigs bzhin du ni brda sprod byed/ /pad+mo rnam 'phrul chos kyi char 'bebs pas/ /'jig rten dga' ba rgya cher kun tu skyed/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan gzungs kyi rin po che mi zad pa'i mdzod las/ /gzungs kyi ngo bo dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa'i gnas te rim par phye ba bzhi ba'o/ /gang gis bdag 'dra'ang zab mo chos dpyod la/ /sbyar ba dge ba'i bshes der phyag bgyid do/ /rmongs pas nongs te drang srong chen po'i rgazhung / /log par gang bshad brtse ldan rnams la 'chags/ /nus pa ji bzhin dam chos la gus pa'i/ /blo yis sbyar 'di mkhas pas 'phya 'os min/ /bsam pa dge bas sangs rgyas sku gzugs kyi/ /dbu la mchil lham bzhag pa'ang ma dpyas ltos/ /chen po rnams kyi gzungs tshul 283

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhetralegs bsnyad las/ /bsod nams dpag bsam shing 'dra gang skyes pas//'gro kun rgyal ba'i chos mdzod yongs rdzogs par/ /bzung ste myur du kun mkhyen sar bgrod shog /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan gzungs kyi rin po che mi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba/ thos pa'i za ma tog kha 'byed pa/ smra ba chen po'i stag gi rgyud du byung zhing / bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi nags 'dabs phyogs gcig na gnas pa/ gangs can shar phyogs pa/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /dace zhing bkra shis// //༄7/ /gang gi rig sngags ye shes skus/ /'gro ba skyob mdzad la btud nas/ /sgo drug rnam par bzhag pa'i gtam/ /bsdus te bdag bis gsal bar bya/ 1/a ni skye ba med pa'i sgo/ /chos 'di skye ba ma mchis te/ bdag las skye na skyed byed chos/ /skye bya'i snga rol med par 'gyur/ 2 /gzhan las skye na rgyu 'bras kyi/ /nges pa snang ba mi rigs nyid/ /gnyis las skye na gnod pa'i phyogs/ /gnyis ka gcig tu 'du bar 'gyur/3 /rgyu med nyid du skye yin na/ /skye ba ldog par rigs ma yin/ /de dag las gzhan skye ba'i tshul/ /sus kyang smra bar mi nus so/4/ra ni chags pa med pa'i sgo/ /chags pa rang bzhin ma grub ste/ /chags zin chags na don ma mchis/ /chags pa las lhag chags pa ci/5 /chags min chags par mi rung ste/ /chags na chags min yin pa 'gal/ /yang dag lam gyis 284

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7774chags pa'i blo/ /'bral ba'ang chags pa grub la med/6 /gnyen pos chags pa'i rgyun bkag na/ /chags pa chags par ma grub nyid/ /chags pa snang bzhin stong ba ste/ /rang bzhin med par gsal ba yin/7 /pa ni don dam zab mo'i sgo/ /chos kyi dbyings la don dam brjod/ /snang 'di bden par grub gyur na/ /don dam bden pa gtan med 'gyur/8/'on kyang rten 'byung stong de'i phyir/ /don dam rigs pas grub pa yin/ /stong ba'ang rang mtshan ma grub mod/ /tha snyad tsam du bzhag pa nyid/9 /bden dngos kun rdzob tu'ang med/ /de phyir don dam yod ces bya/ /yang dag tu ni bden grub la/ /ltos nas ma bzhag don dam ci/10 /tsa ni 'chi 'pho med pa'i sgo/ /srog 'gaṭa pa la shi bar brjod/ /ci ste srog dbang gcig yin na/ /rgan dang gzhon pa ga la rung / 11 /srog dbang skad cig rang bzhin na/ /rdzun par grub pa ma yin nam/ /gang la srog ni yod min pa/ /de la de 'gag ci phyir yod/ 12 /ris mthun gnas pa ldog las gzhan/ /shi ba dngos med yin pa'i phyir/ /rang gi ngo bo tha snyad du'ang / /med par smra la bdag mi 'jigs/ 13 /na ni ming dang bral ba'i sgo/ /ming ni mnyam pa nyid la med/ /ming dang don la cha med na/ /brjod bya rjod byed mi srid 'gyur/14 /gal te de dag cha yod na/ /phan tshun ltos te bzhag par zad/ /brjod 'dod rtog las ming skye na/ /'dzin pas bzhag las ci zhig yod/ 15 /ming don blo yis ma bzhag na//285

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stan574'brel ba'i tshul gzhan gang zhig 'thad/ /rtog btags min pa'i ming dang don/ /rang gi ngos nas grub pa med/16/dhī ni blo gros dam pa'i sgo///chos rab rnam 'byed mchog gi blos/ /ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas/ /ma/ lus yang dag mngon par rtogs/17 /rdul med zhi ba'i ye shes ches/ /bden dang mi bden sna tshogs pa'i/ /'dzin stangs dbyings su brtul nas ni/ /mthong ba med pa'i ngang du gnas/ 18 /'on kyang rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/ /rkyen nyid 'di ba tsam mo zhes/ /ma brtags nyams dga'i snang ba la/ /zab mo'i nges shes lhag par skye/19 /gnas 'di shes nas ji bzhin du/ /gang gi yid la nyams len pa/ /de la myang 'das mi ring ste/ /srid rtsa'i dngos gnyen lhag phyir ro/20 /cung zad spros kyang bdag spob mod/ /gzhung mang dogs nas ha cang bsdus/ /sgo druka tshul la 'jug pa'i gtam/ /'di ni 'jigs med gzhon nus bris/21/byis pa rang lo bco brgyad pas/ /zab don shesabyupa dka' mod kyi/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i bka' drin las/ /gzhung lugs 'di ni 'dir byas so/22 /dge des gzhan la phan 'byung zhing / /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /༄༅/ /sgo drug gi don rnam par phye ba la/ klad dang / gzhung dang / mjug gi don dang gsum las/ dang po la mchod brjod dang / dam bca' gnyis/ dang po gang gi sogs/ gnyis pa sgo drug sogs/ gzhung la 286

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7sgo drug dngos dang /de bsgom pa'i yon tan gnyis/dang po la drug las/a'i sgo bshad pa la/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po a ni sogs/ gnyis pa la bdag skye gzhan skye gnyis skye rgyu med las skye ba dgag pa/ mtha' gzhan pa'i skye ba dgag pa ste lnga las/ dang po bdag las sogs/ gnyis pa gzhan las sogs/ gsum pa gnyis las sogs/bzhi pa rgyu med sogs/ lnga pa de dag sogs/ ra'i sgo bshad pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ dang po ra ni sogs/ gnyis pa la/ chags pa rang nyid dgag pa dang / spang gnyen dgag pa dang / chags pa bden med du bstan pa dngos dang gsum/ dang po chags zin sogs/ gnyis pa yang dag sogs/ gsum pa chags pa sogs/ pa'i sgo bshad pa la/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po pa ni sogs/ gnyis pa la/ don dam nyid sgrub pa dang / de'ang blos bzhag par bstan pa dang / rang gi ngo bos stong par bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po snang 'di sogs/ gnyis pa stong ba'ang sogs/ gsum pa yang dag sogs/ tsa'i sgo bshad pa la/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po tsa ni sogs/gnyis pa la shi ba ngos bzang ba dang / srog ༄ dbang don dam par dgag pa dang / de ma grub pas srog 'gag pa ma grub pa dang / shi ba dngos med tha snyad du'ang med par bstan pa dang kasum/ dang po srog 'gag sogs/ gnyis pa ci ste sogs/ gsum pa gang la sogs/ bzhi ba ris mthun sogs/ na'i sgo bshad pa la/ bstan bshad 287

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mnaganyis/ dang po na ni sogs/ gnyis pa la/ ming don gcig tha dad du ma grub par bstan pa dang / ming don rtog btags su bstan pa/ ming don gyi chos nyid bstan pa dang gsum dang po ming dang sogs/ gnyis pa brjod 'dod sogs/ gsum pa rtog btags sogs/ dhī'i sgo bshad pa la/mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po dhī ni sogs/ gnyis pa la spyir bshad pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni chos rab sogs/ gnyis pa la ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang / ji snyed pa gzigs pa bstan pa gnyis/ dang po rdul med sogs/ gnyis pa 'on kyang sogs/gnyis pa de'i yon tan bshad pa/ gnas 'di sogs/ mjug gi don la rtsom pa po'i ming bstan pa/ rtsom pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa dang / dge ba bsngo ba/ brtsam pa'i gnas bstan pa ste gsum/ dang po cung zad soka/sa/gnyis pa/ byis pa sogs/ bzhi ba zhes pa'ang sogs so/ /zhes pa 'di yar lung pad+ma bkod rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro'i gling nas skad cig yid tsam la bris pa'o /༄/ /spyod 'jug dka' gnas gsal byed be+eḍūr+ya dbang po'i me long bzhugs/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mkhyen rab ni/ /zur phud lnga ba'i gzhon tshul gar gyis rnam rol ba/ /smra ba'i nyin byed 'jam mgon bla ma'i chu skyes zhabs/ /mi ldog mi phyed rtse gcig dang bas gtsug gis mchod/ /blo 288

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7haṃdhem/chog/ mnga' bas legs gsung don/ /kun gyi rtse mor son pa ni/ /rgyal slas yongs kyi sdom pa ste/ /de ston gzhung gi dka' 'grel bya/ de yang 'dir bshad bya'i don ni/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ rgyal slas thams cad kyi bsten bya/ dge legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/rin chen byang chub kyi sems brjod byar gyur ba'i bstan bcos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug 'di la le'u bcu yod pa las/ rtogs dka' ba'i gnas shes rab le'u'i skabs kun rdzob dang ni don dam ste/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis su 'dod/ /ces pa la/ bden gnyis kyi dbye sazhi ni/ rang bzhin med pa yin te/ 'jug pa las/ bden pa gnyis char du yang rang bzhin med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na sanyis las/ kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ blo'i yul du gyur ba'i chos gang zhig dpyad na rdzun pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'o/ /dbye na/ yang log gi kun rdzob gnyis te/ dbang po gnod med la snang ba yang dag kun rdzob dang / gnod pas dkrugs pa'i snang ba rab rib dang nam mkha' la skra shad 'dzag pa dang / dung ser bor snang ba la sogs pa los pa'o/ /de dag kyang 'jig rten shes ngo la ltos nas bzhag pa yin no//de dag la kun rdzob bden pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ /ji ltar sos ka'i nyi ma phyed dus na/ /skyes bu skom pas gdungs shing 'gro ba dag /smig rgyu dag la chu yi phung por mthong / /289

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhechos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes pa ltar/ /snang 'a/ rang bzhin ma grub pas kun rdzob/ blo 'khrul shes kyi ngor bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ blo las 'das pa'i chos/ nyid dmigs pa nye bar zhi ba'i rang bzhin no/ /dbye na/ phyi stong ba nyid dang / nang : phyi nang : stong pa nyid: chen poglo don dam paglo 'dus byas: 'dus ma byas: mtha' las 'das pa: thog mtha' med pa trīdor ba med pa: rang bzhin stong : chos thams cad: rang mtshan: mi dmigs pa: dngos med: ngo bo nyid: dngos med ngo bo nyid stong pa/ nyid de bco brgyad do/ /de rnams la don dam bden pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyi yum la bstod par/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gags nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'khrul ba'i yul las 'das pas so so rang rig pa'i ye shes dang yul yul can dbyer med par gyur ba la rtogs pa'i ming btags pa tsam ste/ dam pa rnams kyi gnyer bya'i don yin pa dang /lam 'bras kyi chos su mi bslu bas bden pa yin pa'i phyir/bden gnyis shes pa la dgos pa yod de/ ka ma shi las/ bden gnyis rnam dbye shes pa dag /thub pa'i bka' la mi rmongs te/ /de dag ma lus tshogs bsags nas/ /phun tshogs pha rol 'gro ba nyid/ /ces gsungs 290

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7pa'i phyir ro/ /yang nyan rang rnams kyi sa bdag med gnyis rdzogs par rtogs ma rtogs kyi gnas la/ spyir sa skya paṇa chen gyi gzhung lugs legs bshad sogs dang / rje tsong kha ba yab sras kyi gzhung lugs rnams las ni/ de dag gis bdag med gnyis rdzogs par rtogs dgos te/ de ltar min na de dag khams gsum du skye ba len par thal ba'i phyir te/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung gi lung don de ltar yin zhes gsungs/ kun mkhyen chos rje'i grub mtha' mdzod du ni/ de ltar ma gsungs te/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lung don 'god par mdzad la/ chen po bdun gyi che ba'ang de ltar na tshang gis/ gzhan du na ye shes chen po 'di la ci tsug smra// zhes bstan la/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod du ni/ lam sgom dus su'ang dbang po'i khyad par gyis bdag med gnyis sgom pa dang mi bsgom pa gnyis ka yod la/ 'bras bu thob dus kyang de ltar yod do zhes kasungs te/ 'dir gang bzhag na thams cad mkhyen pa dri med 'od zer gyi bzhed gzhung bzhin du rig par bya'o/ /yang / gzugs sogs mngon sum nyid kyang ni/ /grags pas yin gyi tshad mas min/ /zhes pa la/dar ṭika tu gsungs pa'i don ni/ nyan thos sde ba na re/ gzugs sogs bden grub yin te/ dbang po lnga la de ltar snang ba'i phyir/ zhes zer/ de la 'di skad ces/ tshur mthong gi dbang bo lnga chos can/ khyod grags pas grub pa'i kun rdzob la tshad mar song ba yin gyi de thams cad kyi de kho 291

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po〉shen nyid la tshad mar song ba ma yin par thal/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/mig dang rna ba sna yang tshad ma min/ /lce dang lus dang yid kyang tshad min te/ /gal te dbang po 'di dag tshad yin na/ /'phags pa'i lam/ gyis su la ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du tshur mthong gis rtosas na 'phags lam gyis dgos pa med par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs la/ mkhas pa chen po thogs med ni/ 'jig rten na de dag grags pa tsam yin gyi tshad mas ni ma grub bo/ /zhes legs par bstan to//yang / gal te don dam mya ngan 'das/ /'khor ba kun rdzob de lta na/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni 'khor 'gyur bas/ /byang chub spyod pas ci zhilga/ bya / /zhes pa la/ myang 'das la rang bzhin rnam dag dang glo bur rnam das si myang 'das gnyis phye ma nus na/ lan mi thebs pas/ 'di ltar 'gre9/ dgos te/ da lta sems can rnams kyang rang bzhin myang 'das yin te/de rnams don dam par bden med yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin par/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos rnams yod pa ma yin no/ /nge phyir stong nyid ma gtogs pa/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar yin kyang sgyu ma ltar 'gro ba rnams srid par 'khor ba yang / mdo las/ /srid pa'i 'gro ba rmi lam bzhin du 'khor/ /zhes so/ /de'i gnas tshul mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/292

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khyephyin drug gi lam sgyu ma ltar nyams su blangs pas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs ldog tu bzlog ste/ sgyu ma lta bu'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur te/ dper na sgyu ma'i rta glang gi rang bzhin ma grub kyang de ltar snang ba de de'i rgyu rkyen rdzas sngags rgyun chad na de dag mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /gal te rang rig yod min na/ /rnam shes dran par ji ltar 'gyur/ /gzhan myong ba dang 'brel ba las/ /dran 'gyur byi ba'i dug bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ rje tsong kha ba yab sras ni/ spyir dpal ldan grags pa la sogs sems tsam pa rnams kyi lugs la/ gang zag gi rgyud kyi sngo 'dzin mig shes de'i yul sngon po nam bzung ba dang dus mnyam du/sngo 'dzin mig shes nyams su myong ba'i rang rig des kyang sngo 'dzin mig shes nyams su myong bar 'dod la/ de'i sgrub byed kyang / myong ba'i rtags su yul can dran la/ myong ba la rang myong gzhan myong gnyis las/ gzhan myong la gnyis te/ mig shes gnyis yod dam/ mig shes kyi skad cig dang pos yul sngon po bzung / de'i skad cig phyi mas de 'dzin nam/ dang po ltar na mdo las/ sems can rnams kyi rgyud ni re re ba'o/ /zhes kasungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa ltar na/ gang zag de'i mig shes skad cig snga mas sngon po mthong la/ skad cig phyi ma de long bar thal lo nge'i phyir de ni rang myong yin no/ /zhes bzhed/ de'i lan/ dpe'i sgo nas 'debs te/ dug can byi bas rmugs pa lta bu ni/ mig shes kyi sngon po 293

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trar+shabazung ba dang mtshungs par sbyor zhing / de'i tshe dug lus la zhugs pa rme/ tshor ba ni/ de'i tshe rang rig gis mig shes sogs nyams su myong ba ma tshor ba'i dpe yin la/ de 'brug sgras bslang ba ni rkyen gyis bskul ba'i dpe dang / gang gi tshe sngar byi ba'i dug zhugs par shes pa ni/ dran pa'i dper gsung / de ltar rang rig gis rna shes sogs 'dzin zhes blo rdzas/ tha dad yin na/ sngar bshad pa'i lugs dang 'gal lo/ /'on te shes nga/ ma yin te/ mi ldan pa'i 'du byed yin no zhe na/ 'o na de'i rang yul 'dzin mi nus par thal/ de ldan min 'du byed yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rna shes rang gis rang myong bar 'dod dgos pas/ 'di lta ste/ rang rig med na bdag nyid ni rna shes dran par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhe na/ ma yin te/ rang ma myong yang dri sogs yul myong tshe yul shes 'brel ba las so// /de'i dpe ni/ byi ba'i dug bzhin no/ /yang grub mtha' ngan pa phyi rol ba'i lugs la/ spyir kun brtags kyi lta ba 'dzin pa sum brgya drug cu yod kyang / bsdu na rtag chad du lta ba gnyis su 'du zhing / dang po la'ang bzhi las/ dang po grangs can pa ni/ shes bya thams cad grangs nyer lngar smra bas na de skad du brjod de/ de'ang bdag ni/ 'jug pa las/ za bo rtag dngos byed po min pa'i bdag /yon tan bya med mu stegs rnams kyis brtags/ /zhes pa ltar chos lnga ldan yin no/ /gtso bo ni/ rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu byed pa/ bsam gtan grub pa'i mngon shes ma gtogs/ drang srong 294

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ser skya'i mig gis kyang mi mthong ba/ rdul mun snying stobs gsum cha mnyam pa'o/ /chen po'am blo zhes pa me long ngo gnyis pa lta bu/ phyi'i sgra sogs kyi rnam 'gyar dang nang skyes bu'i gzags brnyan 'char ba'o /zurag ra༄ zungag ri sna ri'i zurag 15ri ri snang rgyal na/ rnam 'gyur/ snyang stabs/ mun pa can gya nga rgyal ta gsum ma//dang po las/ de tsam lnga 'byung ngo / /de las ni 'byung lnga 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa las/ ngag dang / lag pa dang / rkang ba dang / 'phongs dang /'dom ste lus dbang lnga dang / mig rna/ sna/ lce/ pags pa'i dbang po ste blo dbang lnga dang / yid dbang rnams 'byung / gsum pas ni de dag gi grogs byed do/ /de rnams kyang mu bzhir 'du ste/ ji skad du/ gtso bo byed yin bya ba min/ /chen po sogs bdun bya ba byed/ /bcu drug po ni bya ba yin/ /skyes bu bya min byed pa min/ /zhes pa ltar yin te go sla/ yang nyer gsum kun rdzob dang / gtso bdag gnyis don dam du 'dod do/ /de dag shes pas grol bar smra ste/ ral ba'am spyi bo'i cod pan sogs/ /cha lugs gang gis gnas kyang rung / /de tsam nyi shu lnga shes na/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces so/ /de ltar rtogs nas lam bsgom pas mngon shes 'grub ste/ des gtso bo la bltas pas/ de skyengs nas rnam 'gyur rnams bsdus pa dang / skyes bu yan gar bar gnas pa la thar bar 'dod do/ /gnyis pa dbang phyug pa ni/ skye bo shes pa yod pa ma yin te/ bdag gi bde sdug bdag la rang dbang med/ /dbang phyug gis 295

rngo da/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+shabatang yang na g.yang sa'am/ /mtho ris dag tu 'gro ba kho nar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'gro ba'i bde sdug dang legs nyes bzang ngan thams cad dbang phyug gis byas par grags shing / de'ang / bram ze 'dod la bram ze dang / /rgyal rigs 'dod la rgyal rigs dang / /nor rnams 'dod la nor rnams kyi/ /mchod sbyin dam pa yang dag brtsam/ /zhes pa ltar/ mchod sbyin legs na mtho ris dang / nyes na ngan 'gror 'gro bar khas 'ches/ /don drug 'dod pa ni 'di'i lugs kyi grub mtha' ste/ dbu ma rgyan las/ /rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi/ /bye brag 'du ba rnam pa drug /ces so/ /de la rdzas ni/ bdag /dus/ phyogs/ yid/ nam mkha'/ sa chu me rlung ste dgu las/ rtag rdzas ni dang po lnga dang / mi rtag pa'i rdzas ni phyi ma bzhi yin no/ /yon tan ni/ sgra nam mkha'i yon tan/ dri sa'i/ro chu'i/ reg bya rlung gi/ kha dog me'i yon tan no/ /las ni lnga ste/ 'degs 'jog brkyang bskums 'gro ba'o/ /spyi ni chen po dang nyi tshe ba gnyis so/ /bye brag ni/ 'dre bar mi byed pa'i chos so/ /'du ba ni 'gogs pa'i sgo nas tha mi dad par gnas pa'o/ /khyab 'jug pa ni/ rig byed bzhi smra ste/ skye bo dga' bar byed pa snyan ngag /rang sde rgyal bar byed pa srid bsrung /'di phyi'i don 'grub par byed pa mchod sbyin/ mchog sgrub byed nges brjod rnams so/ /rgyal ba pa ni/ tshig gi don dgu 'dod de/ gang zhe na/srog dang / zag pa dang / sdom pa dang / nges par rga ba dang / 'chi ba 296

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7tradang / las dang / sdig pa dang / bsod nams dang / thar ba'o/ /'di dag ni/ shing sems can yin pa'i rtags su 'dab ma bcad na 'khum pa dang / lpags bshus na skam pa sogs dang / thar ba mdog dbyibs can yin par/ ji skad du/ kha ba rgya spos me tog dang / /ba zho ba mo mu tig mdog /gdugs dkar bzung ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ /thar ba yin par rgyal bas bshad/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phur bu pa ste/ 'dis ni tshe snga phyi med la chos thams cad rgyu med yin no/ /zhes 'dzer te/ 'di skad du/ pad+ma'i ge sar su yis byas/ /rma bya'i ri mo su yis bris/ /tsher ma rnon po su yis brdar/ /thams cad rgyu med ngo bos byung / /zhes so/ /de rnams la tarka sde lnga zhes bya'o/ /'gog tshul ni gzhung na gsal lo/ /yang dbu ma'i satan tshigs lnga ston te/ dang po gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs ni/ don du snang ba 'di chos can/ dngos po dang dngos med kyi mtha' dang bral te/ gcig dang du ma gang du'ang ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rdo rje ka/zegs ma'i gtan tshigs ni/ snang bzhin pa 'di dag chos can/ don dam par bden med yin par tha la/ bdag gzhan gang las kyang mi skye la rgyu med kyang ma yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod med skye 'gog ni/ snang ba'i dngos po 'di dag chos can/ rang bzhin dngos med yin par thal/ngo bo yod med gang du'ang ma grub cing skye ba dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa don byed 'gog pa ni/ shes byar snang tsam chos can/ dngos por 297

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stor+sham grub par thal/ don byed pa ma grub pa'i phyir/ lnga pa rten 'brel chen po ni/ snang tsam chos can/ rang bzhin med de/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir /zhes pa'o/ /de dag gi tshul zhib par ni gzhan las rtogs par bya'o/ /rgyal sras spyod pa phyin drug la/ /'jug pa'i thabs mchog ston byed pa'i//gzhung bzang nor bu'i do shal 'di/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i dgongs rgyan yin/ /de yi rtogs dka'i gnas 'ga' zhig /bsdus te ston pa'i 'bel gtam 'dir/ /tshong bar 'o ma 'tshong ba'i dper/ /gyur ba'i nongs tshogs mkhas la 'chags/ /de las thob pa'i rnam dkar yon tan bdud rtsi'i klung / /phan dang bde ba'i rlabs phreng 'bum du g.yo bzhin par/ /kun mkhyen ye shes chu yi phung por 'dres gyur te/ /don gnyis lhun grub yid bzhin dbang bo'i mdzod gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i dka' gnas gsal bar byed pa be+eḍūr+ya dbang po'i me long zhes bya ba ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa shākya'i rgyal bo'i bstan pa la mngon par dad pa'i gzhon nu 'jigs med pas cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar ngo in+d+ra war ma'i mchod pa'i dus chen la sbyar ba'o//༄/ /bde smon gzhung gi zin tho dum khrigs bzhugs/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde smon bshad pa'i zin bris 'thor bu 'god de/ thog mar e ma ho zhes pa'i skabs/ sems can tshad med pa mtha' dag gi don du dmigs pa dang / dus tshad med pa nam mkha' ji srid du go cha bgos pa dang / dam bca' tshad med pa sems can thams 298

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7tracad kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas ma smin pa smin pa dang / smin par grol bar bya'o zhes thugs bskyed pa ngo mtshar ba dang / de'i ched du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho'i sgo tshad med pa nas yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa'i brtson 'grus kyi 'jug pa ngo mtshar ba dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i zhing dang / yang dag par nges pa'i phung bo sha stag tu gyur ba'i 'khor dang / zhing tshad med par rgyas par 'geng ba'i grags pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi che ba mi zad pa'i 'bras bu yon tan ngo mtshar ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi rnam par thar ba mdor bstan pa'o/ /de nas gzhung don bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu bzhi'i skabs//sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / dge 'dun rjes su dran pa sgo ma pa gtso bor byas pa'i gdams ngag /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med sras dang bcas pa'i sku'i rnam pa la brten nas yang dang yang du yid la byas te gus pa bskyed pa ni/ de na bcom ldan sogs so/ /mos gus phyag la sogs kyi skabs/ gus pa zhes bya ba ni/ yon tan dang yon tan can la bkur ba'i ngo tsha shes pa yin la/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi bya ba dang bcas pas phyag 'tshal ba yin no/ /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas zhes pa la/ spyir chos sku la 'bras bu chos sku dang ye shes chos sku gnyis yod pa yin zhing / snga ma spyi dang / phyi ma de'i bye brag yin la/ 'dir bshad pa 'bras bu chos skur 'thad do/ /'bras 299ji

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mtshibu chos sku de la dbye na sku bzhi yod pa'i nang tshan 'di sprul sku ste/ nge sa pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku ni ma yin la/ gzugs sku ni yin pa'i phyir ro//nges pa lnga ldan min lugs ni dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid du bzhukas par ston pa'i gzugs sku min pa'i phyir te/ sku tshe'i tshad 'og tu bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag g.yas 'od zer las sprul sogs kyi skabs/ spyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpaka med kyi 'khor du bshad pa dang sprul bar bshad pa sogs bshad tshul du ma yod kyang / don la 'gal ba med do/ /sor phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs kyis sgyu ma sprul ba ni sems can mang po dag gis mi shes te/ sangs rgyas sgyu ma'i rgyal po'i sku che zhing / /de bzhin gshegs pa thabs kyi sku mnga' 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir te thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig nyid sku tha dad pa dang / gdung tha dad pa dang / mtshan tha dad du snang ba'i phyir ro/ /'di gzhan 'ga' la'ang mtshungs so/ /sto/nga gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams sogs skabs/ mgon po 'od dpag/ med kyi mtshan thos pa tsam la'ang bsod nams de tsam du 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mtshan de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam dang / tshul khrims dang / ting 'dzin dang / mngon par shes pa'i stobs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i mthu khyad par can du gyur ba'i phyir dang / de nyan pa 300 ji

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7tha'agyipos dad pa'i blos mnyan na ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba dang / kun slong gi dge ba dang / mtshungs ldan gyi dge bar yang 'gyur ba'i phyir ro//de kal te byang chub sems kyis zin na ni nyan rang gi dge ba thams cad zil gyis gnon to/ / mchod pa'i skabs/ lar mchod pa zhes bya ba ngo bo ma chags pa kun slong sems pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa lus ngag gi rnam rig dang bcas pa yin la/ ma chags pa'i bsam pa dge ba med bzhin du nor chen po phug tu sbas/ phran tshegs kyis mchod khral 'jal/ bzang po rang this spyad/ngan dgus dkon mchog gsum bslu rtsis byas pas mi yong ste/po to ba'i zhal nas/ spang spos sna tsha ting nge ba re thab tu 'debs nas/tsan dan a ka ru sogs sbyar ba'i spos/ zhes long bas mig ldan la rdzun katong ba mtshar zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /bshags pa'i skabs/ pha ma'i thog drangs zhes pa tshe 'di'i pha ma'i dbang du mdzad kyi/ pha mar gyur myong gi dbang du mdzad pa min te/yin na bdag sogs 'gro kun gyi zhes pa don med du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro//mi dge ba'i ngo bo ni/ ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med gnyis dang / de dang mtshungs par ldan pa dang / des kun nas bslang ba rnams yin la/ dbye na spyir rnam grangs tshad med kyang che long tsam bsdus nas mi dge ba bcur bshad do/ /de dag che long tsam yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lus ngag 301

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/d+kugi mi dge bdun gyi sbyor mjug sogs 'di dag tu ma bsdus pa'i phyir ro//'on kyang / mdzod las/ de las che long bsdus nas ni/ las kyi lam ni bcur gsungs so/ zhes pa ltar bcu bshad do/ /mtshams med lnga brtsi ba'i skabs/ pha bsad pa/ ma bsad pa/ slob dpon dgra bcom bsad pa ste gsum dang / rgyal ba'i ye shes chos sku la khrag byung ba dge 'dun 'khor lo'i dbyen dang / gzugs sku la khrag byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas spruzho pa'i sku la mtshon gyis rmas pa sogs te 'di ltar bzhag na rung gi gzhan du na gzhung lugs mang po dang mi 'grigs so/ /slob dpon dgra bcom pa zhes pa dgra bcom kyang yin la rang gi slob dpon yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa zhig dgos zer ba min gyi/ spyir dgra bcom rnan/sa chos kyi slob dpon yin pa la go rgyu yin/ de nas nye ba'i mtshams med brtsi ba ni/ dge slong dge tshul bsad dang zhes pa byang sems nges gnas dang / theg dman slob pa 'phags pa gnyis gang rung yin pa'i dge slong dge tshul la bya dgos kyi/ de lta min na lung dang 'gal lo / /dge slong dge tshul smos pa ni mtshon pa'i sgo tsam ste/ gong gi gnyis po gang rung zhig yin na rab byung min kyang 'di'i grangs su bsdu dgos so / /mtshon sgo tsam smos pas gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang zhar la go dgos pa yod de/ dper na 'phags pa zhi ba lhas/ /bsdus 'joms ris 'joms skra sa pa dag /sems kyi rma lta ci'i mi bsrungs/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /btsun rnga/ 302ji

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7tralkephub ces pa'ang / btsun ma tsam min gyi ma yang yin la dgra bcom ma yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa zhig sun byung ba de yin no/ /de nas sku sazugs mchod rten lha khang bshig pa sogs zhes pa ni/ mchod rten bshig pa phyogs mthun dang bcas pa'o/ /sogs kyi sgras dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo phrogs pa bstan to/ /khams gsum sems can bsad las sogs kyi skabs/ byang chub sems dpas khams gsum gyi sems can lam la ma zhugs pa rnams bsad kyang de'i dge rtsa 'chad pa dang / go cha gzhi na sa bgo ba mi dgos kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' la khros shing tshig brlang po brjod na byang chub sems dang yongs su bsngo bas zin kyang rung / ma zin kyang rung ste dge ba'i rtsa ba sngar bsags pa rnams 'joms shing / khro ba'i yul lung bstan thob pa zhig yin na khro ba pos rgo cha gzhi nas bgo dgos te/ sgo gnyis po de la dgongs so/ /dge ba'i phan yon sogs kyi skabs/ tshe snga phyi las rgyu 'bras sogs mi bden te med do snyam pa'i log lta de mtshams med pa'i las lnga bas kyang thu bar ba shad pa ni/ dge rtsa 'chad pa'i sgo nas yin gyi rnam smin gyi sgo nas mtshams med pa las thu ba tsam min no/ /thar med ces pa ni dman la dgag sgra sbyar nas bskal pa shin tu mang bor ngan song las mi thar ba la bya yi/ rigs gtan chad 'dod pa ni min no/ /ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa chen pos bshags zhes pa la/ ngo tsha ni bdag gam chos kyi 303

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /lo70dbang du byas nas sdig pa la 'dzem pa ste/ bdag 'phags pa rnams kyi rtags ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan can yin na/ bdag gis kha na ma tho ba bgyid du ga la rung snyam pa sogs/ las 'di ni dam pa'i chos dang 'gal te/ 'di 'dra dag byed na 'bras bu ngan song du mchi'o/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so snyam du sdig la 'dzem pa'o/ /'di'i 'jigs skrag ces pa ni/ khrel yod pa ste/ de 'jig rten gyi dbang du byas nas nyes pa la 'jigs pa'o zhes/ phung lnga'i rab byed kyi ṭika das tu bshad de/ don ni gang dag gis las 'di lta bu byas pa 'jig rten gyi skye bo ya rabs rnams kyis thos nas de la smad pa dang / 'phya bar byas pa ga ge mo zhig bdag gis shes te/ de bdag gis kyang 'di byas na gzhan dag gis smod par 'gyur ro snyam du skrag pa'o/ /gzhan yang skyes rabs las/ ma mthong bzhin du sdig pa byas na yang / /dug zos bzhin du bde bar ga la 'gyur/ /lha dang rnal 'byor can gyi mi dag si/sa//rnam dag mig gis mi mthong mi srid do/ /zhes pa ltar las 'di byas na 'phags pa rnams dang lha rnams kyis khrel du 'ong ngo snyam nas 'jigs shing skrag pa'am khrel yod yin no/ /'gyod pa la spyir dge mi dge lung ma bstan du ma yod kyang / 'di ni mi dge ba la ngan par byas pa'i dngos por shes te yid la bcag pa'i rnam pa de yin no/ /yi rang skabs/ de yi bsod nams mnyam du thob par gsungs/ /304

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7trazhes pa ni/ yi rang gi yul dang yi rang byed pa po gnyis rgyud tshod mtshungs pa'i dbang du mdzad la/ gzhan du na/ yi rang dang yi rang gi yul gnyis las yi rang bsod nams lhag pa byang chub sems dpas nyan rang gi dge ba la yi rang ba lta bu dang / yi rang gi yul gyi bsod nams lhag pa so so'i skye bos sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i dge tshogs la yi rang ba lta bu mang du yod do/ / gsol gdab skabs/ chos kyi 'khor lo la bzhed tshul mang yang 'dir mthong sgom mi slob lam rnams yin la/ de nyid de bzhin sashegs pas chos bstan pa la brten nas gdul bya'i rgyud la mngon du sna nga bar byas pa ni chos 'khor bskor ba yin la/ de don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa shugs drag tu skyed pa ni chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba' ma gsol ba gdab pa yin no/ /bzhugs gsol skabs/ lhag bcas kyi sa nas lhag med kyi dbyings su zhugs pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya/ lhag ma zhes bya ba ni/ nyer len gyi phung bo la gdags pa spyir btang yin zhing / sangs rgyas 'phags pa ni nyer len gyi phung bo mi mnga' mod kyi tshur mthong gi snang ngor skye ba dang / 'chi ba ltar ston pa'i tshul dbang btsan du byas nas/zhing 'ga' zhig tu gzugs sku'i rnam rol bsdus pa tsam la de skad ces btags la/ blo ldan rnams kyis sems can long ba 'dren pa med pa 305

la/sdojid/ 11 lngardo sdi/nga/ khur:drob/thab byasasprad rngakustagazug rta):rno bkabru/rngab khuradra/zug/ mnarnams kyi don du de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa yun ring du bzhugs par gsol ba gdab pa ste/ ngo bo ni 'dun pa yin no/ /bsngo ba khyad chos drug ldan ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsngo ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba/ bden med rtogs pas zin pa/ ngo bo 'dun pas bsdus pa/ dge ba gong 'phe'/ byed pa rnams so / /de nas bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu gsum pa bshad pa'i skabs/ byang chab mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i tshal bshad pa ni/ 'khor ba'i nyes rig mi rab midamigs smos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ jo bo bka' gdams pa'i man ngag tu/ 'o skol sems can ma bsgral ba bsgral lo zhes dam bca' ha cang ches te/rang nyid 'khor ba la gzhal yas khang du mthong ba 'di 'dras mi lto gsungs pa dang / yang skabs 'di nyid du mi rtag pa bsgom tshul bsta na pa'ang / dpe chos su/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don byed pa po de /blo sna thung spud de/ shes pa tsab ling ba zhig dgos gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de'i gnad ka ci yin na byang chub mchog gi sems skye ba la rtsa ba snying rje chen po yod dgos/ de rgyud la skye ba la sems can yid 'ong si rnam par 'char ba zhig dang de dag sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa can du shes pa gnyis gal che/ de las snga ma ni/ bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs kun/ /zhes pa'i skabs su bstan te/ bdag dang sems can 306

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7gzhan rnams kun/ /zhes ma gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan sems can gzhan/ thams cad thog ma med pa'i dus nas 'o skol la byams pa'i drin gyis 'brel ba ma thogs pa med do zhes tshig gi ro nus bton pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma ni/ thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /sogs kyis bstan te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar yun ring ba dang / 'khor ba'i bde ba la yid rton med pa dang / 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal dos drag pa la sogs pas bstan pa'o/ /des na 'chi ba mi rtag pa'ang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ston pa'i phyir yin no/ /de skabs/ sa cha yul ris khang khyim rnams/ sogs kyi skabs/ bden par ma grub shes par shog /zhes pa de ni rtog pas bzhag pa ma gtogs pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa med do sogs kyi don du mi bya ste/ de 'dra ni 'di'i skabs su ma babs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di ni dper na/ mi de'i gtam mi bden zer ba de gtam des phugs mi thub pa zhig la go rgyu yin pa ltar/ tshe 'di'i gnas khang yo byad 'khor 'bangs sogs ci tsam yod kyang 'chi dus rjes su mi 'brang ba'i phyir/ de dag gis ni mtha' mi thon no/ /zhes pa'i don du bshad dgos so/ /de man chad kyi 'bru non zhing bkod sogs ni go sla zhing / rgya cher dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdor blta dgos pas ma bris so/ /spos chu'i chu klung yan lag brgyad ldan mang / /zhes pa'i yan lag brgyad ni/ bsil ba/ 'jam pa/ ro zhim pa/ srang la gzhal na yang ba/307

sprusprodzad/ 17 jordo sdi/rngaku khur:jib/bzhi byaspurngasno nganabastazug rta):re ba/sdo/ngang 'o/dra/zug/ yanar〉rnyogs pa dwangs pa/ srog chags sogs kyi dri ma med pa/ 'thung na mgrin pa la byams pa/ lto ba la nad kyi rgyur mi 'gyur ba'i gnod pa med pa rnams so/ /rin chen sna bdun them skas zhes pa'i rin chen sna bdun ni/gser/ dngul/ shel/ mu tig dmar po/ baiḍūr+ya/ rdo'i snying bo/ spug rnams so/ /de'i 'og tu me tog pad+ma zhes pa 'di zlos par mi 'gyur ram/ me tog smos pas chog pa'i phyir zhe na/ me tog yin na pad+ma yin pas khyab pa med de/ ku mud bzhin no/ /de skad du spyod 'jug las/ me tog rna/n+da ra dang pad+ma dang / /zhes sogs bshad pa bzhin te/ pad+ma ni zla 'od kyis kha zum zhing nyi mas 'byed pa/ me tog gi nang na nyi 'od kyis zum nas zla bas 'byed pa'ang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la don chung yang blun po kha cig gis g.yar tsha ba'i rtsod pa de lta bu'ang bkod de/ de'i phyir yin no/ /mngon shes lnga dang spyan lnga kun la mnga'/ /zhes pa la/ mngon shes ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten pa'i mngon sum gyi blo ma 'khrul ba yin la/ dbye na drug ste/ nam mkhar 'gro ba sogs byed pa rdzu 'phral gyi mngon shes dang / thag ring thang gi sgra thos pa lha'i rna ba'i chorangami rig midang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs nye ring mthong zhing sems can gyi 'chi 'pho shes shing skye ba shes pa lha'i mig dang / tshe rabs snga ma mngon par dran pa sngon gnas rjes dran gyi dang / pha rol gyi sems shes 308

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7d+ku tra pa'i dang / rang gzhan gyi rgyud zag pa nyon mongs dang bral ma bral shes pa zag zad kyi ste drug go/ /de'ang nam mkhar 'gro ba kho rang rdzu 'phral gyi mngon shes min gyi/ de ltar nus pa'i blo gong smos de yin no/ /'di kazhan lnga la'ang sbyar ro/ /spyan lnga ni/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i ye thes kyi bye brag yin la/ dbye na lnga/ gzugs phra rags mang po shes pa sha'i dang / 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa lha'i dang / bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa shes rab kyi dang / rang gzhan dbang po rno rtul shes pa chos kyi dang / rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes kyi spyan no/ /de ltar rnam bzhag rags pa brjod nas/ da ni kun la mnga' zhes pa dpyad de/ mngon shes drug ga bde ba can pa rnams la yod de/ de ni kun shes pa'i dbang bo mthong ngam ma thob pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta na'ang 'dir bshad pa'i don ni dpyad par bya ba zhig ste/ kho bos ni rngo ma thogs so/ /spyan lnga yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ma gtogs med de/sangs rgyas 'phags pa khyad par byed pa'i chos thun mong ma yin pa ni sangs rgyas kyi spyan yin pa'i phyir te/ de yod phan chad sangs rgyas 'phag/sa pa kho na yin no/ /de nyid sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i smon 'a ma gyi mthu yin no zhes kyang mi rung ste/ de lta na zhing der byang sems 'phags pa gcig kyang med do zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /lung dang yang mi 'gal te/ 'od mdo las ni sangs rgyas spyan bsgrub pa'i pha rol du phyin 309

spubarngan/ 1) jordo sdispyirngaku 'o/:drob/thag byasarngasno ngas〉ltazud rta):re ba/sdosarngab khuradra/zug/ ra〉yanapa sha stag tu bshad do/ /'o na 'di la mkhas grub rā ga 'khrul lam zhe na ga la yin te/ 'di ni/ dper na rgyal bos sbyin par dam bcas shing /rgyal bo'i nor rang la thob nges pa de'i tshe rang la nor de thob bo zhes 'dzer te/ de nor thob pa dngos min kyang thob pa'am rnyed pa las mi ldog pas thob pa dang 'dra ba la bsam nas smra rung ba bzhin du/ zhi/nga de'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub las slar mi ldog pa sha stag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis byang chub chen po thob ma rag pa la dgongs pa ste/ thob pa dang 'dra ba'o/ /de man chad ni go sla'o/ /de ltar na/ 'di nas nyi ma nas ser ltem me zhes pa'i bar gyis zhing khams brten pa dang bcas pa yid la bya ba bstan zhing / mos gus phyag la sogs nas 'grub par shog bar gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa sgo du ma nas gsog tshul bstan la/ bdag dang bdag la nas smon lam btab bzhin 'grub par shog gi bar gyis byang chub du sems bskyed pa dang / dge ba ci bsags zhing khams sbyong ba'i rgyur bsngo ba gnyi sa mnyam du bshad pas/ gzhung 'di'i bstan don bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu bzhi yin no/ /de'ang bsngo ba ni/ dge rtsa blo yul du byas nas de nyid rang gis 'dod pa'i 'bras bu'i rgyur 'dun pas bsgyur ba la bya zhing /'dir dge rtsa la sngon du dmigs pa dngos su ma bshad mod/ 'on kyang 'dun pa de lta bus zin na bsngo bar 'gro'o/ /bde smon gzhung gi zin tho 310

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7zhelo〉'di'ang rje btsun bla ma dzñā na'i mtshan can gyi bzhed skongs su gzhon nu 'jigs med pas gang dran bris pa dge bar gyur cig/maṅga lam/ /༄༅/ /bde legs snang ba stong brdal bde chen zhing / /'phags tshogs rgya mtshor bcas pa'i snang brnyan gzugs/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i la/ma du bkod pa'i tshul/ rjod byed tshig phreng gsar ba bstar la rings/ /nge/ la zhing khams kyi dbus su byang chub kyi shing yal 'dab dang lo ma dang / 'bras bu dang me tog phun sum tshogs pa rin po che'i dril g.yer dang gser gyi skud pa'i 'phyang 'phrul can/ de'i drung na mgon po 'od dpag med seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon na sems dpa' mchog gnyis/ mdun ngos su byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong pags pa gser ltar dri ma med cing dul ba'i ngang tshul can shin tu mang po/ gtso bo'i mdun du rdzing bu dwangs la gsal ba'i nang na pad+ma'i sdong po kun nas mdzes pa'i steng mchod pa'i rdzas sna tshogs bkod pa gris na mdzes par snang / zhing gi mtha' skor du rin po che'i shing ljon pa rim gsum gyis bskor ba/ nags tshal gyi nang nas bzhal med khang phyed tsam snang ba dang / rdzogs par snang ba du ma'i nang na mal stan gya nom pa bsngas khra bo can bkram pa la byang chub sems dpa' mang po 'dug pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams ci rigs par khrus kyi rdzing bu me tog sgas khebs pa gang mang / me tog gi sbubs na byang chub sems dpa' 31 1

po/sprodzad/ 1) jordo sdospyong/ 'o/:drope/thag bya)rngasno ngape|stazug ༷):re ba/sdo/khung khu/dra/skya// lomistanananam〉brdzus te skye ba mang bo lag mthil nas mchod sprin 'byung bzhin snang ba/steng gi bar snang la bde bar gshegs pa'i zhing snang du mar byang chub sems dpa' mang po rdzu 'phrul gyis rgyu zhing lag mthil nas byung ba'i mchod sprin spro ba/ de'i steng gi nam mkhar sprin kha dog sna tshogs pa'i sbubs na mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang/rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dang / spos phor 'dzin pa dang / bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun sbreng ba sogs kyis mdzes par byas na legs par mngon lags/ badz+ra nā tha'i dgyes skong du/ gang dran ca le co ler bris/ /rnam dpyod zhib mos legs dpyad na//mdo sde'i dgongs par 'di nye'o//༄7//skal bzang skye dgu'i legs byas ras gzhi'i ngos/ /phul byung bde chen zhing gi ri mo'i dpal/ /smon lam pir gyis bris pa'i 'od mdzad lha/ /mtshan thos ngan 'gro'i 'jigs 'phrog de la 'dud/ /bde chen zhing thang 'dri tshul dbus su byang chub kyi shing dbyibs legs shing lo 'bras me tog gi mdog sna tshogs su bkra ba rin po che dang dril bu g.yer kha'i dra ba sogs rgyan sna tshogs 'phyang ba'i drung du gzhal med khang yangs shing bkod legs pa'i dbus na 'od dpag med mdzes/ shing brjid chags la zhi ba'i sku can seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa spyi 'gro ltar dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du sras kyi thu bo gnyis sku mdog dkar ngo/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis gtso bo la rnga yab dkar po g.yob cing g.yon 312

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7r+shapharasanyis pad+ma dkar po bsnam pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi pad+ma kha gyes pa dang / mthu chen thob kyi kha 'bus kyi rnam pa can/ phyi khyams rin po che'i ra ba nyams dga' ba'i nang 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang kun tu bzang po sogs byang sems 'khor sgyur chas can dang / gzhon nu rab byung gi cha byad ci rigs pa/ de'i phyi rol du gzhi mnyam zhing tha gru yangs pa'i ne'u sing mdangs dga' bar gser 'od dang ldan pa'i pad+ma chen po dag dang / 'khor lo dang nor bu dang rin po che'i mgul rgyan dang / rna cha gdu bu dkar po sogs lha dang mi'i yo byad mang pos sang ba'i mtha' khrus kyi rdzing bu rin po che'i so phag ka ba ka sgrog sgrom leb rnams ji ltar rigs pa'i ra ba can gyi nye 'dabs na byang sems khrus kyi rtse ba dang lha'i chu bya rtse 'jos rgyags pa dang / rdzing ra'i phyi nas spos kyi shing phran skyes pa'i bar bar na me tog gi sdong bo mang pos bskor ba/ de 'dra ba'i khrus kyi rdzing bu gnyis sam gsum bris pa dag na tsan+dan dang a ka ru la sogs pa'i ljon shing rigs mi gcig pa du mas khebs pa/ shing de dag las lha rdzas kyi gos dang rin po che'i do shal nyis sbrag sa dang chig rkyang la sogs pa'i rgyan gyi khyad par du ma 'phyang bas mdzes pa/ de dag rnams su rgyal ba'i sras po pad+ma las brdzus te 'byung ba dang / chos bgro ba dang bsam gtan byed pa sogs kyi rnam pa ma/nga nyung 'tsham par bkod/ sa gzhi phyi mtha' ri bo'i bkod pa brag 313

11rngad/ 1) lngardo /spyorngaku khur:drob/thag byaspurngasno ngas/lngacad rta):re ba/sdosarngardo 'o/sdo/zug/ 2〉dang nags tshal dang chu'i rgyan thogs pa bkod pa nang gseb la la nas rin po che'i khang bzang ba gam tsam mthong ba/ la la sgo khyim tsam mthong ba/ kha cig gzhal med khang ril gyis thon pa'i nadza na byang sems kha ton dang bsam gtan byed pa'i gzags ci mdzes sa bkod pa/ ri rirang raring bo'i bar nas lha'i chu bo me tog sil ma dang lhan cig 'bab pa/ chu bya'i phreng ba can bya/ steng phyogs kyi nam mkha' la byang chub sems dpa' lha dang dge slong gi cha byad can mang po rdzu 'phrul gyis phar 'gro ba dang tshur 'du zhing lag na me tog gi yol go thog pa'i nang nas ston pa 'od dpag med la lha'i me tog gi char pa 'bab pa dang / me tog de dag byang chub shing gi steng phyogs dang nye bar me tog gi gdugs su gyur pa'i rnam pa dang / gzhan yang gser dang dngul dang in+d+ra ni la'i snying bo can gyi sprin las me tog dang gdugs dang ba dan dang rnga yab pi wang nor bu rdza rnga la sogs pa longs spyod kyi char sna tshogs 'bab pa dang / gzhal med khang nam mkha' la rgyu ba rgyan dang bkod pa rgya chen po rnams su byang chub sems dpa' lha'i bu mo'i 'khor dang bcas te phyogs bcur rnam par blta zhing 'gro ba bris/ mthong bas yid la kun dga' rgyas byed cing / /brtags na mdo sder mthun pas mgu ba skye/ /bsam na sangs rgyas rjes dran 'phel byed pa'i/ /don ldan ri mo'i las 'di dge gyur cig /314

phunadze 〉dzaḥ〉zhe :spro//ste/(54 /11rnga///sa// 1rngos/rngan/ (lha/༄//'phags pa 'jam dpal dmar ser glegs ral/ phyag rdor sngo na po rdo rje/ byams pa dmar ser klu shing gi sdong bu bsnam pa thor chusas la gser gyi mchod rten can/ sa snying ser po me tog sngon po'i thod ching can/shing tog dang / pad+ma nor bus mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ sgrib sel dkar po bum pa bzang po dang / pad dkar zla bas mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ nam snying sngon po chos 'chad rgyas ut+pal ral gris mtshan pa 'dzin pa/kun bzang dmar po bum pa dang /pad dkar nyi mas mtshan pa bsnam pa'o// ༄//gu ru sirji'i rnam bshad ku mu da'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/dpal ldan bde ba chen po pad+ma baṃ bha ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//zang 'jug slob pa min pa'i ye shes sku/ /'chi med bde stong rol ba'i ru'adzum dkar can/ /mtsho skyes grub pa'i bla snang gsar ba zhig /longs spyod 'khor lo'i grong du ci dgar rtse/ /de la gsang sngags rgyal bo 'di 'chad pa'i tshul mang na'ang / da lta khyim bdag phyug po'i sgo nor yan chad kyi rim gror grwa phrug lcug ser gcu nus pa tsam nas kun gyis sngags kyi tshig 'di dag bzlas brjod la snyad btags pa'i 'ur zhog gi ham pa che drag na'ang don gyi 'gro phyogs tsam yang rngo ma thogs pa'i sanas skabs su snang bas/ de dag la gtam du bya ba'i tshig gi sbyor ba nyung la go bde zhing / grong mi'i tha snyad 'ba' zhig gis bshad par bya 315

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/〈mikhulagyib yin pas/ snga 'gyur rgyud sde'i pha rol du son pa'i mkhas grub chen po rnams dang / rtags gsal rtog ge'i tshig rkam la snying bor 'dzin pa'i gzhung lugs pa dag ni gtam 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya ma yin te/go rim bzhin du 'di tsam zhig la ltos 'cha' ba'i rnam dpyod phur khung thug pa min pa'i phyir dang / gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag bod kyi grong sngags ban min bon min pa rnams kyis rang bzo'i sngags log tu 'khrul ba mang ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na blo gros kyi mthu zhan pas don gyi sgrom rlabs chen rtogs par mi nus shing / sngags 'di kha ton du rno/sa pas byed pa'i gang zag shes rab chung ngu dag gis gtam 'di la snya/na dbang g.yar khral du mdzad na bkyal ka'i tshig 'di zhu'o/ /de la sngags 'di rgyal dbang pad+ma nyid kyi rnam par thar ba'i tshul dang lto sbyar te bshad na yid la 'char sla bas/ 'di la gnyis/ slob dpon chen po'i yon tan rjes su dran pa dang / 'dod don yid bzhin stsol bar gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /dang po la/ che ba'i yon tan dngos bshad pa dang /yon tan de ldan gu ru nyid kyi mtshan smos pa ste gnyis las/ dang ngo/ la'ang / spyir bsngags pa dang / bye brag tu gu ru rin po che'i rnam thar gtso bo'i tshul bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pa ste/ spyir sngags rnams kyi thog ma'i mgo 'dren gyi oṃ zhes pa rab bsngags dang dpal ster ba dang / g.yang 'phel ba la sogs pa mdor na bkra shis 316

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7pa'i don can yin par rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa nas bshad na'ang /'di'i skabs su ni oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum po rdo rje gsum gyi snying bo la bshad dgos pas/ oṃ gyi mtshan don ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku rdo rje ste/ lar sangs rgyas gzugs kyi sku thams cad kyang sku rdo rje yin mod/ gtso bor ni ye shes kyi rlung dbyings su 'khyil ba zhes bya ba/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rten dag pa rlung gi cha bde ba chen po gnyug ma'i sems dang ngo bo gcig pa de nyid stobs su gyur ba'am nar son te/sngags bla med thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs kyi lus phra rags gsum du phye ba'i rags pa phyi nang gi lus gnyis dang / phra ba'i lus kyi nang tshan sto nga ba gsum gyi bzhon pa'i rlung gi khams mtha' dag shin tu rnam par dag pa'i dbyings su rang zhi ba na gnyug ma'i rlung snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs pa la 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku zhes 'dogs pa yin la/ de nyid ni rang bzhin theg mchog rgyal bo'i lugs kyi sku rdo rje mthar thug pa'i 'jog tshul yin te/ bla med kyi rgyud gzhan na'ang tshe 'dir sgyu ma'i sku grub pa rnams tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba nges par gsungs shing / de'i tshe rags lus shul du bzhag ste snying ka'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba zhig 'tshang rgya ba min par ma zad bskyed rdzogs gang bsgom kyang rags pa'i lus dam tshig sems dpa' sprul sku lam byed du bsgom pa'i grub don lus rags pa'i rdzas rgyun kyang sangs 317

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phamirgyas sprul pa'i skur 'gyur bas/ de dang 'di gnyis phyogs mtshungs par shes par nus so/ /āḥyig gi mtshan don ni/ gsung rdo rje ste/ de'ang sgyu 'phrul las/ a ni stong dang mi stong gi/ /dbu ma'ang dmigs su yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skabs ltar spyir sangs rgyas kyi gsung rnam ji thams cad pa gdul bya'i mos pa dang bsam pa tha dad pa'i rjes su 'jug pa/ dbyangs kyi yan lag tshad med pa'i rang bzhin can mtha' dag gsung rdo rje yin mod de/ theg pa'i rgyal bo shin tu rnal 'byor gyi lugs thun mong ma yin par/ nges don mi 'gyur ba'i a yig rgyud gzhan du/ snying ka'i dbus na mi shig pa/ /gsal zhing mar me dag dang mtshungs/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu phra ba ste/ /a ni gtso bo dam pa'o/ /zhes rlung sems mi shiṭa pa'i ti la ka'i brdar a yig bshad pa dang don gcig par 'od gsal rdo rje rtse mo nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku brjod med rig stong gi thig le ste/ de nyid ni rjod byed rlung gi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gyi sgrar snang ba/ dbyings su brjod pa mtha' dag gi rten gzhir gyur ba'ang yin te/ zhib tu skye ba dang 'chi ba'i rim pa'i rlung thi skyed sdud la mkhas par byas na shes sla ba nyid do/ /hūṃ gi mtshan don ni /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rdo rje ste/ bshad ma thag pa'i 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid lhun grub phra ba'i rlung dang ro gcig tu gyur pa'i 'od gsal rang byung gi ye shes mthar thug gshis ji bzhin pa'i yin 318

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7zhelugs mngon du gyur pa dag pa rab kyi mthar phyin pas rtag tu skye med spros pa dang bral ba'i de kho na nyid du mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa'i rig stong ka nas dag pa la glo bur rnam dag gi yon tan yongs rdzogs su grub pa'am mngon du byas pa ni stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan rab 'byams dang mi phyed pas na rdo rje'i sgra zhugs pa'o/ /de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rdo rje gsum gyi yon tan ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag thams cad rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra'i gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du rtsal rdzogs pa yin no zhes bstan pa ste/ da dung spyir mdo sngags thun mong gi lugs/ bye brag gsang sngags bla med kyi lugs/ khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad gzhan lta ci smos te/ blun phrug bdag gcig pos bshad kyang glegs bam gyi phung po chen por 'gyur pa tsam yod kyang sngar bshad ltar btsun phrug nged rang gi na tshod du long ba rnams dang rgan po byis pa'i ngang tshul can rnams la lde mig tsam zhig bzhag pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ badz+ra gu ru zhes pa ste/ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i bla ma zhes bsgyur rgyu yin no/ /de'ang yab sras mjal ba las/ dpa' bo chen po thabs mkhas che/ /sems can yongs su smin mdzad phyir/ /bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal nga nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung yang ni 'dren pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas 319

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mang po ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba'i dbang po 'di nyid don du na bskal pa grangs kyis mi chod pa'i snga rol nas byang chub chen por yongs su grub zin pa yin na'ang / tshur mthong gi gdul bya'i snang ngor slob pa'i rig 'dzin 'chi med grub pa'i rnam rol gyis sin+dhu'i chu mtshor 'dab stong ge sar gyi sbubs su bltams pa la mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang chen zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa ste/ de'i rnam par thar ba brjod las 'das pa tsam yod mod kyi/ gtso bo ra gyur pa ni rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam nas mngon par byang chub pa 'di nyid yin te/ dang po yul o ṭi ya na'i rgyal bo spyan med 'byor ldan gyi dam pa'i rgyal thabs la dbang bsgyur ba'i gnas skabs nyid nas ji ltar dpal sa ra has sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud sde la bdag nyid dbang bsgyur ba ltar/ sngon yongs su sbyangs pa'i khyad par gyis tshe 'dir rang dbang du zab mo sngags kyi lam tshogs lam bskyed pa'i rim pa dang /sbyor lam rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rdzogs rim la sbyang ba phul du son te/ phyis su dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du bog 'byin brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas/ mda' bsnun zhabs kyis/ bro gar glu dang rol mo yis/ /phyogs rnams kun tu sgra sgrogs shing / /rnal 'byor ma ni g.yon nas bskor/ /dmigs gtad bral ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'bad pa med pa kun du spyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ zhing sngags lhan cig 320

〉 bying :spro////te/the pa/ /blo/mi/ba//lha/pa// skyi///sprerwaḥ/rī/ (74/skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs chen po dang lhan cig bde stong dga' chen rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyi rol mo cir yang spel ba'i mthu la brten nas/sngags bla med kyi sbyor lam chos mchog dka' ba med par mngon du mdzad de/ za hor rgyal bo gtsug lag 'dzin dang o rgyan rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti gnyis kyi khab tu gshegs pa'i tshe sku zhugs la bzhen par brtsam pa'i tshe/ tsan+dan til mar gyis sbags pa'i me lce'ang bsil ba'i chu klung du bsgyur te/ yid las byang ba'i me tog gi sdong bo la bsil bsil phram re// theg sprekhyo sa sna rtse:khro byedza ri'i phrum ltar bstan pa la gas pa bla mad kya sbyar lam sa ma ga grub pa'i lag rjes su byung ba ste/ phar phyin theg pa thun mong gi lugs la'ang srid pa tha ma ba ni bdag nyid kyis kyang mi 'chi la gzhan gyis kyang mi 'chi ba kho nar mngon pa 'og ma nas bshad na bla med kyi chos mchog rten der rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'pho med zung 'jug gi sku 'grub par nges pa rnams la phyi nang gi 'byung ba las gyur ba'i gnod pa mtha' dag gis mi tshugs pa lta ci smos/ de la sogs pa brtul zhugs rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pa byis pa'i blos gting dpag dka' ba rgya mtsho 'jings lta bus rang dang gzhan gyi don rlabs po che bsgrubs nas/ slar yang mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid la gnyis snang gi mtshan ma shin tu phra ba'ang nye bar zhi ba'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi shes rab zab mo gnyis ro gcig ngo bo dbyer med du gyur ba'i don 321

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ zhe r+shadam 'od gsal ba'i grub pa mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir/ bal yu/'a/ 5/nga le shod du tshogs kyi spyod pa'i nye rgyu yang bsten nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mngon du bsgrubs te/ lam mchog yongs su rdzosas/ pa'i tshe dbang rig 'dzin du grags pa sngags bla med kyi mthong lam thob pa yin te/ gsol 'debs rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub gnas der thob/ /ces gsungs shing / phyag rgya chen po'i mchog hi dngos tshob ni sngags bla med du lam de nyid kyi dbang du byar/ pa'i mthong lam yin par kun mkhyen rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas bshad do/ /de ltar mchog grub nas kyang ye shes chen po de nyid du rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthu las sgom spang gi dri ma snang gsum phra ba'i bag chags dang bcas pa rnam par bcom ste/ mi slob pa'i lam/ mthar phyin lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi sa la bzhugs shing / rnga yab spru'/ ba'i grong khyer du da lta'ang 'chi med g.yung drung lta bu'i gzugs skur lhun gyis grub cing / bod khams bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du 'khon 'jam dbyangs bdun rgyud dang / jo 'brom rnam gnyis/ bsil ljongs shing rta rnam gsum la sogs pa rdo rje'i bla ma sngags rigs grub pa'i ded dpon tshad med pa'i rnam rol rgyun mi chad pa yin no/ /mdor na bla ma'i skad dod gu ru ste/ gu ṇa zhes pa yon tan gyi skad dod dang / ru lci ba'i don can yin pas/ slob dpon chen po thugs yon tan gyis 322

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khyom〉kang zhing lci ba'i don no/ /de la rgyu gang gis lci/ thabs gang la brten nas lci/ lci bar byed pa'i yon tan ji lta bu zhig ce na/ badz+ra ste rdo rje'i sbo nas lci zhes pa'o/ /ji ltar na nyer len gyi rgyu kun rtog glo bur gyi dri ma cha dang bcas pas nam yang mi phyed pa'i phyir sems kyi rdo rje'am kanyug ma'i sems su grags pa 'od gsal gzhi grol chen po gzhi gzhon nu bum sku dang / lhan cig byed pa'i thabs/ gzhi'i yin lugs nang kasal phra ba'i ye shes dang rnam pa 'dra ba'i lam lhun grub snang stong du shar ba zab mo'i bskyed rim dang / khams gsum ye grol du rtogs pa mthar thug gi rdzogs rim khyad par can sogs las 'bras bu sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje gsum lam du byed pa'i phyir bla med rdo rje'i lam 'es bya'o/ /yon tan rang gi ngo bo ni/ gzhi rdo rje'i ye shes nyid rdo rje'i lam gyi thabs mkhas la brten nas yul 'od gsal rang rig pa'i chos nyid mtha' grol yangs pa chen po'i klong du/ yul can ni khyad chos drug tu son pa'i rdzogs pa chen po 'bras bu'i ye shes rnam par mi phyed pa lhun grub rdo rje'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i ngo bor smin pa de nyid do/ /zhes badz+ra gyi sgra'i bstan don no/ /gnyis pa ni/ pad+ma zhes pa ste/kasang ba bla na med pa'i ngo mtshar yon tan gyi bkod pa rgya mtsho de lta bu de gang la mnga' zhe na/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi dbang du byas nas/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa pad+ma zhes sku gsum gyi ston pa'i zhing khams 32 3

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༅shirab 'byams na mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid do/ /de la ci'i phyir pad+ma zhes mtshan btags pa yin zhe na/ pad+ma'i sbubs su brdzus te byung ba'i phyir 'byung khungs kyi sgra btags pa dang / pad+ma'i rigs de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi thugs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi cho 'phrul yin pas ngo bo las btags pa'am yang na rigs las btags pa dang / sha za 'bod sgrogs rgyal bo pad+ma bzhin/ /sa bcu pho nya'i lam gyis bgrod lags sam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje btsun rno/ pad+ma la bsten nas zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang grub pa'i longs spyod kyi gtso bo las btags pa dang / srid pa'i 'gro ba rnams su/ sgyu 'phrul gzugs sku'i rnam rol chu nang gi zla ba bzhin du ston kyang pad+ma 'dam gyis mi gos par 'dam na snang ba ltar chags pa'i 'ching ba las grol bas byed las kyi sgo nas btags pa ste/ dper na 'byung khungs las btags pa gser mngal can lta bu dang / rigs las/ btags pa lha chen po lta bu dang / longs spyod las btags pa me tos zas can lta bu dang / byed las kyi sgo nas btags pa pad+mo'i dgra lta bu'o//de'i phyir slob dpon chen po la pad+ma 'byung gnas/ pad+ma saṃ bha ba/ pad+ma skyes zhes pa la sogs pa mtshan du ma gsol ba ste/ 'di dag phal cher mtshan btags tshul dang po shas che yang / pad+ma zhes pa tsam la tshul ba'i ka yod do/ /longs spyod dang byed las kyi sgo nas grub pa mchog brnyes/ 324

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7pa thams cad kyang bshad ma thag pa 'dra ba sha stag yin pas de'i sgo nas pad+ma zhes 'dogs rgyu yin na 'phags bod kyi grub chen mtha' dag la pad+ma zhes 'dogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes blun dpyad ma bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod/ lag na rdo rje la sogs pa rnams la'ang snying rje chen po tshad med pa yod mod kyi/ de dag la rnam thar gyi sgo gzhan nas mtshan btags shing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la yon tan gyi sgo de nyid nas mtshan btags pa bzhin no/ /yang gong gi longs spyod dang byed las de dag min pa'i slob dpon rin po che'i rnam par thar ba tshad med na pad+ma zhes yon tan gyi phyogs 'ga' zhig nas brtsam pa 'di ci ste gsungs zhe na/ lar gong gi longs spyod dang byed las de dag tu sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'du tshul yang rgya cher bsgrub tu yod mod/ der ma zad lar yon tan thams cad nas ming 'dogs dgos pa'i nges pa'ang med de/ 'jig rten gyi gtam rgyud du'ang khyab 'jug la lha ma yin 'khar ba bsad pa'i che ba ma yin pa de'i yon tan bgrang ba gzhan yang yod de/ de lta na'ang khyab 'jug 'khar ba'i dgra zer ba bzhin no/ khyab 'jug la 'khar ba'i dgra kho nar ma zad de/ ming gi sgo gzhan yang yod do zhe na/ slob dpon chen po la'ang mtshan brgyad/ 'phrul mtshan nyi shu la sogs pa mtshan gyi sgo tshad med pa yod de kha shags la don chung bar shes nas de tsam mo/ /gnyis 325

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa la/ 'dod pa'i don zhu ba dang / de bskul ba'i snying bo bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sid+dhi zhes pa ste/ bod skad du dngos grub kyi don to/ /de'ang dngos grub ni gnyis te/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bo/ /snga ma ni/ mchog dngos mthar thug mi slob pa'i ye shes dang / zung 'jug gi sku dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phrin las rnams yin la/ de dang tshul mthun pa'i rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i spang rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' dag la'ang mchog gi dngos grub ces bya ste/ rnam smin rig 'dzin sngags kyi so skye yin par rgyal dbang pad+ma las grol bzhed pas mchog gi dngos grub ces pa gong smos kyi phyag rgya chen po dngos grub thob pa nas 'jog rgyu kho na'ang min no/ /thun mong gi dngos grub ces pa grub pa brgyad/ las chen bcu gnyis la sogs pa bskyed rim pa dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnams la bya'o/ /de ltar na gan sa skabs su phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i brtul zhugs rab 'byams la mnga' dbang 'byor te sems can tshar gcod pa dang rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che sgrub par nus pa dang / mthar thug rika 'dzin rnam bzhi'i them skas la brten nas/ myur du mi slob pa'i zung 'jug khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang dka' ba med par 'grub pa de dag ni bdag gi 'dod pa'i don yin no zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ hūṃ zhes pa ste/ yi ge ha a ma gsum gyis mtshon pa'i rdo rje gsum ༄326

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7gyi dngos grub bskul ba'i sngags yin pa'am/ yang na hūṃ thugs rdo rje'i snying bo yin pas dngos grub stsol ba la thugs mngon du phyogs par bskul ba dang / dngos grub de'i bsgrub gzhi yang hūṃ yig gi mtshon don gdod nas rnam par grol ba'i gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i sgo gsum rang nyid kyi snying la gnas pa'i de kho na nyid bstan pa yin pas/ dngos grub kyi gtso bo mchog gi ye shes kyi nyer len rang la gnas pa dang / lhan cig byed rkyen gu ru rin po che'i thugs rje bskul ba dang / thun mong gi grub pa'i 'char gzhi dang mthun pa'i rkyen gnyis bstan pa ste/ mdor na dngos grub 'gugs pa dang / brtan par bya ba'i snying bo yin no/ /de dag gis sngags bla med kyi dbang thob la sngags kyi tshig 'di dag la dad pa brtan zhing blo gros dman pa rnams la don 'grel rags pa tsam zhig bstan pa yin la/ de tsam yang rtogs mi nus pa dag gis ni/sngags kyi don/ rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid dam/ rdo rje gsum gyi yon tan chen po tshad med pas lci zhing gang ba'i rgyal dbang pad+ma zhes bos nas bdag la dngos grub stsol/ zhes pa ste/ rdo rje gsum ni sku gsung thugs gsum yin la de gang gis bstan na oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra zhes pas bstamyo//yon tan gyis lci zhes pa/sku mtshan dpe/ gsung tshangs dbyangs/thugs rnam mkhyen gyis lci ba'i don te/ srang dang dngul gyis lci bas lci lugs min gyi/ sa lid dang ldan pa'i li lugs yin la de gang gis ston ri(5) ri rdzume327

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/na gu ṇa ru zhes pa bsdus te gu ru zhes gsungs pa 'dis bstan/ pad+ma ni slob dpon chen po'i mtshan yin pa go sla/ dngos grub zer rgyu de la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mang po yod kyang / deng sang gi mi bsam chung mo khab mig gang tshod dang bstun na/ rta khyog dang g.yag khyog mang ba/ be'u lug gi 'phel ka che ba/ nya shi god log mi 'ong ba sogs yin par 'dug /hūṃ zhes pa dang sirji dngos grub de stsol cig par bskul ba yin/ rgya cher na sngags kyi rgyal bo 'di lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang sbyar te bshad na shin tu legs mod kyi re zhig de tsam ste/ gang dran rtsam khug sprug pa ltar 'god pa gti thug gi las ka yin par thos so/ /dkor chog grwar shes nyul ba'i ban gzhon dang / /gto sgrub yung rdog btso 'dra'i bla sar tsho/ /sngags don 'di 'dra tsam yang mi mkhyen na/ /dad zas rnam smin bsam tshe mchi ma bku/ /zhes pa'ang gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med lhun grub rang byung gi dpal mo byang grol rnga yab gsar ba'i chun 'phyang can gyis brjod pa 'dis kyang der snang bya 'grub pa'i bla dwags can rnam par sdud pa la rang dbang 'byor ba'i rgyur gyur cig gu/ /༄/ /bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi mdo chings tshigs bcad du phab pa dad pa'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba/gang zhig shar bas thog med dus ring nas/ /bsags pa'i gti mug mun pa'i rdul dengs shing / /legs rgu'i yon tan chu gter rgyas 328

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7r+sharketramadzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen zla ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ 1 /rang byung mya ngan 'das pa'i dus 'og tu/ /sangs rgyas mngon sum blta bar mi spyod pa'i/ /sems can khams la rgyal ba nyid 'dra ba'i/ /rlabs chen phrin las mdzad 'dir su mi dad/2 /gang dag sangs rgyas chos nyid mi shes pa'i/ /skye bo de dag gzugs sku mthong ba las/ /gang zhig bla ma'i gdams ngag zab mo'i mthus/ /chos sku mthong ba de dag shin tu bsngags/3 /ji ltar me tog shing gi sa bon dag /gcig nas gcig brgyud rgyu yi rjes 'jug pa/ /de ltar bla ma'i man ngag gcig nas gcig/brgyud 'di thub dbang zhal gyi bdud rtsi lags/ 4 /de slad mang thos phyogs lhung bral ba dang / /rang bzo med par chos bzhin smra ba rnams/ /ston pas bskal pa bgrang du ma mchis par/ /dka' bas btsal ba'i chos mdzod 'di 'dzin yin/5 /slad ma'i dus kyi gdul bya la brtse nas//rgyal ba rnams kyis chos sku'i gter bzhag kyang / /mun pa'i lag khrid 'o nga ba mig 'byed pa/ /'di dag med na su zhig longs spyod 'gyur/6 /nyes spyod chen po'i rnam smin mi bzad pa'i/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar skye ba brgyar ngus kyang / /sun med byis pa sbrul dang rtse ba bzhin/ /da dung sdig pa'i rdzab la dga' ba dag7/'di ni khyed la gcig tu phan pa dang //'di ni rnam kun zhi ba'i sgo yin zhes/ /gdams pa'i dus ston nyin bzhin 'byung ba yis/ /gtan bde'i sa la rkang ba drang mdzad pa/8 /de ci2ci
