phu 21rngad/ 11 lngardo /spyingagu 'o/:drotha/thag byaspurngasno ngape/sdizud rta):re ba//sbokhung khuradra/zug/ ra〉dag dka' ba rgya chen mdzad pa ste/ /gang dag bdag la bya dka' bgyid bgyid pa'i/ /sngon gyi mtshun dang pha ma nye du sogs/ /sus kyang 'di 'dra'i dka' ba bgyis pa med/ 9 /phan 'dogs zhing gi ngang tshul 'di 'dra 'di/ /bsam na de skyon mthong yang smad 'os ci/ /sems can sangs rgyas bsgyur ba'i bka' drin te/ /byang chub snying bo'i mthar yang gzhal sla min/ 10 /khyad par zab mo rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rgyud don gsa'/ bar lta ba'i mig gcig pu/ /grangs med rdo rje 'chang dbang ngo bo nyid//dkon mchog bzhi ba zhes su rgyud nas bsngags/11 /pi waṃ sbyor kun tshogs kyang rgyud med na/ /rol mo'i dgos pa mi nus de bzhin du/ /slo/ba dpon zhal nas dbang bskur ma thob pa'i/ /sgrub po de dag ci yang mi 'grub gsungs/12 /slob dpon mnyes pa rab 'bring tha ma yi rim pa ji bzhin dngos grub 'gugs pa'i stobs/ /mchog 'bring dman pa/'i khyad par du ma zhig /rgyud don rig pa'i mig sngar yang dag grub/ 13 /rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor spangs pa yi/ /tha mal rnam rtog rgyud la gnas nas su/ /dbang bzhi'i ye shes smin par mi nus zhes/ /rdo rje can gyis lan mang gsungs pa'i tshul/14 /rnam dag rigs pa'i lam nas yid ches na/ /gang gi sgo nas bla mar 'jog pa yi/ /sgo de bla ma sangs rgyas blta ba yi/ /dri ma med pa'i rgyu mtshan kho nar grub/15/til gyi bong bu gtams 'dra'i rgyal ba yang / /rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyi lus zhugs 330

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7nas/ /sngags pa'i tshogs gnyis rlabs chen rdzogs byed cing / /sngon bsags las sgrib mang po sbyong gsung dang / 16 /de phyir rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka /tha mal gzugs kyis dngos grub sbyin no zhes/ /bden pa'i zhal bzhes rgyud sde mang po ru/ /bka' bstsal de dag sgo 'di'i nges pa rnyed/17/ji ltar gdul bya 'dul ba'i dbang sna tshogs/ /bzung nas dkyil 'khor dbang phyug rang nyid kyang / /zhi dang khro bo bdud srin phra men sogs/ /rnam pa mang po'i thabs mkhas ston pa ltar/18 /chags dang khro dang shin tu 'gyed la sogs/ /bla ma'i mdzad spyod legs nyes cir snang yang / /de nyid rig pa rnams kyi sgyu ma 'di/ /bsam mi khyab phyir log par brtag nus min/ 19 /de phyir ci mdzad legs par mthong ba yi/ /mos gus lam gyi srog tu nges rnyed nas/ /bsam dang sbyor ba dag pas dus kun tu/ /dam pa'i bshes gnyen mnyes pa sgrub gyur cig20 /skad cig tsam yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /ma mnyes mi bgyid dka' ba brgya stong gis/ /bshes gnyen tshol la ngom pa mi mang 'a ba/ /rgyal sras mkhas pa nor bzang 'dra bar shog 21 /de mthus theg mchog spyi dang bye brag tu/ /zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i gnas rnams kun/ /dri med chos rab 'byed pa'i blo gros kyis/ /tshang la ma nor ji bzhin legs rnyed nas/22 /dam tshig sdom pa mig 'bras bzhin srung zhing / /zab cing rgya che'i lam rnams ma 'chol bar/ /nan tan snying po byed pa'i 331

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgrub pa yis/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin shog23/ces pa'ang chos grogs sdom brtson dam pa tshul khrims nor bu nas bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi ma/rdo chings tshigs bcad du phab pa zhig dgos zhes pa bskul ba ltar sprang smyon 'jigs med bsta na pa'i nyi mas shar mar sbyar ba maṅga lam/ /༄tsho/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i bde sdug dngos kun sems las byung / /'khrul dang grol ba gnyis char sems kyis byas/ /nge phyir rang sems 'dul ba'i man ngag la/ /gcigs su 'dzin pa 'dun ma'i 'gro phyogs bzang / /sems 'dul thabs mchog theg pa che chung dang / /theg chen mdo sngags gsang sngags phyi nang gi /lta sgom spyod pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas las/ /mthar thag snying bo rdo rje rtse mo yin/ /de yi ༄ gnad gsang rgya mtsho ltar zab cing / /mkha' ltar rgya che byis blos dpalga dka' yang / /'gag don sems dang rig pa shan phye ste/ /rig pa rkyang 'ded byed pa gcig pur 'dus/ /yul gyis ma gos sems kyis ma bcings shing / /dpyad 'jog thabs kyis gsar du byas min pa/ /spang blang bsal bzhag bral ba'i rang babs kyi/ /shes rig ma bcos thad kar skyong ba gces/ /gang ltar brtags kyang blo yi ri mo ste/ /ci tsam bcos kyang kun rtog spros pa'i gzeb/ /ngos bzung bsam yul las 'das rig pa'i gshis/ /gtad med ngang la 'dzin med lhag par zhoka/ /sna tshogs yul snang sgyu ma'i bslu brid dang / /bzang ngan phra rags rnam/ 332

mi bsta lhab///bye//the/spro/ /dro/lha/spro//lha/pa// /rngo/rgo2ཿtrī// (tāshā/rtog spre'u'i gar/ /ji ltar shar yang glang bo'i lta stangs kyis/ /bor te zang thal rig pa rang so bzung / /de la gad med g.yang med 'phrang dang bral/ /gol shor nor gsum zer ba tshig tu zad/ /rgya yan khyab kadal rig pa'i bde thang nas/ /sku lnga'i sa la mig 'phrul bzhin du sleb/ /chos 'di skal ldan spyi yi nor yin kyang / /lhag par mos gus dam tshig ldan pa dang / /blo brtan brtson 'grus can gyi nor yin phyir/ /brtson pas rtse gcig sgrub la snying stobs skyed/ ces pa'ang chos shul bla ma mthu dpal gyi ngor 'jigs med bstan nyis smras rim bzhin dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis bris pa dge/ /༄/ /bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi gyur thar lam bdud rtsi skyon med pa/ /rnam dag thos bsam sgom pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog /mtshan ldan dam pa'i zhal nas thos na yang / /don bzhin rang gi rgyud la sbyar ba nyung / /thos pas gzhung mang mtha' rgya gcod nus shing / /bshad pa tshig gi lo 'dab mang gyur kyang / /gnad don nyams len gcig la ma dril na/ /gdams ngag stong gi mdo don stor ba lags/ /'on kyang mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod btsun pa'i tshul/ /grub pa'i grags snyan khri dang bye ba brgya/ /dang po thos pa dam pa'i lag rjes su/ /'byung phyir thos pa nor bu'i gter mdzod yin/ /gang zhig shes na thog med dus ring nas/ /goms pa'i nyes spyod sgo mo bcad dka' ba/ /bag yod yon tan sta re rnon po yis/ /gcod pa'i yu ba mchog gcig thos 3 33

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lo74pa nyid/ /gang ma shes na sdug kun srid pa'i khams/ /'byung dang ldoka/ pa'i rnam dbye mi phyed pa/ /zab mo rten 'brel ston pa mcho ga gi gtam/ /mang thos skye bo mkhas pa'i spyod yul yin/ /gang la bslab na tshogs kyi tshogs nang du/ /rigs pa smra ba'i skal bzang sbyin byed pa/ /chos rab rnam 'byed blo gros dam pa'i skyes/ /thos mang dbyig brgya'i bang mdzod 'di las byung / /gang du sleb na phyin chad mi ldog pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa rims nad med pa'i gnas/ /ji bzhin brnyes nas de bzhin ston pa yang / /thos pa'i them skas btsugs na dka' ba med/ /gang ltar sbyangs na 'phags lam ma skyes par/ glo bur 'chi bdag zhags pa bskyang gyur kyang / /myur du gzhan dring mi 'jog rnam dpyod blos/ /rang 'bras lalge rtser sbyin pa thos pa'i drin/ /gang gi dgos pa tshe der ma grub kyang / /tshe rabs gzhan du rgyal mang bsnyen bkur te/ /rgyal gsung theg gsum bdud rtsi'i snod gyur pa/ /thub tshul thos pa mang na shin tu nye/ /gang du gces par brkyang ba'i lus dang srog /stobs 'byor khab rtse tsam yang mi 'brang ba'i/ /gdug pa gshin rje'i khrims rar song na yang / /thos pa'i dga' ston grib ma bzhin du 'ong / /kun gzigs stobs bcu'i nyi ma sangs rgyas kyang / /sde snod tshig re'i phyir du sku tshe brgya/ /btang ba'i nan tan goms pa lhur bzhes na/ /de sras mkhas pa'i tshogs lta smos ci 'tshal/ /'od byed sa mchog grub pa'i sems dpa' yang / /gsung rab 334

ma bye〉 :spro//////the pa/ /rdo/gh+ri:spro///spros// //sdos4ཿཿda/ (7)/tshigs bcad gcig phyir brtson mdzad na/ /gong ma'i sku skyes yin kyang mi 'ong gi /dang po thos pa dam pa'i zhal skyems bzhes/ /stong chen 'jig rten mes po tshangs pas kyang / /gdol spyod smyig ma mkhan las chos mnyan na/ /mthon po'i dpon bla yin yang ci lto ste/ /thos pa skye dgu'i gnyen 'dir spyi bos thad/ /chen por grags pa'i drang srong rgyas ༄pas kyang / /thub la nyi tsher gyur pa'i chos dris na/ /ston chen stobs 'byor dregs pa'i mi chog gis/ /thos pa yon tan tshogs mang 'dir zhugs shig /btsan yang sdig pa dpung dang bsdur rgyu med/ /phyug kyang thar ba nyo ru mi btub na/ /dregs ldan rgyal po yin yang mi 'ong gi/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos longs mtho yang thos pa gsug 'bul len med cing / /dma' yang thos pa brnyas thabs byed med de/ /dpa' bo gang zhig klog pa'i nan tan can/ /de dag snying la thos mang sog par 'gyur/ /skyob pa'i skyabs su thos pa 'jig rten mig /mthun pa'i yon tan nor brgya'i mchog ster zhing / /mi mthun nyes pa stong gi dgra gsod pa/ /'di la brten na dus kun bslu ba med/ /spyod pa'i khyad nor thos pa rin chen gter/ /rnam grol 'dod dgu'i dga' ston 'dis sbyin te/ /bskal mang goms pa'i mi shes dbul ba yang / /'di la brten na rtsa sbur me chen bzhin/ /mthun pa'i gnyen bshes thos pa legs dgu'i gnyen/ /ma 'dris mdza' bsheg gcig gyur 'di yin te//335

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgek+ṣe'abyor ba'i dus dang rgud pa'i dus kun tu/ /phan dang bde ba'i gzhi gyur 'di kho na/ /sngar zhig thos pa lung gi ba dan 'dis/ /yang dag ltar snang thang sha gcod mod de/ /da ni ston chen rta thog rnyed bkur 'dis/ /zog po grub brdzu'i dbu 'phang mtho ba lags/ /sngar zhig thos pa rigs pa'i ral gri 'di/ /chos min zhags pa gcod pa'i mtshon cha ste/ /da ni gzu lum bstan sel sde 'khrugs 'dis/ /chos min smra ba shed kyis bkur ba mang / /sngar zhig legs bshad thos pa'i me tog 'dis/ /blo gsal stong gi dus ston byas skad de/ /da ni thos sgog tshig gi sbun pa zhes/ /sgom chen stong gi rna ba rtag tu 'geb/ /sngar zhig thos pa nyams len gter mdzod de/ /dgra bcom khri phrag khri brgya'i gshegs shul nyid/ /da ni thos pa sgom gyi gshed ma ru/ /mthong ba'i rtogs ldan sa yi dreg pa tsam/ /'dod pa'i khol bo skyed ma bsad pa yang / /rgyal ba'i sde snod mang du thos pa las/ /mnar med dmyal bar dar gyi pho lung tsam/ /song nas 'chi med lha brgyas bsus zhes thos/ /chags sdang tsher ma'i dbal kyang mi chog pa'i/ /zab drags nyams len mthon po'i lta stangs 'di/ /bzhaka/ nas thos pa yon tan rin po che'i/ /gter mdzod dga' ba'i tshal 'dir zhugs na legs/ /thos pa bdud rtsi'i rdul mang rna ba ru/ /son pa'i bgo skal lag tu thob na yang / /thos don rang gi rgyud dang ma sbyar na/ /tshig tsam snying bor re ba byis pa yin/ /sngon du rang sems chos su 336

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ma sbyar na/ /leg sa bshad gzhan la 'chad pa ne tso'i kha/ /rigs lam stong gi rno so tshur bskor te/ /rtog ngan 'khrul ba'i dug ro khong nas thon//bshad pas kun rmongs nyes pa brgya sel zhing / /rtsod pas lta ba ngan pa'i lam 'gog la/ /brtsam pas legs lam stong gi dmigs phye bas/ /kun kyang rang sems 'dul ba'i grogs su 'gro/ /bshad na mi brjed dran pa'i gsal 'debs shing / /rtsod na rgyal ba'i lam la nges pa brtan/ /brtsam na shes rab zab mo'i bog 'don pa/ /dus rnams kun tu chos kyi dga' ba 'phel/ /rtogs don legs par 'doms pa'i bshad pa dang / /lam min thabs kyis 'gog pa'i brgal dang brtags/ /tshul gsum yon tan tshang ba'i rtsod pa gsum/ /rang don zhar la 'grub pa'i gzhan phan yin/ /gzhan du smra la dga' ba'i rtog ge ba/ /dam chos mar khu'i yang zhun btung nas slar/ /chos spang skyugs pa 'byin pa'i ngan spyod 'dis/ /thub bstan sha na'i gos bzang yongs mi mdzes/ /dpyad pas bsam byung nges pa 'dren mod kyi/ /zab mo go ba gnad du ma song na/ /shes 'chal rin gyis nyos pa yin mchi ste/ /bsams shing bsams na log pa'i lam du 'gro/ /bshad pas lung gi rgyal bstan 'dzin mod kyi/ /don du rang gi rgyud dang ma 'dres na/ /bshad tshad kha g.yang bos pa yin mchi ste/ /don med rnam g.yeng khol bor mi tshe zad/ /rtsod pas rigs lam gdar sha gcod mod kyi/ /rnam dag rton pa bzhi dang ma 'brel na/ /33 baji

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyal bstan dbyen la sbyar ba yin mchi ste/ /snying bo'i zab don mi shes lco ka'i kha/ /rtsom pas legs bshad goms pa skye mod kyi/ /thar lam bdud rtsi'i thig phreng mi 'chad na/ /rgya snag shog gu'i gron 'dzar yin mchi ste/ /snyan tshig phal cher byis pa 'drid pa'i ngag /de slad thub pa chen po'i mdo sde las/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa mang mthong bas/ /rgyal bstan snying bo sgrub pa'i yon tan du/ /mthong nas thos bsam sgom par dga' bas zhugs/ /de skad 'jigs med byis pa'i sprang smyon des/ /dbe mtshan pad+mo'i 'dab brgya 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /mdo smad zal mo sgang gi nye rgyud du/ /byung rgyal smyon pa'i gtam du sbyar ba yin/ /zhes pa'ang snga sor 'di dang phyogs mtshungs kyi tshigs bcad bcu lhag tsam bris pa las slar cung zad kha bskangs te bkod pa dge bar gyur cig/ /༄/ /nags kyi gtam pad+ma dkar po bzhugs/ mtshan dpe'i snye ma dar babs sku'i 'khri shing / /slob pa min pa'i ye shes 'bras bzang khur/ /'degs bzod rnam dkar rgya mtsho'i dpung ba can/ /mi 'dul shākya'i tog des rtag skyongs shig 1 /skyob pa mchog dang de sras bdag nyid ches/ /dben pa'i bsngags brjod me tog rgyan phreng gis/ /mdzes sdug snang ba 'bum sbyin zhi ba'i nags/ /gang na gtam gyi char zim 'di yang 'bab/ 2 /grong khyer chen po 'jigs byed ha la'i shing / /g.yo ba'i longs spyod 'bras bu g.yur za ba//'tsho byed 338ji

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7trazhe nags ma'i ljongs bzhin bsnyen bgyid pa'i/ /skye bo de dag bdag la rngam pa lags/3 /mdza' ba'i g.yar dam bcas pa mi 'gong pa'i/ /rkang sa/nyis grogs kyi 'du ba 'bum phrag brgya/ /sna tshogs las dbang btsan pos bdas bzhin du/ /lnga ba'i lam nas so sor gyes pa lags/ 4/rtsub rno/'i ngag tshig chu srin kum+bhi ras/ /bzung ba min pa'i gsang gtam gang gā'i rgyun/ /rna ba'i bcud du sbreng ba'i lha grogs kyang / /'chi byed gshed mar 'gro ba'i dus shig yod/ 5 /'byor ba'i nyin byed bkrag tu bltas pa'i tshe/ /mdza' gcugs me tog bzhad pa ches mang yang / /bkren phongs thun gsum rang zhal rngam pa na/ /nye du'i tha tshig zum pa bzhin du 'gyur/6 /brlang bo'i gtum tshig g.yab mo gcig gis kyang / /khro kanyer mi bzad phyogs kyi mgron po brgya/ /mkhur tshos lwa ba dmar po'i lding khang du/ /sdud pa'i grogs de bsnyen par dka' ba yin/7 /ser sna'i mdud pa shin tu gzhig dka' bas/ /'khyud bcing bdog pa'i 'byor ba lhun stug kyang / /rngam stabs be con gdeng ba'i bdud rgyal des/ /sgren mo kho nar shul ring lam du 'khrid/8 khang mig yid 'ong brtsegs pa'i tha gru'i khyon/ /sna tshogs rin chen dbyig brgyas lci byas shing / /lhab lhub dar gyi gos bzang rnam bkod kyang / /dus kyi zhags pas 'phrog pa 'ba' zhig 'gyur/ 9 /phrag dog smin ma g.yo ba'i sha ba ris/ /'byor dgu'i rwa dkar 'dreg la ches rngam ste/ /g.yo thabs me 339

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4044khyezhemada'i 'khrul 'khor lhur blangs pa/ /nor ldan sha ba rog po'i gtsuka tu 'bab/10 /dal ba min pa'i brtul zhugs brgya phrag gis/ /snyed dang bkur bsti'i khyad nor rab bsags shing / /grags pa'i dung chen srid pa'i khor bus kyang / /nam zhig snang ba med pa'i phyogs su 'gro/ 11 /'du 'dzi'i ltad mos dga' ba mi 'phel zhing / /rnam g.yeng bzhin ras 'god la mi phyogs par/ /sbyang ba'i yon tan me tog 'dun khang du/ /'jug la rings par rings par chas de mtshar/ 12 /sman gyi nags tshal ring nas bshams pa bzhin/ /rdo leb khri stan lag pas bkram/ ji/ bzhin/ /khu byug bu mos rgyang glus bsu ba bzhin/ /bsam gtan 'dod rnams da ni gshegs re ran/ 13 /dpya khral cod pan 'chang ba'i sa bdag dang / /gla rngan slong mor slong ba'i bran g.yog dang / /dga' gcugs zhags pa skyong ba'i mdza' bshes kyis/ /zhi ba'i nags 'dabs/ btang ba 'ba' zhig yin/ 1'ag /bsog bsrung spel ba'i cho gas ma brel zhing / /'khon zhen rtog pa'i khur chen ma bzung bar/ /dben pa'i nags rir ting 'dzin 'byor tshogs can/ /spong ba pa de bde zhing bange / ba lags/15 /lhun sdug ri bo lha yul ri 'dra bar/ /dus bzhi'i ri rmo/ bris pa ltar snang bas/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi'i thog mar mtshon bgyid de/ /thar 'dod rnams la dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ 16 /mtha' dang dbus med kun khyab gdal ba che/ /'gro 'ong mtshan ma gzhar yang 340

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7tshar dmigs min pa'i/ /dri med mkha' dbyings shin tu zhi ba 'dis/ /mya ngan 'das pa spros kun zhi bar ston/ 17 /spu sdug lha bya bya wang mgrin pa'i shing / khra glag drag shul dgra sta'i drungs phyung ste/ khrag gi skyang nul yang dang yang btab pas/ /srid khams sdug bsngal phung bo mtshon min nam/18 /nags kyi sman ljongs dwangs zhing gtsang ba'i ngogs/ /smig rgyu'i stod g.yoṭa bkab pa bzhin gyur ba'i/ /rten 'byung snang ba snang bzhin stong ngo zhes/ /rtogs par dka' ba'i chos tshul zab mo 'dom/19 /chos kyi sdom bzhi'i brda' thabs 'di 'dra ba/ /zhi ba'i nags su ltad mor bkram nas slar/ /bde ba'i tshogs chas bde ba mchog ster ba'i/ /rnal 'byor can la phu dud ri mor byed/20 /lcug ma'i phang phung rnam rgyal lha'i khanga'i bzang / /shing bal gzhon nu'i lhab lhub 'bum g.yo zhing / /ri skyes lha mo'i zlos gar rtsen pa na/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug lha dbang bzhin du brjid/ 21 /mar gad zhun mar bzhus 'dra'i nags 'dabs la/ /dri bzhon reg pa 'jam pos 'dzum byin pas/ /bsil bcud bdud rtsi'i bgo skal mchog sbyin te/ /rnga yab de 'dras bsam gtan 'dod rnams mdzes/ 22 /lhod lhod 'dab ma skyod pa'i rkang 'thung dbang / /'bol 'jam shing lo'i reg pa khrag khrig gis/ /gtsug phud yang dang yang du nyer byugs pas/ /bsam gtan sgom la dbugs 'byin byed pa bzhin/23 /sprin dkar kha yi zegs ma skyug pa'i chus/ /341

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma〉mo〉ljon pa'i nags tshal gdong ba bkrus nas slar/ /me tog ga shal lan brgyar 'dzum byas pas/ /nags kyi dbang phyug gzigs mos mnyes par byed/ 24 /dbang sngon nor bu'i mdangs 'dra bdud rtsi'i klung / /skom reg bdud rtsi'i gdung ba gzhil mkhas pas/ /nags kyi rnal 'byor 'tsho ba'i las byed de/ /dus rlabs phreng ba'i rnal 'byor can la 'dud/25 /'dab bzang ngang ba gzhon nu'i mgrin pa'i rnga/ /'gro 'ong dbugs kyi daṇ+ḍis bskul ba las/ /dbyangs ldan ngag gi sgra skad mi zad pa'i/ /spong ba'i las can snying la dga' ba 'phel/26 /bde ba'i rgyu tshogs de dang de 'dra ba/ /dben pa'i nags su rang bzhin lhun grub te//thar ba 'dod pa'i skal bzang skyes bu ni/ /nags kyi ljongs su bde ba mchog dang ldan/27 /nags ri'i yon tan dpag bsam dpal 'dra ba//bskal bar brjod kyang pha mtha' yas mod kyi/ /nyung ngu'i ngag 'di dben pa'i nags 'dabs la/ /spro ba'i yid kyis gang dran bris pa lags/ 28 /bsngags 'os bsngags brjod dri za'i rgyud mangs las/ /blang ba'i legs byas bsod nams sprin phung 'dis/ /phan dang bde ba'i char chen 'bum bsnyil bas/ /'jig rten gsum gyi tha gru shis gyur cig 29 /nags kyi gtam pad+ma dkar bo zhes bya ba sprang bo 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis/ /342

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khyotra༄/ /bden gnyis kyi rnam par bzhag pa don bzang me tog rgyas pa'i ljon shing bzhugs/ lha yi lha mchog 'jig rten 'dren pa shākya'i dbang / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ma pham pa/ /thub bstan 'dren pa'i shing rta chen po rnam gnyis sogs/ /bde gshegs slob mar bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig legs par shes gyur na/ /yon tan tshad med dang ldan pa'i/ /bden gnyis rnam par bzhag pa ni/ /shin tu bsdus te gsal bar bya/ /de la bden gnyis gtan la phab pa'i phan yon/ bden gnyis ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs/ bden gnyis kyi go rim/bden gnyis gtan la 'beb tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ gtan la phab pa la dgos pa yod de/ ka ma shi las/ bden gnyis rnam dbye shes pa dag /thub pa'i ba ka' la mi rmongs te/ /de dag ma lus tshogs bsags nas/ /phun tshogs pha rol 'gro ba nyid/ /ces bden ka/nyis shes pas ston pa'i gsung rab la rmongs pa med pa'i shes rab 'thob cing de la brten nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la 'gro bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ khyod ma shes pa la nyes skyon yod de/ dpal ldan zla bas/ kun rdzob bden pa thabs su gyur ba dang / /don dam bden pa thabs byung gyur ba ste/ /bden gnyis rnam 343

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhe d+kudabye gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni rnam rtog log pa'i lam ngan zhugs/ /zhes bden gnyis ma shes pas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la/ rmongs pa la sogs pa dang chabs cig tu gnas par gsungs pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ khyod la go rim yod de/ zhi ba lha sa//brtags pa'i dngos la ma reg par/ /de yi dngos med 'dzin ma yin / /zhes bya ba sogs gsung ba ltar kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan gzhi nges/ par byas rjes/ de nyid blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhaka tsam ma yin par yul rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdod lugs kyis grub pas stong ba'i don dam bden pa nges par byas te/ de'i rjes su/ kun rdzob bden pa nges dgos pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba la/ bden gnyis kyi dbye gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sgra don/ gcig tha dad brtags pa gtan la 'beb byed kyi rigs pa/ de ltar nyams su blang ba'i lag rjes/ kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ khyod la dbye gzhi yod de/ shes bya tsam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kun rdzob bden pa chos can/ khyod la mtshan nyid yod de/ tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad mas rnyed don gang zhig /tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad ma rang nyid la tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad mar song ba de yin pa'i phyir/ don dam bden pa chos can/khyod la mtshan nyid yod de/ mthar thug dpyod byed kyi tshad mas rnyed don gang zhig /mthar thug dpyod byed kyi tshad ma rang nyid la mthar 344

pha shāsta /spro///////35/ ///mi/rdo//lha/sa// /rdo/sa4ཿཿda/ 47skyu/thug dpyod byed kyi tshad mar song ba de yin pa'i phyir/ de yang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mthar thug dpyod byed kyi blo chos can/ tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad ma yin par thal/ a rnam mkho yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ a kyi kun rdzob bden pa gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par thal/ de tha snyad dpyod byed kyi blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na rigs so/ /de chos can/ a kun rdzob rang nyid la tha snyad dpyod byed kyi tshad mar song bar thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ a kyi gzhal bya kun rdzob bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub zer na/ de chos can/ der thal/ a tha snyad dpyod byed kyi blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na dam bca' snga ma dang 'gal lo/ /rgasam pa ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ khyod la dbye ba yod de/ kun rdzob ༄bden pa dang don dam bden pa gnyis po de yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ spyod 'jug las/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam ste/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis su 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po chos can/ a la dbye ba yod de/ yang log gi kun rdzob gnyis yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/der thal/ bden gnyis las/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i/ /kun rdzob kyi ni dbye ba byas/ /zhes rang snang ba'i blo la snang ba ltar don byed nus mi nus gnyis su gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chos can/ lo la dbye ba 345

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+shazheyod de/ stong nyid bcu drug dang de bsdu na bzhir gsungs pa'i phyir/bzhi ba ni/ kun rdzob bden pa chos can/ khyod la de skad brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gnas tshul dang snang tshul mi mthun pa'i bslu ba'i chos yin pa gang zhig ma rig pa'i blo ngor bden pas bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ don dam bden pa chos can/ khyod la de skad brjod pa'i gtan tshigs yod de/ dam pa zag med ye shes kyi rnyed don yin pa gang zhikamathar thug dpyod byed kyi blo ngor bden pa'i phyir/ lnga ba ni/ bden gnyis chos can/ khyod ngo bo gcig yin te/ dbyer med yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/ ldog pa tha dad yin te/ gnas tshul dang snang tshul mthun mi mthun sogs kyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ drug pa ni/ mkhas pa rnyo nga gi gtsug rgyan zhi ba 'jo'i bzhed pa ltar gyi gnad chen po bzhi las/dang po/ dgag bya'i snang tshul nges pa'i gnad ces bya ste/ blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag tsam ma yin par yul rang gi thun rno/nga ma yin pa'i sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa de yin la/ de ni de ltar 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin rang cag la snang ba nyid spang byar shes pa'am/ rig pa'i ched do/ /gnyis pa khyab pa nges pa'i gnad ces bya ste/ 'di ltar gzhi grub na cha bcas yin pas khyab pa gang zhig /chos gang yang rung ba bden grub zhig yod na/ de ltar na bden grub chos can/ ga'i grub yin par thal/ yod pa gang zhig yod na gzhi grub dgos pa'i phyir/346

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7trazhe gyernyazhe'adod na cha can ka ba dang de'i cha shas gnyis chos can/ bden grub yi na par thal/ chos thams cad bden par grub pa gang zhig ka ba chos yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ cha can ka ba dang de'i cha shas chos can/ a bden par grub pa'i gcig gam tha dad gang rung yin par thal/ de'i phyir/ de ltar shes pa gang yin pa'o/ /gsum pa gcig bral nges pa'i sand ces bya ste/ de yang 'di snyam du cha can dang cha shas gnyis bden sdub kyi gcig go zhes dam 'cha' ba/ bum pa dang de'i cha shas drug kyang der 'gyur bas/ de chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na bum pa chos can/ lo la drug yod par thal/ o kyi cha shas drug yod pa gang 'ig a dang de gnyis bden grub kyi gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ de yin na dbyer med kyi gcig yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ yang / bum pa'i cha ༅sa/ drug chos can/ gcig yin par thal/ bum pa gcig las med pa sang zhig a dang de gnyis bden grub kyi gcig yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi ji/ du bral nges pa'i gnad ces bya ste/ cha can dang cha shas bden par grub pa'i tha dad do zhes khas 'che na/ snam bu'i cha shas bsal shul na ni ma bu yod par thal/ de gnyis bden grub kyi tha dad yin pa'i phyir te/de yin na 'brel med tha dad yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ lug bsal shul na ra ston rung ba bzhin no/ /dang po 'dod na/ gzhi ma grub pa zhig khas len dgos la/ gnyis pa 'dod na/ bum pa sogs cha med du khas len 347

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skor+shatrakhyedagos shing / gsum pa 'dod na cha bcas ma yin pa'i gzhi grub 'is khas len dgos pas dam bca' thabs rdugs yin no/ /bdun pa ni/bden gnyis chos can/ khyod nyams su blang ba la dgos pa yod de/ dbu ma chen po'i don glu'i lam nas drang bar/ gzung 'dzin sna tshogs 'di a ma'i 'dzum bag /skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur 'di a ma'i rdzun tshig /ces ji/ ltar chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa la sogs pa dang ldan nga/'i phyir/ 'di ltar rtsom po'ang blo gros mthu/ /ches cher dman pas 'algal/ 'khrul dris/ /gos gyur nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ /'dir 'bad dge ba chu 'dzin gzhon nu'i dpa/la yon las/ /phan dang bde ba'i gru char chen po'i rgyun 'byung ste/ /ris med 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du rnam mkhren gyi/ /'bras bzang rdzogs nas don gnyis lhun grub 'byung bar shog /bden gnyis kyi rnam ji da bzhag pa don bzang me tog rgyas pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba rmongs pa'i blo mnga' byis pa 'jinus med pas o rgyan gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma saṃ bha bas byin gyis rlabs pa'i tshes bcu'i dus chen ngo ra sbya/ra ba rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ /༄/ /mchod pa'i gtam shin tu nyung ngu me tog gi sgrom zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam 'phrul mi zad pas/ /rgyal dang de sras dgyes/ ji/ skong mdzad pa//'jam dpal dpa' bo'i rnam thar rjes dran zhing / /sang 348

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lgem〉zhabs phyag gis mchod nas gtam 'di spro/ /de la 'di skad du/ blo ldan kang zhig 'phral dang yun du dge legs phun sum tshogs pa don du rganyer ba de dag gis ni yon gyi gnas chen po bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa rnam pa du mas bsti bstang du byas la bsod nams ches mang po bsags dgos pas 'dir de'i tshul nyung ngur bshad pa la/mchod pa'i zhing bstan pa/ mchod pa'i rdzas bshad pa/ mchod pa'i tshul brjod pa/ mchod pa'i phan yon smos pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/mchod pa zhes bya ba yon gyi gnas la yon stob pa yin zhing / yon gyi kanas su 'os pa dang mi 'os pa yon tan dang ldan pa dang mi ldan pas phye ste/ de'i phyir rgyal ba sras bcas ni yon yongs su sbyong ba ste/ sbyin bdag gis bsod nams kyi zhing du dmigs te phul ba don mthun du 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ de dag la yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod dang 'dra ba'i zhing dag ni/ /'jig rten gsum na ma mchis te/ khyod ni yon gnas rnams kyi mchog /gral gtsang mdzad pas gtsang ma lags/ /zhes gsungs/ de dag tshogs kyi zhing du spyan drangs pa bzhin du 'byon par yang nges te/ 'byon pa'i gegs med pa'i phyir ro/ /spyan drangs par mi mkhyen pa'am/ mkhyen kyang yon gnas la mi brtse ba'am/ mkhyen cing brtse bar gyur kyang 'byon pa'i mthu med pa rnams dang bral la/ mkhyen 349

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pha'ihaṃpa'i ye shes/ mi dmigs pa'i thugs rje/ thogs pa med pa'i mthu rlabs po mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dngos su bshamatra/ pa'i mchod rdzas rang gi lus dang longs spyod gya noms pa rnams dang / yid las byung ba'i lha'i me tog man+ta ra ba dang / pa ra shi ka dang / dong ka chen po dang /me tog sna ma la sogs pa dang / bdug spos dam pa glang bo'i snying bo/a/ ka ru nag po dang / tsan+dan sa mchog dang / tsan+dan sa steng dam pa 'a/ sogs pa dang / sgron ma 'bar ba nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu'i 'od zer can rnam pa du ma dag dang / rnga pa ṭa ha dang dung dkar dang / mkhar rnga dang gim pa la dang ( rgyud mang la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag n+da tshogasro pa nam mkha' rab 'byams kyi khyon rgyas par 'geng bar bsam/ de yang me tog gcig pu nyid kyang bla bre dang / rgyal mtshan dang / rkon sdi dang / sil mar bkram pa la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad mngon par 'phrul te rgyal ba rnams la mchod de/ dkon mchog ta la las/ me tos phal cher me tog bla bre dang / /me tog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye steme tog sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po de das rgyal ba mchod/ /ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ dngos bshams kyi mchod rdzas rnams kyang / log 'tshos sbags pa ma yin pa dang / ser sna dang brnyas thabs la sogs pa med pa/ gnas khang byi dor bya zhing chags chags gdab pa dang / yo byad la gtsang sbra 'don pa sngon du song nas/ spos 350

phangabasta ཿ///////the pa/ ///rdoḥspros//spros// /rdo//2ཿཿ// 174/dang mar me dang mchod chu sogs bkod pa bstar legs shing sems dwangs bar bshams dgos la/ de'ang rang gi longs spyod kyi mchog rnams phul dgos kyi/ rang la nyer mkho med cing rdzas rin thang chung ngu dngos po dman pa rnams mchod lo byed cing / chen po phug tu sbas pas mi yong / kun slong yang thar lam yang dag la gegs byed pa'i rang rgyud kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i phyir/ bsod nams gsog par 'dod pas zin pa zhig gal che/ khyad par theg chen pa rnams ni sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod kyi rnam pa can gyi sems rin po ches zin pa dang byang chub mchog tu bsngo ba'i rgyas thebs par bya ste/'jam dpal zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ mtshan rab sum cu rtsa gnyis brgyan pa'i sku/ /bde gshegs rgyal bar su dag 'dod pa ni/ /snying la rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems zhog ste/ /mchod pa'i phyir ni de yi thad du song / /zhes pa'i rkang pa gsum pas bstan pa ltar dang / bzhi ba ni/bdag nyid chen po snying rje dri ma med pa mnga' zhing tshogs gnyis phul du byung ba grub pa rnams ni/ sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po bsags pa/smon lam bla na med pa btab pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don 'ba' zhig la gzhol bar gyur pa ste/ de'i phyir de dag la ni gus pa'i yid kyis me tog gcig tsam zhig phal kyang rgya mtsho chen por cha thigs bzhag rari mi rigang pa bzhin du sbyin gnas rnams kyi thugs bskyed dang sbyin bdag gi dad 351

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yonapo〉pa'i dbang gis bskal pa khrag khrig mang por bsod nams kyi mthu 'phel bar 'gyur te/ mdo sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsngags pa las/gang dag ston pa bde gshegs la/ /mchod pa chung ngu byed pa yang / /lha mi'i bde ba kun bgrod nas/ /'chi med dam pa mchog thob 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i phyir legs par 'dod rnams tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /gtam 'di byis pa rang lo bco brgyad pa/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ngas/ /bco lnga'i dus tshes bzang bor bris pa ste/ /'dis kyang yid can kun la sman gyud cig dge'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o/ /༄༅/ /rmongs pa'i byis pa rlung bu'i dbang bo bzhin/ /zin pa'i dus med brel do'i rnam g.yeng ba/ /dal med so nam ngal bas bslus/ mthong nas/ /sos dal nags kyi nang na gnas par smon/ /ci tsam 'grogs kyang de tsam skyon 'go zhing / /chags sdang me yis rang gzhan sreg byed pa'i/ /byis pa'i grogs po'i rnam thar de shes nas/ /nyams dga' nags kyi nang na gnas par smon/ /bstod pas mod la khengs pa'i ru mtshon sgreng / /cung zad smad kyang khro ba'i me 'bar ba/ /gdul dka' sbyang dka' snyigs ma'i grogs mthong nas/ /dben pa'i gnas na gcig pur gnas par smon/ /bslang na mi ster yib na tshol du 'ong / /lan brgyar 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes nyid gyur kyang / /cung zad rkyen gyis dgra zlar gyur mthong ba'i/ /byis pa'i grogs po mthong nas dben 352

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7par spro/ /phan btags bye ba'ang gnod pa gcig gis 'joms/ /phan pa mi 'dren sdug bsngal yus chen 'dren/ /chos la mi dga' sdig pa'i phyogs la mos/ /byis pa'i grogs po mthong nas sems 'di skyo/ /lus la brjid med mgo na klad pa med/ /sangs rgyas las kyang g.yo zol mkhan por dad/ /mos gus mi ldan bla ma mkhyen zhes zer/ /byis pa'i grogs po mthong nas sems 'di skyo/ /chos las zog brin zas gcig mi za bar/ /ro mang myang nas slar la skyug par byed/ /gser snod thogs nas ngan skyug 'chag bgyid pa'i/ /byis pa'i grogs po mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /kha rog 'dug na chos gtam thongs zhes zer/ /chos gtam btang na mi 'dod rna ba 'geb//kha la nyi shar snying la char sprin gtibs//byis pa'i grogs po mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /nor sred btang na rang mdo shor zhes zer/ /bzod pa bsgom na nus pa med ces smra/ /lung gis phyug la kha bshad mkhas zhes sgrogs/ /byis pa'i grogs po mthong nas snying rlung ldang / /bshad pa yin zer kha lta 'ud gog 'thag /sgrub pa yin zer bug pa 'dag zhal byed/ /gzhan phan yin zer gsang sngags bon du gyer/ /byis pa'i grogs po mthong nas sems 'di skyo/ /so thar yin rlom khrims med rtags tsam 'dzin/ /byang sems yin lo byi la'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /gsang sngags yin skad tshangs spyod ring du spongs//snyigs ma'i skye bo mthong nas sems 'di skyo/ /kye ma kye ma lnga brgya tha ma'i 353

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trar+sha'agro/ /brgya phrag las nyon srad bus bcings mthong nas/ /bzod me/da snying rje'i gshog rlabs rab bskyod de/ /theg gsum chos kyi glu sgra sgro sa gyur cig /de skad dben par bskul ba'i gtam/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba'i shing rta 'di/ /dben pa'i gnas la rab dga' ba'i/ /byis pa rtsed rngo can gyis spel/ /dza yan+tu/ /༄༅/ /rten 'brel cha yi zla ba bzhin/ /rtogs nas gzhan 'a 'doms mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal de la phyag byas nas/ /rten 'brel snying bo'i brjod bya 'chad/ /de yang phar phyin theg pa'i skabs kyi dbu ma/ dang sbyar na/rnam shes/ ming gzugs/ skye mched/ reg pa/tshor ba/ skye ba/rga tri rnams 'du byed dang srid pa las byung la/ de dag ni ma rig pa dang sred len las byung / de gsum kyang yang rga shi la sogs pa las grub snya rgyu rgyas bsdus dang / 'bras bu rgyas bsdus kyi mtha' rtogs pa'i phyir dang rmongs pa dag bsal ba'i phyir bstan pa de dag gi tshul ni rgyu 'bras bur mi 'pho ba dang / rgyu med par ma yin zhing / rgyu 'bras ltos med kyi tha dad ma yin la/ rgyu chung ngu las kyang 'bras bu chen po 'byung ba ste/ sa bon dang myu gu la sogs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na gzhan ni rme/ rig pa la brten pas de nyid bcom na gzhan rnams kyang ldog la/ nge nyid ni rtog pa'i dbang las ma yin zhing / don dam pa'i rnam pa'i bdag nyid kyi blos dpyad pas rnyed par yod par 'dzin pa'i phyogs te/354

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7trade'i phyir gzhan rnams la bral ba thob par 'dod pas ni de 'gog pa rtog dang brtags pa'i dngos po ma lus pa bdag nyid kyi cha las btags pa dang / gzhan la ltos te 'jog pa nyid kyis gnas lugs su mred par 'jal ba yang dag pa'i blo'i rnal 'byor la bslabs pas/ngang tshul 'gal ba'i phyir 'di 'phel ba dang / cig shos 'grib pa 'thob ste/ des ni khyad par 'di'i bdag po rang bzhin ma skyes pa'i ngang du gyur pa ni thar ba ste/ de ltar bstan pa 'di ni dpyad pa gsum gyis nongs pa'i rnam dpyod can 'ug pa ba sogs la med kyi/ sngon zab cho/ bzod pa la gnas shing rang dang gzhan mnyam par shes pa'i brtse ba yo/ngas su rdzogs pa'i dbang gis thabs byung gi mdzad pa 'di brnyes pa'i sangs rgyas de bzhin nyid du gshegs pas rnam par bstan pa ste/ngage sbyong chen po de'i lugs su bzhag pa'ibyugatso bo ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go /sngags bla med kyi lam gyi gtso bo sogs dang sbyar na/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba ji snyed pa ni nang gi dngos po med pa las so/ /'di ni gnyug mar gyur ba'i lus kyis gzung zhing 'dzin to/ /byis pa rnams ris mthun du gnas pa nam ldog pa de'i tshe rlung gi khams ma lus pa der sdud cing / skye ba na phra ba'i khams de las sasum dang bzhi'i rim pas slar yang 'byung zhing rim pas rtog pa'i tshogs kyang rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de la bag chags kyi gnas ma brten du 355ji

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sku3sta〉zin na ni de ltar skye zhing 'byung ba med do/ /'di mngon par 'dod pas ni de'i rnam par gnas pa'am/ de nyid kyi grong khyer du yid gzhus pa bya ste/ de ltar byas na rang bzhin gyi sems de'i ngang du gyur te/ de ni 'gyur ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid las grol ba'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir brtan na cig shos 'grib pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bshad pa'i lung ni bdag nyid de bzhin du gshegs nas rdo rje bde ba chen po mchog gi gnas rnyed pa po don dam pa'i dge sbyong rdo rje 'dzin gyis nges par bstan pa'o/ /de dag bstan pa'i gzhung ni 'di yin te/ ye dharmā he tu sdi/ bha bā he turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba tad te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ /zhes pa'o/ /rten snying zab mo'i tshigs bcad pa/ /shin tu rgyas par gang bshad pa'i/ /bsod nams 'di yis 'jig rten 'di/ /'jam dpal khyod dang 'dra bar shog /ces pa'ang gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med pa sa spos thur sor mo bcu gnyis pa zhig zhugs kyis zin pa'i yun la gang dran bris pa dge bar gyur cig /)tsho/ /yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po don bzhin du gtam ston cing / chos bzhin du gdul bya skyong bas dge slong chos mri ba'o/ /zhes grags pa don dang ldan pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang bo'i zhabs kyi pad+mo rnyog pa med pa spyi bos lan brgyar blangs te/skal bzang gi skye bo rnams la sman par bya ba'i phyir dang / 'jig rten 356

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khyon chos kyi rnga bo che rdung zhing grags par bya ba'i phyir dang / rigs pa smra ba rnams la 'bel ba'i gtam gyis phu dud bya ba'i slad du deng tshul gnyis shing rta'i rnam par bzhag pa las 'phros pa'i ngag gi phreng ba zil ba'i thi gas pa tsam zhig spel ba la bdag spobs par bgyi'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na smra ba po gzhan gyis smra mi nus shing rtogs par mi nus pa'i chos zab mo phra ba gting dpag dka' ba sgro skur dang bral ba'i don legs par 'doms pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrog par mdzad de/ ji skad du/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid phra ba phra ba nyid dang / chos rten cing 'brel 'byung phra ba phra ba dag ston zhing khyu mchog glang po che'i gnas su zhal gyis 'ches so/ /de la ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid ston zhe na/ 'di ltar chos chos zhes bya ba ni khams bco brgyad po nyid de/ de rnams las khams bcu bdun lhag ma dang bcas pa ni 'dus byas zhes bya ba ste/ de dag kyang yod pa nyid du mi 'grub ste/ gzugs ni rdul 'dus pa tsam blo ni gsal zhing rig pa'i rgyun tsam yin la gang 'dus pa med na gzugs med/ gang gsal ba'i rgyun med na blo med par ni 'grub/ gang phyogs kyi cha ma dmigs pas rdul med/ gang skad cig ma'i 'gyur ba med pas blo ma mchis par yang grub bzhin du ci'i phyir rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i chos yod do/ /zhes smra/ 'on te ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed yod do zhe na/357

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhehaṃgazugs dang shes pa med na de'i gnas skabs yod du ga la rung /gnas skabs las gzhan pa'i ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyang mkhas pa su zhig smra bar nus/ 'on te chos kyi khams kyi phyogs gcig na 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnam par bzhag pa de nyid yod do zhes byar yang mi rung ste/ ci 'dus ma byas de rgyu rkyen la ltos te bzhag pa zhig yin na ni/ nge ci nas kyang ming gis btags pa dang / gzhan bkag pa la brten nas bzhag pa dang /rang gi ngo bo sgrub pa'i blos spros pa kho na las/rang si/ ngo bos grub pa ma yin te/ lcags kyu med la/ ci ste rgyu las ma bzhag /rkyen las ma btags pa zhig na ni/ shes bya'i khongs na mi gnas te/ skyes nga yang ma yin/ ma skyes pa'ang ma yin zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir chos gang yang yong ye ma mchis pa de la don dam pa'i bden pa zhes bla dwags su gdags mod kyi/ gang de nyid du'ang gnas pa 'ba' zhika/ 5 yin te/ stong ba nyid grub pa med pa'i gnas lugs la ltos nas ni nge la kun rdzob kyi bden pa zhes brdar bya ba la ci zhig rung / de lta bas na tshig dang yi ges brjod pas mi mtshon zhing / ngang gis mtshan ma'i rdu' shin tu zhi bar gyur ba 'di ni de kho na nyid yin no zhes de bzhin gshegs pa de skad du chos ston to/ /de la de bzhin gsheganu/ pa ji ltar chos rten cing 'brel 'byung ston zhe na 'di ltar chos gang yang rang gi ngo bos ma grub pa de nyid kyi phyir na rmi lam lta bu'i chos 'di snang du 358

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7rung ste/ 'dus byas kyi chos 'di dag kyang skad cig ma nyid kyi phyir rgyu rtag pa las 'byung ba ma yin/ rgyu 'bras nges pa nyid kyi phyir rgyu log pa las 'byung ba ma yin/ rnam par 'gyur ba nyid kyi phyir rgyu med par 'byung ba ma yin gyi rang gi dngos rgyu nus pa thogs med las 'byung ba yin la/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyang 'dus ma byas yin pa'i shes byar 'jig rten na grags pa bzhin du 'jog ste/ su zhig gis de ltar 'jog na/ 'das pa'i chos dang ma 'ongs pa'i chos dang da lta ba'i chos dang ma byas pa'i chos zhes kun tu tshad mar gyur ba'i blos 'jog go//de 'jog byed kyi tshad ma de'ang yul 'jal ba la mi bslu ba de'i phyir 'jog pas de 'jog pa'ang yul la ltos/ yul de nyid kyang 'dogs byed kyi tshad mas grub/ pa'i phyir de 'jog pa'ang tshad ma la ltos te/ de'i phyir ma brtags nyams dga' ma brtags nyams dga' zhes brjod do/ /dang po'i gnas tshal de lta ba yin mod kyi tha snyad pa'i blo gnod med ༄ ༄kyis kyang dmigs su mi rung ba'i chos rang mtshan du grub pa dus rtag tu yod do zhes log pa'i blos bzhag pa la goms pa'i dbang gis rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis rnams nye ba dang ring ba bzhin du 'di yod pas 'di 'byung zhes rnam par 'jog pas rgyu 'bras su gyur cing / zla ba dang bsil zer bzhin du 'di skyes pas 'di skyes te/ ma rig pa las 'du byed 'du byed las rnam shes rnam shes las ming gzugs/ ming 359

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tragazugs las skye mched skye mched las reg pa/ reg pa las tshor ba tshor ba las sred pa/sred pa las len pa/ len pa las srid pa/srid pa las skye ba/skye ba las rga shi rga shi las kyang ma rig pa sogs snga ma ji lta ba bzhin du ste/ de lta bu'i rim pas 'khor ba'i 'khor lo thog ma dang tha ma med par brgyud cing 'khyams pa'i sems can bde ba la 'dod cing don du gnyer ba bzhin du kha na ma tho ba'i phyogs shin tu lhur len pa sdug bsngal dang bral bar mos bzhin du srid pa bzlog byed kyi thabs la rmongs par gyur ba rnams kyi phyir phan pa mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas rnam par grol ba bla na med pa'i ye shes mngon du bya ba'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi brtul zhugs las slar mi ldog pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul skyon ma zhugs pa yin no zhes de bzhin gshegs pa de skad du chos ston to/ /gang yang kho bos 'a bel ba'i gtam de skad ces brjod pa 'di ni tshul gnyis zab mo'i gzhung yin no zhes ngo bo tsam du ni brtags par rigs so/ /phra mo ni 'khrul bar 'khum mod kyi gang zag chos kyi spyan ma zum pa de dag gis bzod par mdzod cig /zhes pa'ang chu rta hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin gzhon nu 'jigs med pas ja gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis kyi bar la myur bor bris pa'o/ /༄7/ /tshangs dbang khrag khrig bye ba'i do ker gyis/ /gang zhabs nor bu'i me long dwangs pa'i ngogs/ /phu dud ri mo'i snang bsnyan 'char 360

ma shāstad+ngha /spro//////ji pa/ ///tsho/spro//lha//// / /sa45ཿ// (74/byed pa'i/ /mgon po shākya'i tog des dge bar mdzod/ 1 /bde gshegs nyi ma 'bar ba'i snang ba yis/ dzam bu prik+ṣas mtshan pa'i grong khyer 'di//sum rtsen skyed mo'i tshal las dge byas pas/ /mi 'dul mchog de'i bka' drin slar yang dran/ 2 /snang nas snang bar 'gro ba'i them skas che//phul byang legs lam stong gi gdang bu can/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i lam rir 11re/ 1111zudag //dhe/bzang 'a ra 'dzegs nas/ /mabai ras grong khyer tsho gas rnams skal ba bzang / 3 /gang la brten na nyes pa'i dbul phongs che bsal mdzad dam chos ba mo 'dod 'jo ba/ /blang nas nges legs 'o ma'i dga' ston la/ /spyod pa'i skye bo de dag skal ba bzang /4/zhi bsil dam chos bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar can/ /gang gi yid mkhar lan cig shar bas kyang / /srid pa'i mun rum stug po mthar byed pa/ /de 'dzin blo gsal de dag skal ba bzang / /snying la dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'khyil zhing / 5 /lce las legs bshad snang ba 'bum 'jo la/ /rtag tu dam chos spyod pas mi ngal ba'i/ /blo bzang skye bo de dag skal ba bzang / 6 /rmad byung dge ba gsum ldan dam chos mchog /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yi tshul lugs can/ /snying la mdud rgya bzhin du dam 'chang ba/ /de dag rnams kyi skal ba smad ma 'gyur/ 7 /dam chos lha yi dga' tshal 'di spangs nas/ /snyigs spyod thal phung ngogs su 'gre ldog gar/ /g.yo bas mi ngoms skal ngan skye bo dag /o kyi khong na glo snying med dam ci/8 /tshangs spyod nor 361

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bu'i rgyan chas 'di spangs nas/ /bag med ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor gdengs pa'i rtser/ /dge ba'i srog rtsa 'dral ba'i mi gzhon la/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i snang ba 'char dus dkon/ 9 /skal ba bzang ngo dam pa'i lha grogs rnams/ /skal ba ngan no chos med sdig chen sde/ 'dun ma legs so chos bzhin spyod pa'i grogs/ /'dun lugs nyes so chos min sdig spyod tshogs/10 /zhes pa'ang sprang smyon 'jigs med pas so/ /dge'o/ /༄/ /gnyid thun gcig la nyes brgya'i rmi snang can/ /dus ring goms pa'i ma rig gnyid 'thug ni/ /lhag ma med par sad pa'i mkhyen rab spyan/ /mi zum 'jam mgon lha des shis pa stsol/ /spyir gsang sngags bla med kyi skabs su gnyid dge sbyor du 'gro lugs thun mong ma yin pa yod cing / phar phyin theg par yang gnyid dang lam gyi gzhi mthun 'byung ba yod mod kyi/ thabs mkhas dang bral ba'i gang zag gis gnyid la mang du bsten pa ni nyes dmigs che zhing sangs rgyas kyis ma gnang ba yin pas de dgag tshul mdor bsdus shig brjod par bya ste/de la gnyis/gnyid kyi skyon sems pa dang / bsam nas ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dpal shān+ta de bas/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni/ /sdus bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ /gru 'di phyi nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs pa ltar/ /da lta rang re rnams kyi sa rnyed pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten 'di 'dra ba ni rgyu dpe grangs gsum gang 362

zla bye〉 :spro///shā////pa/ ces/rdo/spros//spros// /rdo//4ཿཿni/ (tāshā/bi/ sgo nas bsam kyang rnyed par dka' zhing / lan cig rnyed pa'ang ring du mi gnas par 'jig pas sems shig yod na mgo la me shor ba phyir bzlog pa lta bu'i brtson 'grus drag po chos phyogs su myur bar rtsom dgos pa la/che'i phyed nyin mo dang / phyed mtshan mo yin cing / mtshan mo ril gnyid la 'dzad par ma zad/ nyin mo'i cha phal cher yang gnyid kyis gron song na/ de nas brtson 'grus rtsom pa mi yong la/ de'i ring la dge sbyor re nus na ba 'jos tsam gyis yun la byang chub kyi sems bsgom pas kyang sa chen po'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams kyi khe 'thob tshul mdo sde rnams las rgyas par gsungs pas/satan gyi 'dun ma dang / gnyid than gcig gi bde ba gnyis brje mi ༄rigs te/ lhag bsam bskul ba las/ shin tu gti mug lta ba mang po'i rgyu//don bzang dam chos yon tan chud gzon pa/ /gnyid 'di brtson 'grus 'phrog par rtogs gyur nas/ /mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa su der dga'/ /zhes so/ khyad par du byang sems kyi sdom pa len skabs mtha' yas pa'i sems can bla na med pa'i bde ba la 'god par khas blangs nas rtag tu gnyid dang snyom las kyi ngang la dus 'da' bar byed pa ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas khrel ba'i gnas su 'gyur te/ mdo sde rgyan sprus/ mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yi/ /sems dpa' mchog ni dal gyis 'gro mi mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /der ma zad chos 363

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ mngon par sems byung gi dbye ba dang byed las 'chad pa na gnyid bya ba 'chor ba'i las can du gsungs pa ltar/ 'phral gyi don dang bya ba phra mo rnams kyang gnyid la dga' ba'i dbang gis chag 'gro ba mngon sum gyis grub ste/ mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs thams cad brtson 'grus kyi rnam 'phrul yin par ston pa dang ston pa'i rgyakyil tshab kyis bshad cing / brtson 'grus kyi dgra gcika la gnyid 'di las thu ba med pas dus rgyun du 'di'i gzhan dbang la song na/ de las blo nyes pa dang / de las gyong sgo che ba gzhan med nga/ yin no/ /gzhan yang gnyid la goms shing gnyid kyis rang dbang med par byas pa'i mi ni dam pa'i chos gral du bsdad kyang chos thun ril bo rmugs thom me ba gcig la bskyal nas blo la zin rgyu'i don lta ci/ tshikas bcad gcig tsam yang med par ston mo chen mo'i nang du bgo skal chad pa bzhin stong hang nge langs te 'gro dgos pa dang / gsung rab kyi glegs bam rgyab khal non pa zhal phye nas mig bkra hrig hrig bltas kyang yid shes la gnyid 'thibs kyi rtsi zhugs nas don blo la nges rgyu ci yang med pas za ma lang tsho ma la bya ba byed mi nus pa lta bur 'gyur ba dang /don rnam par nges pa'i phyir bsam byung gi shes rab skyed par brtsams kyang yid gtad tsam nyid nas gnyid kyi mgo rtsom yong bas dpyad ji/ gting sleb pa thengs gcig kyang 'gror mi ster ba dang / ting nge 'dzin 364

khyo gtamatshogs/ pod/ 7kyisgribapalnga'iyagyalayinapasasgomabyangagishesarabadebasakyangaskyegli ༄ sa med pa dang / dus rgyun du gnyid kyi dbang gis shes pa'i 'phang smad cing / dran rig gi dbal bcag pas chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab ngang ngam shugs kyis zhan du 'gro zhing / dran pa shin tu bul ba dang /brjed nges pa mang du 'gro ba'i nyes dmigs dang ldan par lhag bsam bskul ba las/ gang zhig rmugs dang gnyid la dga' gyur ba/ /de yi shes rab shin tu nyam chung 'gyur/ /de yi blo yang yongs su nyams par 'gyur/ /ye shes las ni rtag tu de nyams 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gang zhig rmugs dang gnyid la dga' 'gyur ba/ /sems kyang rtul zhing de yi dran pa rmongs/ /lung nod kha ton byed la de mi gnas/ /chos smra na yang de ni rtag tu thogs/ /ces bka' ba.a+yo to/ /gnyid kyis shas cher non pa la mi ma yin gtum po dag gis kyang glags rnyed de mdangs 'phrogs par lhag bsam bskul ba dang spyod 'jug bsngo ler gsungs shing / shin tu thub par dka' ba'i dpa' bo'ang gnyid kyi glags la bltas nas dgra nyam chung gi lag tu song ba mthong chos su yang mang po 'dug pa dang /gnyid kyi tshod mi rigs pa tshe'i bar chad du 'gro bar lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu la sogs par yang bshad de/ de 'dra la dgongs nas kun ma.o dri med 'od zer gyis kyang / nyal zhing gnyid pas don rnams 'chor ba dang / bag zon med pas dgra rnams 'jug 365

21cad/ 11 lngardo /spyings 'o/:jib/bzhi byaspurngasno ngas/gzud rta):re ba//sbospyangakhuradra/zug/ miphu'ipa dang / 'dre rnams glags tshol nyes pa tshad med pas/ /don rnams 'byor slad brtson 'grus dpe med mdzod/ /ces ri bong gi rtogs brjod du gsungs so/ /sems kyi yon tan la gnod par ma zad lus kyi zungs yang gnyid 'dis 'phrog par byed de/ gnyid kyis nang gi me'i khams nyams par 'gyur bas kha zas legs par mi 'ju ba dang / za sa la yi ga 'chu ba dang / bad kan dang gcong chen dmu chu sogs nad mang bo 'jug pa dang / chos nyid kyis sha che zhing lhod pa dang / mdog mi sdug par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa sogs kyang gsungs te/ rgyas par bslab btus dang mdo blta bar bya'o/ /da lta gnyid che zhing spang bar dka' ba ni tshe snga ma la sbrul sogs su skyes nas gnyid dang de'i rgyu mun pa yid byed la mang du goms pa'i rgyu mthun yin par gdags pa'i bstan bcos las bshad pa ltar/ da lta gnyid la goms na tshe 'di la de 'dra'i nyes dmigs 'byang bar ma zad/ phyi ma la'ang de'i rgyu mthun bzlog/ raX/ra nyu11 la〉 sna thebs 4rwag 155dka' bas rtsal ca da phyungs nas dgag dgas / /gnyas pa na /brtson 'grus kyi phan yon sogs sems dang bar 'gyur ba'i dmigs/ pa yid la byed pa dang / snang ba'i mtshan ma yid byed la mang du gnas pa'i sgo nas gnyid mang ba'i 'gal zla sgrub pa dang / gnyid byung res kyis nyes dmigs mang du bsam la/ spyod 'jug las/ de bas pang du sbrul 'ong na/ /ji ltar rings bas ldang ba ltar/ /de bzhin gnyid dang 366

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7snyom 'ong na/ /myur du de dag bzlog par bya/ /zhes pa ltar bsgrim nas 'gogs shing phyis mi 'byung ba'i 'phen pa drag po bya ste/ de dag ni gnyid log ma byung gong dang / byung bar rtsom pa na ji ltar bya ba dang /byung ba 'gog pa la yang sbyar ro/ /de lta mod kyi gnyid byung tshabs che ba 'gog pa la ni/ langs nas phyogs bzhir 'chag pa dang / rgyu skar la lta ba dang / gdong la chu grang mo 'debs pa sogs spyod lam gyi sgo nas 'gog tshul nyan sa las gsungs pa rnams kyang bsten dgos shing /spyod 'jug le'u bdun par gsung ba'i 'chi ba sems tshul rnams kyang stobs che'o/ /zhes pa'ang dge sbyong dar lo nas bskul ba bzhin 'jigs med bstan nyis ska da cig la shar mar bris/ /dge'o/ / ༄7/ /gsang sngags kyi gzhung du 'dod pa'i yon tan rgyan du rol bar gsungs pa'i don cung zad bshad na/ deng sang gi sngags gzugs phal cher ni 'dod pa'i yul 'dod pa'i blo 'dod pa'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa gdod nas ma skyes pa nam mkha' lta bu yin pas 'dod yon la spyad kyang mi gos zhes zer mod/ de lta na sngags pa yin rung min rung chos thams cad rang bzhin bden med du mgo mtshungs pas sems can thams cad 'khrul kyang mi rigs la/ spyad yul dang spyod mkhan don dam du med pas tha snyad du med go chod na spyad ces pa'ang mi 'thad de ri bong gi rwas rus sbal gyi spu breg pa bzhin no/ /mi gos 367

21rngad/ 6) jordo sdi/ngape 'o/:drob/thag byaspurngasno rngaku/lngazud rta):re ba/sdosakhunga'o/dra/zug/ r+shar+shar〉zhes pa'ang khyod la mi 'thad de/ mi gos pa nyid kyang bden med yin pa'i phyir ro//des nakhyod rang gi tshig gis rang nyid brlag par zad do//lar gos dang mi gos 'khrul dang ma 'khrul thams cad kun rdzob ma/ brtags nyams dga'i ngor bzhag pa yin gyi don dam par bzhag pa lta ga la yin/ de'i phyir tshig ltar snang ba de 'dras rdo rje 'chang gi bla ma tshongs shig /'o na khyod cag ci tshug smra zhe na/ sngags pas ni sangs rgyas/ kyi sa'i gnas lus longs spyod lam du byed dgos pa yin pas/ 'di na ma dag pa'i chos zhig mi 'jog par snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su bltas te/ don dam rang bzhin rnam dag legs par rtogs shing / tha snyad du dag chen sku dang ye shes su rtogs pa'i phyag rgyas 'dod yon gyi snang ba kun la btab pas 'bras bu khyad par can 'byin zhing gnas/ ngan len mi skyed pa nyid de/ skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu 'o ma dang sbag pa las ro mngar bor 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /'o na gzugs sogs yul gyi snang ba la spyad pas mi 'ching ngam zhe na/rnam pa kun tu 'ching ba'ang ma yin la/thams cad du mi 'ching ba'ang ma yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan rnam pa kun tu gzugs snang bas 'khrul na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang srid par ltung bar thal la/ rnam pa kun tu gzugs la brten nas mi 'ching na gzugs rang bzhin gyis grub par zhen pa'i sems can kho bo lta bu'ang grol ba yin par thal lo/ /de'i phyir yul snang bden grub tu 368

〉 bye :spro//////the pa/ /bye/tsho/rdo///spros// /rdo/sa1ཿཿ// (tāshā/lta ba las chags sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs kyi tshogs 'byung zhing de las khams gsum du ltung ba yin gyi/ srid rtsa bden 'dzin gyi khams bdag med rtogs pas phyung ba rnams la yul gyis 'ching bar ga la 'gyar/ spyir 'bras bur gyar ba'i chos gang skye ba'i gegs med cing rgyu re/rdo༄ /re| /sde/ ni//re /de/ /)pe /drosto—gas kun tshang na — ba— dbang —da pa —na la/ rnal 'a—ra bas mchog gi ye shes skye ba'i gegs bdag tu sred pa 'gog pa'i thabs la blo'i rtsal sbyong zhing / mthun pa'i rkyen dag mnyam chen po'i dgongs pa dang ldan na 'di dag 'grub par mi 'gyur ba med do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gnas 'di gang zag chags can dbang bo rnon po rnams kyi phyir tshul zab mor bstan pa yin no/ /gnad 'di rgyas par de nyid grub pa las rig par bya'o/ /da ni drag po mngon spyod kyi sgrol ba la nyung ngu'i tshul du dpyad par bya ste/ 'di la'ang deng sang gi gto ba dang mthu mkhan phal cher ni 'di skad ces/ dgra bo rnams ni gsad par bya ba yin te/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la 'tshe ba'i phyir ro zhes zer zhing bdag dang bdag gi bshes la chags pa kho na snying la bcag ste/ dgra bo ga ge mos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig byang chub kyi sems bdag la bsgom du ma ster zhes ye shes kyi lha la rdzun lab par 'dug ste/ kho bo'i khyi khog tu dran tshod ltar na 'di 'dra ba rdo rje'i theg par ma tshud pa 'dra ste/ rdo rje'i theg pa zhes bya ba de theg pa chen po 369

11rngad/ 11 jordo sdispyings khur:zutha/thag byasputshosno ngasastagazu/ rta):re ba/sdosang( khuradra/zug/ 〈〉〈snazhig yin/ theg chen bya ba byang chub kyi sems kyis khyad par du byas nga 'i lam yin/ byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer la myong ba thon pa'i sems zhig yin/ de tsa na dgra bo la snying rje chen po'i blo rdul phran tsam yang med bzhin du/ khro ba dang 'tshig pa'i sems kyis srog gcod kyi sgyu thabs brtsam pa tsam zhis/ yin no/ /bdag nyid kyis thub pa'i bstan pa la bya ba byas pa yang med 'a /chi dge ba'i las lam gsang sngags su sgro 'dogs pa'i chos spong gi 'a sa tshabs po che la cang mi sems par/ dgra mtha chung 'ga' zhig la sda rnga ༄ sems kyis 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshigs so zhes smra ba dasob bro la/ byang chub kyi sems de'ang dgra gnyen thams cad la snyom par 'byung ba zhig dgos kyi/ sos dal du lhug lhug por nyal ba tsam byang chub kyi sems ga la yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa skul ba'i grokas la slar khro na khyod rang nyid dgrar gyur gyi kho ga la yin/ 'o na gter gzhung mang bor byang chub sems gnyis bsgom pa'i dgra ru lang / zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de ni dgra bo kho rang gi rgyud kyi zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs kyi tshogs kho rang gi rgyud kyi byang chub kyi semanu/ skye ba'i gegs su gyur ba'i phyir rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi thabanu mkhas phrin las chen po'i shugs kyis dgra bo'i nyon mongs pa thul cig /ces bskul ba yin pas 'gal ba lta ga la yod/'o na nyams pa can sgrol 370

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7haṃba'i thabs gtan nas mi rigs pa yin nam zhe na/ de ni ma yin te/sdig/ can tshe ring na yun ring bor log pa'i lam slob pa rnams la snying brtse ba mngon du bzhag ste/ don gyi sems lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer checi da rtogs pa dang / stong nyid kyi sems rngam pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin 'a gnas nas rnal 'byor pa'i tshe lung khrus kyi dgongs pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pas nyams pa can bsgral te sku bzhi'i nus pa rgyud la 'jog cing /mngon mtho dang nges par legs pa'i sa la dbugs 'byin pa zhig med par smra ba ni ma yin no/ /de'ang gdul bya'i rgyud kyi dge tshogs dus su smi na pa'am sad par byed la dgra bo'i sha khrag gis dgyes mnyam lha yi dkyil 'khor la tshogs mchod sprin gyi rol mor spel ba dang / chos nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang rten 'byung mthong ba'i bden pa rmad du byung ba dang / khrus lung gi dgongs pa zab mo la sogs pa thabs kyi sgo sna tshogs la brten pas/ nyi ma dang chu nang gi nyi gzugs bzhin du nyams pa can la byin rlabs kyi snang ba cir yang 'char ba ni rten cing 'brel 'byung gi mthu nus yin no/ /zhes pa'ang sprang smyon 'jigs med pas smyo gtam cal col du bris pa'o/ /༄tsho/ /na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra ye/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs 'gro ba'i mgon/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs rjes rab dgongs mdzad/ /371

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zheshigangs can bstan 'gro'i gtsug rgyan o rgyan rje/ /mi phyed sgo gsum gus 'dud spyi bos mchod/ /de la 'dir sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyis/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sbyin pa byas na/ sgyu ma lta bu'i tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin te /rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs la brten nas 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs tshegs chung la don che ba phan yon dang ldan pa dus dang rnam pa kun tu/ bsang / chu gtor/ gsur/ lus sbyin sosas sbyin pa rnam bzhi la rtag tu brtson par byed pa'i gang zag de nyid ni//tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag pa dang khyad par du yang tshe 'dir dam/ chos byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal zla mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nyi ma/ sprin las grol ba bzhin du nye bar zhi zhing mthar thug thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs pa chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par byed pa'i lam gyi cha lags su nye bar 'gyur ba yin pas 'di la 'bad par rigs so/ /thos mar bsang lta bu la mtshon na/ bsang rdzas de yang / rgyu bzang ba/ dngos / gtsang ba/ bkod legs pa zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu log 'tsho dang ser snas ma bslad pa zhig dgos pa yin te/ log pa'i 'tsho ba lnga dang / khyad par ser sna ni yi dwags su skye ba'i rgyu yin te/ mchod pa'i dngos po gang la yang rang gi sha la gcig gcod dgos pa lta bu'i ser sna dang bcas pas ni tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba ma yin pas legs par spang dgos/ dngos bzang ba ni rang gis gang za rgyu'i dngos po de las phud 372

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7haṃ dam gang bzang ba de mchod pa'i dngos po byed pa ma gtogs/ gang ngan pa dang / rul ba dang / kha ba/ nag dreg phog pa sogs rang gis bza' mi lom pa la mchod pa byed pa ni shin tu mi rung te/ rgyal ba rnams la bzang ngan dang gtsang sme sogs gnyis snang gi rtog pa mnga' ba ma yin te/ rang gi tshogs rdzogs par byed pas/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /zhe sa pa ltar kha gtsang lag gtsang byas te/ mchod pa'i dngos po de yang shin tu gtsang zhing dag par byed pa ni gnad do/ /bkod legs pa ni/ bsang mkhar sogs mchod stegs de yang rang gi 'u/sa ngal ba tsam la bsam nas ci nyan gang nyan zhig mi byed par ya yo 'khyag 'khyog dang bral ba/ dbyibs mdzes shing khod snyoms pa zhig byed pa ni gal che'o/ /lar bya ba gang la yang lus ngag yid gsum chig dril du ma byas na dgos don mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ 'dir yang yid la bsam rgyu ci yang med par shing kha shog lce tsam kho nas 'don zlos byas kyang rang ngal ba tsam las don 'bras chung bar 'dug pas bskyed rim zhig mi dgos pa'i cho ga zhig 'don rgyu gtan nas yod pa ma yin te/ 'dir yang skyed rim dang dmigs pa kho na la rag las pa yin pas de yang mdo hril gyis dril na/ thog mar skyabs dkon mchog gsum la yid o shes kyi dad pa brtan pos sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / rang gzhan sems can thams cad rdzogs byang thob 'dod kyi kun slong 373

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zheshibasam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang bcas te skyabs/ 'apro dang sems bskyed kyi tshig brjod/ 'di gnyis sngon du ma song na 'ben ma mthong bar mda' rgyag pa dang 'dra bar mtshungs pas skyabs sems gnyis sngon du 'gro bar byas la/ thog mar rang yi dam gyi lha gang rung zhig tu ma gsal bar mchod rdzas kyi dngos po de yang byin gyis rlob mi nus pa yin pas rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃḥ las yi ge ram̐ḥdamar nag gcig spros pa las bsang rdzas kyi dngos po de das bsreg yam̐ las rlung byung pas gtor/ khaṃ las chu byung bas bkru bar byas/ te/ mi dmigs pa chos dbyings ka dag chen po'i dbyings su stong bar sbyangs nas/ slar yang rang nyid yi dam gyi thugs ka nas yi ge oṃ dkar bo thig le'i brgyan pa zhig 'phros te rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che la khyon yangs pa khyab brdal nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa lta bu'i nang du dbyings nas rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ gsung si ngo bo āḥdamar bo/ thugs kyi ngo bo hūṃ mthing nag gi char babs te bsang rdzas kyi dngos po de yang ngo bo stong la zag pa med pa myong grol ye shes kyi bdud rtsi las/ rnam pa bsang mgron rnams rang rang gi spya na lam du/ mig gi 'dod yon gzugs/ rna ba'i 'dod yon sgra/ sna'i 'dod yon dri/ lce'i 'dod yon ro/ lus kyi 'dod yon reg bya sogs mkho dgu'i longs spyod ma tshang ba med pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i 374

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khyomachod sprin lta bur zad pa med pa'i gter chen por byin gyis brlabs te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mang du spel/ yang rang nyid yi dam gyi thugs ka'i hūṃḥlas 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros te/dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron/ mgon po yon tan gyi mgron/ rigs drug snying rje'i mgron/ bgegs rigs lan chags kyi mgron la sogs pa de dag thams cad chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te/dper na chu las chu bur rdol ba'am/ mkha' las klog 'khyugs pa bzhin du spyan 'dren gyi tshig brjod pa dang / mnyam du rang gi rig pa ma/ngon sum dbang bo'i spyod yul du skad cig gis byon par bsam la/lgadan phul/ dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron ni/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sogs nam ma/kha' la skar tshogs bkra ba lta bu/ mgon po yon tan gyi mgron ni/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad de/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa/sayog dang bcas pa/ yang g.yog dang bcas pa/ bu smad dang bcas pa/dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa thams cad nam mkha' la sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu/ rigs drug snying rje'i mgron ni/ lha dang mi dang lha min dang / byol song yi dwags dmyal ba sogs bar snang 375

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhetra la na bun 'thib pa lta bu/ bgegs rigs lan chags kyi mgron ni/bgegs kyi rgyal po byi na ya kas gtsor byas pa'i bgegs rigs sto nga phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ 'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya sogs lan chags kyi 'gro ba thams cad sa gzhi la lha dang mi yi khrom/ chen po 'tshogs pa bzhin du thib kyis 'dus par bsam la/ de nas mchod sbyin gyis dmigs pa ni/ mchod yul gyi lha rnams rang rang bi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can 'od zer gyi rnam pas chu la nyi zer phog pa bzhin du bsang rdzas kyi bcud rnams drangs te gsol bar bsam pa'o//yang na du ba'i zer las mchod pa'i lha mo nyi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyarnga/ par spros te/ de dag gis g.yas dag byed kyi bdud rtsi khrus kyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon sman gyis bkang ba'i gzhong ba las du ba'i dri zhim pos 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu khyab par byed pa/ du ba'i rtse las bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun sogs mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par spros te mchod sbyin gyi dmigs pa bya/ dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron rnams la phul bas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis dag nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa tshe 'di nyid la thob par bsam/ mgon po yon tan mgron rnams la phul bas de dag gi thugs bde stong gi ros myos te dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ nad dang 376

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khye kadon dang rkyen dang bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi zhing / mthun rkyen legs tshogs dge ba'i dngos po thams cad 'bad med yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs dang phrin las gang 'dod bsgrub par bsam/rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams la phul bas de dag ni rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags mtha' dag dang bral te/ gnas skabs su gzhan 'phrul lha'i longs spyod lta bu la mnga' dbang bsgyur te/mthar thug rang snang don gyi 'og min chen po'i dbyings su rang sad de sangs rgyas par bsam/ bgegs rigs lan chags kyi mgron rnams la phul bas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyis tshe rabs thog ma med pa'i dus nas tshe lus 'di la ma thug gi bar du/ bsad bsad tshe thung ba'i lan chags/ brdung brdung nad mang ba'i lan chags/ brkus brkus 'phrog 'phrog gi rgyu'i lan chags/ mtho ba mkhar phab pa/ dma' ba yul phrogs pa/ mi rta gri ru bsad pa la sogs pa'i lan chags 'khor/ bu lon sod/ sha 'khon dag de dag gi las snang sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral zhing khyad par du gzhan la 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad dang bral te/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang ldan par bsam/ de ltar 'don sgom sbrags la dmigs pas rgyas theb par byed pa ni gal che'o/ /mthar mgron bsdu ba'i dmigs pa ni/ bsdu gshegs kyi tshig brjod pa dang mnyam du/ mchod pa po dang mchod pa'i 377

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—tra4r+shadangos po/ mchod pa'i yul mi dmigs pa chos dbyings spros mtha' dang bral ba/ ka dag ye grol chen po'i dbyings su 'byams klas par byas 'a dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba dang shis brjod kyi tshig ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /chu gtor dang gsur lus sbyin sogs kyi dmigs pa yang ha lam de dang mtshungs pa yin pa rigs pas 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /smras pa/ ji bzhin rang gi rgyud la mi nges kyang // /mtshungs med dam pa'i zhal rgyun ma nor bar/ /mkhas rloms rang bzos bsre bslad yongs spangs nas/ /chos mthun grogs kyis yang ya/nga bskul ba'i ngor/ /bsang gi dmigs pa tshig nyung don 'dus bkod/ /nyes 'gal mchis na spyan ldan tshogs la bshags/ /dge bas 'di mthong rang gzhan sems can gyi/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe kun 'i nas/ /chos mthun bsam pa gegs med 'grub pa dang / /don ga/nyis yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang dal 'byor don ldan du byed pa 'dzam gling gnas chen kun la lan grangs du mar byon pa'i btsun pa a co nas bas nga gi dmigs pa tshig nyung don 'dus zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba la brten nas mdo rnge nga kyi sprang po bstan ming bas dben gnas rdo rje brag gi mgul nas bris pa dge'o/dge'o/dashe'o /༄khya/ /'chi kha ma'i man ngag ni/'chi ran dus kyi sngon nas tshags su tshud dgos te/ de la rim/ pa mang yang 'dir spros pa bskyungs la/ 'chi ba la nye ba'i dus su ci ltar 378

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7tra zhebya ba nyung bsdus ni/ snga phyi nam shi yang rung ste/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad mthar 'dor ba'i chos kho na las ma 'das te/ 'di ni 'jig rten spyi yi chos nyid yin no zhes mang du bsam la/ chags zhen gyi 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad/ tshe rabs gzhan dang 'di nyid kyi ring la 'dus byas pa'i sdig pa dang / bcas 'gal gyi ltung ba dran mi dran thams cad bshags shing / sdom sems mang du bsten/ de nas 'chi ba la zhe 'tsher med par rig pa gzengs bstod de spro sing nge ba byas la/ sngar phan chod dge sbyor ci ltar byas pa rnams yid la byas te/ rlom sems dang bral ba'i yi rang mang du bsgom zhing / tshe rabs thams cad du theg pa mchog gi lam yongs rdzogs la sgrub pa snying bor byed pa dang / sgrub pa de yang yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen dang / dad brtson shes rab bag yo da sogs phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel gyi sgo thams cad nas phun sum tshogs pa dang / sdig grogs dang nyon mongs pa sogs kyi gzhan dbang du mi 'gro ba'i bsngo ba dang smon 'dun yang yang byed/ 'dul ba lung na sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar tshul khrims dang ldan pa sogs kyi mchog tu skyes pa rnams kyi dang po'i rgyu bshad dus/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'chi bar smon lam btab tshul sha stag snang bas/ nye ba gang dang goms pa/ gang / zhes pa ltar stobs shin tu che/ de'i grogs su tshe rabs kun tu stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can gyi lam la cis kyang slob dgos snyam 379

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/44trashipa'i 'phen pa drag po gtong dgos te/ gnyid las ldang ba'i 'du shes kyi skabs su'ang / nang dus snga mo nas sad par gyur cig snyam pa'i smo na lam las/ sad par bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa gtong ba stobs che ba la ltos dang shes so/ /smon lam dang 'phen pa gang byas ltar bde blas tu 'grub pa'i rgyu'i yan lag zhing gi mthu la bsten pa zab pas/ dpal khro rgyan chen po dang 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug lta bu gtso bor rang nyid gang la mos pa che zhing / bzlas sgom gyi 'brel ba che ba de dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bor thag bcad de/ 'dod don sgrub pa'i gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab/ de nas 'chi kha dngos la/ de 'dra'i 'khrigs chags su bsam dbang yod dka' bas/ sangs rgyas rjes dran nam/ snying rje'i dmigs rnam mam/ stong nyid kyi lta ba'am/ gzhan yang chos dang / dge 'dun rjes dran sogs sngar goms 'dris gang che dang /thad der bsam du btub shos zhig la sems ci nus su bsres pa'i thoka nas 'chi khar gzhug cing / de yong thabs su/ de'i sngon nas da gzod 'chi khar mtshams sbyor gyi rnam rtog ngan pa mi rgyu bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa yang sbyang ba gal che/ sngon gyi dam pas/ rig pa sdug pa'i dbe sbyor yun ring las/ /rig pa dwangs pa'i dge sbyor zhag gcig dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di thams cad shes pa dga' spro dang ldan nga/ra bcos gang nus byas pa'i ngang nas byed pa stobs che bar go nged rang 380

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lta bus gzhan la phan thogs pa dka' yang khyod kyi sku tshe'i phreng bar theg pa chen po'i bstan pa la bya ba byed pa'i smon lam dang skyabs 'gro 'don rgyu lags/ /'jigs med pas bris/ /༄/ /smyo 'bogs dang de sel tha bas bshad pa smyo brjed sha za'i gshed ma bzhugs so/ /bla ma gang zhig 'khrul spong sman pa mchog /lta bas 'khrul ba kun sel zab mo'i blo/ /spyod pas 'gro kun 'khrul pa'i rgyud spong ba/ /zung 'brel thags rje'i thags mnga' de la 'dud/ /ces mchod brjod kyis ༄ ༄sdun bsus te/ mdzod las/ g.yeng ba'i sems ni yid sems la/ /skrag gnod ma mnyam mya ngan gyis/ /zhes pa ltar/ don 'di go bder dril na/smyo 'bogs dngos bshad pa dang / de sel thabs bsdus te bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ smyo 'bogs khams dang 'gro ba du zhig gis bsdus bshad pa dang / shes pa gang gi 'khor na 'byung tshul bshad pa dang / de rang gi ngo bo rgyu tshogs dang bcas pa bshad pa ste gsum las/dang po ni/ khams gong ma gnyis na smyo 'bogs med de/ de dag ni mnyam bzhag gi sa ba yin pa'i phyir nges rtog phyogs gcig tu g.yeng ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dod khams kho nas bsdus te/ 'dod khams na ni smyo ba'i rgyu rnams kyang yod la/ kha nang du lta ba'i mnyam bzhag gi sa ba'ang min pa'i phyir ro/ /khams gong ma na smyo ba'i rgyu rnams kyang 381

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhek+ṣemed pa yin nam zhe na/ yin te/ rnam smin las smyo ba ni rnam smin can mi dge ba las bskyed pa yin zhing / gong ma'i sas bsdus kyi mi dase/ ba med pa'i phyir dang / de dag dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu brtan pa thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i phyir skrag sngang sa kyis g.yo bar mi nus pa'i phyir dang / mi ma yin 'dod khams pa 'khrugs pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis blta bar yang mi nus pa'i phyir dang / lus shin tu dwangs pa'i khams yin pas 'du 'khrugs med pa'i phyir dang / gong ma'i rgyud de sdug bsngal dang mi 'brel ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod khams kyi nang nas kyang sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs pa dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro mi/ lha ste 'gro ba lnga ka na yod de/ dmyal ba ba'i nang tshan nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba mo'u 'gal gyi bu'i rnam thar nas bshad pa 'dra ba 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa thams cad rtag tu sems sdug bsngal kho nas non te re 'is bdag nyid kyang mi dran pa'i phyir rtag tu smyon pa yin la/ nyi tshe ba nge/ dag kyang smyo rung gi rten yin pa dang / 'gro ba gzhan bzhi ni rtag tu skyo ba'ang ma yin la/ rten gyi sgo nas dang / sa'i sgo nas smyo mi rung ba'ang min no/ /lus 'phags gling sogs gling gzhan gsum na smyo 'bogs yod cing / de sgra mi snyan pa la mi mtshungs pa ci yin zhe na/ de ni dace ba'i las kyi rnam smin 'ba' zhig la spyod pa yin pa'i phyir ro zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo / /lus rten 'dod par gtogs kyang sems rten bong 382

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lgem/ pa yin na smyo 'bogs med de / rgyu mtshan phal cher snga ma bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ smyo ba ni nges rtog 'ba' zhig gis bsdus shing / mdzod 'a/sa ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa dang / nges rtog gi rtog pa dang / rjes dran gyi rtog pa ste gsum bshad pa'i/ dang po dbang shes su bshad la/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa yid shes kyis bsdus pa kho nar bshad do/ /des na 'di ni yid shes kyi 'khor 'ba' zhig pa yin zhing / dbang shes dang gzhi mthun med pa nyid de/ gtso bor nges rtog gi shes pa phyogs gcig tu 'phyo zhing g.yeng ba la bya'o/ /'di'i g.yeng ba ni shes pa ya yo phyad phyod du song ba'i don de yin gyi/ nyon mongs pa'i sems kyi sa mang bo ba rnams kyi bye brag tu gyur pa'i rnam g.yeng dang don mi gcig ste/ don sacig na de gnyis yin khyab mnyam dgos shing / de lta na dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi smyo 'bogs kyang nyon mongs can du 'gyur bas/ nyon mongs pa ma spangs pa'i dgra bcom yod par thal ba'i phyiraro/ /'on kyang smyo 'bogs kyi g.yeng ba dang / rnam g.yeng ngo bo gcig pa med pa ni gtan min te/ mdzod 'grel du/ de gnyis la mu bzhi brtsis pa bzhin no//gsum pa la/ rgyu tshogs dang / dngos bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/spyir lnga ste/ rnam smin dang / 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa dang / 'phral rkyen tsam la sa 'du ba 'khrugs pa dang / mya ngan las gyur ba rnams so/ /de la dang po ni/ smyo byed kyi rig sngags la brten nas gzhan gnod rtsom 383

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po'ikhu74pa dang / pha rol bos mi 'dod bzhin du chang ldud pa dang / rtsed mo sogs kyi phyir gzhan la dngangs skrag slong ba dang / shig la sogs pa srog chags g.yang sar 'phen pa dang / nags la me sbar ba la sogs pa'i las kyi dbang gis lus kyi 'byung ba rnams smyo 'bogs su 'gyur ba'i grogs su 'khrugs pa ste/ bdag 'bras smyo 'bogs dang / bdaka rkyen las kyi rnam smin du gyur ba'i 'du 'khrugs so/ /gnyis pa ni/mi'am/mi ma yin pa'i sems can dang / sems med phyi rol gyi 'byung ba la sogs pa'i dbang gis byung ba yang rung ste/ skrag dngangs slong ba'i rgyu tshogs la brten nas snying kham dkrugs te sems smyo'o/ /gsum pa ni/yul lha la sogs pa mi ma yin gyi snying la mi 'bab pa'i kun spyod kyi dbang gis/ lha sogs gnod byed de dang des gnad du bsnun pa'i yid kyi 'gyur ba dang / dmod tshig bor ba la sogs pa smyo byed kyi sbyor ba brtsams pa dang / rang gi kun spyod la 'khrugs pa min kyang smyo byed kyi gdon yi dwags kyi 'gro bas bsdus pa 'ga' zhig gis gtses pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi ba ni/ thang khrom zos pa lta bu zas dang spyod lam nyes pas/'du ba 'khrugs pa las smyo ba ste/ gtso bor ni snying la rlung zhugs pa las so/ /lnga ba ni/ bya ba rlabs chen ma grub pa'i sems las dang /grogs po shi ba las sdug 'asngal skyes pa la sogs pa'i mya ngan gyi gzhis snying rlung ldang ba lta bu'o/ /de la dang po ma gtogs pa 'phral gyi rkyen 384

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7zhedabang dang / dang po ni gnam gyis bskos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ smyo ba'i rgyu tshogs lnga bo gang rung gis thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen la brten nas nges rtog phyogs gcig tu 'phyo zhing g.yeng ba de'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/rgyu'i dbang gis dbye ba lnga dang / skye 'phags kyi rgyud kyi dbang gis sanyis su phye'o/ /phyi ma 'di las 'phros pa/ 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa dang / ma mnyam pa/ rnam smin las gyur ba dang / mya ngan las gyur ba'i smyo 'bogs ni 'phags pa rnams la med de/ rim bzhin/ 'tshe ba med pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa lnga dang bral ba'i phyir dang / mi ma yin 'khrugs par 'gyur ba'i kun spyod mi mdzes pa mi byed pa'i phyir dang /rnam smin 'di 'dra ba rnams smin nges kyi las rnams byang ba'i phyir dang /'du byed rnams kyi chos nyid rtogs pas mya ngan med pa'i gnas brnyes pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas 'phags pa ma gtogs pa rnams la 'phral gyi mya ngan las gyur ba ni yod do zhes mdzod 'grel du gsungs te/theg dman gyi sde snod kyi dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /gnad 'di dag shes na deng sang rong ba rnams nas dug ldud pa sman du re nas mdza' bshes la chang gi pham phabs sbyin pa dang / srin bu dang / shig sro la sogs pa gang byung du 'phen pa dang / mthu ngan sngags kyi sbyor ba la yon tan du lta ba la sogs pa nyes pa'i sgo mang po zhig gi mtshang rtogs par 'gyur zhing / sgom chen smyo ba thos na mi srid pa'i mtshar gnas su bsam nas 385

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/d+ku zher+shagang zag dam pa smod pa'i nyes ltung yang 'gog par nus so/ /gnyis/ ji/ la/ thun mong du grags pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ smyo 'bogs zhi bar byed pa'i thabs su gyur ba de'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/rnam smin las smyo ba la ni sman dpyad sogs kyis rang dgar bcos/ su mi btub pa'i phyir/ bshags pa'i sgo rmad du byung ba stobs bzhi'i rna'/ 'byor gal che mod/ spyir ni 'di 'dra ba'i rnam smin las gyur ba thob zin pa rnams ni 'chos par shin tu btub dka' bar rtog ge 'bar ba nas mdo lung dang bcas te bshad pas/ las kyi rnam smin gnya' thos tu ma babs pa nas 'chags pa gces so/ /skrag pa'i gzhi las gyur ba la ni/ mi ma yin gyi nyer 'tshe skabs de dang bsdong nas bla'am mdangs phrogs pa las gyur ba'ang yod de/ de ni 'jigs pa dang gnod pa gnyis ka las gyur bar snang yang de'i bdag rkyen gyi gtso bo gnod ji/ yin pas 'og tu 'chad la/ 'dir de las gzhan pa ni/ dbugs 'byin pa la sogs pa thabs la mkhas pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i man ngag gis 'chos so/ /gnod pa las gyur ba'i nang tshan lha kun spyod ma mdze sa nga/sa 'khrugs pa la ni/ mchod gsol dang bzod pa 'bul bas zhi la/ smyo byed kyi gdon sogs la ni gdon de dag skrod pa'i rig sngags la sogs pas/ gzhil bar bya zhing / de dag gang la'ang rig sngags 'chang ba'i nus mthus mi thub pa med cing / mdos kyi cho ga la sogs pa thabs gzhan 386

5byigaphuḥ pa ཿsa//shātothe pa/ /grit+na/rlos/lhas// /rdo//4ཿཿ// 477/yang ches mang ngo / /'on kyang deng sang smyo 'bogs kyi nang nas kyang 'di nyid mang bar snang zhing / de zhi ba la'ang mdos glud kyi yas 'gyed 'di dar cha che mod/ 'on kyang / mdzo rtswa zan mang yang khal theg dkon pa'i dpe ltar song bas gto mkhan gto rgyus la mkhas pa dka' bar snang bas/ mdos glud kyi rnam bzhag che long rags pa tsam brjod na/spyir mdos gzhung rnams su/ mdos la rnam grangs ches mang ba bshad kyang /'dir mkho ba ni bskangs mdos yin la/ bskangs zhes pa bum pa chus bkang bar byed pa la'ang chus bum pa bskangs zhes zer rung bas lha 'dre'i 'dod pa 'geng bar byed pa ste/ mdos kyis bskangs ba la/sking mdos zhes grags/ mdos kho rang ni/ lha 'dre'i mthun rdzas la bya ba rags pa tsam dang /cung zad zhib par btang na/lha 'dre la mthun rdzas spyir yod do cog la'ang mdos mi zer te/ zer na rgog pa ri la skyes pa rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis mdos yin par thal ba'i phyir te/ de mthan rdzas sa 'gro ba'i 'dre yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rig sngags ༄ rabye'achang ba rnams kyis sngags dang / bsam pa'i khyad par gyis bgegs la sogs pa tshim pa'i phyir byin gyis brlab pa'am nus mthus bsgyur ba dang / gang bsgyur rgyu'i rdzas de'ang lha 'dre de dang de'i mthun rdzas yin pa'i gzhi mthun cig la bya ba kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i dgongs par yang snang ngo / /mdo sde sogs nas mdos yas kyi brda chad dngos su ma 387
