pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dhezhe4r+shabyung yang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byor bas gtam nas rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa yid sprul tu bya ba yang gsungs shing / de mchod pa dang / 'di sbyin pa tsam yin pa'i khyad par ma gtogs 'dra ba'i phyir dang / der yang ma zad stong gsum rin po che la sogs pas bkang ste sems can rang rang gis gang 'dod bzhin ster ba yang mdo las gsungs/ rig sngags kyi stobs kyis sems can gyi nye bar spyad pa kang yang snang bar byed nus pa yang mdo las mang du gsungs pas/ lha 'dre'i mthun rdzas nam rgyang mda' 'phang la sogs pa rang rang gi 'dod pa'i dngos po ci ltar 'byor ba la/ rig sngags kyi mthus mang du spel nas sbyin pa la mdos gtong zer bas don ni 'dra la/ mkhas pas tshig tsam gyi rjes gcod par mi byed do/ /glud ni/ skyes rabs su/ ngang ba'i rgyal po'i srog glud du/ /bdag nyid mchid kyis 'tshal bar bgyi/ /zhes brda chad kyang dngos su byung la/ 'di'i glud kyi dngos po kho rang bem po yin pa'i phyir smyo 'bogs can sogs nad pa'i tshab tu rung ba'i sha khrag drod dbugs dang / khyad par du lha 'dre la mkho ba'i mdangs/ sam bla med mod kyi rig sngags kyi mthus lha 'dre'i ngor de dag dngos su yod par snang ba mi 'gal kyang / rig sngags kyi mthus rtsam gong kang zag tu bsgyur chog zer ba min no/ /zhar la 'ong pa'o/ /ma mnyam pa las smyo ba la ni sman pa rnams kyis gso dpyad kyi cho gas zhi bar byed do/ //mya 388

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ngan las gyur ba ni mya ngan bsang ba la brten te/ mya ngan srab par byed pa dang / dga' ba'i dngos po thob pa las mya ngan brjed par 'gyur ba la sogs pa rnam pa de lta bu dag gis phan pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha mnyes par bya ba dang 'brel ba dang / de las gzhan pa'i tshul gnyis te/ snga ma ni 'jam dpal dkar bo'i sgrub thabs su/ tsan+d+ra ka ra gubhas/ phan tshun bzlog pas 'khrul ba 'joms/ /zhes bshad pa lta bu la sogs pa'o/ /phyi ma'i phyogs la'ang / spyir rnam grangs mang zhing sngags bla med kyi rgyud sde'i lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i gegs sel ni kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal bo'i gsang rab yang tig yid bzhin nor ba la sogs par riri sbyo ri rizubashad cing / de las kyang ches zab pa'i gegs sel gyi mchog ni bsam gtan ngal gso las shes par bya'i/ smyo ba bshad pa'i yig phran zhib tu smos kyis mi ldang ste/ de' nga 'jam dpal dkar po'i man ngag las bshad pa 'dra ba ni nges rtog phyogs gcig tu g.yo ba dang rnam pa dngos 'gal yin pa dang / de las gzhan pa phal che ba ni smyo ba'i rgyu tshogs dang 'gal ba la sogs pa'o/ /gnad de dag bshad na ni chu gter gzhi nas dkrugs te 'chad dgos shing / zhib mor ma bshad na 'dra 'dra mo'i chos skad tsam gyis go ba'i gnad dmigs nas zin pa nyung bar snang bas/ bdag lta bu'i byis pa blun po'i kha la mi blta bar rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i man ngag gi gnad rjen par rtogs nas pha shul 389

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bus zin pa re e 'ong blta dgos so/ /spros bshad mkha' lding gshos rlabs shag po min/ /bsdus bshad rkyal ba mchu bcing yig chung 'di/ /kha bshad go ba med pa'i hob rkyal des/ /smyo bshad smyo 'bogs gdung sel bdud rtsir sbyar/ /smyo 'bogs sel thabs dang bcas pa bsdus te bshad pa'i yi ba chung nyung ngu smyo brjed sha za'i gshed ma zhes bya ba gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med pas rang lo nyi shu ba'i ston 'bring dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba'i nyin par zhig tu bris pa dge/ /༄༅/ /nang nas bslab pa rnam dag ma sbyang na/ /ltar snang cha byad bzang yang phan pa dka'/ /spang blang gnas la 'bad pas bag mdzad na/ /bca' lag ra lpags mnab kyang dam pa lags/ /da lta dad zas za ba la bsam nas/ /ka smad kha byang byas tshad gzan sham sprad/ /bstan pa rtag la gnas snyam bla ma phal/ /lha 'bag gdan la bzhag ltar rgyags pa rgyas/ /grwa bas kha tsam dad pa kha la btags/ /bla mas nga mkhas snyam nas nga rgyal mdzad/ /'chad nyan bya mang nang na bya skad ltar/ /mang mang grags kyang rtsa ba phra bar snang / /ska rags ba bla 'dra yang snal ma tsam / /grwa sar bcas bzang sprad kyang khrag rkyal tsam/ /blta dga' bkrag mdangs gsal yang sha lpags tsam/ /thams cad rma bya 'dra yang snang brnyan tsam/ /bshad yam kha rlangs 'dra bas kha nang zad/ /bsam gtan nyams la bltas kyang a thang chad/ /bag yang rang sar bsdad na tha ma/la ba/ /ha ha gang la bltas kyang 'bag 'cham 'dra/ /yang dag lam bzang 390

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7trabashad na rna ba dgab/ /rta g.yag nang rdzas bstan na snang nyams dga'//sangs rgyas rgyal sras ya mtshan rnam thar can/ /sprang 'khyam nga 'dras bltas kyang bzhad gad gnas/ /rtags gsal thal skad cag cag brtsad na yang / /chang brgyags lag 'thab sprad ltar zhal ras dmar/ /a gtad bzhag nas dran pa bsdam na yang / /rgya nag ha shang lta ba 'dra la khad/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bskyang snyam dbang bka' bshad/ /dbang bkas ra tshang nang na'ang gsang ba bsgrags/ /gsang ba bsgrags na dam nyams skar ltar mang / /dam nyams mang na dmyal khams chab 'bangs rgyas/ /rnga skad khrang khrang bsgrags nas ngan sngags bcas/ /dbyangs gdangs thag pa brkyang ltar na ra ra/ /bstan dgra ra rgan bshas nas zhal bstab mdzad/ /smad las dga' dang 'ga' la mtshar nyams shar/ kha nas gdams ngag bshad pa char ltar 'babs/ /nang nas bsam ngan 'char cha sngar las lhag /gzhan phan bya ba byas byas rang rtsa nyams/ /nga 'dras kha bshad lab lab brag cha 'dra/ /nag chang nangs bsam mtshan bsam thal drags pas/ /gzan dkar ral ba bzhag nas ras pa mdzad/ /bshad tshad khram pa 'dra bar ya ma brla/ /sngags 'chang sa ra ha ltar snyad kyang btags/ /zab lam gdams pas rang snang ma dag par/ /gzhan snang dad pa tsam la dga' drags nas/ /zhwa tshad lham la blang ba mang na yang / /rgan rabs mkhas pas brtags 391

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhetshemimachin rang mtshang gsal/ /la las dmar na bzang snyam 'gag sham gzab//la las skya na dga' snyam lpags skya sprad/ /rtags dang mdzad pa tha dad gnas brtan dag /rang rang mkhas snyam byas kyang bltas na gsal/ /a cang mang mang bshad na kha twa 'dra/ /zhwa lham rang sar bzhag na dga' ba la/ /sprang 'khyam rang la shar tshad bsnyad pa lags/ /snang ba dgrar langs lags na bshags pas 'chags/ /phan mdzad sangs rgyas 'phrad pa brgya lam tsam/ /zab rgyas lam bzang yang yang mjal dka' bas/ /da lta dal ba brgyad ldan gnas skabs na/ /yang dag bslab pa sbyang 'tshal skal bzang dag /ces gug nar zhabs 'greng med pa'i a yig nges pa dang sbya ra ba'i smyo gtam g.yos blug ma 'di'ang rdo rong gi sprang bo 'jigs med pas gang dran bris pa/ dge'o/ /༄7/ /yi ge'i 'jug pa gcig kyang don gyi sgo/ /bye ba khrag khrig du ma'i rnam 'byed du/ /ston la mi 'jigs spobs pa'i mthu grub pa/ /chos kyi slob dpon mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don gyi rnam dbye gcig kyang yi ge'i sgo/ khrag khrig bye ba snyed kyis ston mdzad mod/ /de yi blo gros 'jug pa 'dzad med can/ /yi ge'i slob dpon de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi ge'i de/ bzhin nyid dang yi ge'i chos/ /ro gcig so so ma yin tshul mkhyen nas/ /yi ge'i sgo 'phar gcig gis shes bya kun/ /stong dang rten 'byung zab mo'i ngo bor 'dom/ /yi ge mnyam pa nyid kyis mnyam nyid don/ /nam 392

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7mkhas nam mkha' bris bzhin mi mtshon mod/ /rten 'byung rmi lam lta bu'i snang cha na/ /tshig don ma brtags nyams dga'i rol mor ston/ /yi ge tshig gis pha mthar rnam bzhag mod/ /tshig kyang yi ge nyid las brtsams te 'byung / /tshig dang yi ge 'di dag btags pa ste/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i mtshan ma rdul tsam med/ /gang gis yi ge gang zhig rnam brjod pa/ /de tshe yi ge gzhan nas 'ong min zhing / /yi ge gang na'ang gnas pa ma mchis mod/ /yi ge sgra brnyan bzhin du de tshe snang / /su zhig yi ge'i sgo la dmigs gyur pa/ /de tshe yi ge 'phel med 'grib med de/ /ji ltar me long dag la gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /de ni de yi yid la snang tsam nyid/ /don gang yi ge du mas rnam bshad pa/ /de dag brjod 'dod dbang las ma gtogs pa/ /don dang yi ge gcig min tha dad min/ de dag rang bzhin nyid ces brjod mi bya/ /don dang yi ge gcig na lhun po'i tshig /brjod 'dod mgrin pa'i dbus su ri snang 'gyar/ /de dag tha /ji sdo 1/de/ //bye( rig midad nyid na'ang —ga sa don/ /ston pa go skabs snang ba mi rigs so/ /sgra dang rtog pas rab bzhag yi ge'i sgo/ /brag cha bzhin du ther zug ma mchis mod/ /byis pa smig rgyu'i phung pos ri dwags bzhin/ /don dang yi ges bdag tu rmongs par 'gyur/ /de ltar shes nas mkhas pa blo gros can/ /chags med ye shes mkha' la nyi ma bzhin/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i lta ba rab bcad de/ /rmi lam lta bu'i yi ges rmongs mi 'gyur//de 393

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/〈midag bskal pa du mar chos ston kyang / /chos kyi dbyings la bri gang med shes nas/ /spobs pa'i chu rgyun 'dzad pa med 'gyur te/ /thogs pa med pa'i blo gros snang ba 'byung / /zhes pa'ang 'jigs med bstan rgyam pas bris//༄/ /rang dang gzhan la dgos nges kyi dgra 'thab 'dun gros su gleng ba sgyu ma'i sgrung rabs/rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi yul gru sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' mi mngon pas sa kha rgya che zhing gnam lto ba yangs pa'i sa cha/ zhi ba'i ri ngogs med cing / bdud rtsi'i nags 'dabs med pa/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi chu med pa/ phyin ci log gi nyon mongs pa'i tsha dub la bzod thabs med pa/ gang du bltas kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal smug ltem me ba'i nang na 'khrul ba'i smig mang bo lang long du rgyu ba/ mi 'gro'i rang dbang zad pa/ song na gtad so bral ba/ don med rang sdug myong ba'i lam ring bo 'dzad dus med pa /'phags pa'i dga' ba zang zing med cing gya nom pa'i bkrag med nga//chos kyis phongs pa'i mu ge'i thal ba rkya thal le ba/ kha brgyar gyes pa can/stong sde khri shog mang bo'i grong tsho chags pa/ stod gzugs khams dang gzugs med kyi 'brog na bsod nams kyi be'u lug 'tsho skyong mkhas pas ting nge 'dzin gyi dkar sna mod pa/ smad 'dod khams kyi rong yul na dge sdig gi las rnam pa sna tshogs zhing du rmo bas skyid sdug gi 'bru 394

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7sna la 'di mi dar bya ba med pa/ rgyu 'bras kyi nyo tshong la skyed 'phel brtsi ba/ skye shi'i sa tshugs rtsis kyis mi chod pa mu nas rgyad du mthad pa/ sa 11dro /jidrorte /༷༷/ /༷༷/ rir ra༄photshugs dang bar na rtag 'a na — bya —da 'char grangs mang la gzung du med pa'i dri za'i grong 'bum tsho mang bos brgyan pa/ skad cig re nas ci yang med pa/ phar 'gro dang tshur 'ong gi 'du 'god rgyun mi 'chad pas mgron po'i bun long mig sbrid pa lta bu/ cha lugs spyod tshul mi mthun/ za thang dang longs spyod mi 'dra/ grong shog dang skad rigs mi gcig pa'i sems can gzhal du med pa/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i mi dpon gcig gi kheb zha bas su chud pa'i mnga' ris 'di na/ bu rang nyid min pa'i dpa' bo dang thug ma thub/ dgra phar 'dul min pa'i tshur rgol dang phrad ma myong / gnas rang khyim min pa'i sa mtha' gcod dgos ma byung ba'i dpon a ma'i go kha'i gces phrug po kho khrims la yo drang med de ngan g.yo'i lta rgyud du byung / 'bangs la skyong lugs med de nyon bdud kyi tha snyad chags/ drin la ngo so med de sems gshis phyin ci log gi gtso bor gyur nas/ gyod gzhi na yod pa bun du 'jog pa/ gyod rtsa nang du bsdus nas gtang rag gtong ba/ sdug sems na med pa thog 'jog byed pa/ blo'i skor lugs re la lo brgya'i mnar thabs tshang ba/'phral dga' la mtha' ngan pa'i khrims ko dmar gyi 'breng rlon lta bus sems can sdug thag gcod pa'i skabs su/ dpon la za tshod yod rung 395

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/g.yog la 'jal tshod med pa'i dpya khral ya med/ rje la mgu dus med rung bran la sun dus 'byung ba'i zhabs tog ya med/ khrims la mnar phod yod rung 'bangs la brnag nus med pa'i chad pa ya med/ gshed ma gsod snying che rung btson bu 'chi snying med pa'i rang nyams lhus/ pa 'di tsho bsams nas/ sha tsha rang la 'chor ba'i mi 'dra srid na ni/ da bab sdug gi khur bo ri ltar lci bas tho bzhag phyis 'byang phung po'i ra nyutesems khral nad ltar na bas gleng bslang / sngar bskos las — sdug yus mi ro ltar ngam gnag pa bskyed de/ gnam gyis rwa co brdar/ sa yis rnga ma g.yugs/ gnam sa cha lang brdab/ srid pa thog 'og log pa'i dus nam shar rung / rje'i sku tshod 'dzin pa'i thob thang mi dbang yang /bden rdzun rang lam len pa'i spyi lugs de mi dbang don mi 'dug pas yo drang gi dmigs dang / skyid sdug gi dbang skal thig gis bgo ba'i gleng gzhi zhig slong dgos/ de la mi dpon 'di rigs rnams rang ci 'dod kyi ngang la snang ba byung rgyal du 'jog rgyu yod med/ khong gi yab mes la thob thang dbang tshul/ lha sras kyis rang srid skyong rabs/ skyes bu'i skyon yon yod lugs dang bcas pa zur tsam zhig drang por brjod na/ gna' rabs dang po'i thog ma/ 'di ba'i yab mes chos skyong rgyal dang /chos phyug 'bum la sogs pa rigs ngan ma ning gi sde ba las skyes shing / lus bse dri'i sdong bo ltas ngan gyi sha gzugs su grub pas/ ya 396

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7rabs kyi mi khyur ma chud/ gnyen sna rdzi can dang sdeb sa ma snyed nas/'byung ba rdzas sne dgu 'dus zhes bya ba'i yul sa min rdo min las grub pa'i gcong rong / sngo ldum dang me tog med pa/ steng nas nyi ma dang rlung gis rmya ba/ zhabs nas 'dam rul dang ba tshwas gsher ba/ phyi 'khrang la nang myags pa/ rlan dri dang drod rlangs 'dres ma dang / lud 'bu rigs mi gcig pa mang pos khyab pa/ rtswa 'jag mas shugs ring 'byin pa'i sa'i rkub/ lung ba'i gting dong / rdo gor mo yin yang sa mi zin pa lta bu zhig na/ chu gad pa gnyis dang pus mo mnyam btsugs/ rdza pha bong gnyis dang ngo 'jigs ston res byed pa'i skye mched kyi gyang rol bya ba/ nang nas bltas na phyi mi sgrib pa'i sgog po kha ral/ nang na mi ma bsdad/ phyi na du ba mi 'ong ba zhig yod/ de la rten mkhar gyi gtso bo byas te/ snod bcud go ma 'dzol ba'i dus de tsam na yang / sas yar la gcig bltas na/ gnam gyis mar la gcig lta/ ki phar la gcig bos na ri brag gis lad mo zhig zlo ba lta bu ma gtogs/ khyim tshes kyi a ya dang gcigaphyugs lug gi skyong spel dang gnyis/ rmo rko so nam dang gsum/ de rigs tshor yang myong tshod du mi 'dug pa de ltar yin rung / gdung a tsha ske ring gi rgyud du byung bas mu ges ma thab/ ma sdug mo kher 'dug gi bu ༄rgyud yin pas yid gcong ma long / mes glen rigs lug smyon mgo'i tsha rgyud yin pas sems shed ma chad de/ gyong bo khyis ma chod/ ro khur 397

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhe haṃ'adres ma 'dod pa'i kha dpe ltar sdug tshe dmyal ba bas kyang ring bar byung / de lhu ring la sems can gyi rang bzhin dar bas 'jam/ g.yon can gyi nyams rgyus mi shes/ ci zer la bden kha ster/ khyi bas brid sla/khwa bas col chung / byis pa bas mgu skyen zhing / bden yid la 'phrod pa med kyang zog po rdzun la byang ba'i stabs dang / mdzangs rnam dpyod bzang ba min kyang mi khram blo sho rgod pa dang / dpa' bo snying shed che ba min kyang sdar ma gab la mkhas pa'i rkyen las/ ngan pa gong du shor/ ma/ rabs mgo mthon du song ba'i thog dpon 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i spun sde nyi shu/ sku ngo gang zag skyabs dang / shed bu srung sogs phu nu stag shar mang bo dang bcas pa srid pa las kyi gnya' shing du byung ste/ mi dbang ba la zhing rmos/ mi 'os mi la btsan btsugs/ mi dgos las la nan brdung / mi dar dpe la kheb blang / khrims tshe sdug gi rgya ma che la gnyan pa thog mar btsugs/ skye dgu'i cho rigs gser ltar btsun pa'i nang du gdol spyod kyi khrims lung dang por bstan/ 'gro ba'i sems gshis 'o ma ltar dwangs pa la ngan dgu dug bcu'i sdig las kyi ru ma brgyab/'du byed la gzhi bting sred len la sgrub byed/ srid pa la 'phel rtsi/ rga shi la gzung gsog byed pa'i srol sa steng na srid ma myong ba phyi rabs kyi btsas su bzhag ste/ stong khams gsum gyi 'jig rten sdug bsngal gyi ra ba gcig dang / srid pa'i sde ris phal cher sdig spyod kyi khyu gcig tu kha 398

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lo sgyur/ sngon gyi mi rgyud ma 'chugs pa'i rtags su/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad rgya khyon yangs pa/ gnam 'khor lo rtsib brgyad tha gru che ba'i phyi snod 'jig rten gyi rnam grangs 'di tsam zhig yod rung / sde 'dis chas srid bzung nas lo grangs dang mi rabs 'di lon gzhal bar ma nus pa'i dus kyi mthar yang pha gzhis kyi lud khang tsha ro ma 'di min pa'i rem rgyu med pa 'di/ grongakhyer gyi seng ge rnga leb dang / khong rnam pa tsho rigs gtsang ya rabs kyi sde ba nas mched pa'i rten 'brel mi bslu ba'i bden pa/ btum na mi thum/ bzang na mi thub/ bsub na mi zab pa'i ngo mingatshorag mjug zurang ༄༄mi —rig zurari rir ma 'gyur ba da ka yan/ ha ha/ da da ltar bshad na/ ma thams cad rang yul na che/ sde thams cad rang sa na brjid/ rigs thams cad rang thob la gnyan pa ma gtogs/ don yin lugs kyi ngos na dpon 'bangs kyi 'brel ba ma grub mchog dman gyi tha snyad mi srid pa'i ja sig cig yin la/ sgos 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i blo ngan 'di la pha thob kyi 'phru tog ston rgyu/ rang dpung gi ral gri bsdigs rgyu/ ngas byas kyi bzang yus 'dren rgyu/ dbang skal gyi za thang rgyug rgyu sogs sna gcig tsam yang med kyi steng / 'jig rten phal ba tshos/ dgra 'dre gnyis kyi g.yab mo/ ltas ngan stong gi thog ma/ byur chag gi snying rdo brgya dod ma 'di khyim du bcug zon phyi rol du byed zer nas don med kyi stong 'dang mang po gros su shom pas 'dug ste/ de lta bu min/ tshe thog ma med 399

21rngad/ 17 therdo sdispyirngasga khur:dropo/thab byasputshog rngabartagazud rta):re pe/sdosasprang khuradra/zug/ tsharapa'i dus kyi phung rgan po 'di ni nyes byas kyi tshad la gzhal na/ nam mkha' la bla bre rgyong rgyong / bar snang la 'khor lo skor skor/ sa gzhi la rko ba rdung rdung du brdung rung sdug snying mi tshim zhing / zhe 'khon phung shul gyi ming skam la yang brjed mi thub pa'i tshod yin/ bdag chad kyis 'jigs pa'i ser sna can dag dpon gzhung bzang phyi thag ring ba'i sku drin 'di min na dmangs rang yul gyi mnga' ris na sdod thabs mi 'ong zer te/ mi glen pa rgyus med pas rang mgo 'khor ba ma gtogs shes bya mi srid dgu srid/ rgyal khams mi dar dgu dar yin pas/ skyid pa'i rgyal khams med nas 'gro sa zad pa ga la yin/ de yang zur tsam bshad na/ sdig spyod mya ngam thang 'di'i pha mtha' rdzogs mtshams/ 'dzad med sdus sna mang po'i rgya grong zad mtshams/ bsod nams phyug sde 'bol mo'i sde sne thug mtshams shig na/ lam bdud rtsi'i chu klung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'gram ngogs/ gtsang tshangs spyod sil ma'i spos ngad ldang ba'i sa phyob/sa/mtho dben pa las skyes pa'i nyams dga' g.yang du chags pa'i yul gling / ting nge 'dzin gyi nags tshal phyug la spun pa dang / shin sbyang bi bde ba'i 'khri shing ldem la mnyen pa/ snying rje'i 'bab cha bsil la dang ༄ba dang / byams pa'i me tog dgod la bkra ba/ mngon par shes pa'i rtse sna 'khyugs la mtshar ba sogs ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i bzo bkod zad mi shes pa'i sman ljongs/ srid pa sgyu ma'i khang bzang dang / skye ba skyed mos tshal 400

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7'gro ltar rtogs pa'i rgyal sras snying stobs can rnams 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i ye shes kyi rol rtsed dbyar gyi ljongs rgyu ltar ston pa'i ltad mo mthong zhing / thub dbang shākya seng ge 'dus mang 'phags bzhi'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa bde skyid 'chi ba med pa'i ston mo mdzad de/zab zhi rdul dang bral ba'i bsam gtan gyi grib ma la brjod du med pa'i 'gro bas dus yol bar mdzad pa'i mnga' ris yod de/ sa de na ni nga khyod kyi bdag bzang med/ phyug dbal gyi dbye ba med/ lto gos kyi rigazi ni༄mirtsol sgrub thams cad med par/ dus rtag tu/ gtan bde'i ngang la gu yangs/ zhi ba'i mal du lhod chags nas/ rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba shugs 'byung du skyong chog pa'i dge mtshan gyi gzi 'od 'bar/ de dag kyang gnam thog so bco brgyad kyi steng na mi snyed kyi nor sna yod rabs/sa rim pa bcu gsum gyi mar zhabs na mi sleb kyi tshong rdal yod rabs/ 'brel med phongs pa'i rna ba kha g.yang gis brid pa lta bu zhig gtan nas min te/ bla na med pa'i ston pa dang / ston pa'i rgyal tshab/ mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings la sku bzhugs kyang / thugs rje chen po'i spyan ras rjes 'jug la chags pa rnams kyis/ phyis 'byung gi 'dang la mkhas shing /skyid sdug gnyis kyi chus srid la gtan brje phod pa'i mi bzang blo stobs can mang po da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'byung bar gzigs nas/srid pa'i srang sgo gcod lugs/ zhi ba'i 'jug phyogs mtshon lugs/401

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhe〈nyenasrid zhi'i sa mtshams bgo lugs/ 'khor ba dang myang 'das kyi bar na dmu thag gser zam gyi phreng ba tshar du dngar ba'i sa lam gyi rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa rjod byed ngag lam du drangs te/ mkhas bya'i ma mo bzhas/ spang blang gi sbyor tshul bslab/ nyams len gyi khog gzhung bsgrigs pa/'i dmar khrid gdams ngag tu btabs/ bskyar ldab rjes bstan la mdzad/gdams lhag zhal chems su bzhag /bstan rgyun glegs bam du bkod/dus babs zhal mthong gi gdul bya sku dngos kyi mdzad pas rjes su bzung zhing / ma 'ongs phyi rabs kyi 'dul skal brgyud 'dzin thugs sras la gtad de/ legs gsung skye dgu'i nyi ma phyi mtha'i bar du bri gang dang bral bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ gdul bya mchog dman med pas nyams su spyod chog pa'i sku drin mthong chos na yod/ rgyud phreng thag lung phreng rdog drod tshad bcu tshar/ gnad mdo 'dzin du sbyar ba'i lam yig/ mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu 'di tsho yod bzhin du/ lam mkhan la 'phrigs ma tshud par/ slob gsar la zhib cig yod mdog byed cing / glen sgom sems gnas kyi g.yag rgan 'jig lta'i sgo sngun du btags nas/ u tshugs rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi snying rus chen pos nan gyis zhon te/g.yag rgan la 'gro lugs med kyang kha rnam par grol ba'i phyogs su bltas nas 'gro kyin yod snyam pa'i stong 'dang zhig la sngas byas nas bsdad pas mi chog lha khams gsum gyi chos rje sangs rgyas bcom ldan 402

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7haṃ 'das kyi gser yig bka' tham gyi re kha ma nyams pa 'di la gdeng bcas/ gtan 'dun gyi snying bo 'chug med cig la rdog pa gtad de/dpa' 'di byas zer rgyu med par/ dpa' skad kyi kha pho che ba tsam ma yin par/ bdud ngo 'jigs can dang lta res/ dgra kha tshan can dang ka/she res/ dpa' lag dmar can dang 'ju res byas nas khe pham gyi rang skal mngon sum du long ba zhig la bsam sbyor chig sgril dgos par mthong / rang dang gzhan la dgos nges kyi dgra 'thab 'dun gros su gleng ba sgyu ma'i sgrung rabs zhes bya ba'i gtam nag mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad du grags pa'i ya gyal/ rdo rol gyi cha las yul gyi dge bcu ma tshang ba med pa'i sa'i lte ba/ lha chen rdo rje mgar dmar srid pa'i bde sdug gi bzo khyad mang bo mgar du rdung zhing mtha'i so kha la lta ba'i rdzong zur/ zang yag dmar po brag gdan g.yu klung gi ska rags can la brjid pa'i ke'u tshang nas brag srin 'jigs byed 'bar ma mel tshe byed pa'i gnas rtse/ gsung gi rig 'dzin rta mchog khrag 'thung gnyis pa/ 7dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ gsang chen dngos grub gling gi chos grwa zhes bden tshig grub pa'i gsung byin rlabs kyi me tog sil mar bsnyil ba'i grub pa'i ri ngogs nyams dga' ba nas mi smyon lcags kong da ri dras bris/ maṅga lam̐/ /403

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhezhe sge༄/ /bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag snying por dril ba thar 'dod yongs kyi 'jug ngogs bzhugs/smra ba'i seṅge zur phud lnga ba dang / /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mi pham/ bla ma'i zhabs/ /dad pa'i sems kyis spyi bor rab mchod de/ /bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag nyung ngu'i tshig gis spro/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis bslab bya bden pa bzhi'i nang tshan/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan gzhi gang zhe na/ma dag pa'i snod dang ma dag pa'i bcud gnyis po'o/ /sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rang rgyu kun 'byung bden pa las skyes pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi ngo bo'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal rnams so/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gang zhe na/ tshor ba bde ba'o/ /sdus bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gang zhe na/ tshor ba sdug bsngal ba'o/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gang zhe na/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i nyer len gyi phung po'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ mi rtag pa dang / sduka bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / stong pa'o/ /mi rtag pa'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ skad cig ma'o/ /sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang du gyur ba'i phung po lnga'o/ /bdag med pa'i rnam pa kang zhe na/ ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag gis stong pa'i de'o/ /stong ba'i rnam pa 404

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7gang zhe na/ dbang bsgyur ba'i bdag don gzhan gyis stong ba'i de'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni shes par bya ba ste/ ji ltar rlung ngam mkhris pa'am bad kan nam 'dus pa'i nad byung ba'i mis de shes par bya ba bzhin no/ /kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan gzhi gang zhe na/ las dang nyon mongs pa'o/ /kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rang 'bras sdug bden skyed byed kyi cha nas bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi spang bya'i rigs su gnas pa'o/ /kun 'byung gi ngo bo'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi las dang / 'dod chags dang /zhe sdang dang / gti mug ste nyon mongs pa'o/ /kun 'byung gi rnam pa'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ rgyu dang / kun 'byung dang / rab skye dang / rkyen gyi rnam pa'o/ /rgyu gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal gyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i sred pa lta bu'o/ /kun 'byung gi rnam pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal yang yang skyed pa'i sred pa lta bu'o/ /rab skye'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal shugs drag tu skyed pa'i sred pa lta bu'o/ /rkyen gyi rnam pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal gyi lhan cig byed pa'i sred pa lta bu'o/ /kun 'byung gi bden pa ni spang bya ste/ ji ltar nad gang yang rung ba'i rgyu spang bya yin pa bzhin no/ /'gog pa'i bden pa'i mtshan gzhi gang zhe na/ sdug kun gnyis kyi bral 'bras lta bu'o/ /'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rang rgyu lam bden bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i bral 'bras so/ /'gog bden gyi ngo bo'i dbye ba 405

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lgeshigang zhe na/ brda'i 'gog pa dang / don dam pa'i 'gog pa'o/ /brda'i 'gog pa gang zhe na/ so so'i skye bo'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs ci rigs re zhig gi bar du mi skye bar byas pa'i cha'o/ /don dam nga/'i 'gog pa sang zhe na/ 'phags rgyud kyi spang bya ci rigs gtan med du byas pa'i cha'o/ /'gog bden gyi rnam pa'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ 'gog pa dang / zhi ba dang /gya nom dang / nges 'byung gi rnam pa'o/ /'gog pa'i rnam pa gang zhe na/sdug bsngal gyi bral 'bras so/ /zhi ba'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ kun 'byung si bral 'bras so/ / gya nom pa'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ phan bde'i ngo bor gyur ba'i 'phags rgyud kyi de'o/ /nges 'byung gi rnam pa gang zhe na/ 'khor ba las thar ba'i de'o/ /'gog bden ni thob bya ste nad med pa'i bde ba thob bya yin pa dang 'dra'o/ /lam bden gyi mtshan gzhi gang zhe na/ 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa'o/ /lam bden gyi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rang 'bras 'gog bden thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i 'phags rgyud kyi mngon rtogs so/ /lam bden gyi ngo bo'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ mthong larnga/ dang / sgom lam dang / mi slob pa'i lam mo/ /lam bden gyi rnam pa'i dbye ba gang zhe na/ lam dang / rigs pa dang / sgrub pa dang / des 'byin gyi rnam pa'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa gang zhe na/ thar bar bgrod pa'i 'phag/sa/ rgyud kyi de'o/ /rigs pa'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gyur ba'i de'o/ /sgrub pa'i rnam pa gang zhe na/ sems kyi gnas 406

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lugs phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i de'o/ nges 'byin gyi rnam pa gang zhe na/ gtan bde 'khor bar mi ldog pa'i gnas su 'khrid par byed pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi rnal 'byor/ lam bden ni nyams su blang bya ste/ ji ltar sman bsten par bya ba dang 'dra'o/ /kha cig na re/ kun 'byung rgyur gyur ba'i 'bras bu yin na/ sdug bden yin pas khyab zer na/ lhas sbyin gyi rgyud kyi 'dod chags kyi rtog pa snga ma'i phyi logs su byung ba'i rje btsun byams pa'i rgyud kyi byang chub kyi sems chos can/ sdug bden yin par thal/ kun 'byung rgyur gyur ba'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ sdug bden ma yin par thal/ lam bden yin pa'i phyir/rtags ma grub zer na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'ga' zhig na re/ tshor ba yin na sdug bsngal yin pas ma khyab ste/ tshor ba bde ba chos can/ tshor ba yin pa gang zhigasdug bsngal ma yin pa'i phyir zer na/ tshor ba bde ba chos can/ sdug bsngal yin par thal/ mdo las/ gang ci tshor ba yang rung ste sdug bsngal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa gang zhig/khyod tshor ba yin pa'i phyir/la la na re/snod bcud gnyis po gang rung yin na sdug bsngal yin pas khyab zer na/sangs rgyas rang snang las grub pa'i snod dang longs sku chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ phal cher na re/ sdug bsngal yin na kun 'byung yin pas khyab zer na/ rdo chos can/ kun 'byung yin par thal/ sdug bden ‘107

casarngad/ 11 lngardo sdispyirngaku 'o/:drob/thag byaspustasno rngaku/lngazug rta):re po/sdosapa('o/dra/myo// tsharalorayin pa'i phyir/ gzhan dag na re/ 'gog lam gnyis la gzhi mthan yod ༄zer na/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos la gzhi mthun yod par thal/ 'gog bden dang lam bden gnyis de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/de la gzhi mthun med par thal/ rtag mi rtag gnyis 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas yin pa rtags ma grub zer na/ ngo bo nyid sku chos can/ byas par thal te/ 'gog bden 'dus byas ma yin la lam bden 'dus byas ma yin pa gang zhig ngo bo nyid sku 'gog bden yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ stong nyid chos can/ ma rig pa yin par thal/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi ngo bo nyid sku stong nyid yin pa gang zhig de byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig gis 'gog lam ngo bo gcig pa med zer na/ mthong lam rnam grol lam pa'i rgyud na 'gos bden med par thal/ lam bden dang ngo bo gcig pa'i 'gog bden med pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ gzhi grub na bden bzhi gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ nam mkha' chos can/ bden bzhi gang rung yin par thal/ gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de min par thal/ khyod sdug kun gnyis ma yin pa gang zhig 'gog lam gnyis ma yin pa'i phyir/ de das kyang nor 'khrul gyi dbang du gyur ba las legs par bshad pas dben pa'i nongs tshogs sras bcas rgyal ba'i spyan sngar 'chags so/ /'di las nyer bskrun dge ba'i mthu yis ni/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun rgyal ba'i 408

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7sa thob ste/ /stobs sogs rnam par byang pa'i yon tan kun/ /bdag gir byed pa'i dpal dang ldan gyur cig /bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag snying bor dril ba thar 'dod yongs kyi 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba/ btsun pa ma ti bha dra'i ngag gis bskul ba ltar rmongs pa dkon mchog ming bas yar ngo'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /༄༅/ /'dir sngags pa rnams kyis rtag tu mi 'bral bar bcings bar bya ba'i rdor dril ni sngags kyi nyams len gyi rim pa rdzogs par mtshon pas don chen po can yin te/ de la rdo rje ni snang phyogs kyi cha mtshon byed yin pas thabs bde ba chen po'i ye shes zhes bya ba sngags bla med kyi lam gnad mthar thug pa de mtshon byed/ de nyid kyi lto ba zlum pas ye shes de nyid chos nyid stong pa nyid la gnyis snang dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes de mtshon zhing / ye shes de nyid lam dus dang 'bras dus kyi khyad par gyi dri ma thams cad dang bral byed dam bral pa'i bdag nyid can yin pa dang nam du'ang ye shes de nyid dri ma'i ngo bo skye mi srid pas/ ye shes de nyid ye shes lnga dang yul gyi chos nyid lnga mtshon pa'i yar mar gyi rtse lnga/ thugs rje chen pos 'khyud pa mtshon pas cha srin gyi kha dang / ye shes de nyid kyis gdul bya'i re ba ༄bskong ba rgyun mi chad pa'i brdar rin po che'i phreng ba dang ldan pa yin la/ gzhan yang ye shes de nyid kyi rtsal du rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' yab yum dang 'gro 'a dul gyi phrin las kyi mdzad pa rnams mtshon 409

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/44 r+shapa'i brdar yar mar gyi rtse lnga dang pad 'dab brgyad rin po che'i phreng bas mdzes par byas pa yin no/ dril bu ni chos nyid stong ba nyid rtosas pa'i shes rab mtshon byed yin pas dbyings phyug ma'i zhal gyis chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bde chen gyi ye shes de nyid kyis mngon surnga/ gyis gzigs pa mtshon pa dang / rgyal ba'i thugs rtag tu chos nyid 'a/sa mi g.yo bar mnyam par bzhag pas rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / ye shes de la sa dang lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs pas bum pa dang / ye thes de nyid thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid mtshon byed chu srin gyi kha dang de'i rtsal phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i drwa ba drwa phyed/ ye shes de nyid yum/ lnga dang sems ma brgyad la sogs pa lha'i rnam par 'phrul ba pad 'dab dang mgo rtse lnga sogs dang ldan pa shes par bya dgos so/ /mtshon don gzhan yang yod pa ni gzhir bca' 'o/ /dge'o/ / ༄/ /dris lan 'dod ra ma zhes pa/yon tan 'dod na gal gang che/ gang la goms pa de la mkhas bya ba yin pas goms pa gal che'o/ /goms par byed pa la ci drag /sgom/ ji/ gal che'o/ /bsgom kyang ma goms pa cis lan/ sgom rlung gis khyer bar zad do/ /de la ci drag /g.yeng ba'i yul rkyen thag bsring bas dralge /bsring yang rlung gis khyer ba cis lan/ 'du 'dzi bcad kyang rnam g.yeng ma bcad pas lan no/ /'du 'dzir 'phyan pa la sgom chen yod 410

ma bye〉 :spro///shā//(1pa/ /rdo/lha1spro//lha/sa// //yas2ཿཿni/ rdotāshā/dam/ brtan pa thob nas yod do/ /brtan pa ma thob pa 'du 'dzir bsgom na cir 'gyar/ rlung dmar nang na mar me ltar 'gyar ro/ 'du ༷du ༷༷/ rtse(1 yir zerang chararang 1〉〉'ja bcad kyang phyar la ga pa cas lan/ rtad thag rka la 'ashul bas lan no//rtod thag gang yin/ 'jig rten chos brgyad do/ /de gcod na ci dgos/zhen log gi ral gri dgos so/ /ral gri de 'dod na gang zab/ blo ldog rnam bzhi sgom pa zab mod/ dgos med kha ton du bton na ci 'dra/khra ngan gyis dgra bo mi thub zer rgyu der zad/ 'o na de la dgos pa gtan nas med dam/ spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyang / /bya ba yin pas de'ang min/ /chos brgyad spang nas dben pa bsten zer ram/ dben pa bsten nas chos brgyad spong zer/ gnyis ka zer te bya dang sgo nga bzhin no/ /dben par chos brgyad sgrub pa a lta bu la ci zer/ khyim chen spang ba'i khyim chung zer/ de la bya bral mi zer ram/ da lta rang khyim chung gi gza' dpon byas pa de ma go'am/ khyim pa la bya bral zer ram ci/gzhan gyis chos par sems shing / rang chags sdang sgom pa o lta bu la ci zer/ zog po zer ba yin mod/ de ltar yin par shes na de tsug byed pa ci yin/ las ngan gyi 'byung pos gtses pa yin mod/ 'byung po 'di las thar thabs la ci dgos/ zhing gi mthu la brten cing / tshe rabs kun tu dben gnas pa/ /phun sum ldan pa thob par shog /bsam gin bsdad na dga' 'am snyam//dben pa bsten na skyo ba skye bas mi zug gam/4 11

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ t+yātrade nyid de'i phan yon yin te/ skyo shas chos kyi mgo por 'jog pa yin mod/ de gnyis skyo ba zhes pa'i ming du mthun yang don gtan nas mi gcig pas ci zer/ 'o na dbe+en par ci zhig dran nas skyo zer/ bde skyid kyi phun tshogs dran nas skyo ba yin mod/ skyid sdug 'byed pa'i blo mig yod na bde ba'i mchog gis skyo nas bde skyid ngan pa la dag/'a ba gar srid/ 'o na dben pa na bde skyid ci yod/ sems skyid pa yod nge/bde ba'i mchog ni sems skyid pa/zhes so/ /༄7/ /bde skyid bkra shis 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig pu ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin te/ de 'dzin pa'i dam pa phal cher zad pa dang / skye dgu chos min spyod pa'i dus su lha dang mi rnams rgud cing / lha ma yin sogs ngan 'gro'i phyogs rnams stobs 'phel ba ni chos nyid yin la/lhag par bod 'bangs rnams kyis gangs ljongs skyob pa'i mgon gcis bla ma o rgyan rin po che dang / lha thugs rje chen po brjed de/ skyabs 'jig rten pa'i 'byung po la 'tshol/ las su mi dge ba kho na byed pa na/bsod nams kyi lde kha smon lam log pas bsgyur ba'i mi nag pho mo dang /ban+de khrims 'chal/ sngags pa dam nyams rnams nag phyogs kyi 'byung po mthu chen du skyes nas lha srin sde brgyad nang 'khrugs slong zhing / mtha' bzhi'i rgya 'dre ma rung ba rnams kyis sna khrid byas te 'gong bo spun dgu'i dmags dpung dgun gyi 'tshub ma ltar langs/ dkar phyogs kyi 412

zla byi :spro///shā///bye// ///tsho:ba//lha//// /spre/rgo2juḥ// (tāshā/rga/zhi bdag mang po yul bton nas/ phal cher gnya' mnan nas ldang mi nus pa byas/ sangs rgyas mthong ba'i bstan srung mthu bo che rnams kyang bod 'bangs chos kyi gzi byin dang bral ba'i dbang gis skyob pa'i thabs med par shes nas zangs mdog dpal ri sogs rig pa 'dzin pa'i grong khyer khyad par can rnams su bzhud de/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'di mi med kyi 'brog stong lta bur song ba'i gnas skabs na/ mtha' dbas kyi 'byung po 'dres pa'i rtags su mi rnams kyang mtha' dbus ༄'dres shing / yul khams phan tshun nang 'chol ba dang / chas spyod 'chol ba sogs 'byung / de'i dus su spyir nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sogs phyi nang gi 'jigs pa rags la mang ba dang / khyad par mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung mang pos lan gcig ma yin par 'joms tshul dus gsum ma.o pa o rgyan chen po'i gter lung rnams su gsungs shing /de'ang dus 'gyur chen po bcu yong ba'i nang nas deng sang brgyad pa phal cher rdzogs nas dgu ba la nye ba yin/ de bzlog thabs yod kyang bod 'bangs spyi'i las dbang gis byung ba'i sdug bsngal gang zag re re gnyis res bzlog dka'/ mang pos ni sgrub rogs mi byed cing blo mthun rgyu ma red kyang / sgrub mkhan byung na/ spyir bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'ardzi ba'i rig sngags 'chang nus ldan rnams kyis g.yul mdos/ sa gnad me btsa'/ gtor bzlog 'gong po ar gtad/ dam sri mnan pa/413

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/t+yāshechos skyong spyi dang bye brag brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs kyi gsol mchod/zhi drag gi sbyin sreg tshad ldan/ lha srin dam bsgrags sogs bstan 'gro spyi la sman pa'i lhag bsam zol med kyis bsgrub na stobs che yang de 'dra tshad ldan byed pa mang bo 'ong dka'/ sgrub sla la chod che nges ni/ban sngags/ mi nag pho mo/ khye'u bu mo thams cad kyis ma ṇi dung phyur mang po 'don cing dus chen rnams su ma ṇi'i 'ur sgra chen po byed/ ma/ ṇi rdo la brko/ dar du 'dzugs pa sogs dang / gu ru sidzhai de mtshungs/ rtsal du bton/ bsam lhun 'bum ther mang bo dang / khyad par yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag bcu gsum gyi dang po/ hor sogs 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor naḥ zhes pa'i gsol 'debs khri 'bum mang po gsog /lha mo 'od zer can gyi phyag 'tshal dang gzungs sngags tshar grangs mang po 'bri 'don/ sher snying bdud bzlog ci mang /sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal cho ga rnam dag mang bo dang / phyag 'tshal nyer gcis bye ba sogs ci thon/ tā re yig bcu dung phyur ci 'grub/ sgrol ma'i dar chen mang du 'phyar ba rnams shin tu gal che/ 'di rnams ni rang nyid kyis mo phya bgyis pa'am/ rim gro 'di dag bzang yong snyam du zhe rtsis gang che rnams bris pa lta bu gtan nas min gyi/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gter lung lhad med ltar bris pa yin pas yid ches kyi gnas su bzung chog par yod/spyir 'di 'dra'i rigs rnams chu ma cor 414

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khyotra song du rags pa rgyang nas byed pa ltar thog tu ma babs gong nas sgrub dgos pa yin kyang thal zin der zad/ da dung yang tshad ldan sgrub ma/khan mang po srid na khol bu re bde ba la phan nam snyam nas bris pa dge bar gyur cig /༄༅/ /gsal rgyan gyi dngos zin rnams bkod na/ pha ma sogs la mi/ gus pa/ de dag gi ngag bcag pa/ gzhan la bsam ngan 'chang ba/yon gnas rnams las phyag dang bsnyen bkur blangs pa/ dad rdzas la spyad pa/ pha rol gyi sdig pa'i spyod pa la yi rang byas pa/ de dag gi dge ba'i chos kyi bar chad byas pa/ gzhan gyis dge ba byas pa la ma rang ba/byams la snying ring byas pa/ byas pa mi gzo ba/ rdzun smras nas bden pa'i rgyu mtshan med par byas pa/ phra ma sogs ngag gi lhag ma gsum/ pha rol gyi grags pa ma yin pa gsal bar byed pa'am bla btsag ma bslab gsar bu'i rgyal sras la brnyas pa/ su la'ang khyad gsod byed pa/ chos dang chos smra ba la brten pa'i sdig pa skor/ zang zing gnas yo sogs la ser sna byed pa/ gzhan mi dang dud 'gro la sogs pa'i gnas yo phrogs pa/ chos la dpe mkhyud byed pa/ su la cis kyang rung ste g.yo sgyu byed pa/rang gi nyes pa gzhan la sgyur ba/ khong khro dang 'khon 'dzin/ phrag dogagazhan gyi dran pa dang shes rab 'khrugs su bcug ste gnod pa byed pa/sgyu ma'i drwa ba dang sems skor sogs khong du chud kyi phrin las rgyas pa'i 4/5

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhezhegegs byas pa/ gzhan la 'jigs skrag dang spa bkong ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa/ mi'am dud 'gro sogs gzhan dag gnas grogs 'khor yo sogs sdug pa dang phral ba/ gzhan gyi re thag bcad cing 'dod don la bar chad byas pa rigs ngan gzugs ngan sogs rgas pa nad pa la brnyas pa dang 'phya ba/ pha ma bla ma khrims ldan sogs brnyas shing 'phya ba dang smod pa sems mi bde ba bskyed pa/ gzhan la brdeg 'tshog /pha ma dang khrims ldan dang phongs pa dang nad pa sogs kyi 'tsho ba phrogs pa/gzhan gyi gnas dang yo byad ma rung bar byas pa/ dig lkugs glen gsum sogs 'phyas shing brnyas pa/ chos thun ha cang ring ba dang gzhan gyis klog 'don la tsha 'jun byas pa sogs kyis sun dus chos la 'bral 'dod skyes nyen che bas chos sgrib che ba bshags dgos/ sku gsung thugs rten mun rdul khrod du 'o brgyal bar byas shing dril soka/sa kyis bkur bsti ma bgyis/ / 416

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7 ༄/ /dge tshul dang bya rog gi gtam rgyud/bod yul mdo smad kyi cha shas rdo rol zhes pa'i sa'i thig le brdzi med rnam par rgyal ba'i ri bo'i phang ba na chos legs g.yang 'khyil zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs shig yod de/de ni rab mtho phyogs kyi spyi bor 'dzegs/ /nags kyi skyes bu mang pos nye 'khor gang / /byi'u'i na chung shin tu dul ba rnams/ /de dag pang na glu dbyangs len pas mdzes/ /phyogs der dge ba spyod pa'i gtsug lag khang / /rtsig ngos mkhur bkang byas 'dra zla ba'i mdog /nags tshal tshogs kyis shing bal gzhon nu'i rgyan/ /'bul bas bsnyi stangs bgyis pa lta bu yod/ /gtsug lag khang de na dge sbyong gzhon nu shes pa'i mthu can/ bzhad gad la dga' ba/ bdag nyid smra ba gsal zhing / gzhan gyi smra ba mi mngon par rgyas 'debs pa/ shags kyi mtshon cha can/ 'phags pa nye dga' gnyis pa lta bu zhig yod de/ de'i ming ni bzang po'i blo zhes bya'o/ /nags de na bya rog bum pa'i spyi gtsug ces bya ba sgrin zhing mang du smra ba/ sgyu thabs kyi pha rol du phyin pa zhig kyang gnas so/ /dge tshul des dus dang dus su de la gtor ma byin pas de gnyis ring zhig mdza' bar gyur pa la/ re zhig na dge tshul ni zas kyi yo byad mang ba yin cing / bya rog ni rku ba la dga' ba yin 417

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pas/ sha dum brkus pa'i gzhi las rtsod par gyur te/ des thag pa'i 'phrul 'khor las rdo thog ltar 'beb pa'i skyogs kyi sbyor ba byas nas 'phang bar brtsams pa na/ khwa ta 'dzur la mkhas shing / gab byang bas ma phog go /der dge tshal khros nas ru shing mnyen po las gzhu byas te/༄phyogs bzhir bdas pa dang /bya rog kyang nags nas nags dang / ri'i gseb nas ri'i gseb tu bros so/ /'on kyang de dge tshul khro bo des ma btang bas/ de na re/ ltos shig grong khyer mi dang nags kyi bya/ /shākya'i rab byung chos gos phrag bzar nas//nyes med bya rog nags su rgyu ba la//mda' gzhu rna drung bkang ste tho 'tshams pa/ /skyabs las 'jigs pa byung ba'i ngang tshul 'dir/ /ltos dang rmi lam sdig pa brgya yis kyang / /mtshon min ltas 'di rdo yul shar gyur bas/ /phyir bzlog rig sngags sems pa'i dus la bab/ /ces zer ba dang / dge tshul na re/ rkun po srang nas 'ong ba sa steng srol/ /dben mtho bar snang lam nas chom rkun lhung / /nyam chung sbrang ma spu can khyod 'dras kyang / /mthu ldan rkang gnyis mi la 'phrog dus byung / /sna tshogs zas sbyor bshams pa'i tshong 'dus dang / /g.yos khang dpung pa bsgrigs pa'i grong khyer rnams/ /bor nas drang srong zhi ba'i gtsug lag khang / /nyams nyes byed pa'i bgegs khyod bsad na rung / /byas pa mi gzo brku zhing mang smra mkhan/ /da dung nyes med zer ba'i bzlog thabs can/ /khyod 'dra'i bya than mthong na mda' 418

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7dang gzhus/ /phyir bzlog mi rtsom skyes bu su zhig yod/ /ces zer ro de la bya rog na re/ 'phrog la dpa' zhing shags la mdzangs pa yi/ /'phrul gyi blo can nga 'dra ltas ngan min/ /zhi ba'i chas gyon g.yul gyi brlang spyod can/ /khyod 'dra than du 'gyur la dogs pa skye/ /nam mkha'i rdzong 'dzin sa gzhi'i rdzas 'phrog pa'i/ /chom rkun de 'dra nyam chung brjod mi bya/ /gnas 'dir drang srong zhi ba gnas na ko /sha dum brkus pa'i nyes pa sus mi bzod/ /brkus kyang rang gi rigs kyi las yin phyir/ /'di yis kho bo nyes dang bcas mi 'gyur/ /dka' thub nags su mda' gzhu thogs pa khyod/ /rang gi ston pa'i lugs las brgal bas nongs/ /sngon gyi dge slong 'char kas nga 'dra ba/ /bsad pas shākya'i gtso las spyo ba thob/ /de gong gzhi 'di'i bcas pa ma mdzad phyir/ /'char ka'ang khyod ltar nyes pa byas mi 'gyur/ /zhes zer zhing 'di ltar bya dang bya min med par spyod na 'di la yang ldag tu rung ngo zhes 'phongs bteg ste bstan to/ /de nas dge tshul lhag par yang 'khrugs te/ khros pa'i bzhin bsdus nas/ dmangs rigs rang dgar spyod pas rgyags gyur pa/ /de yis rgyal po rang bzhin bzang bar shes/ /dman las dman pa khyod 'dir dregs smra ba/ /'di yis kho bo brtse dang ldan par rtogs/ /bdag cag drang srong dul ba yin na yang / /khyod ltas gnas min brnyas pa ga la bzod/ /ha cang gtsub na bsil ba'i shing las kyang / /rab 'bar me 419

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po'ir+shalce shin tu tsha ba 'byung / /khyod kyis rkus dang phyi sa za ba dag /rigs/ kyi kun spyod yin zhes bdag nyid sgrogs/ /mtshang 'bru 'dod pa'i bzhad gad mkhan rnams kyang / /de las thu ba ci zhig smra bar 'gyur/ /blun ngo/ rigs sun 'byin pas cher rlom khyod/ /mkhas pa'i nye 'khor 'dug tu ga la dbang / /gnod byed bsam gtan tsher ma khyod med na/ /sdom brtson nags na mda' gzhu ci ste 'dzin/ /ston pas bya rog skrod pa datre tshul la/ /gnang bkag nga rang shes kyi kha rog sdod/ /khyod kyi nyes pa bzlog dka' 'di gzigs nas/ /blo bzang 'char kas pha rol gnon pa mdzad/ /phyi sa za ba khyod kyi bshang sgo la/ /nga 'dra ldag pa rmi lam rmi zer na'ang / /de la pho nya mde'u'i lce rnon can/ /lan smra ma btang btang snyoms 'jog re dkon/ /zer nas mda' gcig 'phang ba dang / /bya rog gis mgo bo smad tsam byas pas steng nas shur gyis song ngo yang gcig 'phang ba bya rog mgrin pa bsrang ste dgyed tsam byas pas/ rkang ba'i bar nas mjug sgro la reg tsam byas te rgyab phyogs kyi sa la zug so /de nas bya rog nam mkha' la 'phur te/ bya'i khyu chen po zhig lho phyogs/ kyi nam mkha' nas byang phyogs kyi mkha' la lding zhing 'gro ba'i nang du zhugs nas/ kha phyir bltas te dge tshul mi dga' bar bya ba'i phyir 'di skad ces/ sprin gyi rlabs ldang gnam sngon chu gter nang / /rgod pa'i sgra sgrogs 'dab bzang tshong ba'i khyu/ /rlung gi gzings la zhon nas 'gro ba 420

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7zhe ni/ /bza' shing nags su rab dga' rnyed par gyur/ /ces smras te song ngo / /dge tshul ni khwa ta 'phur ba'i phyi bzhin steng du blta zhing mda' gzhu thogs te/ kye ma kyi hud/ ngas sngon nas sgyu rtsal zhig ma bslab zer zhing khros pa'i shugs kyis sdod mi bzod par ri'i ngos phan tshun kun tu brgyugs so/ /de phyin chad bya rog nam mthong ba na ni mda'i 'phrul 'phen cing / mi mthong ba'i dus su ni rdo skyog 'phangs pa'i sgra 'brug chen gnam lcags 'bebs pa'i nga ro ltar grags pas nags nas nags su 'jigs pa skyed cing 'gro ste/ de 'phangs pa na ri'i gcong rong shin tu zab cing gting ring ba'i rkyen las brag cha'i sgra snga ma las nyis 'gyur sum 'gyur du che bas ri bo ral ba bzhin du snang ngo / /tshul des nyi ma re re zhing gtses pas khwa ta ches pham par gyur nas/ nam zhig na de rang gi tshang mal yod pa'i ljon shing dang nye ba zhig tu 'dug ste/ mchu sa la sbyar nas snying rje rje ltar snang ba'i ngag tu/ a wa a wa/zhes rdo yul ba'i skad kyis 'o dod bos nas slar yang 'di skad du/ brtse ba'i pha ma ma gtogs pa/ /sus kyang ma bskyang khwa ta'i bu/ /bdag med nags su spyod pa la/ /rgyu mtshan med pa'i gyod cig byung / /gtsug lag 'jig pa'i chom rkun la'ang / /dge sbyong 'tshe ba ma thos te/ /deng ni sha dum chung ngu'i phyir/ /bya rog gnas dang bral bar byas/ /ring nas mdza' bo ltar 'dris pa'i/ /ljon pa yan lag rab bzang dang / /mal 421

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgestan mig mang ris khyod kyang / /deng ni spangs te 'gro ba snyam/ /phangs shing sdug pa'i gnas grogs dang / /bral ba'i sdug bsngal dbal tsha yang //shākya'i dge tshul brtse med pa'i/ /me 'dis kho bo 'di ltar bsregs/ /kye ma'o kyi hud/ da ni chung ma stobs bral ma/ /'ba' zhig khrid de mchi ba na/ /phyogs mtha' phyogs mtha' bya tshogs nang / /nyin bzhin brnyas pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes smras nas ring zhig bsams te/ 'jig rten ni phal cher 'dris pa'i rjes su 'jug pa yin pas/ /de rang gi gnas grogs dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis zhe pham bzhin du mdza' mo gcig pu khrid de shar phyogs kyi nags klung bgrod dka' ba zhig tu song ngo / /der bsti gnas su 'os pa'i ljon shing rtse mo mtho ba/ yal ga stug cing 'dzing la ring bor rgyas pa/ shing chen dang shing phran gyi tshang tshing mang bo'i nang du rgyas btab pa bzhin mi mngon par snang ba zhig btsal te/ tshang shing bsags/ bya spu bsdus te rang gi las kyis thob pa'i shes rab dang shin tu gzu ba'i mchu'i 'du byed kyis bzo legs par sbyar ba'i mal stan yang brtsigs nas 'dug go/ /re zhig cig na des bsam pa/ nags tshal 'di na rgyu ba'i bya rog gzhan rnams ni/ 'di nyid du skyes shing 'di nyid na longs spyod pa ste/ rang gi pha mes kyi khab las ma nyams pa sha stag bo nags tshal gzhan na gnas pa rnams kyang de kho na bzhin te/ rang bi yul mi 'jigs par spyod pa sha stag yin na/ bdag gcig pu ni/ rang 422

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7gi yul 'khor nas thon te/ gzhan gyi yul du dman zhing dman pa'i yid kyis rlung gis bus pa'i shing lo bzhin 'khyams shing 'dug ste/bdag gis dge tshul ngan pa de la 'jig rten pha rol du yang khon 'dzin spang bar mi nus so snyam mo/ /yang bsam pa la/ gcig pu snying las chung bas bde/ /dbul po 'du 'god nyung bas bde/ /yul med rang dbang thob pas bde/ /mnga' bran 'gro 'ong sla bas bde/ /de'i phyir da ni dge tshul gtum po des bdag la ci yang byar med kyis/bdag gis khon lan glan pa'i dus ni 'di yin no snyam nas/ de nangs re bzhin dge tshul gtsug lag khang du kha ton dang bsam gtan byed cing 'dug pa'i dus su glags rnyed par shes te/ dus der chung ma dang bcas par lhags pa dang / gtsug lag khang pa'i phyi rol du phyugs kyi sha tsho zhing zhim pa zas kyi ched du gzhan las nyos pa dag thag pa'i gdang la brgyus te/ nyi ma la bzhag pa mthong ste/ ji tsam 'dod par zos shing sha'i lhag ma la bya thal btang nas song ngo / /tshul des yang dang yang du tho brtsams pa la/ dus ring zhig lon pa dang dge tshul gyis tshor nas shug pa'i mda' gzhu mal drung du blangs te bya ra byed do/ /de nas yang nangs snga zhig na bya rog sngar bzhin 'ong nas sha mang du zos pa dang /dge tshul gyis sgra'i mtshan ma las shes te/ skyil mo krung myar ba myar bar /te/ 111 ༷te/ 35sdonor /reshe/)byenor rdo/sgob ga nas mda' gzhu sags nga song ba las/ bya ga sa san pa 423‘

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lgeyin pas tshor nas nye 'khor gyi shing zhig gi rtser 'phur te 'dug go /dge tshul phyi rol tu thon pa dang / bya rog na re/ byon pa legs so nags kyi spong ba pa/ /yang dag 'jog las bzhengs ma thag pa khyod/ /khyod kyi rjes thob spyod pa'i tshul 'di yis/ /mnyam bzhag spyod yul shin tu zhi bar rtogs/ /nyin bzhin bya tshogs gtses nas nangs bar dus/ /byams/ dang mi 'tshe ston pa'i gtsug lag rnams/ /kha ton byed khyod rang gi lce la yang / /ngo tshar mi sems gdong lpags shin tu 'thug /bsam gtan mal du tshangs pa'i rgyal ltar zhi/ /thang dang khyams na srin po'i 'khor ltar khro/ /bden bral 'dod dgur bsgyur pa'i gzugs can lta'i/ /rnal 'byor spyod khyod ring mo zhig nas mthong / /zhes smras pas/ des skyag zan khyod kyi gdams ngag gis kho bo zhi bar 'gyur snyam mam/ khyod kyis/ gtsug lag khang gi nyer spyad rgya chen po nyams par byas pa mi dran nam//tshod mi shes pa'i blun po khyod sdod cig ces mda' gzhu bkang ste bdas/ so/ /der bya rog mo gtsug lag khang gi rgyab phyogs nas byung ste/ bya thal 'thor zhing / 'di snyed phyugs rnams khyod kyis su las brkus/ /spong ba'i nags su sha 'di gang nas byung / /bas mthar 'di 'dra'i las kyis dregs pa khyod/ /gdams pas zhi bar ma 'gyur de re bden/ /zer nas gnyis ka nam mkha' la kya kyur rtse zhing song ngo / /de'i tshe gtum spyod nyi ma dpal zhes pa gdol ba'i rigs las yi ge klog pa'i slob dpon du 424

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7gyur pa zhig gtsug lag khang de'i phyogs gcig na 'dug go /des dge tshul dang bya rog de ltar 'gras pa thos nas dge tshul gyi drung du phyin te smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod gtsug lag khang na klog pa dang spong bas dus 'da' ba dang / bya rog nags kyi nang du grong 'dabs nas gzhan gyis bor ba rnyed pa za zhing 'dug pa gnyis ci zhig la rtsod/ de lta mod kyi khyod cag rgyu mtshan chung ngu'i phyir du rtsod cing 'dug go zhes thos kyi de kho bos zhi bar bya na/ slan chad zhi ba'i nags su rtsod pa'i me ma spor cig khyod kyis legs par soms shig dang / /grags pa mi sdug du ba'i rgyal mtshan can/ /rtsod pa'i bud shing la ni 'jus zin na/ /khyod kyi khro ba'i me lce ma zhi 'di/ /gang la gnas de zhib mos bsam par gyis/ /su 'grogs yid la mthun par byed pa'i mi/ /mang pos bkur ba 'jig rten rig pa dang / /mi 'tshes legs gyur chos kyi lugs yin na/ /blo gros gsal ba khyod lta su zhig rtsod/ /de phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal drag po'i dug/'phrog byed gzu bo'i ngag gis sman byed pa/ /khyed la bsam pa dge ba'i tshul bsam nas/ /nad gso'i sbyor ba 'bras med mi 'gyur byos/ /dge tshul gyis lan smras pa/ grogs po khyod kho bo la sman par 'dod pa ni bden mod kyi/ bdag cag gtsug lag khang gcig na bgo skal gcig la spyod pa yin pas/ phan tshun bsam pa bzang ba la ngo mtshar du bya ba yang med do/ /'on kyang kho bo ni/ rtsod dang 'du 'dzis 'jigs nas 425

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nags su byol/ /mi med nags 'dir khwa tas rtsod pa spel/ /rtsod pa'i khur bu ma bskur mchog yin kyang / /las kyis thob 'di da ni mthar phyung bya/ /gdol ba'i slob dpon gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa bya rog gis thang nas sha dum rnyed de khyer ba gang yin pa de ni khyod la rtsod par 'dod nas ma yin te/ 'di ni thang nas rnyed pa tsam la spyod par zad kyi/ bdag po dang bcas pa dang bdag po med pa'i rnam dbye mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /khyod kyis bag tsam gzhi las ngan skyug gi /'dam rdzab dkrugs pa'i ngal ba lhur blangs na/ /de yis 'dam rdzab pham par mi 'gyur gyi/ /rang nyid grags pa ngan pa'i dris gos 'gyur/ /gang phyir mu cor smra ba'i rjes bsnyegs nas/ /mkhas pa ku sha'i rtse la rlung phog bzhin/ /bskyod pa'i tshal min nags sa spel mthong na/ /bsngags min mi rigang rigang sgrogs dpyod ldan su zhig mchi/ /gang mthus khyod la bya rnams kyang / /glan ka tshol ba ltar snang ba/ /ma bzad yid kyi sgyu ma mkhan/ /'di la su zhig yid rton 'gyur/ /dug lo ma smin dus su 'breg pa bzang / /nags me ma mched dus su gzhil la bzang / /rtsod pa'i chu bo chos dang grags pa yi/ /shing rtsa ma zos dus su bzlog pa bzang / /de nas dge tshul gyis/'di ni bdag la snying brtse bar sems pa yin pas shags kyis spyo bar bya ba'i yul ma yin no snyam nas smras pa/ kwa ye shes ldan khyod kyis kho bo cag gi 'khon zhi bar bya ba'i sgo zhig mthong na/ re zhig de ston cig 426

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7dang / bsam par bya'o/ /gdol bas smras pa/ thub pa'i skye bo dul zhing zhi bas 'phags/ /rten dang mu cor smra bas bya rog nyams/ /de yis de la pha rol gnon bstan na/ /chen po'i mthu rtsal ci zhig bstan par 'gyar/ //redro hāXste /skre) 111 /re/ hāX//tsā/ byeX/(1) dang ldan pa steyod cag gatsho sa — 'a na bar bya ba yang na no/ /de lta mod kyi rtsod pa 'di'i byung ba legs par gtan la phab nas phyis kyang bstan par bya'o/ /zhes smras pa dang / de cang mi zer ro de nas gdol ba'i slob dpon gyis dge tshul cung zad dul bar shes nas/tshe dang ldan pa cang mi smra ba ni rjes su gnang ba'i mtshan mar 'jig rten na grags te khyod kyang 'di ltar cang mi smra bas bdag gis ji skad smras pa 'di gnang bar 'dzin to zhes smras te song ngo / /de'i nyin zhag phyi ma la zan dang sha dang khur skya'i dum bu 'ga' zhig thogs te bya rog gnas pa'i nags su phyin pa dang / bya rog ni 'khu 'khrigs za ba yin pas tshang nas 'byung du ma 'dod pa na/des zas kyi lhag ma de gtor ro//ring zhig na de dag bza' ba'i phyir 'ong bar gyur te/ de lta na'ang / mi ni phal cher ma rungs shing bslu ba nyid kyi phyir/ 'dis kyang bdag la tho 'tsham par 'gyur grang zhes/ rlung gis shin tu bskyod pa'i mar me'i rtse mo ltar phan tshun du blta bas brel zhing / mgrin pa cher bsrang ba dang cher bskum pa dang / ro stod nam mkha' la btegs shing lta ba dang / sa gzhi la bskus pa snyam byed cing lta ba la sogs te rnam 'gyur mang pos 427

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshe'ikhyo'abros par rtsom pa gdol ba'i slob dpon gyis mthong nas/ mkhas pa bden par smra bas mgu/ blun po ngo bstod byas na mgu/ zhes bya ba yin pas/ 'di la ngo bstod dang 'brel ba'i gtam zhig bya'o snyam nas smras pa/ dus la lta zhing tshang nas dus su 'byung / /'jig rten shes pas kun la yid ma rton/ /bag dang ldan phyir rang spyod legs bsrung ba'i/ /'dab chags mkhas khyod nags kyi thig le yin/ /'on kyang bdag la ni khyod 'jigs par bya mi dgos te/ 'di ltar bdag gis rgyus bsnyad par bya na/ bdag ni gdol ba nyi ma dpal/ /bas mtha'i gtsug lag khang na gnas/ /deng ni khyod dang bzang po'i blo'i/ /rtsod pa sdum phyir 'dir 'ongs so/ /tshig de thos nas bya rog kyang cung zad bag phebs par gyur te smras pa/ gang na yid kyi tsher ma de gnas pa'i/ /gtsug las khang pa'i gtam la bdag mi spro/ /'on kyang bdag cag rigs dang rjes/ mthun pas/ /gdol ba zhes bya'i sgra 'di rna bar snyan/ /bdag ni 'dab bzang bum pa'i spyi gtsug ste/ /shing thog bre yis gzhal ba du ma dang / /yal ga'i lag pa 'brel ba'i shing chen dang / /'khri shing mang po'i khyim la dbang bar gyur/ /de nas dge tshul bzang po'i blo gros la/ /'thab mo spel ba'i blo gros skyes gyur nas/ /kho bo sgren mo lag stong 'phyan pa yi/ /shes pa'i rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra 'di dag sprul/ /bzang po'i blo mnga' dge spyod zhi ba yi/ /bzang dang zhi ba'i mdzad pa 'di yin na/ /zla bas 428

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7gdungs bskyed sngon med rgud pa 'di/ /ji lta bur na khyod kyis sel bar 'gyur/ /gdol bas smras pa/ yid ni phyi rol la bltas nas/ /gzhan skyon tshol na mkhas pa ste/ /de ltar nang la mngon phyogs nas/ /bdag nyid dpyod la zhugs tshe min/ /ji ltar khyod la smra ba'i rgyus/ /gzhan ni mu cor smrar shes te/ /de khyod rang nyid kyis ni bdag /snyan dgu smra la mkhas par sems/ /dge tshul na re zas kyi drin lan du/ /rku bas gnod byed bya rog mi srun pa/ /kho nas nongs zer khyod ni 'di lta bur/ /rang gis nongs pa'i gtam tsam yod mi snang / /bzhin bzang de'i phyir khyod kyang blo gzu por gnas nas bdag nyid bsam par bya ste/ kho bo'i ngal ba'ang 'bras bu dang bcas par bya'o/ /zhes bsgos nas song ngo / /dus gzhan zhig na sos ka'i dus ston la bab pa'i tshe/ shags kyi rgyal pham nyan pa'i bya rnams bsdus shing / bya rog dang dge tshul gnyis kyang bos te/ gdol bas smras pa/ shing rnams lag pa me tog khur bus dud/ /bya tshogs rtse bas dregs pa'i ca co yis/ /phyogs kyi mdzes ma sos ka'i chang 'thung bas/ /myos pa'i glu len lta bur dus 'di dga'/ /brtan g.yo mtha' dag dpyid kyi bu mo dang / /lhan cig kun dga'i bdud rtsi 'thung ba na/ /rtsod pas rang gi bde ba 'joms byed pa'i/ /khyod kyi las 'dis dgos pa ci zhig 'thob/ /gang gis khyed cag yun ring na gyur pa'i/ /'khon chen dug de bdag dang cang shes kyi/ /bya brgya 'dus pa'i mdun 429

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tsulgezhet+yā'adir skyug cig dang / /tshul bzhin na ba yin min gdod shes 'gyur/ /der khu byug dang / 'jol mo dang / bya rog chen po dang / 'ol ba la sogs pa bya'i rgan rabs rgan rabs rnams kyang gdol ba ji skad zer ba bzhin dbyangs gcig tu smra zhing / kha gcig 'khri shing rnams kyi rtse rno/ na tog lta bu dang / gzhan dag yal ga'i lag rtse na pi waṃ ltar 'khod de cang mi zer bar nyan cing 'dug go de la bzang blo na re/ don 'di la mang du ci zhig smra ste/ kho bo gtsug lag khang bar bsam gtan dang kha ton byed pa la mang du smra ba dang / mu cor smra ba dang / gsang mthor mri bas lan gcig ma yin par tho brtsams shing / brku ba dang / 'phrog pa'i gnod pa byed pa'i phyir/ bum pa'i spyi gtsug kho na dug sbyor bar zad de/ 'di nyid kho na dug 'thor ba dang / dug gi shugs mi zad pa/ gtong ba yin no zer ro/ /bum pa'i mgo na re/ kha ton sus 'don la sus mi 'don te/ bkres pa'i dka' thub bstan/ nyi ma la sbyin sreg byed/zas kyi bsam gtan la gnas/ yul ngan la thog brdzis gtong zhing / a wa'i gsang sngags zlo ba de nga'i kha ton yin/ rang gi sems las su ma/ rungs pa la mi sems pas/ gzhan gyi kha ton kho nas kho bo'i yon tan gyi khyad par ma thob zer ba'i dge tshul g.yon can 'di'i spyi brtol la ltos dang / a wa wa/ de ltar kho bo dka' thub kyi nags su rig sngags/ 'don pa la log par sgrub cing / da dung rang nyid bsam gtan par mri 430

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ba'i gzu lum can 'di nyid kho na spyod pa'i rtsa ba yin te/ bdag gis ni 'khon lan glan pa'ang med na/ rtsod pa bslang pa lta ci zer ro/bzang blo na re/ dud 'gro'i snyigs ma/ bya brgya'i gdol ba/ khyod 'dra ba bskrad kyang ci zhig nongs te bskrad par 'os pa gnas nas bton pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /deng shākya'i sras po skal bzang rgyal rigs mkhas pa'i bla ma/ lha rnams kyang lung len par byed pa rnams la sngon sus kyang de ltar tho 'tshams ma myong / bya ngan khyod 'dras sngon chad nam yang cang shes kyi mi la gnod pa de 'dra thab myong pa shes sam/bam pa'i mgo na re/rigapho nisir+sharab byung gis mda' thogs nas nags su bya bshor ba'i rabs shig kyang sngon nam yang 'jig rten du byung ba shes sam/ byas mi la drag shul ches che ba bstan pa dang / de ltar bstan yang gyod med pa'i lugs srol sngon dus nas gnas pa ni/ bya'i rgyal po gshog bzang gis ka shi'i rgyal po bsad pa'i byung ba khyod nyid kyis sde snod 'don pa'i sgra las thos na/da khyod rang gi tshig la'ang log par sgrub bam/ bzang blo na re/ rab byung gis bya rog bskrad pa tsam du ma zad bsad pa yang sngon chad byung ba'i tshul dge slong 'char ka'i byung ba sngar bdag cag gnyis thog mar rtsod pa'i dus su khyod nyid kyis tshur la bsnyad pa mi dran nam/ bya yi rgyal po gshog bzang la bya yi rgyal po zer ba de bya ngan gdol ba tha chad khyod dang mi mnyam pa'i rtags yin pas/ khyod dang nam mkha' 431

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+shalding gnyis riṭa pa ga la mtshungs/ mtshungs su chug kyang ngas khyod la mi zas kyi bgo bsha' byas pa'i drin lan du sngar chom rkun byas pas ma tshim par/ da dung gshog bzang gis ka shi'i rgyal po la ji ltar byas pa/ de ma grub pas snying na'am/ bum pa'i mgo na re/ 'char ka dang bya ros gzhan gyi yul du 'phrad pa dang / kho bo rang yul na sdod pa glo bur pa'i skye bos bskrad pa gnyis kyang ga la mtshungs/ khyod kho bo'i yul du 'duka nas sa rin zas kyis bcal ba la drin ci zhig dran par bya/ khyod kyi ma bstab pa'i sha dum bdag gis khyer ba yang yul bdag gis dpya khral blangs pa yin pas ci zhig nongs par 'gyur/ 'on kyang kho bo rang si yul na nyes pa med bzhin bskrad pas khyod kho na shin tu nongs can no//bzang blo na re/ gling 'di la 'dzam gling mi yi yul zhes 'jig rten na shes kyis mtho ris gnyis pa bya yi yul zhes su yis zer/ de'i phyir khyod ni rtag tu gzhan yul na gnas pa yin na sa rin dang dpya khral yang ji ltar dbang bar 'gyur/ der yang ma zad de/ khyod mi yul na gnas pa/ de srid du rngon pa rnams kyi ri dwags dang khyim bdag rnams kyi phyugs ltar mi'i longs spyod kho na yin pas brdung ba dang bskrad pa yang mi nyid dbang ngo / /bum pa'i mgo na re/ sa gzhi 'byung po 'dzin ma 'di 'a gangs rtse'i seng ge nas khung gi phyi ba'i bar gyi byol song mang po sprang po'i gos la shig ltar 'khrigs nas 'dug ste/ de thams cad gling 'di 432

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7 mi yul yin gyi bya yul min zhes pa'i rigs pa 'dis gnas nas dbyung bar nus sam/ de las gzhan du na kho bo gcig pu bskrad pa shin tu yus so/ khyod na re bya mi'i longs spyod yin zer te/ de lta yin na kho bos sha dum khyer ba'ang phyug po'i skyems lhag phyug po'i khyis 'thung bar zad pas ji ltar na gyod 'byung bar 'gyur/ bzang blo na re/ kha smyo ba/ lag rku ba/ sha za ltar glags 'tshol ba/ khyod gcig pu ma gtogs/ gzha na gyis kho bo la tho mi 'tshams pas de dag ga la skred/ gzhan yang khyod lhag ma za ba'i khyi yin zer ba bden nam/ yul 'di'i sa bdag rgyal po yin pa bden ('dir ma phyir tshig 'ga' chad dam snyam)na sa skyong gis lhag ma za ba'i rabs shig smros dang / spyir yang sa gzhi skyong pa zhes bya ba byams pas 'jig rten gyi rdzi bo byed pa gcig yin gyi/ phyi sa kham gang gi don du chung ma la phyi thag stung ba khyod 'dra zhig yin re kan/ bum pa'i mgo na re/ kho bos khyod dka' thub kyi nags su byams pa la gnas pa'i drang srong gi spyod tshul can du shes kyi/ 'dab chags rang skad smra ba dang /bkres pas rgum bu thu ba la de tsam du tho 'tshams par brtsi ba ma shes te/ byi'u khug rta yang rang gi tshang mal du 'dug nas skad ci dgar 'byin cing / zas kyi ched du phyogs bzhir 'gro yang de sus kyang dgag pa mi snang ngo / /khyod kyi smra ba gzhan yang 'brel med yin te/ 'di ltar khyod kyis bya rnams mi yi longs spyod du smra ba dang / de la longs spyod du 433

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brtsis pa'i gces spras mi byed pa gnyis nang 'gal bar brjod pa'i phyir/ khyi'i dpe bstan pa yin gyi kho bo'i pha ma dang / phu nu 'di snyed cis phyogs 'dir gna' bo'i dus nas ci ste yod/ de tsam zhig ma gtogs skyes pa'i pha yul zhes bya ba yang rwa zing nge ba zhig gang nas btsal/bzang blo na re/ bye'u khug rta ni 'dab chags cang shes yin te/ rdza rnga bzhin du re 'ga' na snyan par sgrogs pa dang / khyod blun po dus mi shes pa dus dang dus min med par ku co 'don pa gnyis ci'i phyir dpe don rigs par 'gyur/ khug rta bdag po med pa'i zas sgrub pa dang / khyod gzhan gyis yongs su bzung ba'i rdzas 'phrog pa gnyis kyang gzhan la tho brtsam par ga la mnyam/ khyod kyis rang nyid sa skyong du smras pa'i khas blangs med ces zer ba de ni shin tu legs te khyod 'di lta ra khas blangs pa ma brjed par gyis shig gnod byed lham nang gi rdo ba khyod kyi phu nu 'di na yod pas/ 'di khyod kyi rang yul du ci'i phyir 'grub ste/ khwa ta gnod 'tshe mang / pha mes dang yang mes sogs kyi ring la gzhan dang 'gras nas rang yul nas bton pa'ang yin srid pa'i phyir te/ dper na da res rang gi kun spyod nyes pas las nyams pa bzhin no//bum pa'i mgo na re/ rtag tu 'grogs pas nongs na ca co can gyi 'bab chu la'ang rtsod par gyis shig rdzas ma byin pa khyer bas nongs na bar snang gi rlung la'ang pha rol gnon pa ston cig dang / kye 434

zla bye〉 /spro////te/the/spro/ /bye/1/spro///spros// /rdo/rgo2ཿཿna/ rdotāshā/ma'o/ sno la bya dgos pa mang ngo / /de las gzhan du kho bo la ni ming sa skyong du 'dogs sam mi 'dogs kyang bla'i/ gnas 'di kho bo'i yul yin pa lo kyis khas blangs zin pas bdag gis mang du smras pa'i dgos pa grub kyis/ da ni kho bo mang du smra ba la mi brtson no/ /bzang blos smras pa/ kho bos ji ltar khas blangs/ bum mgos smras pa/ khwa ta rang yul nas gton pa'i mthun dper kho bo nags tshal 'di nas bskrad pa khas blangs pas/ ji ltar ma blangs zhes smras pa dang / dge tshul cang mi zer ro/ de nas gdol ba pash+lau tas/ rtsod pa'i thog ma bya rog gis bslangs pas bya rog nongs pa che tshul/ mi 'tshams pa'i 'khon lan dge tshul gyis brtsams pas dge tshul nongs pa che tshul/ de gnyis bya ba'i ngos nas nongs tshod 'dra mnyam yin yang rten gyi ngos nas dge tshul nongs chen yin tshul dang nyes pa che tshul/ gzhan yang bya rog byas pa ma gzo bas nyams pa dang / dge tshul dka' thab kyi nags su brlang rang /de spyod byed pa sogs de gnyis nongs pa mtshungs tshul dang / mtshungs pa'i tshul mang po zhig bstan nas/ phyin chad dge tshul gyis dus dang dus su bya rog la ston mos mchod pa bya ba dang / de'i tshe bya rog gis kyang tshangs pa'i mkhur tshos nas byung ba'i yi ge oṃ a thā zhes bya ba 'dis dge tshul la shis pa brjod par bya ba sogs khrims su bcas nas rtsod pa zlum pa'i dga' ston yang byas so//nyi ma 'phrin las kyis bris pa yin no//435

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trar+sha༄/ /sprang phyug shags 'gyed/phyug po bu brgya ma zer ba de'i sgor sprang po shig slog can zhig byung nas/ nyi ma'i nang du shig 'thu zhing bsdad pas/ phyug pos de la bltas nas khong 'dzum cig shor te/ 'di skad zer/ phyi rol dgra rkun 'ong snya ma mi dgos kyang / /nang du shig gi srin pos gson zos byed/ /nyin mtshan bar med shig dang g.yul sprad pas/ /sen mo'i mtshon cha zad de las yur bud/ /lpags zad lag sor rtse nas khrag 'dzags shing / /sha dri lus mdog nag la snum zhag bral/ /skra rnams shig sro gnyis kyis g.yeng zhing 'gul/ /khyi mang nang du sprang po thang chad bzhin/ /bros pas mi thar rang gi lus las skyes/ /bsad pas mi 'dzad gos kyi phyi nang khyab/ /sprugs pas mi 'bud skra rtsa shig gis bzung / /skyur ba 'i thabs med mi gcis gos gcig rang / /su 'grogs mi rnams shig med shig tshang byed/ /su/sa mthong mi kun 'go ba'i nad ltar lta/ /mi khyur mi tshud gar song mi yis brnyas/ /hrul bo'i shig slog lus gdon bzhin du 'brang / /dgra yin byas na rang skyes bu dang 'dra/ /gnyen yin byas na lus khrag dron mo 'thung / /'chos na bu ro bskyang na dgra bas sdang / /dgra thabs zin chus gang yang byar mi btub/ /nag po'i skra la sro ma'i 'bru dkar chags / /436

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7'jam po'i lpags rnams 'brum bu'i phung por song / /sos dal lag pa brel bas gzer zhing ngal/ /dang ba'i bzhin ras shig gi zag rngas sdud//char zi pho 4zer zur༄ la༄thomajug ri'i ༄༄mi zi snakya ma rnam pa sna chags las thabs kyas/ /ma la 'cha sbyad 'byung pa mngon sum lta'i/ /shig sro gnyis dang rum bsdong shig gi dris/ /yi ga 'chu ba'i sprang po snying re rje/ /zhes smras pa/ sprang po'i mtshang la phog nas lan smras pa/ khyod kyi khyim sgo lam gsum bu yis gang / /pha ma'i tshe srog za ba'i lus skyes dgra /tshe mjug sdug la 'khor ba'i gsar byung 'dre/ /de yis drag na nga yang shig gis drag /g.yas nas ngu zhing g.yon nas rgyug 'dre byed/ /'tshig dang dgod dang ku co sna tshogs kyis/ /skad cig bsdad kyang 'phral la gzeng nus pas/ /'dre dmag mngon sum khyim du bab pa bzhin/ /'dug na sprel dmag mang pos gtse zhing spyo/ /za tshe yi dwaṭa tshogs kyis phor bu 'degs/ /nyal yang ngu 'tshig sgra yis gnyid 'phrog pa/ /de 'dra'i byur ngan khyod kyi khyim na mchis/ /che mtho'i mal stan gcin dang rtug pas sbag /gtsang sbyar zas kyi snod rnams dri mar byed/ /gces shing phangs pa'i rdzas mang bcag cing bkrum/ /gos dang gdong gi ngos la mchil ma 'debs/ /zho dang 'o ma mar khu'i tshogs mang po/ /tshang mar thal ba dkrugs pas khyim kun khyab/ /slan chad phyags ma thogs pa brgya yis kyang / /khyim de phyi dor bya bar nus ma yin/ /khang khyim mdzod dang thang rnams lhas su bsgyur/ /mdzod kun dbyig dang 437

21rngad/ 17 jordo sdispyings khur:drob/thag byasarngasno rngakubastazud rta):re po/sdisajing khuradra/zug/ po〉lhas mal phyugs kyis gang / /'on kyang 'khyag ltogs gnyis kyis tshe yo la ba/ /ba zhes za 'dre mang po yod pa'i mtha/ /pha ma'i bag yangs bde ba'i rigargya rigaphodaga' ston dang / /sha khrag zad zad bsags pa'i zas gos nor/ mnyam du zos nas byas yus che che ltar/ /ngu ba'i 'dre shig can khyod snying rje'i yul/ /zhes zer ro/ /de phyug po'i byis pa rnams kyis tshor nas/ci zer/ sprang po sdug dred/ rang sdug pa la ngu rgyu bskyur nas/ mi skyid pa la 'phya bzhad byed pa/ phyug po'i khyim gzhis mis bzung ba dang / khyod kyi stsag hrul shig gis gang ba gnyis 'dra zer ram/ 'dra na khyod nged kyi sgor sprang phor rgya rdza tsam bzed nas ci la 'ong / zhes rdo dang dbyus pa dang thal ba'i char 'bebs shing brgyugs pas/ sprang po myur du langs/ te gom pa bca' bcu tsam phar bros nas byis pa'i tshogs la lta zhing /phung shig khyed rnams ma mthong na/ /phyug pos sprang phor 'dzed nyen yo da//sprang po shig la sun srid kyang / /hrul po'i gos la phangs sems med/ /nu/ to'i shig rnams 'grang tsa na/ /gos ngan sbugs su kha rog nyal/ /khyed rnams 'grang tshad zos nas kyang / /ma yi pang na 'tshig cing ngu/ /pha 'a/ za bas shig dang 'dra/ /kha lto che la khyed cag lhag /phyug po 'drad pas ma tshim par/ /sprang po za la rngam mam ci/ /sprang po shig la mi 'jigs te / /shig brgyag sa yong na za rgyu yin/ /ltogs pa byung na gso rgyu yin/ /coka dang am phrag bcug pas chog /sprang po bros kyang mi 'thogs te/ /kos 438

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ste lang bas gzhis rdzogs yin/ /bu smad mang po'i gdos thag las/ /'chor med phyug po snying re rje//zhes smras nas yang bros te song ngo ////༄khya/ /skya ka khra mo dang gleng mol byas pa/ngas skya ka la 'di byas/ bya skya ka khra mo'i 'dab ma bskyod na/ /shing bal gyi yang khyad ngo re tsha ste/ /thugs rlom sems mthon pos che thang ma mdzad//bya spu'i she mong e dran 'dab bzang gi grogs po/ /byas pas/ kho na re/ khyed 'jam dar skyid po'i mal nang nyal tshe/ /phyug po tsho'i gces phrag 'dra la khad de/ /thugs rkyal pa phus gter shag po ma mdzad/ /ram ༄pa'i zhal zas e dran 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ ngas kho la/ sha zos na zhim pa'i tshang ra tshil rkyal/ /sku khog tu slebs dus mnog po yod de/ /zas srog dang bsdos nas 'tshang khra (kha)ma mdzad/ /gyang zhal ba e gzigs su spu sdug gi grogs po/ /byas pas/ khos nga la/ nor bsags na 'phel ba'i dngul sgrom rgyab khal/ /mdzod khang na bzhugs dus zhal ngo dro ste/ srog 'ben la bzhag nas ldom bu ma mdzad/ /gung phyi'i zas thang e gzigs 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ /ngas kho la yang / mchu gzan la rno ba kha mchu'i gzhi ma/ /'byon lam nas kha twa'i ru sna bsham 'dug /bya 'ol ba ser po'i lad mo ma mdzad/ /sku shugs rang tshod e zin 439

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mkha' lding gi grogs po/ /byas pas/ nga la khos/ blo rig pa'i rnam 'phrul byar ngan gyi sna 'dren/ /snyigs dus kyi sems can ko long dam 'duka /༄khong sngon rabs mkhas pa'i lad mo ma mdzad/ /rnam dpyod rang tshod e zin 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ /yang ngas kho la/ zas hab thob mdzad pa bya brgya'i chos nyid/ /gdung ma dang dral phyam khang pa'i shing cha/ /k+shing khang pa'i logs la spu 'thor ma mdzad/ /gzigs tshad kha zas e red gshog bzang gi grogs po/ /byas pas/ khos nga rang la/ gto tshogs gral 'grims pa gto bla'i chos nyid/ /dkon mchog la phul ba dkor gyi gnyan shos/ /rten mchod chas spyan gzigs nga'i yin ma mdzad/ /zangs zhun lto bas e thub 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ /ngas kho la/ mtshan zla ba bkam 'dra'i gzugs su mdzes kyang / /ngan skyug gi zhal zas dri ngad de mnam pas/ /shing jo dar yu ba dril phyis ma mdzad/ /gsung rab bkur sti e yin 'phur 'gro yi grogs po/ /byas pas/ khos nga la/ gzan ngur smrig na bza' mtshan sprin las lhag kyang / /ldan grol gyi bslab bya gu yangs la bzhag nas/ /'khor slob ma sdud pa'i bshes gnyen ma mdzad/ /bstan 'dzin rnam thar e red 'jigs med kyi bstan rgyam/ /zer bas ngas kho la/ a cang ku re yin mod 'dab bzang gzhon nu/ /rtse sgros gnam 'phang gcod pa mkha' lding gi khyad chos/ /sdig zas sha la rngam pa sngon las kyi rgyu mthun/ /bden rigs khyod la yod do bden mri/ 440

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7yi skya ka /byas pas khos kyang nga la/ bden bden nga la yod na byol song rang min mod/ /a cang snyigs mar spyod pa'i rang rtags 'di min na/ /bden smra'i drang srong mchog cig sangs rgyas rang yin te/ /snal ma ser po can tsho'i res mo la babs yod// zer nas 'phur song / zhes pa'ang ngas bris so//ha ha// //༄/ /a kha the le'i rnam bshad/bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi zad spobs pa'i 'byung gnas lhag pa'i lha/ /'jam mgon snying gi nyi ma la btud nas/ /gnad zab tshig gi rnam par gzhag pa ni/ /rnam bzhi'i rnam bshad shin tu bsdus te bya/ /a zhes bya ba dgag pa'i sgra yin te/ /gang la zhe na ma rabs skye bo'i tshig /gang zhig ce na dam pa'i legs bshad dag /gang phyir zhe na don med don log phyir/ /ji ltar lus can dag gi mkhris pa'i ro/ /de la mngar ba'i ro ni yod ma yin/ /de bzhin ma rabs blun po rnams kyi ngag /de la rnam gzhag bzang po yod ma yin/ /de phyir shin tu ma rabs rnams kyi tshig /mkhas pa rnams kyis dgag par bya ba ste/ /legs cha med dang spang bya yin pas na/ /a zhes gzur gnas rnams kyis srid 'dir bsgrags/ /kha zhes bya ba gtam gyi sgo yin te/ /skyes bu tha shal rnams kyi kha nyid ni/ /'dor 'os smad par bya ba'i ngag mang po/ /441

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zher+sha'abyung ba'i gzhi zhes mkhas pas rtogs par bya/ /ji ltar rdul nyog khrod nas 'ong ba'i chu/ /kun tu rnyog mas dkrug pa yin zhes bya/ /de bzhin ma rabs kha nas 'ong ba'i tshig /kun tu nyes pas dkrug pa kho nar zad// /ma rabs kha la dgag byar bstan shugs las/ /kha yi brjod pa slong ba'i yid dang ni/ /kha dang mtshungs pa'i lus kyi spyod pa'ang / /de yis mtshon nas spang byar bstan pa yin/ /the le zhes pa sdug bsngal sgra yin te/ /ma/ rabs yid kyis ma rabs tshig brjod cing / /ma rabs spyod pa rtag tu spyod byed na/ /de ni rtag tu duḥkhas 'debs par 'gyur/ /'di na gang la skye bo rnams kyis ni/ /smod cing phyar ka gtong ba la sogs pa/ /'di kun ma rabs spyod las 'byung ba ste/ /'di bzhin tshe rabs gzhan du'ang the le le/ /ji ltar lus ni gang na 'gro gyur ba/ /de na de yi grib ma/ rjes su 'gro/ /de bzhin ma rabs gang du song gyur kyang / /sdug bsngal the le mi bzad rjes su 'gro/ /de phyir tshig 'di rnams kyi brjod bya ni/ /ma rabs spongs zhes dngos su bstan pa dang / /ya rabs bsgrub ces shugs la bstan pas na/ /mi chos 'dod pas don 'di rtogs par gyis/ /a kha the le'i rnam par bshad pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i mched po kun bzang 'jigs med kyi/ /bzhed pa ji bzhin gzhon nu 'jigs med pas/ /gang dran lhug par brjod pa maṅga lam̐// //442

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7༄/ /lo gsar ston bshad/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis dga' ston gyi 'dun sa/ lha mi'i gral ring bshams pa'i gnas 'dir/ lugs gnyis kyi legs tshogs dang 'brel ba'i gtam nyung ngu zhig mchod pa'i tshul du spro na/ yas gtam dam pa chos kyi byung tshul/ mas gtam 'jig rten srid pa'i chags tshul/ byas shes bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus dang gsum las/ /yas gtam la'ang ston pa sangs rgyas byon tshul/ bstan pa dam chos dar tshul/ bstan 'dzin dge 'dun gyi sde mched tshul rgya che la rnam grangs mang po yod kyang phyogs bsdus rags rim tsam bshad par bya ste//de la gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'dzam gling yul gyi gtso bo/ sems can gyi snying po mang du gnas pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du/ dus phun sum tshogs pa yar snga ma ches skye dgu skyo shas che ba/ mar 'phyi ma drags dbang rnon rgyud smin pa'i gdul bya 'byung ba rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya ba'i dus su/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa sa gsum gyi rnam 'dren gcig pu mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'jig rten du byon te/ de'ang thog mar dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang du lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar zhes bya bar gyur nas bzhugs pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskul nas 'phags pa ma pham pa rgyal tshab tu bzhag ste shākya'i rgyal bo zas gtsang 443

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ haṃshigi btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lhums su zhugs/ zla ba bcu phal cher rdzogs pa na lha mo lum+bi ni'i tshal du ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan bas ma gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te sku bltams/ gzhon nu nyid nas rig pa dang sgyu rtsal thams cad kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i tshul bstan/ shākya'i gzhon nu rnams stobs dang sgyu rtsal gyis pham par mdzad pa'i rgyal du shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma phul ba gtso mor gyur ba'i btsun mo drug khri'i dbus su lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'dod yon gyi dasa' ba la rol bzhin dgongs lo nyer dgu'i bar khab tu bzhugs/ de nanu/ nges par 'byung ba'i rkyen bzhis bskul te mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du mkhan po med par rab tu byung / mu stegs can gyi nga rgyal gzhom pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa mang po'i dbang gis lo drug tu dka' ba dras po spyad/ de nas grong ba'i bu mo dga' ma dang dga' stobs mas phul ba'i 'o thug sbrang rtsi'i snying po can bzhes te sku'i nyams stobs bskyed nas byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs/ rtswa mchog gi gdan la skyil rmo/ dkrung bcas te/ ji srid zag med ma thob pa/ /de srid skyil dkrung gzhig mi bya/ /zhes gsung byon pa ltar srod la bdud btul/ dgung 'a/ mnyam par bzhag tho rangs la bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes pas dgyes nas/ 'jig rten 'dod bde gang yin dang / /lha yul 'dod bange gang yin pas/ /sred pa zad pa'i bde ba la/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod 444

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7do/ /zhes sogs ched du brjod cing zhag bdun phrag ba dun du chos ma bstan par bzhugs pa la/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis gsol ba btab nas wa ra ṇa si'i drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su 'khor phun sum tshogs pa lnga sde bzang po lha brgyad khri dang bcas pa la chos phun sum tshogs pa bden bzhi'i chos 'khor thog mar bskor ba nas bzung chos 'khor rim pa gsum du bskor bas gdul bya mtha' yas pa byang chub gsum la bkod/ bstan pa'i rgyun bzhag bstan 'dzin lung bstan/ rgyal tshab kyi nyan thos byin gyis brlabs te/ sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa dang / rtag 'dzin can skyo ba skyed pa'i ched du dgung lo brgyad cu ba la mya ngan las 'das/ 'od srung la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar grags pa'i nyan thos chen po rnams kyis bka' bsdu ba rim pa gsum gyis bstan pa bskyangs/de nas ring zhig lon pa na rgyal ba nyid kyis lung bstan pa ltar be dar bha'i yul du sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i 'phrin las can 'phags pa klu sgrub byung ba nas bzung ste 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drugamachog gnyis/ chen po bzhi/ rmad byung gnyis la sogs pa paṇa grub gser ri'i phreng ba ltar bzang la mang ba rim par byon te/ bshad sgrub las gsum gyi 'khor los thub bstan mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung zhing bstan 'dzin gyi sde gnam gyi skar ma dang / sa'i rtsi shing lta bur 445
