pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhespel/ /bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rje gnya' khri btsad po nas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du g.yung drung gi bon mchod pa tsam las dam pa'i chos ma dar ba la/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa lha tho tho ri'i ring la bskol phor tsin+dha ma ṇi dang / dpang skong phyag rgya ba/ mdo sde za ma tog rnams pho brang gi dbu rtser dngos grub tu babs te chos kyi dbu brnyes shing / rgyal rabs lnga na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mngon sum mi'i rje bor bstan pa lha srong btsan sgam po byon te dbe bcu'i bka' khrims bcas/ yi ge dang bstan bcos kyi dbu btsugs / smin mtshams mdzod spu las dge slong a ka ra ma ti shi la sprul te rang byon bcu gcig zhal dang / 'phags pa mched bzhi spyan drangs/ mtha'i rgyal po sde bzhi zil gyis mnan nas rgya bal gyi btsun mo rnam gnyis bsus pa'i rdzongs pa'i tshul du jo shāka rin po che rnam gnyis byon te sa/ gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ dpal ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rgya cher bzhengs/ skal ba mchog dang ldan pa 'ga' la thugs rje chen po'i dbang gdams ngag dmar khrid dang bcas pa ci rigs su gnang / de dus bod na rab byung gi sde med kyang khra 'brug tu btsun pa'i gzugs can gcig la lha phyag mdzad de rnga 'ongs dbon sras kyi mchod gnas su 'dul 'dzin 'byung ba'i rten 446

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7'brel bsgrigs pa sogs kyi bka' drin mdzad/ de nas brtsis pa'i gdung rabs lnga ba la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs lha khri lde gtsug brtan gyi sras su mi'i gzhon nu lha'i mtshan rtags dang ldan par 'khrungs nas/ gnam lha babs kyi rgyal po/ sa lhun grub kyi mnga' bdagakhri srong lde'u btsan yin zhes sus kyang mtshan ma gsol bar nyid kyi zhal gyis bzhes pas de ltar yongs su grags/ sku gzhon nu'i dus yab mes kyi yig tshang gzigs pas chos kyi thugs 'dun byung ste/ bdud blon gyi bar chad dang sde dmangs kyi 'then 'khyer sogs thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i 'phrul gyis rang zhir btang / sba sang shi ta sogs pho nyar mngag ste rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na nyi ma ltar rtsod med du grags pa'i paṇa chen byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs/ chos mngon pa dang mdo sde'i gnas la thugs sbyangs shing bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ thugs dam gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul bar zhus pas bod kyi lha 'dre gdug rtsub che bas ngas 'dul mi nus/ deng sang rgya gar yul na pad+ma saṃ bha ba zhes bya ba 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rig sngags 'chang ba zhig yod/ de spyan drangs na rgyal po nyid dang sngon gyi smon lam gcig pas gdan 'drong zhing thugs bzhed 'grub par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa ltar sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs spyan 'dren gyi bang mir brdzangs te gsol ba 447

21spred/ 1) jordo /spyipa'e 'o/:jib/thag byaspurngasno rngaku/lngazud rta):re ba/sdosasprang khurasdo/zug/ ra〉btab pa ltar o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa bod yul gyi dbus su phyas phebs/ bstan ma bcu gnyis dang gnyan chen sde bzhi sogs lha srin mthu bo che rnams dam 'og tu bcug cing bstan pa srang ba'i gnyen da 47 charayig 47 zur 44 mi yig gog ra 43 ོ༄bskas/ da' stabs kyas 'byung pha phra ma' lda rnams kyang dpan bcan du bzung bas 'bangs 'khu mi nus pa lta bur song ste sa gzhi btul/ sde brgyad bran du bkol nas bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang lha 'dre mi gsum gyis brtsigs pas brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra bar ya mtshan che la tshar skyen par lhun gyis grub/ bod la phan pa'i lo paṇa mang ngo/ lung bstan nas dam pa'i chos bsgyur zhus 'chad nyan gyi grwa btsusas/jo bo rje lha cig gis kyang bsam yas kyi rgya dpe rnams gzigs nas/ 'di na da lta rgya gar na mi bzhugs pa'i bka' bstan mang po snang / nge dus kyi bstan pa dar ba 'dra ba rgya gar na'ang dka'/ bod kyi rā dza ngo rnyi sa twa zhes phyag thal mo sbyar nas bsngags brjod mdzad/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos sad mi mi bdun sogs rab tu byung ste 'dul 'dzin gyi sde btsugs/ rgyal pos bod kyi khyim pa thams cad dkon mchog la mchod pa byed pa'i khrims bcas shing bon lugs byar mi gnang ba'i lung bsgrags/ khyad par du gnas phun sum tshogs pa chos 'khor gsum dang sgrub gnas rnam gsum sogs bkra shis byin rlabs 'byung ba'i gnas chen mang por/ dus phun sum tshogs pa chos rgyal mchod yon gsum/ gyi 448

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7 smon lam dus su smin cing bod mi'i bsod nams dgung du bdal ba'i gnas skabs na/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus nas rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi rnam par bzhengs pa rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/'khor phun sum tshogs pa las can rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs bla med gsang sngags kyi gdul bya dbang po yang rab tu gyur pa rnams la/ chos phun sum tshogs pa bka' sde snod gsum gyi bcud phyung ba/ lam bslab pa gsum gyi gnad dril ba/ rgyal ba rig 'dzin rnams kyi dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod brtol ba'i zab chos mtshan tsam yang thos par dka' ba mang po khor yug tu gnang bas/ gdams ngag btab pa dang rgyud grol ba dus mnyam pa'i rig 'dzin grub thob kyi skyes bu yongs la grags pa dang ma grags pa mtha' yas pa byung ste bod ma sang 'dre'i yul gru 'og min sprul pa'i zhing khams sa byin gyis brlabs/ dbon sras ral ba ༄can gyi sku ring la chos mang po gsar du bsgyur zhing / khri srong gi dus su bsgyur ba'i chos rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste brjod bde zhing go sla bar bcos/ mi sde phal cher dkon mchog gi lha 'bangs su phul zhing / dbang dge 'dun la bskur ba sogs bstan pa'i zhabs tog 'gran zla med pa mdzad kyang sku tshe mthar ma 'khyol/de nas smon lam log pa'i rgyal po glang dar ma u dum btsan pos —149

21ཿda/ 11 jordo sdispyib khur:drogab/ byasatshod ba〉lngacad nyi:re ba/sdo/nga khurasdo/zug/ rkyu 〈cosdig blon rnams dang 'jing dril nas rab byung gi sde bsnubs/ dam/ pa'i chos byas med pa'i khrims bsgrags kyang / khyim pa skya bo'i rten can la mkhyen rtogs lo paṇa chen po rnams dang khyad med cing o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa sogs kyi rang lugs dri ma med pa 'dzin pa'i sngags nga/ mang du bzhugs pa rnams rgyal pos tshod ma thig nas gnod pa ma byas/ par mi nag gi gral du ci bder lus pa las phyis su slar yang brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyun mched de chos lung gi nying khu dpon dang / zur gyi gdung brgyud/ sgrol g.yung rnam gnyis/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang gi rgyal po sogs gsang sngags snga 'gyur byi bstan 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang phyug grub pa'i khyu mchog tu gyur pa mang du byon nas da lta'i bar du chos rgyun phal cher ma nub par yod/ glang dar mas dbus gtsang du bstan pa bsnub pa'i dus su yer ba nas/ 'dul 'dzin dmar g.yo gtsang gsum mdo khams smad du byon pa las mu dur dge ba gsal rab tu byung ba bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal du grags/ phyis sa klu mes tshal khrims shes rab dang sam pa ye shes blo sos/ rig mi risi mi darngogi 'jugasogs dbus gtsang mi bcu mdo smad du byon nas bla chen las so thar gyi sdom rgyun blangs te dbus gtsang du rgya cher spel zhing chos gzhi gtsus lag khang mang du btab/ stod mnga' ris su lo chen rin chen bzang pos chos mang du bsgyur ba sogs bstan pa'i bya ba chen po mdzad/ khyad 450

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7par du bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud mnga' ris pu rang gi rgya la po lha bla ma ye shes khu dbon gyi drin las bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas mi'i rol gar du bstan pa jo bo rje lha gcig di baṃ ka ra 'phags yul nas byon te bod du lo bcu gsum bzhugs/ bstan pa'i srol nub pa gzhi bzhengs sa gsos shing / kha rngog 'brom gsam dang / rnal 'byor pa raring rari mi rig migong 'og sogs bstan pa 'dzin nus kyi slob ma'i mchog mang po dang /yang slob sku mched gsum dang / khams pa lung ba sogs bka' gdams gzhung ba/ gdams ngag pa/ man ngag pa gsum las rgya cher gyes te bod gangs can gyi 'gro ba rgyal ba'i sras po khyu gcig tu mdzad/phyi ma'i dus su 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pas mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang po dang / lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan las bka' gdams kyi chos skor mtha' dag gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes te byang chub lam rim che chung gi gzhung brtsams pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'chad spel gyi mdzad pa bskyangs pas kha che dza lan+dhar nas shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i bar du bka' gdams kyi bstan pas khyab par byung / /'dul 'dzin sad mi bdun nas 'khon klu dbang srung gi dbon brgyud 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i sras su sa chen kun dga' snying po 'khrungs te 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi dngos slob zhung dgon pa sogs las rje btsun bir wa ba'i gdams ngag lam 'bras skor sogs mdo 451

21rngad/ 11 jordo sdispyingape khur:drob/thag byaspupod rngasgabastazug ༷):re bkasdosasprang 'o/dra/zug/ ra〉sngags gsar rnying gi chos thams cad la gsan bsam ris med du mdzad cing / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum du gdams pa'i bdud rtsi bstsal/ mgon po bir wa ba dngos dang mjal nas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol te grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs/ slob ma mchog thob pa gsum/ bzod pa thob pa bdun sogs rgya cher byung ba las sku'i sras rje btsun rtse mo sku mched brgyud 'dzin gyi thu bor gyur/ rje btsun sku mched kyi gcung dpal chen 'od po'i sras su 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam par rol ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bltams/ byis pa'i dus nas rig gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i shes rab kyi gter grol zhing / 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i ye shes kyi skus mngon sam du byin gyis ༄brlabs pas shes bya'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du phyin/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shri bha dra las bsnyen par rdzogs te 'dul 'dzin mkhas pa yongs kyi mchos tu gyur/ mu stegs kyi mkhas pa 'phrog byed dga' bo 'khor bcas dri ma med pa'i rigs pas tshar bcad de rgyal bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan bsgreng bas dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes snyan par grags pa'i rnga bo che 'dzam gling gi sa g.yo ba tsam du ldir/ sku tshe'i smad la gong ma hor gyi rgyal po 'i dpung gis bod la gnod du nye ba gzigs nas de 'dul ba'i phyir rgya nag tu phebs/ rgya nag gi rgyal pos tshod bgam pa'i phyir sgyu 452

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7 ma mkhan la grong khyer ba'i gshang gci'i phung por gzhal med khang bkod pas mdzes pa sprul du bcug nas der spyan drangs pa na rten 'brel snying pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog gtor nas nang du byon pas phyir bsdu ma nus par byang phyoṭa sprul pa sde'i lha khang zhes dus phyis kyang yod pa sogs ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pas rgyal po 'khor bcas dad par byas te bde ba can du gshegs/ dbon chos rgyal 'phags pa gong ma'i bla mar gyur te rdzu 'phrul dang chos bstan pa'i sgo nas rgyal bo'i mdzad pa legs lam du bsgyur bas mnga' 'bangs skyid cing bstan pa dar ba'i gzhi rtsa btsugs/bod kyi dge 'dun rnams chos dang zang zing gi char gyis tshim par mdzad/ de gong bod du rig gnas kyi srol ka cher ma dar ba las chos rje khu dbon 'di gnyis kyis sgra dang snyan dngags sdeb sbyor mngon brjod zlos gar gyi gzhung mang po bsgyur zhing / rgya cher dar ba'i bdag rkyen mdzad pas lhag par yang rin po che sna tshogs kyi yul gling chen po lta bur gyar/ de'i rjes su dpal ldan bla norami /)byem dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang bdag na blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs gdung brgyud dang / gzhan yang g.yag rong rnam gnyis/ ngor rdzong rnam gnyis/ go shāka rnam gnyis/ tshar chen yab sras sogs skyes chen mang du byon nas rang lugs bshad sgrub kyi rgyun bzung zhing / ngor/na len+d+ra/ rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal/ mnyanatsho yod bya rgod gshongs 453

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stset+yār+shasogs chos sde grags pa can mang du btab//gzhan yang lho brag mar ba lo tsā rgya gar du byon te/ dpal na ro ba sogs paṇa grub kyi bla ma mang du bsten/ slar bod yul du bstan pa bskyangs pa'i slob ma ka ba bzhi las sgrub brgyud kyi bka' babs mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rjes spyir grub thob kyi bu slob mang du bton pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa mnyam med sgam po ba zla 'od gzhon nu'i bka' brgyud la/ phag gru/ dus mkhyen/ zhang tshal ba/ 'ba' rom bka' brgyud de che bzhi/ gdan sa bka' brgyud dang lnga/ 'bri gung / 'brug pa/ stas lung / khro phu ba sogs bka' brgyud chung brgyad/ de dag re re la yang grub brnyes rnal 'byor pa'i sde dpag tu med pa dbyar dus kyi chu bo ltar 'phel te dpal ldan 'brug pa kho na'i bka' brgyud kyis kyang bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad khyab par grags/ des mtshon nas bod dbus gtsang gi ljongs su bstan pa dar ba'i tshul rgyas par brjod kyis mi long yang zur tsam bshad pa yin la/mdo khams kyi yul na che ba shar phyoṭa 'bri klung gi rgyud 'di ni sngon chen po gling gi dus nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa gtso bor mchod pa'i srol dar zhing / rjes la sde dge chos rgyal chen po rim byon rnams kyang gdung brgyud gong ma 'gar chen ye shes bzang po'i dus nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i nang 'khor yin pa dang / phyis su'ang dpal e waṃ pa'i mkhan 454

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7brgyud kyi phreng ba rnams dang mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel du gyur pa sogs kyi rten 'brel las dpal ldan sa ngor rnam gnyis rigs bdag tu 'dzin pa sha stag byung la/ sde dge bo thar gyi dus su pho brang gi sa gzhi dang por 'dul ba dang / rgyal srid la mnga' gsol ba'i byed po grub chen thang stong rgyal po yin cing / phyis su gter ston 'ja' tshon snying pos sde dge grub thob kun dga' rgya mtsho la zan gyi sdig pa ra tsa'i gzugs shig bcos nas gnang ste/ 'di yi dam gu ru drag po'i phyag mtshan yin/ khyed rang gi thel rtags la 'di thob/ sa stod rnams sa skya dang / sa smad rnams rnying ma pas zungs dang rgyal srid phyi na gas med pa dang nang na srub med pa 'ong zhes lung bstan pa ltar byung ba sogs kyis gsang sngags rnying ma ba rnams kyang mchod gnas kyi phud du bkur/sde dge sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sku ring la bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas a lo re 'khru ngas pa dbus phyogs kyi gdan sar ma phul bar dpal spung gi chos grwa btab nas der bzhugs su gsol ba nas bzung ste si tu'i sku phreng rnams gtsug gi nor bur bsten pas sgrub brgyud rka tshang gi yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mtshungs bral du gyar/ byang rgyud rdza chu kha na ri bo dge ༄shi shāje/ skye(1 1sheldan pa'i mtshan nyid kyi chos grwa'ang 'ga' ga da sna mdor na gangs ri'i khrod kyi ris med pa'i rgyal bstan mtha' dag gru bzhir skyong zhing /455

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sngon dus rgyal rabs re bzhin rin po che dang tsaṇ+ḍan las grub pa'i sku gzugs mchod rten mang po dang / gser btul ma'i bka' 'gyur sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bzhengs mang du mdzad la/ khyad par du dge 'dun gyi sde rnying ba mchod cing gsar ba 'dzugs pa dang /bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung 'bum/ sna tshogs rig gnas kyi skor sogs glegs bam gyi phyi mo'i par shing grangs mang la dngos gtsang ba rin po che'i brag ri brtsigs pa lta bu bzhengs te/ phyogs bzhi'i skal bzang chos don gnyer ba'i skye bo rnams rgya mtsho chen po las nor bu len pa'i tshul du tshur 'du ba dang /chos kyi rnyed pa grub nas dga' bzhin rang gnas su ldog pa'i 'gro 'ong mang po'i rgyu 'grul gyi bun long nyin re bzhin du rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bas mdo khams stod smad bar gsum chos kyi longs spyod rnam thos bu'i bang mdzod kha phye ba lta bus bkang ba 'di dag sde dge byang chub sems dpas bzhengs pa'i rten/ bsgrub pa'i chos/ bsags pa'i rnam dkar/ sngon smon gyi che ba yin pas khams chu bzhi sgang drug bi/ khongs 'dir rgyal bstan stobs kyis 'degs pa dang / skye dgu'i phan bde gso ba la 'gran zla thams cad bral ba khas bstod bstod la mi bltos par mig gi mthong gsal la gnas pa de ga lags/ /khams phyogs 'dir gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i chos sde byung ba 'a 456

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7snga ba ni zur gsang bdag sgro phug pa'i dngos slob dzam ston 'gro ba'i mgon po'i thugs sras bla ma shar ba spobs pa mtha' yas sam yongs grags su dam pa bde gshegs zhes grub chen mi tra dzo kis rgyal sras zhi ba lhar ngos bzung ba des khams spo 'bor gyi sa'i char kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi chos sde btab ste/ rgyal tshab gtsang ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang byams pa 'bum nas bla rabs bcu gsum/ drung rabs bcu gsum sogs spyir mdo sngags mtha' dag la mkhas shing khyad par mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi rang lugs 'dzin pa'i gdan rabs kyi phreng ba yid bzhin nor bu'i do shal lta bu tshar du bsgrigs/ sngon chos sde 'dir dus gcig la dge 'dun khri phrag ba co brgyad 'dus par grags shing /'ja' lus kyi grub mtha' snyogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa'ang 'ga' zhig byon/dus phyis kaḥthog grub brnyes byang chub rgya mtsho'am gter ston bdud 'dul rdo rje'i ring la pad ma'i rgyal tshab rig 'dzin mi 'gyar rdo rje ༄ngom du 'khrungs/sku gzhon nu nas sngon sbyangs stobs su gyur pas nyam/sa rtogs kyi klong brdol/ rtsa gsum lhag pa'i lha'i zhal gzigs/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter khar grags pa'i chos mdzod la dbang bsgyur/ rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje dang yang mjal te phan tshun thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ rgyal ba karma pa zhwa nag dbang phyug rdo rje dang / zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gnyis kyi dngos slob sems dpa' chen po 457

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ karma chags med dang mjal bas tshad ldan gyi gter ston du thugs nges 'khrungs te zhabs spyi bor blangs/ gsung gi bdud rtsi bzhes/ mnyes pa gsum gyis thags bzang / dgongs gter rnams la gsal byed cholga /༷༷1 dmi mi ///sgo chosi mi /rdo gle 2755 / gas dang / kha nga / zur rgyan/ zin sdes sogs mang du mdzad cang nyams bzhes dang 'chad spel gyis phrin las rgya cher bskyangs/ dpal yul rnam rgyal byang chub gling dang rmugs sang gdan sa sogs las rang lugs 'dzin pa'i chos sde mang du mched/ thugs rje'i byin rlabs/ chos kyi 'gro don/ bka' babs kyi chos bdag sogs sgo kun nas phun sum/ tshogs pas sde dge lho rgyud/ hor zhabs/ 'gu log gser thal/ reb kong / rgyal mo rong sogs chos brgyud kyis khyab cing / dbang lung gi brgyud srol zin pa/ thugs dam phyag rdzogs la mdzad pa/ snying rus sgrub tshugs la skyel ba/ gdams ngag sne gcig gi steng 'dus sde tshugs pa'i dam/ pa'i skyes bu mang du byon/ yang chags med rin po che'i bu chen dam pa pad ma rig 'dzin gyis phyogs med kyi bla ma mang du bsten/ chos bka' spyi dang khyad par rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi gdams pa zhun thar chod par gsan nas khams dbus kyi sgrub gnas rnams su sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas nyams rtogs kyi rtsal chen rdzogs te/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa lnga ba chen pos kyang bstod bsngags kyi dbugs dbyung / dgung lo drug cu bzhes dus khams ru dam du phebs nas/ o 458

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7rgyan bsam gtan chos gling gi gdan sa btab ste slob ma bskyangs pas tshogs pa stong phyed lnga bgyo tsam 'dus shing / nag shod srin rdzong / zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling / rgya rong rtag brtan sgrub sde sogs yan lag gi chos sde che phra mang por 'phel/ mkhas grub kyi bu slob bya khyu 'phur ba tsam thon pas mdo khams rdzogs chen pa zhes dbus gtsang khams gsum du grags shing / mtshan don gyis gung kheb pa byung / de rnams la kaḥrdzogs dpal gsum zhes mdo khams kyi yul 'di'i gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i chos sde thams cad kyi rtsa bar da lta'i bar gong 'phel du bzhugs pa de yas gtam dam pa chos kyi lo rgyus rags rim tsam lags/mas gtam la'ang steng na rje'i gdung rabs/ 'og na 'bangs kyi mi rabs/ stong sde srid pa'i chags tshul dang gsum las dang po'i dbang du btang na/ 'jig rten thog mar chags nas yun ring ma song ba'i dus su mi la phongs phyug dang longs spyod la gsog 'jog med cing /dpon g.yog gi tha snyad med de bsam gtan lha gnas dang cha 'dra ba'i bde skyid chen pos 'tsho yang / bskal pa mar 'grib pas bsod nams rim gyis phri ste 'byung ba dwangs ma'i zas rnams nub/ skye bo rnams 'bras sā lu'i zhing la spyod pa'i skabs su lo tog la gsog 'jog dran zhing nga khyod kyi ris su bcad de phan tshun mi mthun par rtsod pa na rgyal 459

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhepo la snga ba mang pos bkur ba byung ste/ drang po'i gzhung lam bzung /longs spyod chos bzhin bgos/ rtsod pa'i zug rngu phyungs pas drin lan du drug cha'i dpya thang gis mchod/ mi la mtho dman phye ste rje dang 'bangs su bzhag dbang rje la gtad de skyid sdug shes su 'jug pa'i srol dod/ de'i bu brgyud la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lnga sogs nas shākya'i rgyal po zas gtsang ma mched bzhi'i bar du rgyal po dang rgyal rigs 'bum phrag lhag pa'i gdung rabs mu tig phreng ba star la brgyus pa ltar byung / rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras bcom ldan 'das dang mdzes dga' bo gnyis/ bcom ldan 'das khab na bzhugs dus kyi sras sgra gcan zin te/ 'di yan chad kyis mang pos bkur ba'i rgyud dngos rdzogs par gsungs/ gzhan yang ma ga dha dang / ko sa la dang / ko sham+bha'i rgyal po'i rigs dang / li tsi bi'i rigs sogs grags pa can gyi rgya'/ po'i rigs mang / de'i rjes nyi ma'i rigs las 'dzam bu gling gi rgyal ngo/ mya ngan med dang snying po'i thig le dang seng ge lnga ba sogs dang /tsan+d+ra'i rigs kyi rgyal rabs mang po sngon dus su byung zhing / phyis rgya' po'i grub thob go pā la dang de ba pā la dang chos rgyal mya ngan med la gzi byin 'gran pa rgyal po chen po dharma pā la'i rigs kyi rgyal po mang du mched pas mtshon/ bsod nams las shugs kyis yangs pa'i sa chen ngo/ la dbang bsgyur zhing / mnga' thang longs spyod kyis dkon mchog gi 460

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7gdan khri 'degs pa/ dpung stobs gzi brjid kyis gzhan sde'i rgol ba zil gyis gnon pa'i rgyal po dang rgyal phran mang po 'phags yul shar nub lho byang dbus lnga kun tu byung //bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir ni ston pas 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud du gsal bor lung bstan pa ltar 'phags yul li tsa bi'i rigs las mtshan dang ldan pa'i gzhon nu zhig rkang 'khyam ste rim gyis bod g.yo ru'i yar lung lha ri zhol po'i rtse mor byon pa phyogs de'i rdzi bo mang pos mthong nas gnya' bar khri brtsigs te rjer bkur ba'i che ming btsan po zhes gsol ba mi rje gnya' khri btsad po ste/ de nas rim par gnam la khri bdun/ sa la legs drug tshigs la btsan lnga/ logs la sde brgyad/ skyid pa'i gdung rabs bcu gsum sogs byung ba'i nang tshan mi rje srong btsan sgam pos dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas kyang khrims yig rgyas par ma mdzad pa la/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan dang 'gos khri bzang lha lod rje blon gyis rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing sbram la lci ba dang / chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa 'jam la dam pa gnyis su phye ste bka' gcigs kyi yi ge zhib mo bris/ 'gyar med kyi phyag rgyas btab ste ༄khrims bsdam pas rgyal po bka' btsan/ khrims lugs drang la snyoms/yul mi rje la gus pas rgyal khams bde skyid dang ldan par gyur/ chos rgyal dharma pā la dang yang phrin yig gi lam nas ma mthong ba'i mdza' 461

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bor dz+rel/ phyogs bzhi'i 'gran zla che dgu dbang du bsdus te chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du rdo ring bslangs/ sras mu tig btsad pos rgyal sa bzung ste bod mi'i phyug dbul lan gsum bsnyams/ mnga' bdag ral ba can gyis dbon zhang gi 'khrugs pa bsdums te rgya rgya yul dang bod bod yul na skyid par byas pa sogs mes dbon rnams kyis rgyal srid snying rjes bskyangs pa'i mdzad pa rlabs che/ de mthar ral ba can gyi gcung glang dar mas chos khrims bshigs pas rgyal khrims rang shugs kyis zhig /gdung brgyud sil bur 'thor/ de phyin mnga' ris kyi lha bla ma khu dbon sogs skyes bu dam pa mang du 'khrungs kyang bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po ma byung / phyis su gnam se chen rgyal pos mdo smad rta'i chol kha/ mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ dbas gtsang chos kyi chol kha ste chol kha ༄gsum 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa la dbang yon du phul bas bod khams mtha' dbus thams cad dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chab 'bangs su gyur te dpon chen shākya bzang po sogs bod spyi la dbang ba'i mi dpon rim par bskos pa rnams kyis hor lugs dang bstun pa'i khrims kyis/ bzang la gtang rag dang ngan la chad pa byas/ de'i rjes su lha gzig sa rlangs kyi gdung las tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod khri skor bcu gsum dbang du bsdus nas pho brang sne'u gdong rtse bzung / sngon gyi bod chos rgyal mes dbon gsum gyi khrims yig la gzhi blang ba'i bka' 462

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7khrims bzang po gsar du bcos te bod khams bde bar bskyangs/ rab byung bcu ba'i nang du chen po hor gyi yul nas jing gir bstan 'dzin chos rgyal byung ste bod shing sgo can mtha' dag dpung gis mnan/dbus gtsang gi sa'i cha thams cad rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras la phul/ mi ring bar gnam gong ma yung lo rgyal pos kun mkhyen lnga pa pe cing du spyan drangs nas ti shrir mnga' gsol/ gnam 'og gi skye bo mtha' dag bstan pa gcig tu gyar pa'i 'gyar med rdo rje lha rdo'i /re/ shā)( rang /bye/rtedherde :de/'chang rgya ma bla ma —sa pa mtshan dang / khyab bdag 'chang las ka phul ba nas bzung ste dga' ldan pho brang gi dbu 'phang dgung la reg cing lugs gnyis kyi bka' khrims drang por bsrang bas chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi phrin las 'o mtsho ltar kha gting med par dkar ba'i rgyun slar yang 'phyur te bod khams thams cad dkar la mdangs che bar byas//sne'u gdong gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan khu dbon gyi ring tsam na chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i gung blon chen po bzhi'i mchog tu gyur pa 'gar stong btsan yul bzung gi mi rgyud las bde chen bsod nams bzang po zhes bya ba khams su byon nas chen po'i las ka bzung ba na mi kun gyis sde dge zhes 'bod par byung ste/ sde ris dge bar skyong ba'i rten 'brel du gnam gyis ming byin par grags/ de'i 'og tu sde dge bo 463

〉 pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhezhethar gyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i bka' bzhin rgya'/ khab lhun grub steng bzung ba nas brtsams te mes las tsha dang / tsha las yang tsha lhag pa'i tshul gyis mnga' thang je cher rgyas shing / gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen pos kyang lung las ka lag rtags dang bcas pas gzengs bstod de stod smad lho byang stong sde khri shog mang po la dbang bsgyur/ lha chos la gzhi bcol ba'i rgyal khrims/ 'jam la non che ba bcas te/ lugs gnyis kyi srol bzang sngar yod rgyun gsos shing sngar med gsar du btsugs/ khrims mthun gyi lesas byed gtang rag gis spel/ khrims 'gal gyi dpe ngan chad pas bsnubs//mthon po'i gong mnan/ dma' ba thabs kyis bskyangs/ nyam chung gi pha ma mdzad/ rang mnyam mthun 'jug gis bsdus/ 'gran zla dpung shed kyis btul/ rgyal po bzhugs gdan dang ma bral yang sa mtha' snyan grags kyis khebs te/ pha yul thag ring gi mi sde skyid pa'i lung 'os tu babs kyis 'du ba byung / chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring gi dus su rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa skal bzang rgya mtsho mdo khams mi nyaka bi yul nas dbu ru gru 'dzin gyi pho brang chen por gdan 'dren pa'i mthun 'gyur zhabs tog bsgrubs pa nas bzung ste dbus kyi gzhung sa chen po dang yang da lta'i bar du pad ma dang nyi ma'i dpe bzhin mchod yon gyi 'brel zab thun mong ma yin pa gong 'phel du gnas pa 'di bzhin 464

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lags/'bangs mi'i gnas tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ stod rgya gar gyi yul rnams skal ba bzang po'i grong khyer yin pas mi'i mchog dang longs spyod kyi rtse mo 'byung / sde mang la 'byor ba che/ gtsug lag gi gzhung dang sgyu rtsal gyi rnam grangs mang / tshong 'dus kyi ltad mo dang bzo gnas kyi 'phrul mod/ mi rigs bzhi'i rnam dbye gsal/ mtho dman gyi khyad spyod pas dbye/ phyug po las mkhas pa bkur/ zong las rig pa brin/ zhib la brtags dpyad rno/ sngon gyi drang srong phyi rjes ring bor gzigs pa mang du byon pas bya bzhag thams cad la bstan bcos yod/ las dang bya ba ci byed bstan bcos dbang por 'jog pas dus bzang gi lugs srol mi 'gyur/ pha mes kyi rigs chos gzhung srong bas gna' bo'i lag rjes mi nub cing mi'i go rim mi 'chol/ mgo nag mi la chags snga zhing 'dzam gling yul dbus na gnas pas sde mang nang nas phud du brtsi ba de lags/ /bod kha ba can 'di dang po mi min 'dre'i rgyal khams su yod pa las/ thugs rje chen po'i dge bsnyen 'phags pa sprel sgom dang / sgrol ma'i sprul pa brag srin mo 'dus te/ rigs drug nas 'phos pa'i las can gyi 'gro ba drug sras su bskyed pa las mang por 'phel nas blo ldan rang bzhin bzang ba rnams pha'i rigs dang / gshis ngan spyod pa gyong 465

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dhekhyokhyob rnams ma'i rigs su byin gyis brlabs/ de dag las rus chen sde lnga/re re bzhin gyes pa'i rnam grangs mang po dang bcas bod khams mtha' dbus kyi mi rnams rim gyis mched/ de'ang bod la bod dang / bod chen po gnyis las/ bod yul dbus kyi rgyal khams/ dbus khri skor drugagatsang khri skor dru ga yar 'brog khri skor gcig ste sde khri skor bcu gsum// skad chos skad du smra/ yon tan gang che'i skye bo 'tshogs/ rigs gang mtho'i che dgu gnas/ mtha' bzhi'i nor sna 'du/ phyogs bzhi'i mi sna 'dzoms/ 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos/ bod rje gong ma'i yig tshang / khrims srol yul dus kyis bsgyur ba'i khyad par sogs la mkhas shing mthong rgya che/ skyes bu'i lus kyi rtsal gsum zhes mtheb kyis sha non pa/ rkyal gyis chu chen brgal ba/ yang rtsal bya la 'gran pa rnams dang /'o rgyus kyis dge thon pa/ gtam gyis bzhad gad thon pa/ shags kyis pha rol gnon pa ste ngag gi rtsal gsum/ mdzangs la blo 'gyu ba/ dpa' 'a sran tshugs pa/ kha gsal zhing gting mi rtogs pa rnams yid kyi rtsal gsum ste pho rtsal sna dgu dang / gtam yig rtsis gsum/ mda' rdo mchong gsum/ bang rkyal shed gsum ste rtsed mo sna dgu sogs sgyu rtsal gyi shes nga/ mang pos rang srid 'dzin mkhas shing / gzhan sde 'dul mkhas/ bod khams phan bde'i rtsa lag chos 'khor rnam gsum sogs la zhabs tokasangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgya mtsho chos sde rnam bzhi sogs la bsnyen bkur/466

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7'phags chen sprul pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyi dge bcu'i bka' khrims la brtsi 'jog sogs las thabs chos phyogs su smin cing / lag rjes chos la che bas dbus gtsang chos ldan gyi yul grur grags pa don la gnas/ bod chen po ste mdo khams la/ khams stod/ bar khams/ mdo smad de gsum mo/ sa kha rgya che/lung ba phu thag ring / mi sde'i rnam grangs mang mi rig sa dang skad rigs mi gcig cha lugs dang spyod yul mi 'dra ba'i sde shog tha dad/ la la thang ma ltar brdal che/ la la tshom bu ltar spungs legs/ gang yang dbyar kha'i me tog ltar sna tshogs su bkra ba'i tshul du yod pa las/ mdo khams yul gyi lte ba/ dgu gling sa'i mdud 'dzom/ sde dge byang chub sems dpa'i mnga' ris la/ lho rong sde khang zhing can gyi bdag po/ dpa' mdzangs ya rabs rgyud las/ rgyal khrims kyi lugs shes shing / spyod pa so zin pa/ gong rje'i mdun blon du 'os shing / sde rang thob kyi chas tshags thab pa'i rdzong dpon nyi shu rtsa lnga/ byang 'brog sde ༄ ༄ ༄shog chen bcu gnyis kyi bdag po/ gdung zhal dkar can gyi mi rgyud/mdzangs la blo brtan pa/ rje la snying nye zhing / 'bangs la khrel gzhung che ba'i dpon khag sum cu so lnga/ de dag gang yang chos kyi rgyal po rim byon rnams kyis legs par bskyangs pas mi thams cad rang bzhin gyis dul nas/ rje byams/ 'bangs skyid/ yul 'jam/ rgyal khams rgan mo gser khur lta bur spyod pas phyug pos skyong sla/ med pos btsal sla/ slong 467

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/)khyot+yāzhemo bas rnyed sla/ mi la mkhas pa mang / ya rabs kyi lugs srol shes/ mi chos la shes sgo yangs/ lha chos la go ba bzang / rig gnas la rnam/ dpyod zhib/ spyod pa khrims lugs dang mthun/ yon tan can gyi rgya' khams su byung ba las/ lho rong gi bye brag gdung rgya mkhar sras po'i rdzong 'og sde ku se rgyal mo tsho drug de'i nang gses ku se smad pa'i mi risas kha chos 'don la mkhas pa/ lag yig rigs la byang ba/ blo rig pa la goms pa/ sde dge chos rgyal rim byon rnams kyi bzhed srol skyong ba/ khyung bo g.yu khri sogs sngon gyi bzo bo 'phrul gyi rnam dpyod can rnams kyi lag rgyun 'dzin pa/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog gi bstan srog mi nub pa'i srog shing 'dzugs pa/ rten bzhengs la byas pa che bas rje'i thusas su 'thad pa/ longs spyod bzo gnas kyis 'grub pas rkun jag gi sro/'a ngan nyung ba/ rtsal 'gran yon tan la byed pas lo bcu'i byis pa ya na chad bslab shes mkhan por 'gro ba/ e yul rig pa'i 'byung gnas lta bu'i mi sde ste 'og na 'bangs kyi mi rabs zhes bya/ /yul sde'i chags tshul ltar bshad na/ 'jig rten dang por chasas dus 'byung bzhi'i khams rab las ri rab rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin dang / 'bring las gser gyi ri bdun gser 'ba' zhig las brtsam/sa pa gnyis mtho ris lha'i yul du byung / khams tha ma sa rdul las gling bzhi mi'i yul du grub ste/ khams rab dang 'dres pa'i rten 'brel las 468

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7rin po che'i 'byung khungs mang bar byung / gling bzhi'i nang nas lho gling nam mkha' sngon po'i kheb 'og longs spyod 'dzam ba prika'i shing tog no༅ ṣamatshor lhung ba gser du 'gyur ba'i cha las 'dzam bu'i gling du ming btags/ gling 'dir bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong 'byon pas gling gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /de la yul chen yul phran grangs kyis mi chod pa yod pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na bhang ga la dang o ṭi bi sha dang kha che sogs re re bzhin mi khyim 'bum phrag mang po dang bcas pa dang / 'phags yul dngos la mi gtogs kyang de'i phyogs su bsdu ba gser gling dang sing ga la'i gling sogs bgrang dka' ba yod kyang gtso bor gyur ba ni wa ra ṇa si/ yangs pa can/ mnyan yod/ gnas bcas/tsam pa ka rgyal po'i khab ste yul dbus kyi grong khyer chen po drug tu grags/ de dag gi dbus na ston pa mngon par byang chub pa'i gnas rdo rje gdan byang chub shing gis brgyan pa dang / nub o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling na rang byung he ru ka'i lha khang sogs ngo mtshar can mang po dang /dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi khyad par lha yul la 'gran pa yod/ /de las byang gi phyogs na gnas pa bod kha ba can gyi yul gru ri thams cad gangs kyis g.yoṭa pa/ chu thams cad bsil la dwangs pa// sngo thams cad sman du skye ba/ ri brag la sprul ba'i rang byon 'byon pa/ tshad 469

rngosarngad/ 11 lngardo /spying/ 'o/:drob/bzhi byaspurngasno spreb/stacad rta):re po//sdusprang khuradra/zug/ tsharapa'i dbal chung ba/ gdug pa'i srog chags nyung ba/ dus bzhi'i rnam 'gyur gsal ba/ yul bkod sna tshogs su bkra ba ste/ stod mnga' ris zhang zhung / bru sha pu rang sogs skor gsum la dbye ba dgu rdzing gi tshul dang / bar dbus gtsang gnyis kyi dbus na dbu ru dang g.yo ru gnyis/gtsang na g.yas ru dang ru lag gnyis te ru bzhi yur ba'i tshul/ smad mdo khams tsha ba sgang / spo 'bor sgang / 'bri rdza zal mo sgang sogs sgang drug gi khongs su chad pa zhing gi tshal te/ de dag la lha gcig cha'i riring dming rigang pad+mas sa'i dpyad gzigs pas srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba'i dbyibs su 'dug nas de'i kha gnon du bzhengs pa'i mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul/ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhi gsum bcu gnyis dang / dbus na lha ldan dga' bzhi 'phrul gyi lha khang ngam/ dpal ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsuka lag khang / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i bden stobs kyis rgya mtsho bsub pa'i steng na chags shing / rdzu 'phrul sprul ba'i bzo bos dngos su bzhengs pa/ rten gtso jo shāka rnam gsum dang 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad sogs sangs rgyas sprul ba'i sku dngos dang khyad par med pa mang po bzhugs pas/ dga' ldan lha yul na yang ngo mtshar gyi gleng gzhir byed pa/ rgya phibs kyi dbu rtse mthong bas kyang rgyud la byin rlabs 'junu/ pa dang / de'i lho rgyud g.yo ru'i sa cha na dpal bsam yas/ steng khang rgya gar/ bar khang li yul/ 'og khang rgya nag gi lugs su bzhengs pa'i 470

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / gling bzhi/gling phran/ yak+ṣa ltag 'ogajo mo gling gsum dang bcas pa/ rten gtso byang chub chen po sogs sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs shing / mkhan slob chos gsum zhal 'dzoms nas sa rab tu gan/sa pa'i me tog 'thor bas nyi 'og gi rgyal khams na byin rlabs che ba mthong thos kyi 'brel ba thob tshad phyir mi ldog pa'i skal ldan du byed pa/ de sogs rten gsum dang gtsug lag khang gi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa yod/ gzhan yang stod mnga' ris na gangs brag nyi shu/ bar dbus gtsang na sgrub gnas nyer gcig smad mdo khams na gnas chen nyer gcig gangs chen bzhi/ grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi/ sbas yul rgyal po gsum/ lung lnga/ gling drug yul phran brgya rtsa sogs yod/ stod smad kyi lho rgyud thams cad dro la 'bru smin/ yul gyi dge bcu tshang zhing sa'i btsan brling 'dzom/ mkhar khang dang rmos zhing 'brel bar khyab/ byang rgyud thams cad bsil la dkar bcud 'phel/ spyod yul khyon yangs shing /phyogs bzhi'i mgron lam bde/ sbra khyim dang phyugs 'brog sbrel mas 'dzin/ gang yang sa'i dpyad bzang dgu 'dzoms/ grub thob kyi gdan sa dang dgon gnas mang pos brgyan pa ste/ rong 'brog sbra dang chon thag gi tshul/ dgon grong gos dang gong ba'i tshul du chags/ /rang yul ku se lung ba la dper brjod na/ sngon slob dpon bai ro 471

21rngad/ 11 therdo sdispyirngaspro khur:drotha/05 byaspurngasno rngaspro/lngazud rta):re ba/sdosajing khuradra/zug/ thamalomitsa na khams rgyal mo rong nas byon dus ku se 'phags lung thang zhes par yi ge 'bri ba'i phyag smyug lhung ba las gser gyi ljang bu skyes pa'i shul du phyis dgon gnas btab pa la deng sang yang gser ljang dbon du grags te/ yul 'dir yi ge'i rig pa la mkhas pa mang du 'byung ba de'i byin rlabs kyis yin par gleng / gzhan yang rmugs sang gi ga/nas na bya khyang rang byon gyi ltad mo dang / rmu ba chos nyid rdo rje zer ba'i grub ༄thob chen po cig gi sgrub gnas rmu phug sogs dang / rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i gnas lag tu grags pa sgam bu gnas/ rje grub thob chen pos byin gyis brlabs par grags pa'i rdo zam ya mtshan che ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan rtags mang pos khyad par du mtshon te/ mdor na bsil ldan gangs ris bskor ba'i yul 'di sngon rgyal ba nyid kyis 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la bkas gtad pas thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung zhing / mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po'i zab don yi ge drug tu bsdus nas gdul bya'i snying la rgyas btab pas byis pa lo gsum gyi dus nas ma ṇi pad+me rang shes su 'ong ba'i ngo mtshar can/ ri'i rgyal po ta la dang rnam dbyer ma mchis nga/'i zhing mchog khyad par can yin pas de'i yon tan dang lo rgyus mtha' dag brjod par dka' yang da dung ma 'ongs pa'i gnas skabs kun tu bkra shis dga' ston dang 'brel bar yang yang gleng ba'i rten 'bre' 472

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7byed/ /byas shes bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du btang na/ ma dag pa'i zhing du snyegs ma lngas gdung bas nyam thag pa'i sems can rnams la thugs rjes gzigs te/ mthong grol gzugs sku'i nyi ma bsod nams brgya ba'i mtshan dpe can dngos su byon/ gdul bya mchog dman med par rjes su bzung / nye ring med par chos bstan nas 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sgo bcad/ mtho ris dang thar ba'i 'jug ngogs lam po che bzhin du gsal bor btod/ zhal dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba med kyang thos pa don ldan gyi mtshan dang gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang deng sang gi 'gro bas kyang longs spyod du yod par mdzad pas ston mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i bka' drin stong gsum gser gyis bkang / gser zhing nor bus spras te phul yang cha shas tsam yang gzhal bar mi nus la/ de'i rjes su dam pa'i chos 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas legs pa'i lam bzang gsal bar mdzad de gdul bya'i lhag ma bskyangs pas 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs 'phags yul paṇa grub kyi phreng ba rnams kyang sku drin che/ de nas bod yul mun pa'i gling du dkon mchog gsum gyi sgron me sbar/ mnga' ris bde skyid la bkod/ 'gro ba'i kha lo gyen la bsgyur bas chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsam sogs sngon gyi mi rje sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyang sku drin che/༄473

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/d+ku d+ku phyogs 'di'i bstan pa la sdang ba'i yul bdag lha srin stobs po che rnams dam 'og tu btsud/ lha mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing du chos gzhi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bstan rtsa rab byung dang gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i sde btsugs/ skal ldan gyi 'gro ba smin grol la bkod/ skal med la thar ba'i sa bon bzhag ste rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bsgrubs pas o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa sogs sprul pa'i lo paṇa chen po rnams kyang sku drin che/ de rnams kyi mdzad pa'i 'phro bskyangs te/ nyan bshad sgom sgrub kyis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa bzung zhing / rnyed bkur dpung stobs kyis chos/ kyi dbu 'phang mtho bar byas te/ gangs can phan bde'i srog mkhar gzhi brling bar mdzad pas sa dge bka' rnying gi bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams dang / gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang ba dang / sde dge chos rgyal rim byon rnams kyang sku drin che/ mngon mtho rten bzang byin nas dkon pa brgya dang dka' ba stong gis gces par bskyangs pa'i drin chen pha ma dang / sa gdan thog gcig tu 'grogs te/skyid na mthun sbyo ra legs spel/ sdug na sems gso skyo grogs/ skrag na skyel ma ra mda'/ steng gi skyibs/ 'gab kyi skyor byas pas phu nu nye mdza' rnams kyang drin che/ de thams cad kyi drin las sngon nas kha sang gi bar du dpal gyi nyi ma snum la bag dro ba yang dang yang du shar ba yin la/ /tshul de bzhin du/ (gsar tshes gnam lo rgyal po'i 'dzum zhal thos 474

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7mar mthong ba'i)dus bzang 'dir yang yul mi thams cad bsod nams dga' ston gyi las la 'dus te/ bde la yangs pa'i gdan bting / 'grigs la ring ba'i gral bsgrigs/ dkar dmar gyi zas sna g.yos su byas/ ja chang gi ston mo skyem du sbyar/ drang srong mgron 'gyed pa lta bu'i lha mchod mi mchod yul dus dang 'tshams par spel zhing /srid zhi'i dge legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dkon mchog gsum dang / dkon mchog mchod pa'i sbyin bdag bstan pa dar ba'i yul gling dang bcas ba'i lo rgyus la khog bcol te/ chos dang bkra shis kyi gtam snyan la 'brel chags shing skabs su babs pa bgyis nas/ phun tshogs chos ldan gyi bde ba'i dga' ston rgya che la rgyun ring bar 'byung ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa legs lam du 'grigs nas/ lha bde/ klu zhi/lo legs/ 'bru 'phel/ mi phyugs skyid dar 'dzom/ dmag 'khrug dang nad yams med/ rje'i mnga' thang 'phel/ mi sde nang mthun/ yul khams chos la spyod/ thub pa'i bstan pa dar/ bstan 'dzin gyi sku tshe ring / dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel/ phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis rdzogs ldan gyi 'byor ba char bzhin 'bab pa'i rten 'brel smon lam zhu//blo chung sbyang ba dman la gtam sgo dog /gzhon dus mi khyur ma song gab nas bsdad/ /rgas dus yod tshad zos nas nyal zhing gnyid/ /bdag 'dras lugs gnyis gtam gzhung ji ltar 'chad/ /'on kyang ban bun 475

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnam rtog spra ba'i me/ /bskul tshig sbud pas bus nas cher mched de/ /sna tshogs dbyibs su gyur ba'i me lce 'dis/ /phyogs kun bkra shis snang bas 'gengs gyur cig /ces pa'ang rkos mkhan rgya mtsho nas lo gsar dga' ston sogs dang 'brel ba'i gtam lab snyan ngag gi brdas ma bsgribs pa'i shin tu kha gsal ba zhig phris zhes bskul ba'i ngo ma bzlog bar rdo ba bstan nyis smras rim bzhin blo gsal chos kyi grags pas yi ger bris pa dge bar gyur cig /lo gsar dang ma 'brel na rtags(zla khyim)bar blangs pas chog bla ma'i lung 'don pa'i tshul du mi bya bar/ skad cha dkyus ma lab lab byas nas dal la tshig 'bru gsal bar bshad/ sngon nas byang cha thon par byas te sgra log mi zer zhing /snga phyi'i gcod mtshams mi nor bar bya'o// 476

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7༄/ /dpal ldan bla ma la mos shing dang ba'i blo gros las byung ba'i rdol thabs kyi ca cos bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa tsan+dan nags rlung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal ldan bla ma la mos shing dang ba'i blo gros las byung ba'i rdol thabs kyi ca cos bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa tsan+dan nags rlung /gtsang 'jam mtshan dpe'i sku dang tshang dbyangs gsung / /zab yangs mkhyen brtse'i thugs la dbang 'byor zhing / /thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i rol ba mang po yis//'brel tshad thar bder 'khrid la gsol ba 'debs/1/pad+ma ltar rgyas ye shes rang 'od gsal//mdo sngags chos kyi snang bas sa gsam 'gengs/ /lus can spyi dang lhag par snyigs ma'i 'gro'i/ /gling ༄dang skyob par gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ 2 /'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings las sprul pa'i sprin/ /gdul ('dir ldeb gcig chad) thon pa'i 'gro 'di ma bzung bar/ /gting med gnas su bying na mi rung zhes/ /thug sa rje'i dbang gis bsam bzhin skye ba bzung / 12 /chen po'i las kyi gdos su bcug pa dang //kun gyis brnyas pa'i rigs ngan rgyud dag tu//sprin rum zla ltar snang ba 'gyed dka' bas/ /dbus ma'i rigs su 477

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ 13 /zla tshes gzhon nu lta bu'i na tshod nas/ /yi ge 'bri klog skar nag rtsis rig dang / /gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kun sbyangs pas/ /mkhas pa'i phul du son la gsol ba 'debs/14/byis pa'i 'khor nang rtsed mo'i 'chad nyan dang / /rgan rabs gzigs tshe rig pa ci shes rmed/ /rol rtsed zhar du'ang chos la bsnyen bkur mdzad/ /gzhon nu'i spyod mchog bstan la gsol ba 'debs/15brda sprod ka swa gnyis dang tsan+d+ra ba/ /go don ri mor bcas pa la byang ste//ngag tshig brjod pa gtsang ba'i mchog tu gyur/ /smra mkhas pa ṇi gnyis par gsol ba 'debs/ 16 /snyan ngag lho shar lam gnyis so so dang / /thun mong sgra don rgyan rnams byang bar mkhyen/ /mṛt+ta dzā ti ngo mtshar rtogs byed bcas/ /sdeb sbyor rgya mtsho brgal la gsol ba 'debs/ 17/dpal ldan 'chi med seng ge'i mngon brjod gzhung / /rdzogs par thugs chud sdeb legs rnar snyan pa'i/ /tshig sbyor phreng bas mkhas pa'i tshogs dbus su/ /kun dga'i dus ston spel la gsol ba 'debs/ 18/sku gzugs mchod rten dkyil 'khor bris 'bur kyi/ /thig tshad mi 'dra'i khyad par mang mkhyen cing / /grags dang ma grags bzo gnas gzhan gyi yang / /rnam grangs dpag yas gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/19 /sa skya ngor dang na len dra sogs su/ /rig gnas mkhas pa'i dam pa mang btud cing / /gang du bzhugs kyang sna tshogs rig pa mkhan/ /du 478

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7ma'i zhabs pad bsten la gsol ba 'debs/ 20 /che la ma rngam chung la ma brnyas par/ /dam pa'i bshes gnyen gar bzhugs yul kun du/ /khengs dang zhum med rlung ltar rgyu mdzad de/ /dam chos 'ba' zhig btsal la gsol ba 'debs/ 21 /gzugs bzang kun spyod gtsang la 'grogs na bde/ /gtong phod che ldan chos phyir dka' spyad bzod/ /bla ma la gus gcig tu g.yo med pas/ /yongs 'dzin mtha' dag mnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ 22 /rgyal dang de sras brgyud pa rin chen gyi/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang ma chad pa'i/ /gdams ngag sna re'i phyir yang 'bad pa brgyas/ /bla ma mnyes par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/23 /chos kun lan re gsan pas thugs chud kyang / /chog par 'dzin min zhib mor dpyod pa dang / /kun tu 'dri bas mkhas par byang gyur cing / /the tshom zug rngu phyungs la gsol ba 'debs/ 24/lhag par zab dang rgya che'i theg mchog lam/ /mtha' dag rnam grangs du mas yang dang yang / /rgya cher gtan 'bebs gdams pa'i mdzod gcig pu/ /shes phyin gzhung mang gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ 25 /de tshe mkhyen pa rnam gsum sbyor ba bzhis/ /nyams su blangs pas chos sku phrin las bcas/ /'thob tshul rgyal yum mdzod kyi gces nor kun/ /nyid kyi longs spyod gyar la gsol ba 'debs/ 26 /yum gsum lam gyi cha kun lus gcig niri mi /rdo/gi snye//spyo //sde bye/rngo tu/ /bsdegs nas yongs gas bstan pa ༄ gnad kun la/ /ba blag 479

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nges ster dpal ldan a ti sha'i/ /gdams ngag bdag por gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ 27 /sa rgyan bslab spyod gnyis sogs 'phags yul pa'i/ /lam rim gzhung la blo gros cher rgyas shing / /paṇa grub mang pos dngos nyams mnal lam du/ /zhal bstan gdams pa gtad la gsol ba 'debs/ 28 /bka' rnying jo zhal sa dge las 'ong ba'i lam rim blo sbyong khrid tshul mtha' yas pa/ /gsan cing thugs nyams bzhes pas byang chub kyi/ /sa mkhan zla med gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ 29 /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i gzhung mang gru bo che/ /rigs lam dar chen bsgrengs pas nyer drangs te/ /bdag med chos kyi rgya mtshor dkri mkhas pa/ /thar 'dod ded dpon che la gsol ba 'debs/ 30 /'phags rnams bslab pa'i nang mdzod 'dul ba dang / /rgya chen shes bya'i gnas ston mngon pa'i gzhung / /kun gyi legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bcud gsol bas/ /blo gros lus stobs rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ 31 /sde bdun rig pa'i gnad gsang legs gzigs pas/ /mngon sum rjes dpag sgrub dang sun 'byin bcas/ /yang dag ltar snang khyad par zhib mo kun/ /rnam 'byed blo mchog grub la gsol ba 'debs/ 32 /rgol bas mi 'phrog rig tshul rtsa ba brtan/ /thub bstan de nyid rtogs pa'i sdong po brlings// rnam mang bshad pa'i yal 'dab phyug la snum/ /kun dga'i grib bsil stug la gsol ba 'debs/ 33 /mnyam rjes kun tu yum don snying po yi//480

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7rnal 'byor bar med chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'jug /kun spyod yongs dag tshul khrims spos ngad ldang / /dri med gser sbyang 'dra la gsol ba 'debs/ 34/gsan pas zab rgyas gnas kun thugs su chud/ /tshul ba zhin bsgrub pas nyams myong klong chen rdol/ /gsan bsam sgom pa'i shes rab gcig gis gcig /thug mtha' med par rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ 35 /rmongs pas bsnyen yang gdams ngag rnyed par sla/ /mkhas pas brtags kyang dgongs pa gting dpag dka'/ /ring nas gsal la btud kyang ches zab pa/ /ma 'dres chos kyis 'phags la gsol ba 'debs/ 36 /ston pa'i legs gsung bod 'a dir 'gyur ro 'tshal/ /lung nod rgya cher gzigs shing yang dang yang / /bsnyen bkur mdzad pas chos las 'od shar te/ /'jig rten snang bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ 37 /dpung dang rigs gzugs nor la ma gzigs te/ /chos 'dzin skyes bu 'ba' zhig bsngags mdzad cing / /yid bzhin nor dang rang gi sras bzhin du/ /gces spras chen po mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ 38 /nyes brgya'i zhugs kyis gdung ba'i lus can la/ /nyin bzhin thugs rje chen po'i sprin bsdus te/ /zab brtan snyan par sgrog pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /chos char 'dod dgu 'bebs la gsol ba 'debs/ 39 /lan 'gar mi gsung btang snyom ltar bzhugs kyang / /gar bzhugs gnas rnams chos spyod rnam pa bcus/ /rin chen chos kyi 481

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshong rdal cher snang ba/ /sa steng bstan pa'i dpal la gsol ba 'deb sa/40 /rdo rje'i blo mchog mtshungs pa med pa'i mthus/ /rgyal kun gsang ba zab mo'i mdzod bzung ste/ /'gro la dngos grub dga' ston 'gyed mkhas pa/ /gsang bdag dpa' bo gnyis par gsol ba 'debs/ 41 /sngon rabs sku che'i phreng ba dpag med nas//paṇa grub rig 'dzin yongs kyi rjer gyur kyang / /rjes 'jug yid ches skyed pa'i don slad du/ /smin grol rgyun mang bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ 42 /rgyus shes tshong bas rin chen len tshal du/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon brtags shing ༄btsal/ /rnyed nas bsten tshul sngags kyi 'dul ba bzhin/ /mi 'da'i yal gam bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/43 /sangs rgyas byang sems rig pa'i lha mo sogs/ /zhi dang khro bo'i rnam 'gyur re re zhing / /gong 'og rgyud sde'i dbang bskur tha dad pa'i/ /chu rgyun grangs med brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ 44 /dbang bka' gcig kyang gtsang ma'i brgyud srol ni/ /mang por gyes rnams slob dpon gzhan dang gzhan/ /bsnyen nas chog shes med par legs mnos pas/ /byin rlabs klong chen brug la gsol ba 'debs/ 45 /dbang dus khas blangs dam tshig sdom pa'i gnas/ /srung thabs phyir bcos dang bcas ches zhib par/ /mkhyen cing 'bad pa kun gyis rtse gcig tu/ /nan tan snying por mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/46/rig gsum thun mong so so 'jig rten pa'i/ /rtog pa dang 482

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7bcas rnam snang mngon byang dang / /phyag rdor dbang bskur la sogs bya spyod kyi/ /rgyud sde'i gnas mang gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ 47 /bya ba'i rgyud du bzlas brjod yan lag bzhi/ /bsam gtan rnam gsum bya ba'i grogs bcas dang / /spyod rgyud mtshan bcas mtshan med bsnyen pa'i lam/ /kun gsal ye shes sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ 48 /rnal 'byor rgyud rgyal de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud/ /bshad rgyud rtse mo cha mthun dpal mchog bcas/ /paṇa grub gsum gyis bkral ba'i rnam bshad kyi/ /bdud rtsis blo mig dag la gsol ba 'debs/ 49 /dang po sbyor ba la sogs ting 'dzin gsum/ /tha dad gdul bya la ltos dum bu bzhi'i/ /lam du phye ba'i bsnyen pa'i lam rim la/ /ches mkhas gsang sngags sdong por gsol ba 'debs/50 /gang yang bsnyen pa rdzogs nas rig 'dzin sogs/ /dngos grub khyad par can gyi them skas las/ /byang chen 'chi med grong khyer nyer bgrod pa'i/ /ngo mtshar dga' ston gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/51/rgyud sde gsam gyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la/ /rang ༄rang gzhung bzhin bsnyen pa mthar son te/ /las dang dngos grub rab 'byams phyag mthil kyi/ /rdzas bzhin rang dbang gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ 52 /sngags rgyud kun las rgyal mtshan tog lta bur/ /ches 'phags gsang ba bla med rgyud sde'i dbyig /rtsod med lo tsā che dgu'i khyad nor gyis//thugs kyi bang mdzod gtams la gsol ba 'debs/53/483

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpal ldan 'dus pa 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /dgyes pa rdo rje gdan bzhi mā yā dang / /thod pa la sogs rgyud sde'i mdzod mang po'i/ /lde mis gcig pur bzhugs la gsol ba 'debs/ 54 /rgyud sde gcig la'ang 'phags bod paṇa grub kyi/ /bshad srol mi 'dra'i tshul dang man ngag si //gnad gsang rgya mtsho'i chu ltar dpag dka' ba/ /gzigs shing dgyes/ pa 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ 55 /blta dgod lag bcing bde ba lam byed kyis/ /mtshon min lhan skyes bde ba'i rnal 'byor dang / /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zab gsal gnyis med lam/ /rgyud don snying por dgongs la gsol ba 'debs/ 56 /bsgrims kyang bltar med dpyad kyang rnyed min pa'i/ /lhan skyes 'od gsal ji bzhin mthong ba'i mig /kun rtos/ dhu tir sdom pa'i man ngag gi/ /rnam grangs rgya mtshos phyug la gsol ba 'debs/ 57 /rgyud sde so sos rtsa rlung gtum mo dang / /bsre 'pho grong 'jug pho nya'i rnal 'byor sogs/ /gang gang lhag par rtsal 'don de dang de'i/ /khyad chos ma 'dres gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ 58/dang po'i sangs rgyas dri ma med 'od bcas/ /sbyangs pas stong gzugs sku dang 'gyur med bde/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i lam gyi 'phrul gsang la/ /mkhyen bzang nyin byed 'bar la gsol ba 'debs/ 59 /ches phra rdzogs rim lam gyi cha rnams dang / /mthun par rags pa'i rnal 'byor sngar bsgom pas/ /lam mchog tshegs med bgrod pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /sku 484

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7gsum lag rtser sbyin la gsol ba 'debs/ 60 /bskyed rim nyid la'ang rags phra'i rim pa yis/ /slob pa'i tshul dang bskyed chog tha dad dang / /rgyas bsdus mi 'dra'i khyad par bsam yas par/ /dpang gyur sngags shes gtso bor gsol ba 'debs/ 61 /rgyud don zab lam snying po'i bcud bsdus pa/ /lam 'bras chos drug lugs gnyis phyag rgya che/ /sdug bsngal zhi byed la sogs sgrub brgyud kyi/ /shing rta'i srol mang 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ 62 /dbang bskur phyir dang rab 'byams las kyi phyir/ /dkyil 'khor mang po'i bsnyen pa yongs rdzogs shing / /'od gsal bsam mi khyab kyi ting 'dzin mthus/ /skal bzang smin grol mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ 63 /rlung sems mi shigs thig le'i dbyings sa ༄bsdams/ /pho nya gsum gyi longs spyod dbang du gyur/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos kun dpyid kyi bde bar 'bar/ /brtul zhugs gdeng chen thob la gsol ba 'debs/6sda.in+d+ra bhu ti dpal ldan sa ra ha/ /lū hi pa dang ye she sa zhabs la sogs/ /gru ba mchog mang pos mngon sum byin brlabs shing / /rgyal tshab skyes bur bsngags la gsol ba 'debs/ 65/bstan pa kun la mkhas kyang gdul bya'i ngor/ /rang rang mos pa ji bzhin phyogs re ston/ /su la ji ltar gdams pas phan btags kyang / /ma mngon sbas tshul spyod la gsol ba 'debs/ 66 /de nyid bcu shes rgyud sde'i las tshogs dang / /thun mong grub chen sgrub pa'i cho ga'i sgo/ /pha 485

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mtha' yas pas lus can re ba kun/ /yid bzhin skong bar nus la gsol ba 'debs/67/khyad par rgyal bas lung bstan lha btsan po//khri srong lde'u btsan bsod nams tshong zong gis/ /nyos pa'i gsang rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i mdzod/ /kun gyi mnga' bdag gcig pur gsol ba 'debs/ 68 /khyu mchog khyu yi thog mar 'gro ba bzhin/ /phyogs 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i gsung rab kyi/ /dang por dbu brnyes rgyud sde'i ma lta bu/ /gsang sngags rnying mar mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs/ 69 /'phags yul gsang sngags bstan pa rdzogs ldan dus/ /'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags 'chang rgyal gtsos/ /skal ldan mchog gi 'khor la pham phab tu/ /phogs pa'i khyad chos gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ 70 /yo ga gsum gyi srog 'dzin rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /bka' babs chu bo rnam bzhi yongs tshang ba'i/ /phrin las rgyun ring snying po'i rgyud chen gyi/ /bshad rgyun ngoms par bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ 71 /de tshe gzhi rgyud gnyug ma'i rdo rje sems/ /thabs grol lam rgyud zab mos nyer bskul bas/ /sgrib bral 'bras bu'i rgyud du yongs sad pa'i/ /gsang don chu gter brgal la gsol ba 'debs/72/gsang ba'i theg pa lam mchog rnam bkod dang / /lta ba'i phreng ba la sogs rig 'dzin gyi/ /man ngag rgun chang btung bas cher myos te/ /mkhyen rtog sa gzi brjid 'bar la gsol ba 'debs/ 73 /shangs mdor dpal chen dgyes pa'i sgra 486

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7dbyangs kyis/ /dbang rgyud man ngag bum ba gang byo ru/ /bstsal nas sgyu 'phrul snying po'i srog 'dzin du/ /thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 74/de mthus mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog dang / /rjes su rnal 'byor kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/ /rtsa bshad kun gyi gnad la'ang mi 'jigs pa'i/ /rgyud 'chad rtse mor son la gsol ba 'debs/75 /ye shes gcig las lha sngags rnam 'gyur dang / /dgongs pa'i sgrub lugs tha dad la brten nas//sgrub sde brgyad du phye ba'i bka' babs kyi/ /khyu mchog 'gran zla spangs la gsol ba 'debs/ 76 /bdud rtsi bam brgyad khrag 'thung gal po dang / /phur ba rtsa bshad la sogs he ru ka'i/ /bka' gter rgyud sde'i sprin las legs bshad kyi/ /dbyar rnga dal bur dgod la gsol ba 'debs/ 77 /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen rnam gsum gcig las gcig /snying por yongs bsdus bka' brgyad rnam pa gsum//'chad tshe sngon byon rje 'bangs rig 'dzin rnams/ /gcig tu byas 'drar snang la gsol ba 'debs/ 78 /gzhan yang rdzong 'phrang bla ma bka' brgyad sogs/ /bka' brgyad lugs srol mang bo gzigs tsam gyis/ /khri srong sku tsher sbyang ba sngon song mthas/ /rang nor rgyus bzhin ༄mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs/ 79 /dkyil 'khor bdag pos grub pa'i rgyal thabs byin/ /snang srid dag pa'i yo lang gcig tu shar/ /dngos grub las rnams dgongs pa tsam gyis 'grub/ /mthu chen dpa' bo 487

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ 80 /rab 'bar bde chen me yis chos kyi dbyings/ /snang ba gcig gyur gdod ma'i he ru kar/ /bzhengs pas shes bya'i 'khor lo mtha' dag gis/ /srog snying dus gcig phul la gsol ba 'debs/81/snod bcud rnam dag bdud rtsi'i ting 'dzin dang / /myong grol sbyin pas grangs med 'gro ba'i rgyud/ /khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i gdung du byin rlabs pa'i/ /gdul thabs bsam mi khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ 82 /srung zlog gsad dang sgrib sbyong khrus chog dang / /rdo rje'i tshe sgrub rten gsum lhag gnas sogs/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phrin las sgo mang gis/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad la gsol ba 'debs /83 /sku tshe'i phreng bar gdul bya dpag med la/ /dbang bskur phyag gis sku bzhi'i sa bon btab/ /kun kyang ring por mi thogs byang chab che'i/ /༄snye phung g.yur du 'khrigs la gsol ba 'debs/ 84/rtsol bcas theg pa las 'das sangs rgyas sar/ /mig 'phrul bzhin du 'gro ba'i zab khyad can/ /myur lam rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag la/ /dbang 'byor grub pa'i tshogs rjer gsol ba 'debs/85/mkhyen rab sku can 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ /sde gsum klong dgu'i bstan pa'i rgyal thabs la/ /gtad rgyas dbang bskur nyid kyi gsang gsum dang / /mi phyed rdo rjer bsgrubs la gsol ba 'debs/ 86 /spang gnyen zhen pa'i mtha' las grol ba'i gnad/ /chos kun ye shes rol ba dbyings kyi rgyan/ /so 488

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7sor rtsal 'don sems klong sde gnyis kyi/ /rdo rje'i gnas kun gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ 87 /rnam mang gdams pa'i ba mo bzhos pa'i bcud/ /zab las ches zab nying khur yang dang yang / /dril ba'i mthar thug man ngag snying thig gi /bdud rtsi'i yang zhun brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ 88 /bī ma mkha' 'gro'i snying thig ma bu dang / /dgongs pa zang thal mdzod chen bdun la sogs/ /snying thig rgyas bsdus gzhung dang rnam bshad tshogs/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan bzung la gsol ba 'debs/89 /pad 'byung bī ma'i thugs bcud rgyal ba'i gdung / /khri srong blo mtshor tog gi blo gros su/ /nyer babs klong chen snying thig bstan pa'i srog /bshad sgrub bdud rtsis mthud la gsol ba 'debs/ 90 /de tshe gnyis med gnyis pa ltar snang ba'i/ /dri med 'od zer rgyal ba'i dbang pos kyang / /dgyes zhal dngos bstan bu zhes dbugs phyungs nas/ /dgongs brgyud cod pan bcings la gsol ba 'debs/ 91 /yul sems med snang stong pa'i rang gzugs la/ /rgyan dang rol bar sgom pa ngal ba'i rgyu/ /nyag gcig rig pa rgya yan cog bzhag ngang / /spros pa'i zug rngu phyungs la gsol ba 'debs/ 92 /'khrul pa'i gzeb dral shes pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhig /shes rab klong rdol snang sems khyab brdal 'dres/ /srid dang zhi ba ro mnyam gcig tu brdal/ /spang rtogs rtsal chen rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ 93 /thogs med mkha' la nyi ma rgyu ba 489

pod/ 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin/ /chos zad dbyings su rig pa rnam grol te/ /rtsol bcas lam gyi 'ching ba gnyid sad kyi/ /rmi lam lta bur dag la gsol ba 'debs/9sdadagongs pa gdod ma'i mgon por byang chub kyang / /mdzad pa tha mal gdul bya'i ngor bstun nas/ /brda sprod slob dpon byis pa klog 'jug bzhin/ /dpag dka'i rnam 'phrul mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ 95 /chu zad nya bzhin lnga bdo'i tshad pa yis/ /gzir ba'i 'gro mang rdzas chos drag sngags chus/ /bsil mdzad gter ston rgya mtsho'i gdengs can dbus/ /ma dros klu dbang 'dra la gsol ba 'debs/ 96/bod 'bangs pad+ma'i zab gter la spyod pa/ /gang mchis khri srong rje yi smon lam mthu/ /bgrang yas skyes pa rabs kyi phreng bas kyang / /gter brgyud lhag par spel la gsol ba 'debs/ 97 /kun mkhyen nga las nu khyod 'dir byung tshe/ /rin chen 'dzin ma 'di yang nu bam las/ /chos nor dam rdzas 'o ༄ma'i rgyun 'bab cing //khyod drung ma bzhin bsnun la gsol ba 'debs/98 /ring nas pad 'byung rgyal bas rgyal tshab cher/ /mnga' gsol snyan brgyud gtad rgya rdzogs pa'i dbang / /dpe brgyud rgas med bzhugs pa'i sa 'dis byas/ /rtsod med sprul skur grags la gsol ba 'debs/99 /gtad rgyas 'od gsal dbyings sgrom chos kyis gtams/ /rgyal rnams chos kyi pham phab nyin bzhin 465/ /mkha' 'gros gsang mdzod sgo rnams rtag tu phye/ /bsam yas chos kyi mdzod la gsol ba 'debs/490

gtam tshogs/ pod/ 7100 /ming can ming med gter chen gter phran dang / /rang gter yang gter byang dang 'a byung 'gyar kun/ /ye shes me long ngos la pra phab shāri 0gar chag zibyu ra༅0ga li charabazhan/ /sgrab mad mngan sum gzags la gsa'/ ba 'dabs/ 101 /dngos kyis sbas mngon tshul du bton pa dang / /pho nya bkyes dang skyes bzhin 'ong ba sogs/ /brtul zhugs rdzu 'phrul sgo mo sna tshogs kyis/ /gter yig dbang du bsdus la gsol ba 'debs/ 1002 /ya mtshan sgyu ma'i sgra ldan brda'i('phrulayig red)rol mtshor/ /rig rtsal 'jig rten mes po rjes chags pas/ /tshig don lang tsho rab rdzogs zab gter gyi/ /dbyangs can mgron du khug la gsol ba 'debs/ 103 /dus gsum gter ston yongs kyi chos mdzod kun/ /khyod kyi ngo mtshar bka' babs rnam bdun las/ /gsum pa yang gter nor bu'i sgrom kho nar/ /ma tshang med par rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ 104 /de slad bla rdzogs thugs gsum sgrub sde('di man gyi ma phyi re zhig ma rnyed)491

pod 7bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/de yang mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las/ rma rol dang /smar rol/ rdo rol/ zla rol sogs su gtso bor chags pa'i lcags mo mgo log pa 'di dag yongs grags ltar na phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mjug ste bod rab byung bdun pa tshugs ma thag tsam la khams 'gu kho lung nas gnas spo byas te/ da lta'i mgo log pad+ma rdzong gi sa cha gtso bor gyar ba'i rdo 'dzi smar gsam gyi niring rig miyul gru bdag gir byas nas ring du ma song ba na/ mgo log phag thar gyi sras su kaḥthog bla ma byang chub seng ge'i thugs zin gyi slob bu mkhas shing grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po mgo log bla ma chos 'bum bya ba 'khrungs pas dbu bzung / rim bzhin kar rnying bstan pa'i sgron me karma yongs 'dzin chen po dang / zhwa nag sku phreng bcu ba mchog sprul chos dbyings rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa chen po ye shes rdo rje/ zhwa dmar bdun pa ye shes snying po/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i yang sprul de ma thag pa mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/ zhe chen rab 'byams lnga ba kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs gangs 1

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/can bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen por gyur ba dag dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po gtsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa gsung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched/ rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dge bshes chen mo/ gsang chen bka' babs shar wod grags pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng / rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa/ rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo rje/ theg mchog smra ba'i bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sogs mkhas dbang nor bu'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa dang /dgon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dgos/ khyim pa sbra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dge 2

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 7thon cing / dpe gtam sgrung rgyud 'chad la mnga' brnyes pa/ dkar nag rtsis kyi 'phrul la thogs pa med cing / gso byed sman gyi lugs la dbang 'byor ba/ ri mo dang yi ge'i bzo rtsal la mdzes byang gi cha khyad du thon pa sogs mang du byung 'dug par brten de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rig gnas kyi shul bzhag tu gyur ba par ma dang bris ma'i glegs bam du byas pa'ang da lta'i bar mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs yod pa la/ spyir grub mtha'i dbang du byas na yul 'dir snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge ldan pa/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba sogs bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' che rigs phal cher zhig mnyam gnas su bzhugs shing / sa bab kyi dbang du byas tshe'ang mdo khams lho byang 'brel mtshams su chags yod pa sogs kyi dbang gis yul 'di'i rig gnas spyi dang dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas tshun chad la mdo khams rig gnas ma lag gnyis ka 'dres pa las byung ba'i khyad chos than mong ma yin pa zhig yod par brten/ myar skyob dang zhib riring dmi mi'ajug dpyad gzhi'i rin thang 'gangs che ba zhig yod par gdon mi za/de'i phyir spyir bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bya bzhag la rang ngos kyi nus shugs 'bul ba dang / sgos thun min 3

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang khyad thon pa'i sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar spel byed pa'i kun slong gis bskul te/ nged las khungs nas 'tshol bsdu sgrig gsam gyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi ༄nyung ba zhig lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ 〈mgo log sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉zhes pa zhig bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhig par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dag gi gdeng 'jog legs po dang 'brel yod sde khag gi gzengs bstod thob/ rting skul de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rig gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhig bzos nas khul srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag star byed pa'i skal ba legs po thob/de la 'dir〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor gsal bshad du 'os pa 'ga' zhig zhu ba 'di lta ste/1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la mgo log khul u dang / khul 4

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 7dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsugs thog 'brel yod don bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yig thog nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam gsang ba sngags dang 'brel ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' dog dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bstun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'og gsung 'bum gcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos gang rgyas shos kyi rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du 5

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ bzhugs pa'i thor bu dag kyang lag tu ci 'ong gis gsab snon byas yod pas/ so so'i gsung 'bum gang la mtshon na'ang mig snga ltar na da lta'i〈dpe tshogs〉'dir 'khod pa kho na kha tshang shos dang rgyas shos su brtsi chog snyam/3 gsung chos go rim sgrig stangs skor la sngon gyi ma phyi gang legs shos su snang ba de'i sgrig stangs gzhir bzhag gi rmang gzhi'i steng gcig 'gyur dang dgos dbang sogs la gzhigs te rtsom sgrig pa nas las babs kyi 'gan dbang spyad de 'os 'tsham gyi skyar sgrig dang slar sdeb kyang byas yod/4 ma phyi phal cher la dpe chod yang yang bgyis la tshad ldan gyi par gzhi med pa sogs kyi dbang gis yi ge mi dag cing / chad lhag shor ba/ go rim 'chol ba/ ma yig mi gsal ba sogs cung mang ba la rang blos lcigs pa 'khrul med du snyam pa dag legs par bcos shing dag par bsgrigs la/ dogs gzhir mthong ba du ma zhig gzigs pa yangs shing de phyogs su nang rgyus che ba'i mkhas pa du mar drung bcar bka' 'dri yang yang byas te dogs pa chod pa dag de bzhin du bcos/ re zhig khungs lung mi gsal zhing dpog par dka' ba re zung 'dug pa phyis kyi dpyad gzhir zin bris su bgyis thog 'ol tshod kyis ma bcos shing dpyad yams la ma 6

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 7//bye/ /rdo/( //bye/ //bye/ /bye/shā'ajus par ma sor 'a ga byas nga / 'ga' ga la yin shas bar 'dod pa'i yi ge de zur gyi zla khyim du bkod yod/5 klog bde bar gzhigs te gsung chos bye brag pa phal mo cher mdzad byang sogs las dras te kha byang bkod cing / sa bcad blangs la/ ldeb byang yang bye brag tu bkod yod/6 ba zur 'dogs min lta bu sogs yi ge skor zhig gi bkol stangs da lta'i dag yig 'ga' zhig dang gcig tu mthun min yod kyang mkhas pa tshad ldan gyi phyag rgyun la thar chags su yod phyin khungs lung re yod srid la phyis su dag yig zhib dpyod pa dag gi dpyad gzhir nye bar mkho yang srid snyam nas ji bzhin sor 'jog byas/ gzhan yang ma yig tu skabs 'gar mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung thung ngu tsam re yongs su drangs 'dug pa zhib par dpyad tshe gong 'og gi gsung gang rung re de'i zur rgyan nam gsal 'don ci rigs su song ba sogs 'brel shin tu che bas dgos dbang la gzhigs nas 'dir yang ma yig ltar bkod pa lags/bye brag rdo grub chen rin po che 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum la gsal bshad du zhu dgos pa zhig ni khong la da reb kyi deb bdun po 'dir 'khod pa las gzhan da dung gsung chos mang tsam yod par nges la de ltar du'ang thos mod dus dbang 7

pod 7 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ du gyur bas yid phangs la/ nga tshos rtsad gcod byas pa ltar na'ang khong gis mdzad pa'i rus mdzod deb gcig da dung yod nges su 'dug kyang da reb lag son ma byung la/ dpal ldan bla ma la rdol thabs kyi ca cos bstod pa ces pa'i rtsom de'ang cung zad kha mi tshang bar 'dug pas slad char don gnyer can dag la thugs 'dog do gzigs kyi las su zhu'o/ /mtshams 'dir slebs tshe nga tshos cis kyang dran yul du bslang bar 'os pa ni〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid la thog mtha' gang rung du thags khar rgyab skyor khyad du gnang zhing 'di nyid kyi ched du sku no༅ ra༅tshegs 'o brgyal mdzad pa'i 'brel yod 'go khrid dang mkhas dbang blo mthun gyi tshogs dag yin te/ khong cag rnam pa'i rgyab skyor rogs ram dang bral phyin〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid klog pa po dag gi spyan lam du gzigs mor spro ba'i de ring gi skal ba bzang po 'di nyid nyams par 'gyur bas/ nga tshos khong rnam par lhag bsam dag pas bka' drin zhu ba lags/ lhag par du〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun sogs gang ci'i thad thugs khur dang phyag ston bla lhag gnang zhing / gnad don du ma'i 'gag mdor gyur ba par skrun ma dngul gyi mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i cha nas bka' drin khyad du thon cing mdzad rjes kun las lhag 8

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 7pa ni khul u'i hru'u ci gzhon pa khul gna' rtsom dpe tshogs 'tshol sdud dag sgrig par skrun 'go khrid tshan chung gi tshan gtso sku zhabs pad ma rnam rgyal lags yin pas rang re 'brel yod mi rabs snga phyi kun nas khong gi bka' drin yid la 'chang zhing rjes su dran par 'os zhes 'di gar ched du gsal 'debs zhus pa lags/ de bzhin rdzong gtso smug lo lags nas kyang sa gnas mi rigs rig gnas phyogs dgongs klong yangs la spyod pa mdzangs pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba mdzad pa dge ba'i phyag rjes su che/gzhan yang zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang bod yig rtsom sgrig khang nas nga tshor phyogs gang ci'i thad bla na med pa'i mthun rkyen bskrun cing mi rigs rig gnas la gcig tu brtse ba'i lhag bsam dkar pos phyogs du ma nas dmigs bsal chen po'i mdzad pa bskyangs pas dngos gnas bka' drin che zhu/ lnga rig mkhas pa'i dbang po bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang bde legs rab rgyas dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ju bkra shis bzang po nas kyang〈dpe tshoṭa〉'di la thugs khur sku tshegs kyi mdzad pa bzhes shing / gsung chos sam mdzad pa po so so la 'brel yod kyi dgon sde bla sprul rnam pas rang ngos kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba'ang rang re klog pa po dang bcas pas yid la bsrel bar 'os pa nyid do//9
